Punchline.Original: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
Punchline.Translated: BOCCHI 来让你的 Occult Crescent 体验更顺畅。

Description.Original:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)
Description.Translated:
BOCCHI 来让你的 Occult Crescent 体验更顺畅。
- 不再需要烦人的“走路”或“找宝箱”。那是失败者才做的事。
- 一个可爱的小型 FATE 和 CE 面板，会告诉你它会提供什么奖励，并且帮你自动寻路过去，哇哦。
- 一个额外的非法“illegal mode”，适合那些更愿意去摸草或玩点有值得玩内容的游戏的人。

命令前缀：bocchi（别名：och）
  /bocchi → 打开主窗口
  /bocchi config → 打开配置（别名：cfg、c）
  /bocchi config list → 列出配置键
  /bocchi config get <key> → 打印配置值
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → 设置配置值
  /bocchi buff → 开始/停止 buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → 传送到最近的匹配活动
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → 控制 Illegal Mode（无参数时打开窗口）
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → 标记在地图上登记 CE
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → 在地图上标记一个 FATE
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → 标记一个非 pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → 重新加载翻译文件（别名：rt）
  /och … → 与 /bocchi 相同（旧别名；也是 /occultcrescenthelper）

Description.Original:
Questionable now ships as "WigglyQuest". Its internal name changed so it no longer shares Dalamud's install and config folders with the PunishXIV fork of Questionable; the plugin you see in the installer is still called Questionable.

This final build under the old name does no questing. It opens a short guide, installs WigglyQuest from the same repository with one click, and then points you at the plugin installer to remove itself. WigglyQuest copies your settings and local quest files on its first start.
Description.Translated:
Questionable 现在以“WigglyQuest”形式发布。其内部名称已更改，因此不再与 PunishXIV 分支的 Questionable 共用 Dalamud 的安装和配置文件夹；你在安装器中看到的插件仍叫 Questionable。

这个以旧名称发布的最终版本不执行任何任务。它会打开一份简短指南，一键从同一仓库安装 WigglyQuest，然后指引你前往插件安装器将其自身移除。WigglyQuest 在首次启动时会复制你的设置和本地任务文件。

Description.Original: Turns one action into many! Similar to how PvP actions work, we take an action and build a whole combo out of it. Sometimes it's as simple as a 1-2-3 combo, other times it's a full job rotation. Either way, you'll find something suited for your rotation needs.

Punchline.Original: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time

Description.Original:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!
Description.Translated:
Splatoon 是 Final Fantasy XIV 的可编写脚本的预警与覆盖层引擎，基于 Dalamud 插件框架构建。它允许脚本直接在游戏世界中绘制形状、标记、标签和指示。这些覆盖层可以附着到角色、位置或事件上，并以精确的定位进行渲染。

Splatoon 默认不包含预设或战斗逻辑。如果你想要预设，必须自行创建或从他人处导入。

简而言之，Splatoon 负责绘制。绘制什么由你决定！

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.

Description.Original:
Character Select+ allows you to create, save, and instantly apply fully customized character profiles with the press of a button. Switch between your OCs effortlessly using /select CharacterName, applying Penumbra Collections, Glamourer Designs, Customize+ Profiles, and Honorific Titles in one command.

While profile switching is its core purpose, Character Select+ includes additional features:
✔ Advanced Mode – Create custom macro setups for deeper character customization.
✔ Profile-Specific Designs – Use multiple outfits, styles, and looks per character.
✔ Favorites & Sorting – Keep profiles organized by name, date, or importance.
✔ Quick Swap Bar! 
✔ One-Click Macro Execution – Run predefined commands instantly when selecting a character.

Whether you're roleplaying, gposing, or just love quick customization, Character Select+ makes switching between characters faster, easier, and seamless.
Description.Translated:
Character Select+ 让你只需按下一个按钮，就能创建、保存并即时应用完全自定义的角色配置。使用 /select CharacterName 即可轻松在多个 OC 之间切换，一条指令即可应用 Penumbra Collections、Glamourer Designs、Customize+ Profiles 和 Honorific Titles。

虽然切换配置是其核心用途，Character Select+ 还包含额外功能：
✔ 高级模式 – 创建自定义宏设置，实现更深入的角色自定义。
✔ 配置专属设计 – 为每个角色使用多套装备、风格和外观。
✔ 收藏与排序 – 按名称、日期或重要性整理配置。
✔ 快速切换栏！ 
✔ 一键执行宏 – 选择角色时立即运行预设指令。

无论你是在角色扮演、gpose，还是只是喜欢快速自定义，Character Select+ 都能让角色切换更快、更轻松、更无缝。

Description.Translated: Chroma 是一个简单的无障碍工具，允许对所有 AOE 预兆/指示器进行完全的颜色自定义——甚至更多。

Punchline.Original: Opt-in Crowdsourced packet capturing tool
Punchline.Translated: 选择性加入的众包数据包捕获工具

Description.Original:
Chronofoil is a plugin that allows you to capture in-game packets for analysis later.
It also allows you to upload a censored version of these captures to a central repository for
preservation and analysis. Privacy controls are at the center of Chronofoil, which is why it
requires two levels of user opt-in, has minimum delays on releasing any submitted user info,
and allows users to delete their submitted data at any time.
Description.Translated:
Chronofoil 是一个插件，允许你捕获游戏内数据包以供后续分析。
它还允许你将经过审查的捕获数据上传到中央存储库，以供
保存和分析。隐私控制是 Chronofoil 的核心，因此它
要求用户进行两级选择性加入，对发布任何提交的用户信息有最小延迟，
并允许用户随时删除其提交的数据。

Description.Original: A presence and gear tracker that syncs your in-game job, zone, level and gear changes to the tomestone.gg web site.
Description.Translated: 一个在线状态和装备追踪器，可将你的游戏内职业、区域、等级和装备变化同步到 tomestone.gg 网站。

Punchline.Original: Dungeons while you sleep, eat, or work. (Swimsuit Shtola made easy.)
Punchline.Translated: 在你睡觉、吃饭或工作时打副本。（泳装 Shtola 轻松搞定。）

Open with /fctracker (alias /fct).

Description.Original:
Enhance Steam Game Recording by automatically adding configurable in-game events to the timeline, allowing for easy rewinding and clipping. Rewind to the moment of your death to reassure yourself that you did dodge the AOE before it went off and that the game does hate you personally with greater efficiency than ever!

Non-steam users will have to follow a setup guide located in the configuration's window Status tab to get everything working.
Description.Translated:
通过自动将可配置的游戏内事件添加到时间轴来增强 Steam Game Recording，让你可以轻松倒回和剪辑。倒回到你死亡的那一刻，以比以往更高的效率安慰自己：你确实在 AOE 爆炸前躲开了，而游戏确实就是在针对你！

非 Steam 用户需要按照配置窗口 Status 标签页中的设置指南操作，才能让一切正常工作。

Description.Original:
Start a countdown that sends fun facts to your chat!
"/ffcd" to open the settings.

"/ffcd <length> <interval1> <interval2> ..." to begin the fun fact countdown.

For example, "/ffcd 15 10 5 0" will start a 15 second countdown and share a fun fact to your chosen chat channel (Party by default) at the 10 second, 5 second, and 0 second marks!

***If no intervals are given, your party will enjoy a fun fact for every second of the countdown.
Description.Translated:
启动一个倒计时，将趣闻发送到你的聊天频道！
"/ffcd" 打开设置。

"/ffcd <length> <interval1> <interval2> ..." 开始趣闻倒计时。

例如，"/ffcd 15 10 5 0" 将启动 15 秒倒计时，并在 10 秒、5 秒和 0 秒标记时向你选择的聊天频道（默认为小队）分享一条趣闻！

***如果未提供间隔，你的小队将在倒计时的每一秒享受一条趣闻。

Description.Original: Custom Market Terror fork with Teamcraft list imports.
Description.Translated: 带有 Teamcraft 清单导入的自定义 Market Terror 分支。

Punchline.Original: Adds View Search Info to player right-click menus.
Punchline.Translated: 为玩家右键菜单添加查看搜索信息。

Description.Original: Adds the game's native View Search Info action to right-click menus for visible players, so you can open their Search Info directly without using Player Search first.
Description.Translated: 将游戏原生的查看搜索信息操作添加到可见玩家的右键菜单中，无需先使用玩家搜索即可直接打开其搜索信息。

Punchline.Original: Gold Saucer GATE loop helper for Saucy.
Punchline.Translated: 为 Saucy 提供的金碟 GATE 循环助手。

Description.Original: Registers for selected Gold Saucer GATEs, starts supported events, and returns to the Keeper afterward. Command: /sgl
Description.Translated: 报名选定的金碟 GATE，开始受支持的事件，之后返回 Keeper。命令：/sgl

Punchline.Original: /gamemode creative
Punchline.Translated: /gamemode creative

Description.Original: Build anything, anywhere. Jump puzzles, castles, whatever you can think of.
Description.Translated: 随时随地建造任何东西。跳跃谜题、城堡，你能想到的任何东西。

Punchline.Original: Experience better housing!
Punchline.Translated: 体验更好的房屋！

Description.Original: A housing tweak collection plugin.
Description.Translated: 一个房屋调整合集插件。

Punchline.Original: Because sometimes you just need to know why.
Punchline.Translated: 因为有时候你就是需要知道原因。

Description.Original: Detailed death recap for you and your party members. Track damage events, killing blows, and unused defensive cooldowns for yourself and your party members with a sleek, localized UI.
Description.Translated: 为你和你的队友提供详细的死亡回放。通过简洁的本地化 UI 追踪伤害事件、致命一击以及你和队友未使用的防御技能。

Punchline.Original: The ultimate UI experience.
Punchline.Translated: 终极 UI 体验。

Description.Original: Total FFXIV UI Overhaul - Premium unit frames, party lists, and quest tracking.
Description.Translated: 全面的 FFXIV UI 重制——高级单位框体、小队列表和任务追踪。

Punchline.Original: Turns Group Pose depth of field off when GPose starts.
Punchline.Translated: 在集体动作开始时关闭景深。

Description.Original: Automatically disables the GPose depth-of-field toggle on entry, then restores your previous graphics setting when you leave Group Pose.
Description.Translated: 进入集体动作时自动关闭景深开关，离开集体动作时恢复之前的图形设置。

Punchline.Original: Fight timeline callouts - never miss a mitigation window again.
Punchline.Translated: 战斗时间轴提示——再也不会错过减伤窗口。

Description.Original: Define per-fight timelines with ability callouts that flash on screen at specified times. Auto-detects combat start, supports countdown alerts, and import/export of timeline files. Use /callout to open.
Description.Translated: 为每场战斗定义时间轴，在指定时间于屏幕上闪烁显示技能提示。自动检测战斗开始，支持倒计时警报，以及时间轴文件的导入/导出。使用 /callout 打开。

Punchline.Original: Displays strat images on screen at timed fight triggers.
Punchline.Translated: 在战斗触发时间点于屏幕上显示攻略图片。

Description.Original: Show strategy images during combat triggered by fight timer or boss casts. Supports named strategy variants per fight so you always see the right strat for your group. Use /strat to open.
Description.Translated: 在战斗中根据战斗计时器或 Boss 读条触发显示攻略图片。支持每场战斗命名攻略变体，让你始终为队伍显示正确的攻略。使用 /strat 打开。

Punchline.Original: Pre-pull readiness checker for savage/ultimate raids.
Punchline.Translated: 零式/绝境战开怪前的准备检查器。

Description.Original: Checks your food buff, gear condition, inventory items, and party food status before pulling. Shows a clear green/yellow/red overlay so your static never pulls unprepared.
Description.Translated: 在开怪前检查你的食物增益、装备耐久、背包物品以及队伍食物状态。显示清晰的绿色/黄色/红色悬浮提示，让你的固定队不再毫无准备地开怪。

Punchline.Original: All your currencies, caps, and progression goals in one HUD.
Punchline.Translated: 将所有货币、上限和进度目标整合在一个 HUD 中。

Description.Original: Track Gil, Tomestones, weekly caps, beast tribe reputation, and custom progression goals in a single, always-visible overlay. Use /currboard to toggle the display, /currboard config to open settings.
Description.Translated: 在单个常驻悬浮窗中追踪金币、神典石、每周上限、蛮族声望以及自定义进度目标。使用 /currboard 切换显示，/currboard config 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Some quality of life improvements for materia
Punchline.Translated: 一些关于魔晶石的便利性改进

Description.Original:
Currently you can use it to retrieve all materia from a gear piece and also queue multiple in succession via an added context menu option on items.

Especially helpful for penta melded gear, where you normally have to wait for each individual retrieval to finish.
Description.Translated:
目前你可以用它从一件装备上取出所有魔晶石，也可以通过物品上新增的右键菜单选项连续排队多次取出。

对五孔禁断镶嵌的装备尤其有用，通常你只能等待每次取出单独完成。

Punchline.Original: Update manually installed plugins from trusted download links.
Punchline.Translated: 通过受信任的下载链接更新手动安装的插件。

Description.Original: Select an existing development plugin, copy its trusted download link, and update it with a local backup. Includes an advanced update option. Open with /apm.
Description.Translated: 选择一个现有的开发版插件，复制其受信任的下载链接，并借助本地备份进行更新。包含高级更新选项。使用 /apm 打开。

Punchline.Original: Parser of all databases.
Punchline.Translated: 所有数据库的解析器。

Description.Original: Parser of all databases.
Description.Translated: 所有数据库的解析器。

Punchline.Original: Don't manual.
Punchline.Translated: 别手动。

Description.Original: Don't manual.
Description.Translated: 别手动。

Punchline.Original: Finding stuff is hard.
Punchline.Translated: 找东西很难。

Description.Original: Finding stuff is hard.
Description.Translated: 找东西很难。

Punchline.Original: Information and access to the XA Zod early beta.
Punchline.Translated: 关于 XA Zod 早期 beta 的信息和访问权限。

Description.Original: XA Zod is a private early beta testing environment for XA Slave functionality. Access may be available through Aethertek collaboration, Ko-fi support or donations. Public download provides access information only. Features may remain private for months or indefinitely.
Description.Translated: XA Zod 是用于 XA Slave 功能的私有早期 beta 测试环境。访问权限可能通过 Aethertek 合作、Ko-fi 支持或捐赠获得。公开下载仅提供访问信息。功能可能会保持私有数月或无限期。

Punchline.Original: Blacklist-aware targeting protection and player highlighting for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 的黑名单感知目标保护与玩家高亮。

Description.Original: Prevents targeted actions from firing on blacklisted players, highlights blocked players in the world, and adds a quick blacklist command. Use /blockchecker to configure.
Description.Translated: 阻止对黑名单玩家发动指向性技能，在世界中高亮被屏蔽的玩家，并添加快速黑名单命令。使用 /blockchecker 进行配置。

Punchline.Original: Makes the dungeon release hold-button effectively instant.
Punchline.Translated: 使副本中释放的按住按钮实际上变为瞬时。

Description.Original: Shrinks the revive/release hold duration on the SelectYesno popup while the Revive agent is active.
Description.Translated: 在 Revive agent 激活时，缩短 SelectYesno 弹窗上的复活/释放按住时长。

Punchline.Original: Sync hunt watcher area presence to shared sheet.
Punchline.Translated: 将狩猎监视区域状态同步到共享表格。

Description.Original: Synchronizes active character world/area status to a shared spreadsheet for S-rank hunt observation.
Description.Translated: 将当前角色的服务器/区域状态同步到共享电子表格，用于 S 级狩猎观察。

Punchline.Original: Automated treasure map hunting bot with party coordination.
Punchline.Translated: 具有队伍协调的自动寻宝图狩猎机器人。

Description.Original: LootGoblin automates treasure map hunting by opening maps, reading local map flags, teleporting to the nearest aetheryte, coordinating with party members, and flying to the treasure location. Use /lootgoblin or /lg to open.
Description.Translated: LootGoblin 通过打开地图、读取本地地图标记、传送到最近的以太之光、与队伍成员协调并飞往宝藏位置来自动进行寻宝图狩猎。使用 /lootgoblin 或 /lg 打开。

Punchline.Original: Overlay de performance (DPS/HPS) connecté à IINACT.
Punchline.Translated: 连接到 IINACT 的性能悬浮窗（DPS/HPS）。

Description.Original: Affiche un overlay de performance en temps réel pendant les combats. Se connecte à IINACT via WebSocket pour parser les données. Commande: /kdps
Description.Translated: 在战斗期间实时显示性能悬浮窗。通过 WebSocket 连接到 IINACT 以解析数据。命令：/kdps

Punchline.Original: Désynthétisez rapidement vos équipements non équipés.
Punchline.Translated: 快速分解未装备的装备。

Description.Original: Un plugin permettant de désynthétiser tous les équipements de votre inventaire et arsenal qui ne sont pas enregistrés dans un set d'équipement, en un seul clic.
Description.Translated: 一个插件，可一键分解背包和兵装库中所有未保存在装备套装中的装备。

Punchline.Original: Faites de vos recrues une unité d'élite.
Punchline.Translated: 让你的队员成为精英部队。

Description.Original: Grand Company (GC) Squadron Optimizer. Calculates attributes, success chances, and training recommendations for your barracks.
Description.Translated: Grand Company (GC) Squadron Optimizer。为你的军营计算属性、成功率和训练建议。

Punchline.Original: Summons or dismisses minions based on housing state.
Punchline.Translated: 根据房屋状态召唤或解散宠物。

Description.Original: Automatically summons a minion on housing exteriors and dismisses it inside housing interiors or apartments. Main command: /autominion
Description.Translated: 在房屋外部自动召唤宠物，在房屋内部或公寓中自动解散宠物。主命令：/autominion

Punchline.Original: Real-time mitigation calculator for party buffs and enemy debuffs.
Punchline.Translated: 实时计算队伍增益与敌人减益的减伤效果。

Description.Original: Displays total physical and magical mitigation from active party buffs on you and debuffs on your current target. Use /mit to toggle the overlay.
Description.Translated: 显示你身上生效的队伍增益以及当前目标身上减益所提供的物理与魔法减伤总和。使用 /mit 切换悬浮窗。

Punchline.Original: Build proximity and emote-triggered reactions for nearby players.
Punchline.Translated: 为附近玩家构建基于距离和表情触发的反应。

Description.Original: Create presets of automatic reactions that run when a specific or any nearby player enters range or performs an emote. Choose the response command, timing, cooldown, distance, weather, targeting, and optional nameplate glow; COPYCAT can mirror incoming emotes, and advanced rules can launch local media. Use /hfh or the guided setup wizard to configure.
Description.Translated: 创建自动反应预设，当特定或任意附近玩家进入范围或做出表情时触发。可选择响应命令、时机、冷却、距离、天气、目标以及可选的姓名板发光；COPYCAT 可模仿收到的表情，高级规则可启动本地媒体。使用 /hfh 或引导设置向导进行配置。

Punchline.Original: Multiboxing follow and automation companion for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 多开跟随与自动化助手。

Description.Original: Native Dalamud plugin for managing 2+ characters in various situations. Follow party members, auto-mount, combat integration, and more. Use /frenrider or /fr to open.
Description.Translated: 用于在各种情况下管理 2 个及以上角色的原生 Dalamud 插件。跟随队员、自动坐骑、战斗集成等。使用 /frenrider 或 /fr 打开。

Punchline.Original: Log things so you can press buttons better(also showoff)
Punchline.Translated: 记录各种信息，让你更好地按按钮（也能炫耀）

Description.Original: General Logging Plugin,DPS meter and performance analysis plugin
Description.Translated: 通用日志插件，DPS 统计与表现分析插件

Punchline.Original: Auto-recreate your Party Finder after reco or datacenter switch
Punchline.Translated: 断线重连或切换大区后自动重建你的招募

Description.Original:
Captures your PF configuration and automatically recreates it after a disconnect or datacenter switch.

Commands:
/pfr
Description.Translated:
捕获你的招募配置，并在断线或切换大区后自动重建。

命令：
/pfr

Punchline.Original: Browse FFXIV community events in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内浏览 FFXIV 社区活动。

Description.Original:
Browse FFXIV community events directly in-game. Filter by data center, time, and tags.

Commands:
/venuescope or /vs: open VenueScope
Description.Translated:
直接在游戏内浏览 FFXIV 社区活动。可按大区、时间和标签筛选。

命令：
/venuescope 或 /vs：打开 VenueScope

Punchline.Original: The Great and Mystical Swami Sophie will give you chillingly accurate readings.
Punchline.Translated: 伟大而神秘的 Swami Sophie 将为你带来令人毛骨悚然的精准占卜。

Description.Original: Draw arcane spreads and receive theatrical omen readings from Swami Sophie. Command: /swami
Description.Translated: 抽取神秘牌阵，从 Swami Sophie 处获得充满戏剧性的预兆解读。命令：/swami

Punchline.Original: Encounter management tool for DMs.
Punchline.Translated: 供 DM 使用的遭遇战管理工具。

Description.Original: Send help I've been trapped in a sweatshop dear god please
Description.Translated: 救命，我被困在血汗工厂了，天哪求求了

Punchline.Original: A visual weekly work schedule planner for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 的每周工作日程可视化规划工具。

Description.Original: /burnout - opens the weekly schedule planner
Description.Translated: /burnout - 打开每周日程规划器

Punchline.Original: I Kardia on my Phlegma till I Kerachole
Punchline.Translated: 我给 Phlegma 挂 Kardia，直到我 Kerachole

Description.Original: Meant to import/create mit plans and showcase the cooldowns in real time
Description.Translated: 用于导入/创建减伤轴并实时展示冷却时间

Punchline.Original: Make Final Fantasy feel more alive.
Punchline.Translated: 让 Final Fantasy 更有生机。

Description.Original: Spawns npcs as a persistent client-side NPC companion. Interact with them to hear location-based dialogue using the native Talk window.
Description.Translated: 生成 NPC 作为持久的客户端侧 NPC 同伴。与它们互动，通过原生 Talk 窗口聆听基于地点的对话。

Description.Original:
A plugin for giving hints for your Archipelago games.

Hint tokens obtained from:
- Fates
- Gold Saucer
- PvP
- The Hunt
- Crafting Collectables
- Gathering Collectables
- Ishgard Restoration
- Allied Society Quests
- Faux Hallows
- Island Sanctuary
- Cosmic Exploration
- Eureka
- Bozja
- Occult Cresent
- Endwalker & Dawntrail Extreme Trials
- Endwalker & Dawntrail Savage Raids
- Dawntrail Alliance Raids
- Dawntrail Chaotic Raids
- Ultimate Raids
Description.Translated:
一个为你的 Archipelago 游戏提供提示的插件。

提示代币获取途径：
- Fates
- Gold Saucer
- PvP
- The Hunt
- 制作收藏品
- 采集收藏品
- Ishgard 复兴
- 友好部族任务
- Faux Hallows
- Island Sanctuary
- Cosmic Exploration
- Eureka
- Bozja
- Occult Cresent
- Endwalker & Dawntrail 极神战
- Endwalker & Dawntrail 零式
- Dawntrail 团本
- Dawntrail 混沌 Raids
- 绝境战

Punchline.Original: A modern DPS meter overlay for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: 适用于 FFXIV 的现代 DPS 计量器悬浮窗

Description.Original: SkyeMeter connects to IINACT to display real-time DPS, HPS, and encounter statistics with a customizable ImGui interface. Features include pet damage merging, dual DPS/HPS tables, history tracking, and extensive visual customization. Additionally, we calculate the actual healing done, instead of merging healing and overhealing, for a REAL display of the healing done by each Combatant.
Description.Translated: SkyeMeter 连接到 IINACT，通过可自定义的 ImGui 界面显示实时 DPS、HPS 和战斗统计。功能包括宠物伤害合并、DPS/HPS 双表、历史记录追踪以及丰富的视觉自定义。此外，我们计算实际治疗量，而不是将治疗与过量治疗合并，从而真实显示每个战斗人员造成的治疗量。

Punchline.Original: Radial Menu 'uff Said
Punchline.Translated: Radial Menu，无需多言

Description.Original: A radial menu implemented with ImComponents
Description.Translated: 使用 ImComponents 实现的径向菜单

Punchline.Original: Stand-alone healing/JOAT/powerleveling and authenticated Helper/Newb pairing.
Punchline.Translated: 独立治疗/JOAT/带级以及经过认证的 Helper/Newb 配对。

Description.Original: HealBot has four operating roles: Off, Stand-alone, Helper, and Newb. Stand-alone runs HealBot, healer-first JOAT, or BRD/MCH PowerlevelBot without networking. Helper listens for one authenticated Newb and activates JOAT for remote healing and chase; Newb connects asynchronously and performs no local healing or attacking. Pairing traffic is authenticated but not encrypted, so names and coordinates remain visible on the network. Use /healbot, /hb, or /copellia to open.
Description.Translated: HealBot 有四种运行角色：Off、Stand-alone、Helper 和 Newb。Stand-alone 会在不联网的情况下运行 HealBot、治疗优先的 JOAT，或 BRD/MCH PowerlevelBot。Helper 会监听一个经过认证的 Newb，并激活 JOAT 以进行远程治疗和追随；Newb 会异步连接，且不在本地执行治疗或攻击。配对流量经过认证但未加密，因此名称和坐标会在网络上保持可见。使用 /healbot、/hb 或 /copellia 打开。

Punchline.Original: Plan and coordinate duty runs across your FFXIV characters.
Punchline.Translated: 跨你的 FFXIV 角色规划并协调副本运行。

Description.Original: DAD is a duty planner and multibox coordinator for FFXIV. Create reusable character presets, wake or relog the right clients, prepare jobs, assemble and verify parties, queue supported duties and roulettes, and chain presets into manual or daily schedules. Live readiness checks, clear blockers, reconnect status, cancellation, and Stop All keep every run visible and recoverable.
Description.Translated: DAD 是 FFXIV 的任务规划器与多开协调器。创建可复用的角色预设，唤醒或重新登录正确的客户端，准备职业，组建并验证小队，排队受支持的任务和随机任务，并将预设串联为手动或每日计划。实时就绪检查、清除阻碍、重连状态、取消和 Stop All 让每次运行都保持可见且可恢复。

Punchline.Original: Local TTS commentary and classic transition alerts.
Punchline.Translated: 本地 TTS 解说与经典转场警报。

Description.Original: Preset-driven commentary for login, travel, combat, idle, BGM, and other events; cached Piper or Windows speech; configurable triggers and cooldowns; and optional Krangler integration.
Description.Translated: 由预设驱动的登录、旅行、战斗、空闲、BGM 及其他事件解说；缓存式 Piper 或 Windows 语音；可配置的触发器和冷却时间；以及可选的 Krangler 集成。

Punchline.Original: Translate selected FFXIV chat channels in real time.
Punchline.Translated: 实时翻译选定的 FFXIV 聊天频道。

Description.Original: DhogGPT translates incoming chat from selected channels and gives you a translate-and-send composer for outgoing messages. Use /dhoggpt, /dgpt, or /dog to open it.
Description.Translated: DhogGPT 会翻译来自选定频道的传入聊天，并为你提供用于传出消息的翻译并发送编辑器。使用 /dhoggpt、/dgpt 或 /dog 打开。

Punchline.Original: Hide the crowd. Gate rendering. Keep the party.
Punchline.Translated: 隐藏人群。控制渲染。保留小队。

Description.Original: An experimental Dalamud utility for weak machines. Hide non-party players, pets, chocobos, and minions while keeping party members and, optionally, your current target visible. Toggle foreground or background no-render modes, bind safety and mode hotkeys, and save or restore the game window position and size. Results vary by system; use All Off to restore normal rendering and visibility.
Description.Translated: 一款面向低配机器的实验性 Dalamud 工具。隐藏非小队玩家、宠物、陆行鸟和随从，同时保留小队成员以及可选的当前目标可见。切换前台或后台无渲染模式，绑定安全和模式热键，并保存或恢复游戏窗口位置和大小。效果因系统而异；使用 All Off 恢复正常渲染和可见性。

Punchline.Original: Inspector Footybrand is here to make sure your feet are ok. Don't worry the inspector respects Lodestone privacy.
Punchline.Translated: Inspector Footybrand 来确保你的脚没事。别担心，这位检查员尊重 Lodestone 隐私。

Description.Original: Footballer is a private privacy-respecting foot showcase plugin with a saved main-window krangle toggle, cached Lodestone face gating, preview-only barefoot mode, and hidden debug research surfaces.
Description.Translated: Footballer 是一个私密且尊重隐私的足部展示插件，带有已保存的主窗口 krangle 开关、缓存的 Lodestone 面部门控、仅预览的赤脚模式，以及隐藏的调试研究界面。

Punchline.Original: Local screenshot privacy: hide, rename, or restyle visible characters.
Punchline.Translated: 本地截图隐私：隐藏、重命名或重新设计可见角色的外观。

Description.Original: Krangler is a local-only screenshot privacy and appearance tool. Garble chat, pseudonymize player names, randomize or preset appearances, hide or replace exact race/clan/gender combinations, capture visible looks as presets, and spawn an optional local follower. Use /kr to configure.
Description.Translated: Krangler 是一个仅本地的截图隐私与外观工具。混淆聊天内容、将玩家名称假名化、随机化或预设外观、隐藏或替换精确的种族/部族/性别组合、将可见外观捕获为预设，并可生成一个可选的本地追随者。使用 /kr 进行配置。

Punchline.Original: Automated duty farming and mogtome acquisition.
Punchline.Translated: 自动副本刷取与 mogtome 获取。

Description.Original:
# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** is a Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that automatically accepts or declines Party and Alliance Ready Checks based on a customizable counter. 

Whether you are stepping away for a moment or just tired of clicking, this plugin handles ready checks for you while mimicking human reaction times.

## ✨ Features

* **Auto-Answer Ready Checks:** Automatically clicks "Yes" or "No" when a ready check appears.
* **Configurable "Yes" Counter:** Set a specific number of times you want to automatically answer "Yes". Once that limit is reached, the plugin will automatically start answering "No" to prevent pulling when you are actually away.
* **Natural Delay:** Enable a randomized delay (0.7 to 2.5 seconds) before the plugin answers, making it look like a natural human reaction.
* **Smart Chat Triggers (Regex):** Add custom text phrases to the plugin. If someone says one of these phrases in Party or Alliance chat (e.g., "reset", "pulling"), your counter will automatically reset back to zero.
* **Bilingual Support:** The user interface is available in both English and German.

## 🚀 Usage

1. Type `/iar` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window.
2. Click the **Inactive/Active** button at the top to turn the auto-responder on or off.
3. Adjust the **Yes Count** slider. For example, if set to `5`, the plugin will answer "Yes" to the next 5 ready checks, and "No" to any checks after that.
4. Click the **Start** button at any time to manually reset your current counter back to zero.

### Chat Triggers (Regex Patterns)
At the bottom of the window, you can expand the **Regex Patterns** section. Here you can add simple words or complex regex patterns. 
If the plugin reads a matching message in your Party or Cross-World Party chat, it will instantly reset your counter to zero, assuming a new pull or instance is starting!

/iar - opens the I Am Ready tool
Description.Translated:
# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** 是一个用于 Final Fantasy XIV 的 Dalamud 插件，可根据可自定义的计数器自动接受或拒绝小队和团队准备确认。 

无论你是暂时离开，还是只是厌倦点击，这个插件都会替你处理准备确认，同时模拟人类的反应时间。

## ✨ 功能

* **自动回答准备确认：** 当出现准备确认时自动点击 "Yes" 或 "No"。
* **可配置的 "Yes" 计数器：** 设置你希望自动回答 "Yes" 的具体次数。一旦达到该限制，插件将自动开始回答 "No"，以防止在你实际离开时开怪。
* **自然延迟：** 启用随机延迟（0.7 到 2.5 秒）后再让插件回答，使其看起来像自然的人类反应。
* **智能聊天触发器（Regex）：** 向插件添加自定义文本短语。如果有人在 小队或团队 聊天中说出这些短语之一（例如 "reset"、"pulling"），你的计数器将自动重置为零。
* **双语支持：** 用户界面提供英语和德语。

## 🚀 用法

1. 在游戏内聊天中输入 `/iar` 打开配置窗口。
2. 点击顶部的 **Inactive/Active** 按钮来打开或关闭自动应答器。
3. 调整 **Yes Count** 滑块。例如，如果设为 `5`，插件将对接下来 5 次准备确认回答 "Yes"，之后任何检查都回答 "No"。
4. 随时点击 **Start** 按钮，将当前计数器手动重置为零。

### 聊天触发器（Regex Patterns）
在窗口底部，你可以展开 **Regex Patterns** 部分。在这里可以添加简单词语或复杂 regex 模式。 
如果插件在你的 小队或跨服小队 聊天中读到匹配消息，它会立即将你的计数器重置为零，假设新的开怪或副本即将开始！

/iar - 打开 I Am Ready 工具

Description.Original: 方便查看buffid和bossid和技能id
Description.Translated: 方便查看buffid和bossid和技能id

Punchline.Original: A collection of QoL tweaks
Punchline.Translated: 一系列生活质量改进

Description.Original: Some kind of mistake, I'm sure
Description.Translated: 肯定是搞错了什么

Description.Original: Furniture selection based on what you see, keybinds, and more.
Description.Translated: 基于所见即所得的家具选择、快捷键等更多功能。

Description.Original: Drag and and drop textured directly onto what you see!
Description.Translated: 将贴图直接拖放到你所看到的内容上！

Description.Original: Player synced custom voices, Twitch playback integration, and more!
Description.Translated: 玩家同步的自定义语音、Twitch 播放集成等更多功能！

Punchline.Original: Native ImGui damage meter overlay powered by IINACT
Punchline.Translated: 由 IINACT 驱动的原生 ImGui 伤害统计悬浮窗

Description.Original: DM @mtvirux on discord for assistance or bug reports.
Description.Translated: 在 Discord 上私信 @mtvirux 寻求帮助或报告 bug。

Punchline.Original: Basic plugin to detect if chocobo is summoned while trying to stable it.
Punchline.Translated: 当尝试寄存陆行鸟时检测陆行鸟是否已召唤的基础插件。

Description.Original: This plugin will populate a window as soon as you open a stable if your chocobo is currently summoned. It asks if you want to unsummon it. Upon clicking yes, it closes the chocobo stable and withdraws your chocobo.
Description.Translated: 如果当前已召唤陆行鸟，该插件会在你打开鸟棚时立即弹出一个窗口。它会询问你是否要收回陆行鸟。点击是后，会关闭鸟棚并收回你的陆行鸟。

Punchline.Original: A plugin that will populate a window whenever maintenance is scheduled, advising you that there is maintenance
Punchline.Translated: 当有维护计划时弹出一个窗口，提示你即将进行维护的插件

Description.Original: This plugin will detect whenever FFXIV has maintenance scheduled, and it will cause a large window with large text advising the user of the maintenance and the day and time.
Description.Translated: 该插件会检测 FFXIV 何时安排了维护，并弹出一个带有大号文字的大窗口，告知用户维护信息以及日期和时间。

Punchline.Original: SkiaSharp-powered UI rendering framework. Give your plugins what Sansflaire lacks.
Punchline.Translated: 由 SkiaSharp 驱动的 UI 渲染框架。为你的插件提供 Sansflaire 所缺少的功能。

Description.Original: PanacheUI is a vector graphics UI framework for Dalamud plugins, backed by SkiaSharp (the same engine as Chrome and Flutter). Provides a node tree, CSS-like styling, layout engine, and smooth rendering — far beyond what vanilla ImGui can offer.
Description.Translated: PanacheUI 是面向 Dalamud 插件的矢量图形 UI 框架，由 SkiaSharp 提供支持（与 Chrome 和 Flutter 相同的引擎）。提供节点树、类 CSS 样式、布局引擎和平滑渲染——远超原生 ImGui 所能提供的功能。

Punchline.Original: Real-time combat damage/healing meter for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 实时战斗伤害/治疗统计。

Description.Original: Tracks damage dealt, healing done, DPS, HPS, overhealing, damage taken, and more in real time for you and your party. Stores up to 20 recent combat sessions with manual save slots. Fully configurable display, bar colors, and window styles.
Description.Translated: 实时追踪你和队员造成的伤害、治疗量、DPS、HPS、过量治疗、承受伤害等。可存储最多 20 场近期战斗记录，并有手动保存槽位。显示、条颜色和窗口样式均可完全配置。

Punchline.Original: Where mods
Punchline.Translated: Where mods

Description.Original: Where mods
Description.Translated: Where mods

Punchline.Original: Improved screenshots in and around GPose
Punchline.Translated: 改进 GPose 及其周围的截图

Description.Original: Alpha - please be careful!
Description.Translated: Alpha - 请谨慎使用！

Punchline.Original: Mini-games for Dalamud in one window.
Punchline.Translated: 在一个窗口中为 Dalamud 提供的小游戏。

Description.Original: Play Minesweeper, Hangman, and Sudoku from a single Arcade hub.
Description.Translated: 从单一的 Arcade 中心畅玩扫雷、Hangman 和数独。

Punchline.Original: Healing without targeting.
Punchline.Translated: 无需选中目标即可治疗。

Description.Original: Remove the need to target people for healing, instead assign actions to mouse buttons and use them by clicking player names.
Description.Translated: 无需选中目标即可治疗，改为将技能绑定到鼠标按键，并通过点击玩家名字来使用。

Punchline.Original: Bridges FFXIV chat with Discord via webhooks and slash commands.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 webhooks 和斜杠命令桥接 FFXIV 聊天与 Discord。

Description.Original:
Forwards FFXIV chat channels to Discord via webhooks and allows sending messages back from Discord using slash commands.

Bugs & suggestions: https://github.com/havyrl/FFXIVDiscordChatBridge/issues
Description.Translated:
通过 webhooks 将 FFXIV 聊天频道转发到 Discord，并允许使用斜杠命令从 Discord 发回消息。

Bug 与建议：https://github.com/havyrl/FFXIVDiscordChatBridge/issues

Punchline.Original: Quiet Penumbra mod-complete notifications.
Punchline.Translated: 静默 Penumbra mod 完成通知。

Description.Original: Suppress Penumbra mod-complete toasts and selected error notifications. The command to open the settings menu is /penumbraquiet.
Description.Translated: 抑制 Penumbra mod 完成弹窗与部分错误通知。打开设置菜单的命令是 /penumbraquiet。

Punchline.Original: A MakePlace shopping-list companion for market board runs.
Punchline.Translated: 用于市场板采购的 MakePlace 购物清单助手。

Description.Original: A MakePlace shopping-list companion for market board runs, inventory tracking, and Patch 7.5 consolidated dye handling.
Description.Translated: 用于市场板采购、库存追踪以及 7.5 版本整合染色处理的 MakePlace 购物清单助手。

Punchline.Original: Refreshes your Party Finder listing on a timer.
Punchline.Translated: 按定时器刷新你的 Party Finder 招募。

Description.Original: Automates refreshing a Party Finder listing.
Description.Translated: 自动刷新 Party Finder 招募。

Punchline.Original: Liste de choses à tracker.
Punchline.Translated: 待追踪事项列表。

Description.Original: Liste de choses à tracker.
Description.Translated: 待追踪事项列表。

Punchline.Original: Stream internet radio stations while playing FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: 在游玩 FFXIV 时收听网络电台

Description.Original:
Listen to your favorite internet radio stations directly in-game. Browse stations and manage your favorites.
Use /cradio to open the radio player
Description.Translated:
直接在游戏内收听你喜爱的网络电台。浏览电台并管理收藏。
使用 /cradio 打开电台播放器

Punchline.Original: Easily keep track of your Start/Final bank and results.
Punchline.Translated: 轻松追踪你的起始/最终资金与结果。

Description.Original: Simple and fast way to know your night gamba results.
Description.Translated: 简单快速地了解你当晚的 gamba 结果。

Description.Original: Outil de jets de dés pour le Système Très Simple.
Description.Translated: 用于 Système Très Simple 的掷骰工具。

Punchline.Original: Create your own custom slash commands.
Punchline.Translated: 创建你自己的自定义斜杠命令。

Description.Original: Lets players create custom slash command aliases from an in-game UI.
Description.Translated: 让玩家可以通过游戏内 UI 创建自定义斜杠命令别名。

Punchline.Original: Support for Ukrainian characters in chat input field.
Punchline.Translated: 在聊天输入框中支持乌克兰语字符。

Description.Original: Support for Ukrainian characters in chat input field. When using the Ukrainian keyboard layout, this plugin remaps keys so that Ukrainian letters are correctly entered in the chat input. This plugin is supported on Windows only.
Description.Translated: 在聊天输入框中支持乌克兰语字符。使用乌克兰语键盘布局时，此插件会重新映射按键，使乌克兰语字母能正确输入到聊天输入框。此插件仅支持 Windows。

Description.Original: Hooks into Penumbra via IPC and renders a scrollable image carousel above the tab bar whenever a mod with an "images" subfolder is selected.
Description.Translated: 通过 IPC 挂接到 Penumbra，并在选中带有 "images" 子文件夹的 mod 时，在标签栏上方渲染可滚动的图片轮播。

Punchline.Original: Play casino games in XIV!
Punchline.Translated: 在 XIV 中玩赌场游戏！

Description.Original: A fully-featured casino engine for FFXIV. Use /casino to open the interface.
Description.Translated: 适用于 FFXIV 的功能齐全的赌场引擎。使用 /casino 打开界面。

Punchline.Original: Checks boss health against time thresholds.
Punchline.Translated: 根据时间阈值检查 boss 血量。

Description.Original: Helps track health targets based on time goals. Useful for when you need to check if you're ahead of a known enrage time or a set kill time.
Description.Translated: 帮助根据时间目标追踪血量目标。当你需要检查自己是否领先于已知的狂暴时间或设定的击杀时间时很有用。

Punchline.Original: Tracks your Triple Triad Cards.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪你的 Triple Triad 卡牌。

Description.Original: Tracks your Triple Triad collection with filters to show what you have uncollected and where you can find each card.
Description.Translated: 通过筛选器追踪你的 Triple Triad 收藏，显示你尚未收集的卡牌以及每张卡牌的获取位置。

Punchline.Original: A toggleable helper to track real/fake debuffs for the monkes.
Punchline.Translated: 可切换的辅助工具，用于追踪武僧的真假 debuff。

Description.Original: A toggleable helper to track real/fake debuffs for the monkes.
Description.Translated: 可切换的辅助工具，用于追踪武僧的真假 debuff。

Punchline.Original: Player resizer with automatic nameplate adjustment.
Punchline.Translated: 玩家缩放器，带自动名牌调整。

Description.Original: Lets you resize your character and automatically adjust the nameplate position. Contact: support@arzolath.com
Description.Translated: 让你调整角色大小，并自动调整名牌位置。联系方式：support@arzolath.com

Punchline.Original: Render a live video screen anywhere in the game world.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏世界任意位置渲染实时视频屏幕。

Description.Original:
Places a virtual screen in 3D world space that displays images and video with proper depth testing. Supports local files, direct URLs, YouTube (via yt-dlp), and multi-player sync so all players with the plugin see the same content simultaneously.

Note: yt-dlp.exe must be placed in the plugin folder for YouTube support (host only — sync clients receive a direct stream URL automatically).
Description.Translated:
在 3D 世界空间中放置一块虚拟屏幕，以正确的深度测试显示图片和视频。支持本地文件、直接 URL、YouTube（通过 yt-dlp）以及多玩家同步，使所有安装该插件的玩家都能同时看到相同内容。

注意：若要支持 YouTube，必须将 yt-dlp.exe 放在插件文件夹中（仅限主机——同步客户端会自动接收直接流 URL）。

Punchline.Original: Custom status effects for players and companions alike!
Punchline.Translated: 玩家与同伴均可使用的自定义状态效果！

Description.Original: An inclusive and extensive custom status effect manager. Apply them to targets, group custom statuses with presets, or apply them under conditional events.
Description.Translated: 一个全面且功能丰富的自定义状态效果管理器。可将其施加到目标上，用预设对自定义状态进行分组，或在条件事件下施加它们。

Punchline.Original: Marketboard analytics for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 市场布告板分析

Description.Original: Advanced marketboard tools and cross-world arbitrage scanning.
Description.Translated: 高级市场布告板工具与跨服套利扫描。

Punchline.Original: Venue analytics and smart greetings in one window.
Punchline.Translated: 在一个窗口中实现场地分析及智能问候。

Description.Original: Tracks venue guests, greeting history, and nightly statistics with export support.
Description.Translated: 跟踪场地访客、问候历史和每晚统计，并支持导出。

Punchline.Original: Auto-Guard against Marksman's Spite in PvP.
Punchline.Translated: 在 PvP 中用 Auto-Guard 应对 Marksman's Spite。

Description.Original: Detects when an enemy Machinist uses Marksman's Spite on you and automatically uses Guard. Includes an Execute tab to coordinate your own Marksman's Spite with a teammate, with optional auto-Bravery sequencing.
Description.Translated: 检测敌方 Machinist 对你使用 Marksman's Spite 时自动使用 Guard。包含一个 Execute 标签页，以便与队友协调你自己的 Marksman's Spite，并支持可选的自动 Bravery 连招。

Description.Original: You know :p
Description.Translated: 你懂的 :p

Punchline.Original: Telegram notifications for FFXIV events
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 事件的 Telegram 通知

Description.Original: Send Telegram notifications for various in-game events like level ups, currency thresholds, duty completion, and more.
Description.Translated: 为升级、货币阈值、任务完成等各种游戏内事件发送 Telegram 通知。

Punchline.Original: 雨露霜雪
Punchline.Translated: 雨露霜雪

Description.Original: An advanced combat rotation platform for FFXIV high-end content.
Description.Translated: 面向 FFXIV 高难度内容的高级战斗循环平台。

Punchline.Original: Keep your RP scenes organized, visible, and easy to follow.
Punchline.Translated: 让你的 RP 场景井然有序、清晰可见、易于跟进。

Description.Original: A lightweight SFW roleplay scene assistant for tracking RP partners, organizing scene chat, keeping notes, drafting posts, and making active scenes easier to follow.
Description.Translated: 轻量级 SFW 角色扮演场景助手，用于追踪 RP 伙伴、整理场景聊天、记录笔记、起草帖子，并让进行中的场景更易跟进。

Punchline.Original: Even more XIVCombo
Punchline.Translated: 更多 XIVCombo

Description.Original: Custom XIVCombo
Description.Translated: 自定义 XIVCombo

Punchline.Original: Can't seem to find the right weapon for the job?  This may help!
Punchline.Translated: 找不到适合当前职业的武器？这或许能帮上忙！

Description.Original: Adds a Clas/Job Icon Overlay in Armoury Chest.  Split from VIWI plugin's Kitchen Sink module.
Description.Translated: 在兵装库中添加职业/特职图标覆盖层。从 VIWI 插件的 Kitchen Sink 模块中拆分而来。

Punchline.Original: Browse FFXIV venues and teleport to them with one click.
Punchline.Translated: 浏览 FFXIV 场地并一键传送。

Description.Original:
Discover active FFXIV venues with data powered by the FFXIV Venues API. Browse currently open and upcoming venues in a sortable table featuring color-coded data centers, opening times, and a visual timeline. Filter by region, search by name, and adjust the lookahead window to find venues opening soon.

Save favorites, blacklist venues, and add your own custom venues with custom schedules and tags. Lifestream integration lets you teleport directly to any venue, while a compact popout window gives you a quick overview at a glance.

Use /avf to open.
Description.Translated:
借助 FFXIV Venues API 提供的数据发现活跃的 FFXIV 场地。以可排序表格浏览当前开放和即将开放的场地，表格包含按颜色区分的服务器、开放时间和可视化时间轴。可按地区筛选、按名称搜索，并调整预览时间窗口以查找即将开放的场地。

保存收藏、将场地加入黑名单，并添加带有自定义时间表和标签的自定义场地。集成 Lifestream 后可直接传送到任意场地，紧凑的弹出窗口让你一眼掌握概况。

使用 /avf 打开。

Description.Original: Build Questionable quest JSON files via UI.
Description.Translated: 通过 UI 构建 Questionable 任务 JSON 文件。

Punchline.Original: Blackjack dealer dashboard for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 二十一点庄家仪表盘

Description.Original: A dealer-side dashboard for running Blackjack games in FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 用于在 FFXIV 中主持二十一点游戏的庄家端仪表盘。

Description.Original: Smart crafting profit calculator with market demand analysis.
Description.Translated: 智能制作利润计算器，附带市场需求分析。

Punchline.Original: In-game companion for xivvenuemanager.com — log patron visits, sales, and services without leaving FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: xivvenuemanager.com 的游戏内伴侣 —— 无需离开 FFXIV 即可记录顾客到访、销售和服务。

Description.Original: In-game companion for XIV Venue Manager, a venue-management platform for FFXIV player-run venues (xivvenuemanager.com). Tracks patron entry and exit at your venue, logs sales and services to your web dashboard in real time, and keeps guest lists in sync with the staff, roles, and services you configure on the website. Set up an account at xivvenuemanager.com, generate an API key from the dashboard, and paste it into this plugin's Settings tab to start syncing.
Description.Translated: XIV Venue Manager 的游戏内伴侣，这是一个面向 FFXIV 玩家自营场所的场所管理平台（xivvenuemanager.com）。追踪顾客进出你的场所，实时将销售和服务记录到你的网页仪表盘，并使宾客名单与你在网站上配置的员工、角色和服务保持同步。在 xivvenuemanager.com 注册账号，从仪表盘生成 API key，并将其粘贴到本插件的 Settings 标签页即可开始同步。

Punchline.Original: Export your chat and forward it to Discord.
Punchline.Translated: 导出你的聊天记录并转发到 Discord。

Description.Original: Captures your in-game chat, exports it (txt/json/html/md) and optionally forwards it live to a Discord channel via webhook or bot. Type /easychatlog or /ecl to open the main window or /easychatlog config for settings.
Description.Translated: 捕获你的游戏内聊天，将其导出（txt/json/html/md），并可选通过 webhook 或 bot 实时转发到 Discord 频道。输入 /easychatlog 或 /ecl 打开主窗口，或输入 /easychatlog config 进行设置。

Punchline.Original: A timeline viewer for FFXIV casts.
Punchline.Translated: 用于 FFXIV 施法的时间轴查看器。

Description.Original: Import cast logs and display them in a timeline view.
Description.Translated: 导入施法日志并以时间轴视图显示。

Punchline.Original: Document Penumbra + Glamourer + Customize+ in one file.
Punchline.Translated: 将 Penumbra + Glamourer + Customize+ 记录到一个文件中。

Description.Original: Exports the combined state of Penumbra, Glamourer and Customize+ for the local character as Markdown, HTML or JSON. Ships a selective re-import path, export history, a mod option template gallery with shareable codes, optional git auto-commit and auto-export on zone change. Type /glamdoc to open the window or /glamdoc export [md|html|json] for a headless export.
Description.Translated: 将本地角色的 Penumbra、Glamourer 和 Customize+ 组合状态导出为 Markdown、HTML 或 JSON。提供选择性重新导入、导出历史、带可分享代码的 mod 选项模板库、可选的 git 自动提交以及切换区域时自动导出。输入 /glamdoc 打开窗口，或输入 /glamdoc export [md|html|json] 进行无界面导出。

Punchline.Original: Narrates A Quest Reborn dialog into a separate window.
Punchline.Translated: 将 A Quest Reborn 的对话呈现到独立窗口中。

Description.Original: A companion plugin that forwards A Quest Reborn dialog text into a dedicated window for Chat2 users.
Description.Translated: 为 Chat2 用户将 A Quest Reborn 的对话文本转发到专用窗口的伴侣插件。

Punchline.Original: Highlights the final safe-move window while casting.
Punchline.Translated: 高亮施法期间最后的安全移动窗口。

Description.Original: Adds a cast-bar overlay that marks the slidecasting timeframe so you can start moving without interrupting the cast. Includes an optional audio cue when the safe window begins.
Description.Translated: 添加施法条悬浮层，标记滑步施法的时间窗口，让你在不中断施法的情况下开始移动。可选在安全窗口开始时播放提示音。

Punchline.Original: Rule-based inventory sorter with comprehensive filters.
Punchline.Translated: 基于规则的背包整理器，提供全面的筛选条件。

Description.Original: Define a stack of sorting rules and BagAssistant will route items to the right bag every time. Filter by item category, rarity, level range, item level, class/job, HQ, tradeable, name match, vendor price, item ID and more.
Description.Translated: 定义一组整理规则，BagAssistant 每次都会将物品归入正确的背包。可按物品类别、稀有度、等级范围、品级、职业、HQ、可交易、名称匹配、商店售价、物品 ID 等进行筛选。

Punchline.Original: Real-time DPS and HPS tracking with encounter history and an overlay.
Punchline.Translated: 实时 DPS 与 HPS 追踪，包含战斗历史与悬浮层。

Description.Original: Tracks DPS, HPS, overheal, pet contribution, and encounter summaries with a compact overlay and detailed breakdowns.
Description.Translated: 追踪 DPS、HPS、过量治疗、宠物贡献与战斗摘要，提供紧凑的悬浮层和详细分解。

Punchline.Original: Configurable in-game minimap overlay with entity markers.
Punchline.Translated: 可配置的游戏内小地图悬浮层，带实体标记。

Description.Original: Displays a resizable, zoomable minimap overlay using the current zone's game map texture. Shows player position, party members, aetherytes, FATEs, and more. Supports north-up and player-up rotation modes.
Description.Translated: 使用当前区域的游戏地图贴图，显示可调整大小、可缩放的小地图悬浮层。显示玩家位置、队员、以太之光、FATE 等。支持北向朝上与玩家朝向朝上两种旋转模式。

Punchline.Original: Duty Recorder
Punchline.Translated: Duty Recorder

Description.Original: A plugin that helps you to record your duty.
Description.Translated: 帮助你录制副本的插件。

Punchline.Original: Draft or send AI replies in the chat channels you choose.
Punchline.Translated: 在你选择的聊天频道中起草或发送 AI 回复。

Description.Original: Personal dev plugin that watches the selected FFXIV chat channels, sends per-channel context to LM Studio or API models like Gemini, supports saved system prompt presets, and can print or send replies back into the same channel in game. Slash command: /xivaichat
Description.Translated: 个人开发插件，会监视选定的 FFXIV 聊天频道，按频道将上下文发送到 LM Studio 或 Gemini 等 API 模型，支持已保存的系统提示预设，并可在游戏内打印回复或把回复发送回同一频道。斜杠命令：/xivaichat

Punchline.Original: Easily see who you have doted and who has doted you
Punchline.Translated: 轻松查看你宠爱了谁，以及谁宠爱了你

Description.Original: Easily see who you have doted and who has doted you
Description.Translated: 轻松查看你宠爱了谁，以及谁宠爱了你

Description.Original: Plugin to display ACT combat log data.
Description.Translated: 用于显示 ACT 战斗日志数据的插件。

Punchline.Original: Hit record. No alt-tab required.
Punchline.Translated: 点击录制。无需 Alt-Tab。

Description.Original: Record gameplay, UI, and moments without leaving the game.
Description.Translated: 无需离开游戏即可录制游戏画面、UI 和精彩瞬间。

Description.Original: Plugin to display ACT combat log data.
Description.Translated: 用于显示 ACT 战斗日志数据的插件。

Punchline.Original: Export your gear to XIVGear directly from the game!
Punchline.Translated: 直接从游戏中将你的装备导出到 XIVGear！

Description.Original: Use /xivgearexport to export current equipped gear to JSON in XIVGear format
Description.Translated: 使用 /xivgearexport 将当前装备以 XIVGear 格式导出为 JSON

Punchline.Original: Replaces your own character's displayed name.
Punchline.Translated: 替换你自身角色显示的名字。

Description.Original: A client-only rename for your own character. Affects nameplate, party list, target info, and the sender label of your outgoing chat. This is client side only; other players still see your real name.
Description.Translated: 仅客户端的自我角色改名。影响名牌、小队列表、目标信息和你的发送聊天频道标签。仅在客户端生效；其他玩家仍会看到你的真实名字。

Punchline.Original: Manual market intelligence and arbitrage scanner for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 用于 FFXIV 的手动市场情报与套利扫描器。

Description.Original: Analyzes market opportunities with Universalis data, watchlists, velocity filters, and manual undercut helpers. All actions are manual. Now includes real-time undercut notifications.
Description.Translated: 使用 Universalis 数据、关注列表、流通速度过滤器和手动压价助手分析市场机会。所有操作均为手动。现已包含实时压价通知。

Punchline.Original: Filter and move unwanted gear out of your armoury chest.
Punchline.Translated: 筛选并将不需要的装备移出兵装库。

Description.Original: Define filters by job, minimum/maximum equip level, and item level. Armoury Cleaner scans each gear slot and moves only items that match all active filters into your inventory so you can discard them.
Description.Translated: 按职业、最低/最高装备等级和物品等级定义过滤器。Armoury Cleaner 会扫描每个装备槽位，仅将符合所有启用过滤器的物品移入你的背包，以便你将其丢弃。

Punchline.Original: One-click teleport to the nearest aetheryte for each active quest.
Punchline.Translated: 为每个进行中的任务提供前往最近以太之光的一键传送。

Description.Original: QuestNav lists all your active quests and adds a Teleport button next to each one. Clicking it teleports you to the nearest unlocked aetheryte to the quest's location ? no more hunting through the map.
Description.Translated: QuestNav 会列出你所有进行中的任务，并在每个任务旁添加一个传送按钮。点击后会传送到距离任务地点最近的已解锁以太之光 ? 无需再在地图上苦苦寻找。

Punchline.Original: Tired of every mount with the same generic music? Set the music you want for any mount you want!
Punchline.Translated: 厌倦了每只坐骑都是同样的通用音乐？为你想要的坐骑设置你想要的音乐！

Description.Original: A Plugin that allows the user to customize the mount music choosing a different BGM for it.
Description.Translated: 一个允许用户自定义坐骑音乐的插件，可为坐骑选择不同的 BGM。

Punchline.Original: True Crafting Cost Analyzer for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 真正的制作成本分析器。

Description.Original: Calculates the raw material cost of crafted items using Universalis market data.
Description.Translated: 使用 Universalis 市场数据计算制作物品的原材料成本。

Punchline.Original: Define custom command aliases that execute multiple commands in sequence.
Punchline.Translated: 定义按顺序执行多条命令的自定义命令别名。

Description.Original: Silkstring lets you create custom command aliases that expand into one or more chat commands, executed in order. Use /silkstring to open the settings window.
Description.Translated: Silkstring 让你创建自定义命令别名，展开为一条或多条聊天命令并按顺序执行。使用 /silkstring 打开设置窗口。

Punchline.Original: Daily cross-server arbitrage route — flip items, make gil.
Punchline.Translated: 每日跨服套利路线——倒卖物品，赚取金币。

Description.Original: Namazu Flippers connects to the Saddlebag Exchange API to find daily cross-server arbitrage opportunities. Get a route-optimized shopping list, travel between servers, buy low, sell high on your home world. One scan, one route, done in under 20 minutes.
Description.Translated: Namazu Flippers 连接 Saddlebag Exchange API 以寻找每日跨服套利机会。获取经过路线优化的购物清单，在服务器之间旅行，低价买入，在本服高价卖出。一次扫描，一条路线，20 分钟内完成。

Punchline.Original: Truth or Dare Helper for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 真心话大冒险助手。

Description.Original: Helps you manage and host Truth or Dare games.
Description.Translated: 帮助你管理和主持真心话大冒险游戏。

Punchline.Original: Plan and optimize your treasure hunt route.
Punchline.Translated: 规划并优化你的寻宝路线。

Description.Original: Import coordinates from selected channels and enjoy your treasure hunt. Optimize routes considering player location, aetheryte costs, and distances.
Description.Translated: 从选定频道导入坐标，享受寻宝。根据玩家位置、以太之光费用和距离优化路线。

Punchline.Original: Your PvP Limit Break, fired for you.
Punchline.Translated: 你的 PvP 极限技，自动为你释放。

Description.Original: Fires your PvP Limit Break for you when an enemy's HP drops below a configurable threshold.
Description.Translated: 当敌人 HP 低于可配置阈值时，自动为你释放 PvP 极限技。

Punchline.Original: Scrolling skill timeline overlay powered by IINACT.
Punchline.Translated: 由 IINACT 驱动的滚动技能时间轴悬浮窗。

Description.Original:
Real-time scrolling timeline showing skill usage with action icons, cast bars, and per-player tracking. Requires IINACT for network log data.

DM @mtvirux on discord for assistance or bug reports.
Description.Translated:
实时滚动时间轴，显示技能使用情况，包含技能图标、咏唱条和按玩家追踪。需要 IINACT 获取网络日志数据。

在 Discord 私信 @mtvirux 获取帮助或报告 bug。

Punchline.Original: 你开8服5A
Punchline.Translated: 你开8服5A

Description.Original: 自动找A怪，依赖插件: LifeStream, Teleporter, Vnavmesh, HuntHelper
Description.Translated: 自动找A怪，依赖插件: LifeStream, Teleporter, Vnavmesh, HuntHelper

Description.Original: Scans inventory, armoury chest, saddlebag, retainers, glamour dresser, and armoire to show item set collection progress with job filters.
Description.Translated: 扫描背包、兵装库、鞍囊、雇员、幻化柜和收藏柜，以通过职业筛选显示套装收集进度。

Punchline.Original: Manage and grab preview/cover images for local Penumbra mods.
Punchline.Translated: 管理并获取本地 Penumbra 模组的预览/封面图片。

Description.Original: A helper tool to easily attach local, XIVModArchive, or direct URL preview/cover images to your Penumbra mods.
Description.Translated: 一个辅助工具，可轻松将本地、XIVModArchive 或直接 URL 的预览/封面图片附加到你的 Penumbra 模组上。

Punchline.Original: Manage and grab preview/cover images for local Glamourer designs.
Punchline.Translated: 管理并获取本地 Glamourer 设计的预览/封面图片。

Description.Original: A helper tool to easily attach local, XIVModArchive, direct URL preview/cover images, or take cropped screenshots of your characters to attach to your Glamourer designs.
Description.Translated: 一个辅助工具，可轻松将本地、XIVModArchive、直接 URL 的预览/封面图片附加到你的 Glamourer 设计上，或截取角色的裁剪截图并附加到你的 Glamourer 设计上。

Punchline.Original: Family Feud host helper for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 的 Family Feud 主持辅助工具。

Description.Original: Allows hosting custom Family Feud games with point tracking and chat output.
Description.Translated: 允许主持自定义 Family Feud 游戏，支持积分追踪与聊天输出。

Punchline.Original: Organize, browse, and preview pose presets.
Punchline.Translated: 整理、浏览并预览姿势预设。

Description.Original: A manager solution for organizing pose presets inside FFXIV, with an interactive 3D skeleton mannequin and full-screen preview viewer.
Description.Translated: 一个在 FFXIV 内整理姿势预设的管理方案，带有可交互的 3D 骨骼人偶和全屏预览查看器。

Punchline.Original: Optimize multi-item marketboard shopping with Universalis pricing and Lifestream navigation.
Punchline.Translated: 借助 Universalis 价格与 Lifestream 导航优化多物品市场板购物。

Description.Original: Helps you organize shopping lists by fetching live prices from Universalis, grouping items by cheapest server based on customizable stinginess profiles, navigating via Lifestream IPC, and tracking purchases.
Description.Translated: 通过从 Universalis 获取实时价格、依据可自定义的抠门程度配置按最便宜服务器对物品分组、通过 Lifestream IPC 导航以及追踪购买记录，帮助你整理购物清单。

Punchline.Original: BiS planner, Materia Advisor, and round-trip optimizer for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 的 BiS 规划器、Materia Advisor 和往返优化器。

Description.Original: In-game half of Tonberry Tactics. Reads equipped gear and live character stats, audits materia, compares Etro/XIVGear targets, exports GG-EXPORT:v2 gear data to the web companion, and imports GG-PLAN:v1 recommendations. Shared optimizer and formula logic comes from GearGoblin.Core.
Description.Translated: Tonberry Tactics 的游戏内部分。读取已装备的装备和实时角色属性，审核魔晶石，对比 Etro/XIVGear 目标，将 GG-EXPORT:v2 装备数据导出到网页伴侣，并导入 GG-PLAN:v1 建议。共享的优化器和公式逻辑来自 GearGoblin.Core。

Punchline.Original: Never lose your mouse cursor again!
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会找不到鼠标光标！

Description.Original: Configurable cursor trails and a cursor ring indicators.
Description.Translated: 可配置的光标轨迹和光标环指示器。

Punchline.Original: A native Dalamud DPS meter overlay for IINACT.
Punchline.Translated: IINACT 的原生 Dalamud DPS 表悬浮窗。

Description.Original: Native Dalamud DPS meter HUD for IINACT combat data. Especially useful for linux users who use tiling window managers!
Description.Translated: 用于 IINACT 战斗数据的原生 Dalamud DPS 表 HUD。对使用平铺窗口管理器的 Linux 用户尤其有用！

Punchline.Original: Native IINACT-powered encounter callouts with a cute chocobo for moral support!
Punchline.Translated: 由 IINACT 驱动的原生遭遇战提示，还有一只可爱的陆行鸟提供精神支持！

Description.Original: A native Dalamud encounter callout engine powered by IINACT log events, with a cute chocobo for moral support!
Description.Translated: 由 IINACT 日志事件驱动的原生 Dalamud 遭遇战提示引擎，还有一只可爱的陆行鸟提供精神支持！

Punchline.Original: Review cutscene dialog while it is happening.
Punchline.Translated: 在过场动画对话进行时即可回顾。

Description.Original: Records dialog boxes shown during cutscenes and adds an in-game transcript button so you can review missed lines and replay audio without leaving the cutscene.
Description.Translated: 记录过场动画中显示的对话框，并添加游戏内对话记录按钮，让你无需离开过场动画即可回顾错过的台词并重播音频。

Punchline.Original: What can I make right now, what's it worth, and what would it take to make the rest?
Punchline.Translated: 我现在能做什么、它值多少、做剩下的还需要什么？

Description.Original: Catalogs every recipe you can craft, buckets them by how much effort the missing materials take, prices them with Universalis, and hands the missing-material work to Artisan / GBR / ARC / Lifestream.
Description.Translated: 编录所有你能制作的配方，按缺失材料所需的精力分档，用 Universalis 定价，并把补齐缺失材料的工作交给 Artisan / GBR / ARC / Lifestream。

Punchline.Original: Auto-lists your always-sell items and matches market board prices
Punchline.Translated: 自动上架你常卖的物品并匹配市场板价格

Description.Original: Keep an Auto-Market list of items you always sell. The companion lists them through your retainers in the stack size you choose (keeping a reserve in your bags if you want), prices every listing by matching the lowest board price instead of undercutting, and can do all of it inside AutoRetainer's venture cycle. Also re-prices existing listings (Auto Pinch). Successor to Dagobert Price Matcher; your old settings are imported automatically.
Description.Translated: 维护一份常卖物品的 Auto-Market 列表。该配套插件会通过你的雇员按你选择的堆叠数量上架它们（如需要可在背包中保留一部分库存），所有上架都以匹配最低市场板价格定价而非压价，并且可以在 AutoRetainer 的雇员探险循环中完成这一切。还会重新定价已有上架（Auto Pinch）。是 Dagobert Price Matcher 的继任者；你的旧设置会自动导入。

Punchline.Original: Sits you down while you fish. That's it.
Punchline.Translated: 钓鱼时让你坐下。就这样。

Description.Original: Checks every few seconds while you are fishing; if you are not sitting, it runs /sit for you. Leaves you alone once you are seated (ground sit, chair, or pose).
Description.Translated: 钓鱼时每隔几秒检查一次；如果你没有坐下，它会替你执行 /sit。一旦你已坐下（地面坐、椅子或姿势），它就不再打扰你。

Punchline.Original: Real-time retainer venture countdowns for your dashboard.
Punchline.Translated: 为你的仪表盘提供实时雇员探险倒计时。

Description.Original: Serves the logged-in character's live retainer and venture state on loopback HTTP (127.0.0.1:10504) so the ffxiv dashboard relay can show real-time venture countdowns instead of AutoRetainer's occasionally-stale file cache.
Description.Translated: 通过回环 HTTP（127.0.0.1:10504）提供当前登录角色的实时雇员与探险状态，使 ffxiv dashboard relay 能显示实时探险倒计时，而不是 AutoRetainer 偶尔过期的文件缓存。

Punchline.Original: What to wear, what to dye, and what you'll score - before Masked Rose judges you.
Punchline.Translated: 该穿什么、染什么、能得多少分——在 Masked Rose 评判你之前。

Description.Original: Fashion Report assistant for the Gold Saucer: shows the week's hints, the exact +2 dye and +1 shade for each left-side slot, and top candidate items from the crowdsourced database filtered to what you actually own - with a live score predictor as you assemble the outfit.
Description.Translated: 金碟游乐场的时尚品鉴助手：显示本周提示、每个左侧装备槽确切的 +2 染色与 +1 色调，以及来自众包数据库、筛选为你实际拥有物品的候选物品前列——并在你搭配服装时提供实时得分预测。

Punchline.Original: PvP-only auto-rotation
Punchline.Translated: 仅 PvP 自动循环

Description.Original: PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 的仅 PvP 自动循环。在 PvP 区域激活。

Punchline.Original: Per-job HP, MP, and deep dungeon potion automation.
Punchline.Translated: 按职业的 HP、MP 与深层迷宫药水自动化。

Description.Original: Auto-uses the highest-tier HP potion, MP potion (Ether), and the deep dungeon regen potion (Sustaining / Eurekan / Orthos / Pilgrim's) at configurable thresholds. Each potion's threshold and on/off state is stored per-job, so casters and tanks can have completely different setups.
Description.Translated: 在可配置的阈值自动使用最高阶 HP 药水、MP 药水（Ether）以及深层迷宫恢复药（Sustaining / Eurekan / Orthos / Pilgrim's）。每种药水的阈值与开关状态按职业保存，因此法系与坦克可以有完全不同的设置。

Punchline.Original: Per-dungeon view of which armoire-eligible gear pieces you're still missing
Punchline.Translated: 按副本查看你仍缺少哪些可放入柜子的装备

Description.Original: Lists every armoire-eligible dungeon drop in the game and shows whether each is in your inventory, in your armoire, or still missing. Sort by level, hide completed dungeons, toggle to show owned items too. Open the armoire UI at an inn once per session to populate the in-armoire state; in-inventory and equipped state is detected automatically.
Description.Translated: 列出游戏中所有可放入柜子的副本掉落，并显示每件是在你的背包中、柜子中，还是仍然缺失。可按等级排序、隐藏已完成的副本、切换显示已拥有的物品。每次会话在旅馆打开一次柜子 UI 以填充柜子内状态；背包内与已装备状态会自动检测。

Punchline.Original: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Punchline.Translated: Wrath Combo 的 Lalalazy 分支 - 为非常懒的玩家准备的 XIVCombo。

Description.Original: Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description.Translated: Gluttony Combo - Gluttony Combo 的 lalalazy 分支。为非常懒的玩家准备的 XIVCombo。

Punchline.Original: FFXIV Wondrous Tails probability calculator.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 天书概率计算器。

Description.Original: Adds row probabilities to the Wondrous Tails display along with the average probability of what would happen if you shuffled. Upgraded for modern FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 为天书显示添加行概率，以及重新洗牌时可能发生情况的平均概率。为现代 FFXIV 升级。

Punchline.Original: Your character has a personality now.
Punchline.Translated: 你的角色现在有个性了。

Description.Original: Mannerisms gives your character a life of their own. Set up gestures that react to what you say in chat — type 'bye' and your character waves, say 'WHAT' and they recoil in shock. Create idle profiles so your character reads, checks their phone, or paces around when you're AFK. Supports regex triggers, target-aware emotes, random emote pools with rarity controls, and fully customizable idle sequences.
Description.Translated: Mannerisms 让你的角色拥有自己的生命。设置能对你在聊天中说的话做出反应的手势——输入 'bye'，你的角色就会挥手；说 'WHAT'，他们就会震惊地后退。创建空闲配置文件，让角色在你 AFK 时阅读、看手机或来回踱步。支持 regex 触发器、目标感知表情、带稀有度控制的随机表情池，以及完全可自定义的空闲序列。

Punchline.Original: Free your mouse and fingers from repetitive trading.
Punchline.Translated: 让你的鼠标和手指从重复交易中解放出来。

Description.Original: Free your mouse and fingers from repetitive trading
Description.Translated: 让你的鼠标和手指从重复交易中解放出来

Description.Original: GW2-style action camera: hold a key to capture the mouse, rotate the camera freely, auto-face your character, and soft-target the nearest enemy in view.
Description.Translated: GW2 风格动作相机：按住一个键捕获鼠标，自由旋转视角，自动面向你的角色，并软锁定视野内最近的敌人。

Punchline.Original: Straightforward character selection, no fluff or hassle
Punchline.Translated: 简单直接的角色选择，不花哨、不麻烦

Description.Original: Simple Character Select
Description.Translated: Simple Character Select

Punchline.Original: The daily word game for Eorzea.
Punchline.Translated: Eorzea 的每日文字游戏。

Description.Original: A word puzzle plugin for Final Fantasy XIV inspired by wordle. Features multiple themes and stat tracking.
Description.Translated: 一款受 wordle 启发的 Final Fantasy XIV 文字解谜插件。具有多种主题和统计追踪功能。

Punchline.Original: TEST BUILD ONLY - zbee/ARC PR#3 IPC surface (separate instance)
Punchline.Translated: 仅测试版 - zbee/ARC PR#3 IPC 接口（独立实例）

Description.Original: TEMPORARY test build of zbee/ARC PR #3 (ipc-venture-work): adds ARC.AddItem / ARC.GetInProgress / ARC.GetListCount IPC used by LazyCrafter's ArcDispatch. Installs alongside your normal production ARControl (different InternalName, no config or IPC collision at rest) for in-game verification only. Pre-seeded with a copy of your existing ARControl venture setup so no re-setup is needed. Not maintained; remove after testing is done.
Description.Translated: zbee/ARC PR #3（ipc-venture-work）的临时测试版：添加了 ARC.AddItem / ARC.GetInProgress / ARC.GetListCount IPC，供 LazyCrafter 的 ArcDispatch 使用。与正常生产环境的 ARControl 并存安装（InternalName 不同，静态时无配置或 IPC 冲突），仅用于游戏内验证。已预置现有 ARControl 探险设置的副本，因此无需重新设置。不再维护；测试完成后请移除。

Punchline.Original: PvP match history and stats tracker — Dalamud API 15 fork.
Punchline.Translated: PvP 对局历史与数据追踪器 — Dalamud API 15 分支版。

Description.Original: Record, browse and filter your Crystalline Conflict, Frontline and Rival Wings match history, view match scoreboards and view aggregated statistics like win rate and average damage dealt per match. Community fork of wrath16/PvpStats restoring compatibility with Dalamud API 15 (FFXIV patch 7.5).
Description.Translated: 记录、浏览并筛选你的 Crystalline Conflict、Frontline 和 Rival Wings 对局历史，查看对局记分板以及胜率、每场平均伤害等汇总统计数据。wrath16/PvpStats 的社区分支，恢复了对 Dalamud API 15（FFXIV 7.5 版本）的兼容性。

Punchline.Original: The Habitat Nightclub Plugin
Punchline.Translated: Habitat Nightclub 插件

Description.Original: The official companion plugin for Habitat Nightclub
Description.Translated: Habitat Nightclub 的官方配套插件

Punchline.Original: In-game meld optimizer with BisBuddy export and overcap awareness.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内镶嵌优化器，支持 BisBuddy 导出与属性溢出感知。

Description.Original: FFXIV in-game meld optimizer. Pick a job, load your equipped gear, click Auto-Optimize: the plugin picks the best food and places materia to match the BiS target while respecting per-piece stat caps. Auto-detects job changes, preloads equipped gear, and exports to BisBuddy in one click, with proper HQ flag handling.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 游戏内镶嵌优化器。选择职业，载入已装备的装备，点击自动优化：插件会挑选最佳食物并放置魔晶石以匹配 BiS 目标，同时遵守单件装备的属性上限。自动检测职业切换，预载已装备的装备，并可一键导出至 BisBuddy，且正确处理 HQ 标记。

Punchline.Original: Custom ImGui Emote Grid
Punchline.Translated: 自定义 ImGui 表情网格

Description.Original: A standalone plugin providing a scalable ImGui grid for emotes.
Description.Translated: 一个独立插件，提供可缩放的 ImGui 表情网格。

Punchline.Original: Find the absolute best way to spend all your FFXIV currencies.
Punchline.Translated: 找到花费所有 FFXIV 货币的绝对最佳方式。

Description.Original: Fork of CurrencySpender by Blackcatz1911. Never wonder 'What should I do with this?' again. Access real-time prices from Universalis, identify missing collectibles tied to your currencies, and unlock new possibilities for utilizing your in-game resources effectively.
Description.Translated: Blackcatz1911 的 CurrencySpender 的 Fork。再也不用想“我该拿这个做什么？”。访问 Universalis 的实时价格，识别与你的货币相关的缺失收藏品，并解锁有效利用游戏内资源的新可能。

Punchline.Original: Fully automated FATE grinding utilizing vnavmesh, lifestream, and Gluttony Combo.
Punchline.Translated: 利用 vnavmesh、lifestream 和 Gluttony Combo 的全自动 FATE 刷取。

Description.Original: Automates FATE grinding, including Zodiac Atma, Anima Luminous Crystals, Resistance Memories, Phantom Demiatmas, Yo-kai Watch Medals, and Bicolor Gemstones. Seamlessly integrates with vnavmesh for pathing and flight, lifestream for zone swapping, TextAdvance for dialogue skipping, and Gluttony Combo/BossMod for combat. Use /lazyfate to open.
Description.Translated: 自动化 FATE 刷取，包括 Zodiac Atma、Anima Luminous Crystals、Resistance Memories、Phantom Demiatmas、Yo-kai Watch Medals 和 Bicolor Gemstones。与 vnavmesh 无缝集成以进行寻路和飞行，与 lifestream 集成以切换区域，与 TextAdvance 集成以跳过对话，与 Gluttony Combo/BossMod 集成以进行战斗。使用 /lazyfate 打开。

Punchline.Original: Track your Skyward points for all jobs toward the Pteranodon mount
Punchline.Translated: 追踪所有职业的 Skyward 点数以获取 Pteranodon 坐骑

Description.Original: Tracks all jobs' Skyward points for the Pteranodon mount achievement. Scans your inventory for Skybuilders turn-in items and projects how many points they'll add, shown as a cyan bar extension on each job's progress bar. Use /lazysky to open.
Description.Translated: 追踪所有职业用于 Pteranodon 坐骑成就的 Skyward 点数。扫描你的背包中的 Skybuilders 提交物品，并预估它们会增加多少点数，以每个职业进度条上的青色条延伸显示。使用 /lazysky 打开。

Punchline.Original: Never forget to eat your food again.
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会忘记吃食物。

Description.Original: Auto-eats food in combat duties with per-job selection, auto-select based on best stats, and a low-food warning.
Description.Translated: 在战斗副本中自动吃食物，支持按职业选择、根据最佳属性自动选择，以及食物不足警告。

Punchline.Original: Track upgradable gear sets and what it costs to finish them
Punchline.Translated: 追踪可升级的装备套装以及完成它们所需的成本

Description.Original: Tracks upgradable gear collections piece by piece. Starts with Occult Crescent: North Horn's Phantom Vision sets - all 7 roles, 5 slots, 4 tiers. Shows which pieces you own and at what tier, what the next upgrade costs, and the exact obol/fixative shortfall to finish a role or the whole collection. Every item ID and price is read from the game's own shop data at runtime, so it stays correct across patches. Also flags Arcanaut's gear you can trade up for free. Use /lazygear to open.
Description.Translated: 逐件追踪可升级的装备收藏。先从 Occult Crescent: North Horn 的 Phantom Vision 套装开始——全部 7 个职能、5 个部位、4 个品级。显示你拥有哪些部件及其品级、下一升级需要什么，以及完成一个职能或整个收藏所缺的确切 obol/fixative 数量。每个物品 ID 和价格都会在运行时读取游戏自身的商店数据，因此能在各补丁中保持正确。还会标记可免费升级兑换的 Arcanaut 装备。使用 /lazygear 打开。

Punchline.Original: Tracks duties
Punchline.Translated: 追踪副本

Description.Original: Tracks duties done.
Description.Translated: 追踪已完成的副本。

Punchline.Original: Market board price alerts via Universalis.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Universalis 提供市场板价格提醒。

Description.Original: Monitors the Universalis market board and fires in-game chat and toast alerts when items on your watchlist hit a target price. Supports per-item scoping to a world, data center, or full region.
Description.Translated: 监控 Universalis 市场板，当关注列表中的物品达到目标价格时，发送游戏内聊天与弹窗提醒。支持按物品分别指定服务器、数据中心或整个大区。

Punchline.Original: WIP, 18+ plz
Punchline.Translated: 开发中，仅限 18+

Description.Original: Welcome to kinklink, the kinky plugin with aimed to help you connect and play with other kinksters around the world!
Description.Translated: 欢迎来到 kinklink，这款特殊癖好插件旨在帮助你与全世界的同好建立联系并一起玩乐！

Punchline.Original: Real-time skin decal compositor for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 实时皮肤贴花合成器

Description.Original: Composites image decals onto character skin textures (diffuse + normal) in real time via Penumbra. No game file modification. Supports per-layer emissive, iris glow, ColorTable PBR, and Mod (.pmp) export. Under active development - feedback welcome via Issues or Discord. Type /skintattoo to open.
Description.Translated: 通过 Penumbra 将图像贴花实时合成到角色皮肤纹理（漫反射 + 法线）上。无需修改游戏文件。支持逐层自发光、虹膜发光、ColorTable PBR 以及 Mod (.pmp) 导出。正在积极开发中——欢迎通过 Issues 或 Discord 反馈。输入 /skintattoo 打开。

Punchline.Original: Live FFXIV DJ and venue tracker
Punchline.Translated: 实时 FFXIV DJ 与场地追踪器

Description.Original: Track live DJs and venues across Eorzea with real-time updates from XIV Rolladeck.
Description.Translated: 通过 XIV Rolladeck 的实时更新，追踪艾欧泽亚各地的现场 DJ 与场地。

Punchline.Original: Transform Lalafells into other races
Punchline.Translated: 将拉拉肥转换为其他种族

Description.Original:
Transforms all Lalafell characters and NPCs around you into your chosen race.
/polala on = enable
/polala off = disable
Description.Translated:
将周围所有拉拉肥角色和 NPC 转换为你选择的种族。
/polala on = 启用
/polala off = 禁用

Punchline.Original: Plans the optimal treasure-map route for your party.
Punchline.Translated: 为你的队伍规划最优藏宝图路线。

Description.Original: Listens for treasure-map coordinates posted in party chat, groups them by zone, and shows the shortest aetheryte-rooted route per map. Use /troute to open the window.
Description.Translated: 监听队伍频道中发布的藏宝图坐标，按区域分组，并显示每张地图以以太之光为起点的最短路线。使用 /troute 打开窗口。

Punchline.Original: Never hunt aether currents blind again.
Punchline.Translated: 不再盲目寻找风脉泉。

Description.Original: Shows aether current locations as markers on the in-game World Map for all expansion zones.
Description.Translated: 在所有资料片的区域中，将风脉泉位置作为标记显示在游戏内世界地图上。

Punchline.Original: Repeat-buy items from NPC shops with stop conditions.
Punchline.Translated: 带停止条件地从 NPC 商店重复购买物品。

Description.Original: Embeds a small overlay next to the standard NPC Shop window. Pick an item from the mirrored shop list, choose a stop condition (fixed count >99 OK, until owned, gil floor, inventory full), and the plugin handles the repeat purchases for you. Shows an estimated total cost popup before starting and warns in red if you cannot afford it. Six-language UI (EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO).
Description.Translated: 在标准 NPC 商店窗口旁嵌入一个小型悬浮窗。从镜像商店列表中选择物品，选择停止条件（固定数量 >99 也可以、直到拥有、金币下限、背包已满），插件会替你处理重复购买。开始前显示预计总花费弹窗，若金币不足则以红色警告。六语言界面（EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO）。

Punchline.Original: Bulk reprice and split-list retainer market listings across all retainers.
Punchline.Translated: 跨所有雇员批量改价并拆分上架雇员市场售卖列表。

Description.Original: Cross-retainer market workbench with a plan-then-apply flow. Reprice tab: per-retainer 'lowest -N g' / 'lowest exact' buttons walk each listing, fetch live market data via Dalamud's IMarketBoard.OfferingsReceived (skipping your own retainers, deduplicated per item/HQ), stage every change in a queue, then commit them all via a single Apply that calls SetRetainerMarketPrice directly. New listing tab: per-row qty x slots, target retainer combo, auto stack-splitting (e.g. 990 / 99 → ten listings of 99), and direct listing from character bag / Chocobo Saddlebag with no entrust step (saddle items are bulk-staged to the bag in one phase, then listed). Live progress dialog shows the current step (selecting retainer, fetching market data, listing, …) so long runs don't look frozen. Six-language UI (EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO). Warns once at startup if AutoRetainer is also loaded since both drive retainer summoning.
Description.Translated: 跨雇员的市场工作台，采用先规划后应用的流程。改价标签页：每个雇员的“最低价 -N g”/“最低价精确值”按钮会遍历每条上架信息，通过 Dalamud 的 IMarketBoard.OfferingsReceived 获取实时市场数据（跳过你自己的雇员，按物品/HQ 去重），将所有改动暂存到队列中，然后通过一次“应用”直接调用 SetRetainerMarketPrice 提交全部改动。新上架标签页：按行设置数量 × 栏位、目标雇员下拉框、自动堆叠拆分（例如 990 / 99 → 十个 99 的上架），并可直接从角色背包 / 陆行鸟鞍囊上架，无需委托步骤（鞍囊物品会在一个阶段批量暂存到背包，然后上架）。实时进度对话框显示当前步骤（选择雇员、获取市场数据、上架……），因此长时间运行不会看起来卡死。六语言界面（EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO）。若同时加载了 AutoRetainer，会在启动时警告一次，因为两者都会驱动雇员召唤。

Description.Original: Search the wiki effortlessly
Description.Translated: 轻松搜索 wiki

Punchline.Original: RP tools for FFXIV - custom inventory, dice rolls, and more.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 的 RP 工具 - 自定义物品栏、掷骰等。

Description.Original: RPFramework provides roleplay helpers including a custom item inventory (/rpinv or /rpinventory), a synced BGM player (/rpbgm), inventory trading and shared bags over a relay server, and more modules coming soon.
Description.Translated: RPFramework 提供角色扮演辅助功能，包括自定义物品栏（/rpinv 或 /rpinventory）、同步 BGM 播放器（/rpbgm）、通过中继服务器进行物品栏交易与共享背包，以及更多即将推出的模块。

Punchline.Original: Desynthesises all the fish in your inventory.
Punchline.Translated: 自动分解你物品栏中的所有鱼类。

Description.Original: Automatically desynthesises all Seafood-category items from your inventory. Supports bulk desynth for stacks. Use /defish to open the window.
Description.Translated: 自动分解你物品栏中所有 Seafood 类别的物品。支持按堆叠批量分解。使用 /defish 打开窗口。

Punchline.Original: A fun trivia game for your FFXIV community!
Punchline.Translated: 为你的 FFXIV 社区准备的趣味问答游戏！

Description.Original: Host FFXIV-themed trivia nights with your Free Company or friends! The host shouts questions in chat and players answer via /yell or /shout. First correct answer wins the point! Features: configurable win conditions, 60-second timer, manual score adjustment, 50 FFXIV-themed questions, and question tracking to avoid repeats.
Description.Translated: 与你的 Free Company 或朋友一起举办 FFXIV 主题问答之夜！主持人以聊天喊话出题，玩家通过 /yell 或 /shout 作答。首位答对者得分！功能：可配置的获胜条件、60 秒计时器、手动分数调整、50 道 FFXIV 主题题目，以及题目追踪以避免重复。

Punchline.Original: Allows you to automatically see the max crafting level that uses a material.
Punchline.Translated: 让你自动查看使用某材料可制作出的最高等级。

Description.Original: Adds text to the item tooltip for materials displaying the max level and crafter class for the recipe that uses the item.
Description.Translated: 在材料物品的 tooltip 中添加文字，显示使用该物品的配方的最高等级和制作职业。

Punchline.Original: Enemy HP Split Gauge
Punchline.Translated: 敌人 HP 差值量表

Description.Original: Provides a visual representation of the HP difference between two enemies on your aggro list.  Open the plugin config window to see a preview of the gauge and to change options.
Description.Translated: 在仇恨列表中为你显示两个敌人之间的 HP 差异可视化。打开插件配置窗口可预览量表并更改选项。

Punchline.Original: Shows the destination zone's concept art while loading
Punchline.Translated: 加载时显示目的地区域的概念图

Description.Original:
This plugin shows the destination zone's concept art while loading.
NOTE: ONLY LOOKS RIGHT ON 16:9 SCREENS! The concept art is not any bigger, and we can't expand/fix it. Sorry!
Description.Translated:
此插件会在加载时显示目的地区域的概念图。
注意：仅在 16:9 屏幕上看起来正常！概念图尺寸无法更大，我们也无法扩展/修复它。抱歉！

Punchline.Original: Export in-game collection progress for FFXIV Collect import.
Punchline.Translated: 导出游戏内收集进度以供 FFXIV Collect 导入。

Description.Original: Adds /akuxivcollect to scan supported in-game collection unlocks and copy or save JSON for https://ffxivcollect.com/import.
Description.Translated: 添加 /akuxivcollect 以扫描支持的游戏内收集解锁，并复制或保存 JSON 以供 https://ffxivcollect.com/import 使用。

Description.Original: Shows an improved ingame (and outgame map) and collects the seen information to display later.
Description.Translated: 显示改进后的游戏内（以及游戏外地图），并收集已见信息以便之后显示。

Punchline.Original: A radial wheel for quickly using actions in FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 用于在 FFXIV 中快速使用动作的径向轮盘。

Description.Original: Adds a customisable radial wheel to Final Fantasy XIV. Assign emotes or macros to slots, organise them across multiple pages, bind a key to open the wheel, and execute them with a single click. Supports per-character and per-page colour theming.
Description.Translated: 为 Final Fantasy XIV 添加可自定义的径向轮盘。将表情或宏分配到槽位，跨多个页面组织它们，绑定按键以打开轮盘，并单击即可执行。支持按角色和按页面的颜色主题。

Punchline.Original: Hides the on-screen visual when using the in-game /countdown.
Punchline.Translated: 使用游戏内 /countdown 时隐藏屏幕上的视觉显示。

Description.Original:
Suppresses the large on-screen countdown overlay produced by the /countdown command. The countdown still runs and fires normally — only the visual is hidden.

Commands:
/countdownhide — toggle the feature on/off
/countdownhide config — open settings
Description.Translated:
屏蔽 /countdown 命令产生的大型屏幕倒计时覆盖层。倒计时仍会正常计时并触发——只是隐藏了视觉显示。

命令：
/countdownhide — 开启/关闭该功能
/countdownhide config — 打开设置

Punchline.Original: Export your in-game macros to Discord for archival.
Punchline.Translated: 将游戏内宏导出到 Discord 以进行存档。

Description.Original:
MacroVault lets you send your FFXIV macros to a Discord channel via webhook.

Commands:
/mvexport — export the currently selected macro
/mvbackup — export all non-empty macros (both tabs)
/mv — open the settings window
Description.Translated:
MacroVault 可让你通过 webhook 将 FFXIV 宏发送到 Discord 频道。

命令：
/mvexport — 导出当前选中的宏
/mvbackup — 导出所有非空宏（两个标签页）
/mv — 打开设置窗口

Punchline.Original: Auto-replace words in your outgoing chat messages.
Punchline.Translated: 自动替换你发出的聊天消息中的词语。

Description.Original:
SharkChat intercepts your chat before it's sent and swaps words or phrases for whatever you want.
