Set up rules like Thanks → Thankies, and they'll apply automatically every time you chat — across any channel.

Features:
• Whole-word matching (so "tank" won't mangle "thanks")
• Case-insensitive by default
• Per-rule enable/disable
• Live preview so you can test rules before using them

Commands:
/shark — toggle on/off
/shark config — open settings
Description.Translated:
SharkChat 会在聊天发送前进行拦截，并将词语或短语替换为你想要的内容。

设置诸如 Thanks → Thankies 的规则，它们会在你每次聊天时自动生效——适用于任何频道。

功能：
• 全词匹配（因此 "tank" 不会误改 "thanks"）
• 默认不区分大小写
• 可针对每条规则单独启用/禁用
• 实时预览，可在使用前测试规则

命令：
/shark — 开启/关闭
/shark config — 打开设置

Punchline.Original: Pauses Artisan while GatherBuddy Reborn has work, then resumes it during dead windows.
Punchline.Translated: 在 GatherBuddy Reborn 有任务时暂停 Artisan，并在空窗期恢复。

Description.Original: Coordinates GatherBuddy Reborn and Artisan so timed gathering windows preempt crafting lists, with optional apartment-only crafting resume and conservative teleport-stall recovery.
Description.Translated: 协调 GatherBuddy Reborn 与 Artisan，使限时采集窗口优先于制作列表，并提供可选的仅在公寓内恢复制作以及保守的传送停滞恢复。

Punchline.Original: Records enemy actions by zone for logdata collection.
Punchline.Translated: 按区域记录敌人动作，用于日志数据收集。

Description.Original: Tracks actions used by battle NPCs/enemies in the current territory and exports observations as JSON and JSONL. Slash command: /akust
Description.Translated: 追踪当前区域内战斗 NPC/敌人使用的动作，并将观测数据导出为 JSON 和 JSONL。斜杠命令：/akust

Punchline.Original: Adds a quick special-symbol picker beside the chat mode button.
Punchline.Translated: 在聊天模式按钮旁添加快捷特殊符号选择器。

Description.Original: Adds a Quick Symbols button beside the chat mode selector and other text inputs.
Description.Translated: 在聊天模式选择器和其他文本输入框旁添加快捷符号按钮。

Punchline.Original: Manage and use custom emotes with Penumbra mod integration.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Penumbra 模组集成管理和使用自定义情感动作。

Description.Original: An emote management plugin with Penumbra mod association. Add/remove/rename/duplicate emotes, auto-toggle Penumbra mods, search and organize your emote collection. Use /emotes to open.
Description.Translated: 一个与 Penumbra 模组关联的情感动作管理插件。可添加/删除/重命名/复制情感动作，自动切换 Penumbra 模组，搜索并整理你的情感动作收藏。使用 /emotes 打开。

Punchline.Original: Stop the lobby error from closing your game, Kupo!
Punchline.Translated: 阻止大厅错误关闭你的游戏，库啵！

Description.Original: Prevents the game from closing on connection errors.
Description.Translated: 防止游戏因连接错误而关闭。

Punchline.Original: Trim CPU, GPU, and RAM on idle multibox clients via per-subsystem render hooks.
Punchline.Translated: 通过按子系统渲染钩子削减空闲多开客户端的 CPU、GPU 和 RAM 占用。

Description.Original: Per-subsystem render hook trimming for FFXIV. Disables individual rendering subsystems (animations, models, vfx, water, lights, etc.) to reduce CPU on idle multibox clients beyond what a basic render-skip plugin achieves. Each trim is independently toggleable. Includes a Working Set memory trim that dramatically reduces RAM footprint of background/AFK clients, and a multibox broadcast feature that propagates configuration to peer clients with one click.
Description.Translated: 面向 FFXIV 的按子系统渲染钩子裁剪。可禁用单个渲染子系统（动画、模型、VFX、水面、灯光等），以降低空闲多开客户端的 CPU 占用，效果超出基础渲染跳过插件。每项裁剪均可独立开关。包含 Working Set 内存裁剪，可大幅降低后台/挂机客户端的 RAM 占用，以及多开广播功能，可一键将配置传播到对等客户端。

Description.Original: A tool for Omni-100 players. Updates and saves the 'Optimize Gear' function for all healers, tanks, etc. with a single click.
Description.Translated: 面向 Omni-100 玩家的工具。一键为所有治疗、坦克等职业更新并保存“Optimize Gear”功能。

Punchline.Original: Track gil flow across self, retainers, and FC chest.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪自身、雇员和部队储物柜之间的金币流动。

Description.Original: An always-on gil tracker for FFXIV. Watches your own gil, every retainer, and the FC chest, classifies each change (submarine return, retainer sale, NPC purchase, marketboard buy, repair, etc.), and surfaces the flow through a configurable widget (4 density modes) and a dashboard (timeline / chart / breakdown / heatmap). Read-only — never writes back to game state. Six-language UI (EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO).
Description.Translated: 一个常驻的 FFXIV 金币追踪器。监控你自己的金币、每个雇员和部队储物柜，对每项变动进行分类（潜水艇收益、雇员出售、NPC 购买、市场布告板购买、修理等），并通过可配置的小部件（4 种密度模式）和仪表盘（时间线 / 图表 / 明细 / 热力图）展示金币流动。只读——绝不写回游戏状态。六语言 UI（EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO）。

Punchline.Original: An alternative to Customize+, with a true smithing studio.
Punchline.Translated: Customize+ 的替代品，带有真正的锻造工作室。

Description.Original: BoneSmith is an alternative to Customize+, with native profile and template handling, a true smithing studio, profile diagnostics, and safer appearance workflow tools.
Description.Translated: BoneSmith 是 Customize+ 的替代品，具有原生配置档案和模板处理、真正的锻造工作室、配置档案诊断，以及更安全的外观工作流工具。

Punchline.Original: Intelligent tab-targeting, also enabled in PvP.
Punchline.Translated: 智能 Tab 目标选择，在 PvP 中也可启用。

Description.Original: A fork of Better Targeting System that also runs in PvP. Only the target selection (camera-cone + proximity) is affected - no combat mechanics change.
Description.Translated: Better Targeting System 的分支，也可在 PvP 中运行。仅影响目标选择（摄像机锥形范围 + 距离），不改变战斗机制。

Punchline.Original: Shows the destination zone's concept art while loading
Punchline.Translated: 加载时显示目的地地区的概念图

Description.Original:
This plugin shows the destination zone's concept art while loading.
NOTE: ONLY LOOKS RIGHT ON 16:9 SCREENS! The concept art is not any bigger, and we can't expand/fix it. Sorry!
Description.Translated:
此插件在加载时显示目的地地区的概念图。
注意：仅在 16:9 屏幕上显示正常！概念图不会更大，我们无法扩展/修复它。抱歉！

Punchline.Original: Precise vanilla HUD editing.
Punchline.Translated: 精确的原生 HUD 编辑。

Description.Original: Enhances the vanilla HUD Layout editor without replacing it, adding snapping, undo/redo, precise coordinate placement, and pixel nudging with arrow buttons or keyboard arrow keys.
Description.Translated: 增强原生 HUD 布局编辑器而不替换它，添加吸附、撤销/重做、精确坐标放置，以及使用方向按钮或键盘方向键进行像素微调。

Punchline.Original:
自动记录每日随机任务，包括指导者随机任务。

Auto record your daily roulettes including mentor roulettes.
Punchline.Translated: 自动记录每日随机任务，包括指导者随机任务。

Description.Original:
帮助你记录每日随机任务、导出报告，并实时同步到 DungeonLogger。

Help you to record your daily roulettes, export reports, and sync with DungeonLogger in real time.
Description.Translated: 帮助你记录每日随机任务、导出报告，并实时同步到 DungeonLogger。

Punchline.Original: Race/job animation swaps + Glamourer territory automation
Punchline.Translated: 种族/职业动画互换 + Glamourer 区域自动化

Description.Original:
Swap walk/run animations between races. Swap weapon hold, movement, and auto-attack animations between jobs. Auto-apply Glamourer designs by territory.

Requires Penumbra (for animation swaps) and Glamourer (for glamour automation).
Description.Translated:
在不同种族之间互换走路/跑步动画。在不同职业之间互换持武器、移动和自动攻击动画。按区域自动应用 Glamourer 幻化方案。

需要 Penumbra（用于动画互换）和 Glamourer（用于幻化自动化）。

Punchline.Original: Run venue raffles with ticket tracking, macros, and winner draws.
Punchline.Translated: 通过票据追踪、宏和抽奖来运营场所抽奖活动。

Description.Original: A lightweight raffle ticket manager for FFXIV venues.
Description.Translated: 一个用于 FFXIV 场所的轻量级抽奖票据管理器。

Punchline.Original: An alternative simple frontend for Glamourer, because glamour is the real endgame.
Punchline.Translated: Glamourer 的另一个简单前端，因为幻化才是真正的终局玩法。

Description.Original: A custom simple frontend for applying designs from Glamourer. Lets you browse and apply designs, and optionally upload your own images to more easily be able to decide on which design to wear.
Description.Translated: 一个用于应用 Glamourer 幻化方案的自定义简单前端。让你可以浏览并应用方案，还可选择上传你自己的图片，以便更轻松地决定穿哪套方案。

Punchline.Original: Shows the animation currently playing and a session log of recent ones.
Punchline.Translated: 显示当前正在播放的动画，并记录近期动画的会话日志。

Description.Original: A minimal utility that displays your character's currently running animation and keeps a log of recent animations for as long as the window stays open.
Description.Translated: 一个极简工具，显示你角色当前正在运行的动画，并在窗口保持打开期间记录近期动画的日志。

Punchline.Original: Price imported and custom item lists from Universalis
Punchline.Translated: 从 Universalis 导入价格和自定义物品列表

Description.Original: Builds an item list manually or from artisan/teamcraft link imports, fetches marketboard prices from Universalis, and shows per-item plus total cost.
Description.Translated: 手动构建物品列表，或从 artisan/teamcraft 链接导入，从 Universalis 获取市场板价格，并显示每个物品及总成本。

Punchline.Original: Auto-react to emotes with emote, expression, and macro responses.
Punchline.Translated: 自动对情感动作做出反应，支持情感动作、表情和宏响应。

Description.Original: Credit to FoxShadow10 for the original AutoEmotion plugin. This version builds on that base and adds macro-slot responses directly in the Emote Reaction table, alongside emote and expression reactions.
Description.Translated: 归功于 FoxShadow10 的原始 AutoEmotion 插件。此版本在此基础上构建，并在 Emote Reaction 表中直接添加宏槽位响应，与情感动作和表情响应并列。

Punchline.Original: Keep your opener clean by avoiding accidental pre-pulls.
Punchline.Translated: 避免意外提前开怪，保持起手干净。

Description.Original: Prevents accidentally walking into boss aggro range before a pull. Automatically disables once combat starts.
Description.Translated: 防止在开怪前意外走入 Boss 仇恨范围。战斗开始后会自动禁用。

Punchline.Original: Browser overlays rendered in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内渲染的浏览器悬浮窗。

Description.Original:
Renders browser overlays in-game to enable playing in fullscreen (and G-SYNC) while having access to ACT overlays.
Use the settings button below or the '/bw config' command to configure.
Based on the BrowserHost plugin by ackwell.
Description.Translated:
在游戏内渲染浏览器悬浮窗，以便在全屏（和 G-SYNC）下也能使用 ACT 悬浮窗。
使用下方设置按钮或 '/bw config' 命令进行配置。
基于 ackwell 的 BrowserHost 插件。

Punchline.Original: Camera dynamics, animation swaps, glamour automation, and QoL tools for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: 相机动态、动画替换、幻化自动化以及面向 FFXIV 的 QoL 工具

Description.Original: All-in-one plugin: dynamic camera system, race/job animation swaps, Glamourer automation, custom teleport menu, compass overlay, HP vignette, MSQ teleport, chat bubbles, and more.
Description.Translated: 一体化插件：动态相机系统、种族/职业动画替换、Glamourer 自动化、自定义传送菜单、指南针悬浮窗、HP 晕影、MSQ 传送、聊天气泡等更多功能。

Punchline.Original: Remove letterboxing from cutscenes on ultrawide monitors.
Punchline.Translated: 移除超宽显示器下过场动画的黑边。

Description.Original:
Removes the letterboxing bars while watching cutscenes on ultrawide monitors.

This may expose scene edges, unloaded actors, or other content outside the intended camera framing.
Description.Translated:
移除超宽显示器上观看过场动画时的黑边。

这可能会暴露场景边缘、未加载的角色或其他预期镜头取景之外的内容。

Punchline.Original: Calendar reminders and official Lodestone event tracking.
Punchline.Translated: 日历提醒与官方 Lodestone 活动追踪。

Description.Original: A calendar for personal events, reminders, and official Lodestone in-game events. Use /pcalendar to open Eorzea Outlook.
Description.Translated: 用于个人事件、提醒及官方 Lodestone 游戏内活动的日历。使用 /pcalendar 打开 Eorzea Outlook。

Punchline.Original: Review and retrieve materia from your gear.
Punchline.Translated: 查看并从装备中取回魔晶石。

Description.Original: Adds a safe review window for retrieving attached materia from inventory and armory gear. Open it from /mr or an item's context menu, filter gearset and non-gearset items, then begin or cancel the retrieval queue when ready.
Description.Translated: 新增一个安全的查看窗口，用于从背包和兵装库装备中取回已镶嵌的魔晶石。可通过 /mr 或物品的右键菜单打开，筛选套装与非套装物品，然后在准备就绪后开始或取消取回队列。

Punchline.Original: Save and restore GPose camera presets.
Punchline.Translated: 保存与恢复 GPose 相机预设。

Description.Original: Save, load, and manage GPose camera presets.
Description.Translated: 保存、加载和管理 GPose 相机预设。

Punchline.Original: 地图编辑器 Map Editor
Punchline.Translated: 地图编辑器 Map Editor

Description.Original: 地图编辑器-你的世界。支持创建持久化角色/编辑本地物件等。Yourcraft creates and restores persistent actors, applies saved appearances, and edits local scene objects with GPose-aware rebuild support.
Description.Translated: 地图编辑器-你的世界。支持创建持久化角色/编辑本地物件等。Yourcraft 可创建并恢复持久化角色，应用已保存的外观，并支持 GPose 感知的重建来编辑本地场景物件。

Punchline.Original: Job-specific mount rotations with visual selection
Punchline.Translated: 按职业区分的坐骑轮换并可视化选择

Description.Original: Customize your mount experience! Set up job-specific mount rotations and summon them with a keybind or command. Includes multi-seat mount favorites and visual mount selection with icons.
Description.Translated: 自定义你的坐骑体验！设置按职业区分的坐骑轮换，并通过快捷键或命令召唤。包含多人坐骑收藏和带图标的可视化坐骑选择。

Punchline.Original:
在游戏里直接查看队伍战斗统计。
Local ACTX-style combat stats directly inside the game.
Punchline.Translated:
在游戏里直接查看队伍战斗统计。
在游戏内直接查看本地 ACTX 风格战斗统计。

Description.Original:
一个基于本地 ACTX 风格统计口径的 Dalamud 战斗统计插件，直接在游戏内显示队伍 DPS、HPS、承伤、概览和战斗历史，不依赖外部网页面板。支持宏命令 /dps settings、/dps dps、/dps skills 快速开关设置面板、DPS统计悬浮窗和技能监控悬浮窗。
Local ACTX-style combat meter for Dalamud. Displays party DPS, HPS, damage taken, overview summaries, and encounter history directly in game without relying on an external web overlay. Macro commands are available: /dps settings, /dps dps, /dps skills.
Description.Translated:
一个基于本地 ACTX 风格统计口径的 Dalamud 战斗统计插件，直接在游戏内显示队伍 DPS、HPS、承伤、概览和战斗历史，不依赖外部网页面板。支持宏命令 /dps settings、/dps dps、/dps skills 快速开关设置面板、DPS 统计悬浮窗和技能监控悬浮窗。
一个用于 Dalamud 的本地 ACTX 风格战斗统计插件。直接在游戏内显示队伍 DPS、HPS、承受伤害、概览摘要和战斗历史，不依赖外部网页悬浮层。可用宏命令：/dps settings、/dps dps、/dps skills。

Punchline.Original: 鎶婂父鐢ㄦ彃浠跺叆鍙ｆ敹绾虫垚鍙姌鍙犵殑鎮诞鍥炬爣鏍忋€?Collect common plugin entry points into a collapsible floating icon dock.
Punchline.Translated: 把常用插件入口收纳成可折叠的悬浮图标栏。

Description.Original: 鎶婂父鐢?Dalamud 鎻掍欢鐨勪富鐣岄潰鍜岃缃叆鍙ｆ敹绾冲埌涓€涓彲鎶樺彔鐨勬偓娴浘鏍囨爮閲岋紝骞舵彁渚涘彲閰嶇疆甯冨眬涓庡揩鎹疯闂€?Collect common Dalamud plugin entry points into a collapsible floating icon dock with configurable layout and quick access.
Description.Translated: 把常用 Dalamud 插件的主界面和设置入口收纳到一个可折叠的悬浮图标栏里，并提供可配置布局与快捷访问。

Punchline.Original: 鍏抽棴灞忚斀璇嶈繃婊わ紝骞堕珮浜亰澶╁拰鎷涘嫙鏉块噷鐨勫睆钄借瘝銆?Disable word-filter blocking and highlight filtered words in chat and Party Finder.
Punchline.Translated: 关闭屏蔽词过滤，并高亮聊天和 Party Finder 里的屏蔽词。

Description.Original: 鍏抽棴灞忚斀璇嶈繃婊わ紝骞剁壒娈婃樉绀鸿亰澶╅閬撴垨鎷涘嫙鏉垮彂鍑虹殑灞忚斀璇嶃€?Disable word-filter blocking and specially highlight filtered words from chat channels or the Party Finder.
Description.Translated: 关闭屏蔽词过滤，并特殊显示聊天频道或 Party Finder 发出的屏蔽词。

Punchline.Original: 鍦ㄥぉ涔︾晫闈㈠疄鏃舵樉绀鸿繛绾挎鐜囥€?Adds row probabilities to the Wondrous Tails display.
Punchline.Translated: 在 Wondrous Tails 界面实时显示连线概率。

Description.Original: 鍦ㄥぉ涔︾晫闈㈠疄鏃舵樉绀?1 绾裤€? 绾裤€? 绾挎鐜囷紝骞舵彁渚涢噸鎺掑悗鐨勫钩鍧囧弬鑰冦€?This plugin prints the probability of getting a row in Wondrous Tails to the in-game display along with the average probability of what would happen if you shuffled.
Description.Translated: 在 Wondrous Tails 界面实时显示 1 线、2 线、3 线概率，并提供重排后的平均参考。

Description.Original: Tracks gil trades and statistics.
Description.Translated: 追踪 Gil 交易和统计。

Punchline.Original: Simulate crafts, create computer-assisted macros, and get mid-craft suggestions from the comfort of your own game!
Punchline.Translated: 在你自己的游戏内即可模拟制作、创建计算机辅助宏，并获取制作中的建议！

Description.Original: Allows you to generate macros and simulate all sorts of crafts without having to open another app. Open your crafting log to get started! (.NET 10 / API 15 build)
Description.Translated: 允许你生成宏并模拟各种制作，无需打开其他应用。打开制作日志即可开始！(.NET 10 / API 15 build)

Punchline.Original: Track FFXIV unlockables and open their map locations.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪 FFXIV 可解锁内容并打开其地图位置。

Description.Original: Shows unlockable content, marks completed quest-backed entries when possible, keeps manual state for unsupported entries, opens map flags for known locations, can mark NPCs or retainer bells then run /gtf, and can run Lifestream shortcuts. Commands: /vunlock, /npc <name>, /bell, /inn, /mb, /jumbobuy, /fashion
Description.Translated: 显示可解锁内容，尽可能标记已完成且由任务支持的条目，为不支持的条目保留手动状态，为已知位置打开地图标记，可标记 NPC 或雇员铃，然后运行 /gtf，并可运行 Lifestream 快捷方式。命令：/vunlock, /npc <name>, /bell, /inn, /mb, /jumbobuy, /fashion

Punchline.Original: Live S-rank hunt tracker from Faloop, with one-click teleport via Lifestream.
Punchline.Translated: 来自 Faloop 的实时 S 级狩猎追踪器，可通过 Lifestream 一键传送。

Description.Original: Connects to Faloop's real-time websocket feed and shows S-rank spawn cards with a zoomed map preview and route hints. Echoes new spawns to chat with a clickable map link, plays a sound, and lets you teleport to the closest aetheryte (cross-world, via Lifestream). Commands: /faloop (full tracker), /faloopmini (slim auto-popping window), /faloopcompact (high-density view).
Description.Translated: 连接到 Faloop 的实时 websocket 数据流，显示 S 级刷新卡片，带有放大的地图预览和路线提示。将新刷新以可点击的地图链接回显到聊天、播放声音，并允许你传送到最近的以太之光（跨服，通过 Lifestream）。命令：/faloop（完整追踪器），/faloopmini（精简自动弹出窗口），/faloopcompact（高密度视图）。

Punchline.Original: Log what a watched player targets.
Punchline.Translated: 记录被监视玩家的目标。

Description.Original: Select a nearby player and track everything they target over time.
Description.Translated: 选择附近的一名玩家，并随时间追踪其所有目标。

Punchline.Original: Lets ReShade's accumulation depth-of-field add-ons drive the GPose camera.
Punchline.Translated: 让 ReShade 的累积景深插件驱动 GPose 相机。

Description.Original:
• Presents FFXIV's camera to ReShade as an IGCS camera tool, which is what accumulation depth-of-field add-ons need in order to work. Nothing has ever provided one for FFXIV before.

• Works with iMMERSE Parallax DoF and Otis_Inf's IGCS Depth of Field, and with their panorama and multishot capture.

• Frame the shot however you already do — Group Pose, Cammy, Brio. The camera is only taken over while an add-on is stacking frames, and handed straight back afterwards, so this does not compete with anything else you use.

• Requires ReShade 6.4+ with add-on support, plus a compatible depth-of-field add-on.

Type /camtools to see whether an add-on is connected.
Description.Translated:
• 将 FFXIV 的相机作为 IGCS camera tool 提供给 ReShade，这正是累积景深插件工作所需。此前从未为 FFXIV 提供过这样的工具。

• 可与 iMMERSE Parallax DoF 和 Otis_Inf's IGCS Depth of Field 配合使用，也支持它们的全景和多重拍摄捕获。

• 按你原有的方式构图 — Group Pose、Cammy、Brio。仅在插件堆叠帧时接管相机，之后立即交还，因此不会与你使用的其他任何东西冲突。

• 需要带插件支持的 ReShade 6.4+，以及兼容的景深插件。

输入 /camtools 查看是否有插件已连接。

Punchline.Original: A private contacts & places list.
Punchline.Translated: 私人联系人与地点列表。

Description.Original: Adds a private list for contacts and places. Right-click Add to privacy, profile images, notes, tells, party invites and more.
Description.Translated: 添加一个用于联系人和地点的私人列表。右键添加至隐私列表、个人资料图片、备注、悄悄话、小队邀请等。

Punchline.Original: Cappuccino now in game too!
Punchline.Translated: Cappuccino 现在也在游戏内了！

Description.Original: Displays market tax info, FC events, and more in a convenient UI.
Description.Translated: 在便捷的 UI 中显示市场税信息、FC 活动等。

Punchline.Original: Quickly toggle nameplate presets via chat commands.
Punchline.Translated: 通过聊天命令快速切换名牌预设。

Description.Original: Quickly toggle nameplate presets via chat commands.
Description.Translated: 通过聊天命令快速切换名牌预设。

Punchline.Original: FFXIV 2d20 tabletop toolkit
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 2d20 桌面游戏工具包

Description.Original: Character sheet, trackers, roller, and DM tools for Valor & Chaos in FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 用于 FFXIV 中 Valor & Chaos 的角色卡、追踪器、掷骰器和 DM 工具。

Punchline.Original: PvPSmart target selection on top of RotationSolverReborn.
Punchline.Translated: 在 RotationSolverReborn 之上加入 PvPSmart 目标选择。

Description.Original:
Personal fork of RotationSolverReborn that adds PvPSmart, a scoring-based PvP target selector. PvE behavior matches upstream.

The stock PvP cycle ranks targets by absolute current HP, which biases toward tanks over genuinely vulnerable squishies. PvPSmart composes weighted factors (role value, effective HP, finish-kill bias, mitigation penalty, distance, hysteresis, crystal carrier, LB cast, isolation, threat) and skips invuln targets entirely, producing more focus-fire-friendly target selection in Crystalline Conflict.

Use only if you specifically want the PvPSmart targeting mode. For general use, install upstream RotationSolverReborn instead.
Description.Translated:
RotationSolverReborn 的个人分支，新增 PvPSmart——一个基于评分的 PvP 目标选择器。PvE 行为与上游一致。

原生 PvP 循环按当前绝对 HP 对目标排序，这会让坦克比真正脆弱的脆皮更受偏向。PvPSmart 综合加权因素（角色价值、有效 HP、斩杀偏向、减伤惩罚、距离、滞回、水晶携带者、LB 释放、孤立、威胁）并完全跳过无敌目标，从而在 Crystalline Conflict 中产生更利于集火的目标选择。

仅当你特别想要 PvPSmart 目标选择模式时使用。一般用途请安装上游 RotationSolverReborn。

Punchline.Original: Personal fork of Dagobert.
Punchline.Translated: Dagobert 的个人分支。

Description.Original: Personal fork of Dagobert, the automatic market board undercut plugin. Adds bait listing protection so a 1-unit decoy at 5 gil can't drag your retainer prices to the floor while real stacks sit at 1.2k. If you don't need that, install upstream Dagobert instead.
Description.Translated: Dagobert 的个人分支，Dagobert 是自动市场板压价插件。新增诱饵挂单保护，使 5 gil 的 1 单位诱饵无法在你的真实堆叠仍为 1.2k 时把你的雇员价格拖到最低。如果你不需要这个功能，请改安装上游 Dagobert。

Punchline.Original: Wondrous Tails row probabilities, on API 15.
Punchline.Translated: 基于 API 15 的 Wondrous Tails 行概率。

Description.Original: Personal fork of MidoriKami's EzWondrousTails, ported to Dalamud API 15 after the upstream repository was archived. Injects row probabilities, exact shuffle averages, and shuffle advice into the Wondrous Tails journal, and adds a standalone plugin window so the same information is reachable when the journal isn't open.
Description.Translated: MidoriKami 的 EzWondrousTails 的个人分支，在上游仓库归档后移植到 Dalamud API 15。将行概率、精确洗牌平均值和洗牌建议注入 Wondrous Tails 日志，并添加独立插件窗口，以便在日志未打开时也能获取相同信息。

Punchline.Original: Market and retainer-sales intelligence.
Punchline.Translated: 市场与雇员销售情报。

Description.Original: Market and retainer-sales intelligence for FFXIV. Reads your own retainer listings and completed sales from the game client and pairs them with board-wide market context (listings, sales history, velocity) from the Universalis API.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 的市场与雇员销售情报。从游戏客户端读取你自己的雇员挂单和已完成销售，并将其与来自 Universalis API 的全市场背景（挂单、销售历史、成交速度）配对。

Punchline.Original: Overlay compositor and second-skin renderer for Penumbra mods
Punchline.Translated: 用于 Penumbra 模组的叠加层合成器与第二皮肤渲染器

Description.Original:
• Lets you use overlays — skin-tight gear, tattoos, scales and the like — as a regular Penumbra mod you can toggle on and off, bind to designs and collections, and more.

• Overlays render two ways. Painted into your skin, except now your overlays are dyeable. Or as a second skin, which lets you use sphere maps, metalness and animated glow that skin materials can't do.

• Cloth overlays can enable skindenting with one click.

• Supports Penumbra .pmp and Onion .omp packs.

• Imports Atramentum Luminis glow tattoos (.ttmp2). Their glow becomes a Proteus overlay you can recolour and dim, with no shader mod needed.

• Import regular old mods and equip them without using a gear slot.

• Add toggles to any mod.

Automatically make all hairs hat-compatible.

Type /proteus to manage your Proteus mods.
Description.Translated:
• 让你将叠加层——紧身装备、纹身、鳞片等——作为常规 Penumbra 模组使用，可开关、绑定到设计与收藏等。

• 叠加层有两种渲染方式。绘制到你的皮肤上，但现在你的叠加层可染色。或者作为第二皮肤，从而使用皮肤材质无法实现的球面贴图、金属度和动画发光。

• 布料叠加层可一键启用 skindenting。

• 支持 Penumbra .pmp 和 Onion .omp 包。

• 导入 Atramentum Luminis 发光纹身（.ttmp2）。其发光会变成可重新着色和调暗的 Proteus 叠加层，无需着色器模组。

• 导入常规旧模组，并无需占用装备栏即可装备它们。

• 为任意模组添加开关。

自动使所有发型兼容帽子。

输入 /proteus 管理你的 Proteus 模组。

Punchline.Original: Limits frame rate based on GPU usage.
Punchline.Translated: 根据 GPU 使用率限制帧率。

Description.Original: Dynamic frame rate limiter to allow GPU headroom for Windows to do other things, preventing other apps like Discord and YouTube from freezing when FFXIV is in focus.
Description.Translated: 动态帧率限制器，为 Windows 留出 GPU 余量以处理其他任务，防止 FFXIV 处于焦点时 Discord 和 YouTube 等应用卡死。

Punchline.Original: For when you want to know how much you spend/earn in ffxiv!
Punchline.Translated: 用于想知道自己在 FFXIV 中花了/赚了多少的时候！

Description.Original: For when you want to know how much you spend/earn in ffxiv!
Description.Translated: 用于想知道自己在 FFXIV 中花了/赚了多少的时候！

Punchline.Original: Highlighting of card status effects.
Punchline.Translated: 高亮卡牌状态效果。

Description.Original: A tool to make it easier to track who has already got a card buff. To prevent you from accidentally double-buffing those sneaky DPS's trying to keep all the buffs to themselves!
Description.Translated: 用于更轻松地追踪谁已经获得卡牌增益的工具。防止你不小心给那些试图独占所有增益的狡猾 DPS 重复上增益！

Punchline.Original: Auto-greet and track visitors in FFXIV housing venues.
Punchline.Translated: 自动迎接并追踪 FFXIV 房屋场地的访客。

Description.Original: Housing venue visitor queue and greeting assistant.
Description.Translated: 房屋场地访客排队与迎接助手。

Punchline.Original: High-precision telemetry logging engine for Monk duels.
Punchline.Translated: 用于武僧对决的高精度遥测记录引擎。

Description.Original: High-precision vector and combat tracking telemetry engine for Monk mirror matches.
Description.Translated: 用于武僧镜像对局的高精度向量与战斗追踪遥测引擎。

Punchline.Original: Allows you to sculpt and export your face to C+ in a comfortable way.
Punchline.Translated: 以舒适的方式雕刻你的面部并导出到 C+。

Description.Original: Visual face bone sculpting with brush tools, mirroring, and direct Customize+ import/export.
Description.Translated: 使用画笔工具进行可视化面部骨骼雕刻，支持镜像和直接导入/导出 Customize+。

Punchline.Original: Native high-resolution screenshots with region, hotkey, and ReShade post-effects support.
Punchline.Translated: 原生高分辨率截图，支持区域选择、快捷键和 ReShade 后期效果。

Description.Original: Adds /blens commands and a settings window for scaled full-frame or region screenshots, UI hide/restore, custom save paths, keyboard shortcuts, and ReShade post-effects capture when available.
Description.Translated: 新增 /blens 命令和设置窗口，用于缩放的全帧或区域截图、隐藏/恢复 UI、自定义保存路径、键盘快捷键，以及在可用时捕获 ReShade 后期效果。

Punchline.Original: Control internal render policy from Dalamud.
Punchline.Translated: 从 Dalamud 控制内部渲染策略。

Description.Original: It help you save on electricity bills by blocking 3D rendering.
Description.Translated: 通过阻止 3D 渲染帮你节省电费。

Punchline.Original: Doman Mahjong, solved for you.
Punchline.Translated: 多玛方城战，替你解。

Description.Original: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and either suggests the best discard or plays the match for you.
Description.Translated: 读取你的多玛方城战手牌，并给出最佳弃牌建议或直接替你打完对局。

Punchline.Original: Daily allied tribe quests, done for you.
Punchline.Translated: 每日友好部族任务，替你完成。

Description.Original: Does your daily allied tribe quests for you: tick the tribes, the plugin handles the rest.
Description.Translated: 为你完成每日友好部族任务：勾选部族，插件处理其余一切。

Punchline.Original: Custom build of Glamourer by MTVirux with added features
Punchline.Translated: 由 MTVirux 制作的 Glamourer 自定义构建版，带有额外功能

Description.Original: DM @mtvirux on discord for assistance or bug reports. THIS REPLACES GLAMOURER, so make sure to uninstall either Glamourer or GlamorousTerror before installing the other.
Description.Translated: 如需帮助或报告 bug，请在 Discord 私信 @mtvirux。本插件会替换 Glamourer，因此安装其中之一前请确认已卸载 Glamourer 或 GlamorousTerror。

Punchline.Original: Custom build of Market Board Plugin
Punchline.Translated: Market Board Plugin 自定义构建版

Description.Original: Custom build of Market Board Plugin with Lifestream and FFXIVMT sales data. /pmb to open
Description.Translated: 带有 Lifestream 和 FFXIVMT 销售数据的 Market Board Plugin 自定义构建版。使用 /pmb 打开

Punchline.Original: Smart player messages translation tool for FF14
Punchline.Translated: FF14 智能玩家消息翻译工具

Description.Original: Listens to the chat channels you choose and echoes a translation back in your target language. Japanese can show romaji and Chinese can show pinyin in parentheses. Sends translated messages on your active channel via /jp and /zh. Open settings with /ducfg, /duconfig, or /duduconfig.
Description.Translated: 监听你选择的聊天频道，并以你的目标语言回显翻译。日语可显示 romaji，中文可在括号中显示拼音。通过 /jp 和 /zh 在当前频道发送翻译后的消息。使用 /ducfg、/duconfig 或 /duduconfig 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: GW2-inspired manual tab targeting for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 受 GW2 启发的 FFXIV 手动 Tab 目标选择。

Description.Original: Tyrian Targeting is a GW2-inspired manual targeting refinement plugin for FFXIV. It improves tab targeting with configurable target cycling, called targets, target markers, presets, filters, and theme options while keeping all targeting fully manual.
Description.Translated: Tyrian Targeting 是一个受 GW2 启发的 FFXIV 手动目标选择优化插件。它通过可配置的目标循环、目标呼叫、目标标记、预设、过滤器和主题选项来改进 Tab 目标选择，同时保持所有目标选择完全手动。

Punchline.Original: Auto-chain Shared FATEs across ShB/EW/DT.
Punchline.Translated: 自动串联 ShB/EW/DT 的共享 FATE。

Description.Original:
Open-world FATE grinder. Walks between FATEs, mounts, flies, engages, and chains across zones. Uses vnavmesh for pathfinding, BossmodReborn (FateUtils + autorotation) for combat, and Lifestream for cross-zone teleport.

Required plugins: vnavmesh, BossmodReborn, Lifestream
Description.Translated:
开放世界 FATE 刷取工具。在 FATE 之间移动、上坐骑、飞行、交战，并跨区域串联。使用 vnavmesh 寻路，BossmodReborn（FateUtils + 自动循环）进行战斗，Lifestream 进行跨区域传送。

必需插件：vnavmesh、BossmodReborn、Lifestream

Punchline.Original: Because gardening shouldn't be a full-time job.
Punchline.Translated: 因为园艺不该是一份全职工作。

Description.Original: Full-featured FFXIV gardening plugin with automated tending, harvesting, planting, crossbreeding optimization, and status tracking. Handles the tedious work so you can focus on the fun parts of gardening.
Description.Translated: 功能齐全的 FFXIV 园艺插件，支持自动照料、收获、种植、杂交优化和状态追踪。处理繁琐工作，让你专注于园艺中有趣的部分。

Punchline.Original: Plays Spotify when you mount up.
Punchline.Translated: 骑乘时播放 Spotify。

Description.Original: Automatically mutes game BGM and starts Spotify playback when you mount your mount. Restores BGM and pauses Spotify when you dismount.
Description.Translated: 当你骑上坐骑时，自动静音游戏 BGM 并开始 Spotify 播放。下坐骑时恢复 BGM 并暂停 Spotify。

Description.Original: Lightweight plugin to help with Venue Hosting.
Description.Translated: 用于协助 Venue Hosting 的轻量级插件。

Punchline.Original: Turns a loose, unsorted mod list into a real folder structure - not for already-organized libraries.
Punchline.Translated: 把松散、未整理的 mod 列表变成真正的文件夹结构——不适用于已经整理好的库。

Description.Original: Best for a loose, unsorted mod list - takes it from chaos to a reasonable folder structure in one pass. If you've already built your own folder scheme, this probably isn't for you: auto-categorization is based on equipment/customization data and won't reproduce a hand-tuned taxonomy, and animation/skeleton/UI/tool mods can't be auto-sorted at all (Penumbra doesn't expose that data). Always review before applying. Note: Penumbra's API doesn't support deleting folders, so folders left empty after a sort must be removed manually in Penumbra's own mod list.
Description.Translated: 最适合松散、未整理的 mod 列表——一次性把它从混乱变成合理的文件夹结构。如果你已经建立了自己的文件夹方案，这大概率不适合你：自动分类基于装备/自定义数据，无法复现手动调整的分类体系，并且动画/骨骼/UI/工具 mod 完全无法自动排序（Penumbra 不会暴露这些数据）。应用前请务必检查。注意：Penumbra 的 API 不支持删除文件夹，因此排序后留下的空文件夹必须在 Penumbra 自己的 mod 列表中手动删除。

Punchline.Original: Unsticks DLSS from DLAA.
Punchline.Translated: 将 DLSS 与 DLAA 解绑。

Description.Original: Automatically sets upscaling to FSR in the main menu (to allow render resolution scaling) and switches to DLSS on login (to force custom resolutions from DLSS Tweaker).
Description.Translated: 在主菜单中自动将上采样设为 FSR（以允许渲染分辨率缩放），并在登录时切换到 DLSS（以强制使用来自 DLSS Tweaker 的自定义分辨率）。

Punchline.Original: Frontline automation plugin.
Punchline.Translated: 前线自动化插件。

Description.Original: Required plugins: vnavmesh, Rotation Solver Reborn.
Description.Translated: 前置插件：vnavmesh、Rotation Solver Reborn。

Punchline.Original: Customizable DTR overlay.
Punchline.Translated: 可自定义的 DTR 悬浮窗。

Description.Original: Create customizable DTR overlay.
Description.Translated: 创建可自定义的 DTR 悬浮窗。

Punchline.Original: Turn retainer listing from market-board chore into one-click momentum.
Punchline.Translated: 把雇员上架从市场板杂活变成一键搞定的流程。

Description.Original: AutoList turns retainer Market Board chores into supervised AutoList, AutoRefresh, and AutoTidy workflows with a small in-game tray that lights up when your character is ready to start.
Description.Translated: AutoList 将雇员的市场板上架杂活转变为可监督的 AutoList、AutoRefresh 和 AutoTidy 工作流，并配有小型游戏内托盘，当角色准备就绪时托盘会亮起。

Punchline.Original: See craft cost vs market price at a glance.
Punchline.Translated: 一眼看清制作成本与市场价格的对比。

Description.Original: Crafting profit tracker for FFXIV. Compares craft costs against market board prices in item tooltips, scans for the most profitable recipes to craft, and builds shopping lists with max-price guidance. Made by Aygea — twitch.tv/crazyaygea
Description.Translated: FFXIV 制作利润追踪器。在物品提示框中对比制作成本与市场板价格，扫描最赚钱的制作配方，并生成带有最高价格参考的购物清单。作者：Aygea — twitch.tv/crazyaygea

Punchline.Original: Whisper management with tell target dropdown and quick-reply.
Punchline.Translated: 带悄悄话目标下拉菜单和快速回复的密语管理。

Description.Original: Personal fork of ChatTwo with quality-of-life improvements: tell target dropdown for easy whisper switching, cross-world aware target tracking, and performance optimizations. Based on Infiziert90/ChatTwo. Made by Aygea — twitch.tv/crazyaygea
Description.Translated: ChatTwo 的个人分支，带来体验优化：悄悄话目标下拉菜单以便轻松切换密语对象、跨服目标追踪，以及性能优化。基于 Infiziert90/ChatTwo。作者：Aygea — twitch.tv/crazyaygea

Punchline.Original: FATEs, farmed for you.
Punchline.Translated: FATEs，为你刷取。

Description.Original: Farms FATEs for you: tick the zones, and the plugin teleports in, finds active FATEs, and runs them in a loop until your target is met.
Description.Translated: 为你刷 FATEs：勾选区域，插件会传送过去，寻找活跃的 FATEs，并循环执行，直到达成你的目标。

Punchline.Original: PvP Series, grinded for you.
Punchline.Translated: PvP Series，为你刷取。

Description.Original: Grinds PvP Series Malmstones for you: queues and plays Casual Matches in a loop until your goal is met.
Description.Translated: 为你刷 PvP Series Malmstones：循环排队并进行 Casual Matches，直到达成你的目标。

Punchline.Original: A smartphone, built for you.
Punchline.Translated: 一部智能手机，为你打造。

Description.Original: An in-game smartphone that puts everything you do into a single window: one device, endless things to do.
Description.Translated: 一个游戏内智能手机，将你所做的一切集中到一个窗口：一台设备，无尽事项可做。

Punchline.Original: Hunt bills, cleared for you.
Punchline.Translated: 狩猎通缉令，为你清完。

Description.Original: Clears your hunt bills for you: tick the daily and weekly bills you want, and the plugin picks them up at the hunt board, finds every mark, and fights it until each bill is done.
Description.Translated: 为你清理狩猎通缉令：勾选你想要的每日和每周通缉令，插件会在狩猎板上接取它们，找到每个目标，并战斗直到每张通缉令完成。

Description.Original: Automates dungeon farming, GC expert delivery, and grand company item purchasing. Supports AutoDuty and ADS.
Description.Translated: 自动化副本刷取、GC 专家交付和大国防联军物品购买。支持 AutoDuty 和 ADS。

Punchline.Original: Right skill. Right second. Every pull.
Punchline.Translated: 正确的技能。正确的那一秒。每次开怪。

Description.Original: Build or import a timeline, auto-load by zone, job, and Phase preset, then follow cues on list and major overlays with optional hotbar icon highlights.
Description.Translated: 创建或导入时间轴，按区域、职业和 Phase 预设自动加载，然后在列表和主要悬浮窗上跟随提示，可选高亮热键栏图标。

Punchline.Original: A slidecast marker over your native castbar.
Punchline.Translated: 在原生咏唱条上显示滑步标记。

Description.Original: Draws slidecast timing as an overlay on the native castbar.
Description.Translated: 将滑步时机绘制为原生咏唱条上的覆盖层。

Punchline.Original: A customizable quick panel overlay.
Punchline.Translated: 可自定义的快捷面板悬浮窗。

Description.Original: A customizable quick panel overlay for actions, items, macros, and text commands, with multiple pages and style presets.
Description.Translated: 可自定义的快捷面板悬浮窗，用于技能、物品、宏和文本命令，支持多页面和样式预设。

Punchline.Original: Hide models locally, clear the HUD, and lock the camera for cleaner overlays.
Punchline.Translated: 本地隐藏模型、清空 HUD 并锁定镜头，以获得更干净的悬浮窗。

Description.Original: Hides player, pet, NPC, and enemy models without despawning them, so position-based overlays like Splatoon still track. Optionally replace models with dummies, hide nameplates with Enable Veilay, hide selected HUD Layout elements, mute battle effects, target lines, fly text, and pop-up text during duty replay, and lock the camera. Models, HUD, and camera each apply independently; character-config changes stay replay-only.
Description.Translated: 隐藏玩家、宠物、NPC 和敌人模型而不使其消失，因此像 Splatoon 这样基于位置的悬浮窗仍能追踪。可选择将模型替换为假人、使用 Enable Veilay 隐藏名牌、隐藏选定的 HUD 布局元素、在副本回放期间静音战斗特效、目标连线、浮动文字和弹出文字，并锁定镜头。模型、HUD 和镜头各自独立生效；角色配置更改仅在回放中有效。

Punchline.Original: Manual mark assist via party-aligned hotbar highlights.
Punchline.Translated: 通过按队伍顺序对齐的热键栏高亮来辅助手动标记。

Description.Original: Highlights mark-macro hotbar slots by party order for manual marking.
Description.Translated: 按队伍顺序高亮标记宏热键栏槽位，用于手动标记。

Punchline.Original: Stops the Command Panel from closing on death, wipes, and zone changes.
Punchline.Translated: 阻止 Command Panel 在死亡、团灭和区域切换时关闭。

Description.Original: Keeps the in-game Command Panel open through deaths, instance resets, and area transitions. Toggle with /cmdpanelpersist [on|off].
Description.Translated: 让游戏内 Command Panel 在死亡、副本重置和区域切换期间保持打开。使用 /cmdpanelpersist [on|off] 切换。

Punchline.Original: A cyberdeck companion for The Grid venue.
Punchline.Translated: The Grid 场馆的 cyberdeck 伴侣。

Description.Original: Opens a cyberdeck-style venue app for The Grid: map, menu, syncshell, Discord, crew profiles, broadcasts, local network presence, and Penumbra install and update tools.
Description.Translated: 为 The Grid 打开 cyberdeck 风格的场馆应用：地图、菜单、syncshell、Discord、crew 档案、广播、本地网络在线状态，以及 Penumbra 安装和更新工具。

Punchline.Original: 4x4 in-game shortcut pad for FF14 and plugin commands.
Punchline.Translated: 用于 FF14 和插件命令的 4x4 游戏内快捷面板。

Description.Original: A Dalamud in-game shortcut pad with 10 saved pages, 4x4 icon buttons, editable labels, FF14 commands, other plugin commands, icon paths, and Japanese settings UI.
Description.Translated: 一个 Dalamud 游戏内快捷面板，包含 10 个已保存页面、4x4 图标按钮、可编辑标签、FF14 命令、其他插件命令、图标路径，以及日文设置 UI。

Punchline.Original: Exports FF14 icons as PNG files for FF14 PC Shortcut Pad.
Punchline.Translated: 将 FF14 图标导出为 PNG 文件，供 FF14 PC Shortcut Pad 使用。

Description.Original: Exports FF14 hotbar, cross hotbar, action menu, macro, mount, minion, emote, item, and job icons as PNG files for FF14 PC Shortcut Pad.
Description.Translated: 将 FF14 热键栏、十字热键栏、动作菜单、宏、坐骑、宠物、情感动作、物品和职业图标导出为 PNG 文件，供 FF14 PC Shortcut Pad 使用。

Punchline.Original: Your real, observed retainer-venture odds.
Punchline.Translated: 你实际观察到的雇员探险概率。

Description.Original: Logs every retainer venture return and computes your own observed drop rate for tracked items (Peregrine Helm, Onion gear, etc.). No invented percentages — just your data, with a confidence interval so small samples don't lie.
Description.Translated: 记录每次雇员探险回报，并计算你追踪物品（Peregrine Helm、Onion gear 等）的实际观察掉落率。没有编造的百分比——只有你的数据，并附带置信区间，避免小样本说谎。

Punchline.Original: Offline-first chatbot scaffold with per-account and per-character policy.
Punchline.Translated: 离线优先的聊天机器人脚手架，支持按账号和按角色策略。

Description.Original: Offline-first chatbot scaffold with per-account and per-character policy.
Description.Translated: 离线优先的聊天机器人脚手架，支持按账号和按角色策略。

Punchline.Original: Making Final Fantasy more accessible to everyone.
Punchline.Translated: 让 Final Fantasy 对每个人都更易于使用。

Description.Original: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech functionality.
Description.Translated: 语音转文字和文字转语音功能。

Punchline.Original: Highlights your mitigation spells in real time during fights. Works with xivmitigation.com.
Punchline.Translated: 在战斗中实时高亮你的减伤技能。可与 xivmitigation.com 配合使用。

Description.Original: Reads an XIVMitigation plan file and shows an in-game overlay with upcoming spells for your role. Works with plans exported from XIVMitigation (https://xivmitigation.com). Use /xivmit to toggle the overlay, /xivmit config to open settings.
Description.Translated: 读取 XIVMitigation 方案文件，并显示游戏内悬浮窗，展示你所在职能即将使用的技能。可与从 XIVMitigation (https://xivmitigation.com) 导出的方案配合使用。使用 /xivmit 切换悬浮窗，使用 /xivmit config 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Safely clean unused gear from your Armoury Chest.
Punchline.Translated: 安全清理兵装库中未使用的装备。

Description.Original: Armoryeet finds Armoury Chest items that are not equipped or used by any gearset. Review and select the results, then move them to your inventory with capacity checks, movement safeguards, and a final gearset recheck.
Description.Translated: Armoryeet 会找出兵装库中未装备或未被任何套装使用的物品。查看并选择结果，然后在进行容量检查、移动保护和最终套装复查后，将它们移至你的背包。

Punchline.Original: Hosted blackjack tables with friends.
Punchline.Translated: 与好友开设主持式二十一点牌桌。

Description.Original: Adds private blackjack tables for friends. In hosted games, the host acts as dealer and banker: players trade bets to the host, and the host manually pays winnings. Bot games are no-bet practice rounds. The plugin tracks table state and payouts but does not automate gil transfer.
Description.Translated: 为好友添加私人二十一点牌桌。在主持对局中，主持人担任庄家和银行家：玩家将赌注交易给主持人，主持人手动支付赢利。机器人对局为无赌注练习局。该插件会跟踪牌桌状态和赔付，但不会自动转移金币。

Punchline.Original: Synchro ta progression FFXIV vers XIVPath.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的 FFXIV 进度同步到 XIVPath。

Description.Original: Synchronise automatiquement ta progression FFXIV vers XIVPath : niveaux de jobs, quetes MSQ, donjons/defis/raids accomplis. Synchro plugin-first avec dedup et signaux gameplay precis (job actif, quete suivie, roulettes daily, groupe).
Description.Translated: 自动将你的 FFXIV 进度同步到 XIVPath：职业等级、MSQ 任务、已完成的地下城/讨伐战/raid。以插件优先方式同步，带去重和精确的游戏信号（当前职业、正在追踪的任务、每日随机任务、队伍）。

Punchline.Original: Remove letterboxing from cutscenes on ultrawide monitors.
Punchline.Translated: 在超宽显示器上移除过场动画中的黑边。

Description.Original:
This plugin removes the letterboxing bars when watching cutscenes on ultrawide monitors.
Beware! You may see things that you are not supposed to be seeing, such as upcoming NPCs popping in or T-posing.

Thanks to aers for finding this.
Description.Translated:
此插件会在超宽显示器上观看过场动画时移除黑边。
注意！你可能会看到本不该看到的内容，例如即将登场的 NPC 突然弹出或摆出 T-pose。

感谢 aers 发现此问题。

Punchline.Original: Automatically dismiss your minion when entering a house and summon it back when you leave
Punchline.Translated: 进入房屋时自动收回你的宠物，离开时自动重新召唤。

Description.Original: Automatically dismiss your minion when entering a house and summon it back when you leave
Description.Translated: 进入房屋时自动收回你的宠物，离开时自动重新召唤。

Punchline.Original: DICE! GAMES! UNO! Cards Against Humanity!
Punchline.Translated: 骰子！游戏！UNO！Cards Against Humanity！

Description.Original: A fun collection of bar games, Cards Against Humanity, Liar's Dice and UNO
Description.Translated: 有趣的酒吧游戏合集，包括 Cards Against Humanity、Liar's Dice 和 UNO

Punchline.Original: Enhanced Party Finder with filtering, sorting, search, and custom alerts.
Punchline.Translated: 增强的 Party Finder，支持筛选、排序、搜索和自定义提醒。

Description.Original:
View FFXIV party listings with advanced filtering, sorting, and search capabilities. Set up custom alerts for specific duties or conditions. Use /pfex to open.

This uses the https://xivpf.com website as it's datasource and will also contribute pf listings back to the site.
Description.Translated:
查看 FFXIV 队伍招募列表，具备高级筛选、排序和搜索功能。可为特定任务或条件设置自定义提醒。使用 /pfex 打开。

此插件使用 https://xivpf.com 网站作为数据源，并会将 PF 列表回传到该网站。

Punchline.Original: An essential companion app for all Studium members.
Punchline.Translated: 面向所有 Studium 成员的必备伴侣应用。

Description.Original: The Studium app is an essential companion app for all Studium Members.
Description.Translated: Studium 应用是所有 Studium 成员的必备伴侣应用。

Punchline.Original: Custom Quest Banners
Punchline.Translated: 自定义任务横幅

Description.Original: Adds several bits of UI inspired by recent Zelda games. Currently supports Quest Banners and Duty Banners.
Description.Translated: 添加了一些受近期 Zelda 游戏启发的 UI 元素。目前支持 Quest Banners 和 Duty Banners。

Punchline.Original: In-game FC project tracker, trading scanner, and craft helper.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内 FC 项目追踪器、交易扫描器和制作助手。

Description.Original: Browse open FC craft projects and claim tasks directly from inside the game. Trading queries, item search, and craft-from-inventory with live Marketboard prices.
Description.Translated: 在游戏内直接浏览开放的 FC 制作项目并领取任务。支持交易查询、物品搜索，以及结合实时 Marketboard 价格的背包内制作。

Punchline.Original: Combined GPose toolkit - posing, animation, camera, and scene tools in one plugin.
Punchline.Translated: 整合式 GPose 工具包 - 将摆姿势、动画、相机和场景工具集于一个插件。

Description.Original:
Starfall Studio - combined GPose toolkit for actor posing, animation control, camera editing, and scene building.
- Actor list with click-to-select
- World-space transform gizmo
- Animation control and pause
- Advanced appearance and wetness editing
- Camera editor (Ktisis-style workflow)
- Bone manipulation with bone tree
- MCDF actor import
- NPC/overworld actor import
- Pose import and export
Description.Translated:
Starfall Studio - 用于角色摆姿势、动画控制、相机编辑和场景搭建的整合式 GPose 工具包。
- 可点击选择的角色列表
- 世界空间变换控件
- 动画控制与暂停
- 高级外观和湿润度编辑
- 相机编辑器（Ktisis 风格工作流）
- 通过骨骼树进行骨骼操作
- MCDF 角色导入
- NPC/野外角色导入
- 姿势导入与导出

Punchline.Original: Readable cooldowns and a barrier-aware party panel.
Punchline.Translated: 易读的冷却时间和可感知屏障的小队面板。

Description.Original: On-screen cooldown bars plus a Sage-focused party panel that tracks barriers, HP/MP, and statuses at a glance. Toggle with /clearsight; /clearsight party for the party panel.
Description.Translated: 屏幕上的冷却时间条，以及一个以 Sage 为重点的小队面板，可一目了然地追踪屏障、HP/MP 和状态。使用 /clearsight 切换；/clearsight party 打开小队面板。

Punchline.Original: Bulk-desynth items by bag, ID, or filter — dry-run preview before anything actually happens.
Punchline.Translated: 按背包、ID 或筛选条件批量分解物品——实际操作前先进行空跑预览。

Description.Original:
Queue and run bulk desynthesis jobs without clicking each item by hand. Target by item ID, bag, item-level / equipment-slot filters, or armoury chest category. Every job is dry-run first: the plugin builds a preview list of slots it intends to desynth, you click Confirm, then it walks the list one item at a time on the framework tick.

Usage:
  /bds         - open the main window
  /bds bag <n> - preview bag N (1-4)
  /bds item <itemId> - preview every copy of an item in inventory
  /bds stop    - cancel a running queue
Description.Translated:
无需逐个手动点击物品，即可排队并执行批量分解任务。可按物品 ID、背包、物品等级 / 装备栏位筛选条件，或兵装库分类来指定目标。每个任务都会先空跑：插件会生成一份准备分解的栏位预览列表，你点击确认后，它会在框架 tick 上逐个处理列表中的物品。

用法：
  /bds         - 打开主窗口
  /bds bag <n> - 预览背包 N（1-4）
  /bds item <itemId> - 预览背包中该物品的每一份
  /bds stop    - 取消正在执行的任务队列

Punchline.Original: Automatically greet players who enter your defined area.
Punchline.Translated: 自动问候进入你所定义区域的玩家。

Description.Original: /gg - Opens the Greety Greeter panel. Define a sphere or cube zone, and the plugin will automatically send customizable /tell sequences to any player who enters it.
Description.Translated: /gg - 打开 Greety Greeter 面板。定义一个球形或立方体区域，插件就会自动向任何进入该区域的玩家发送可自定义的 /tell 序列。

Punchline.Original: WoW-style floating combat text.
Punchline.Translated: 《魔兽世界》风格的浮动战斗文字。

Description.Original: Replaces ability damage flytext with a yellow value (no name, no damage-type icon) and strips the icon from auto-attack damage.
Description.Translated: 将技能伤害浮动文字替换为黄色数值（不含名字、不含伤害类型图标），并移除自动攻击伤害的图标。

Punchline.Original: i love roblox!!!
Punchline.Translated: 我爱 Roblox!!!

Description.Original: Play the OOF! sound on fall and/or death. The Only Plugin You Need!
Description.Translated: 在坠落和/或死亡时播放 OOF! 音效。你唯一需要的插件！

Punchline.Original: This was supposed to be simple...
Punchline.Translated: 这本该很简单的……

Description.Original:
A collection of Quality of Life tweaks. Aiming to improve the experience without changing anything drastically.
All changes are toggleable, with everything disabled by default. Visit the Repo for a full list of tweaks. (Globe icon below)
Description.Translated:
一系列便利性微调。旨在不做出任何大幅改动的前提下改善体验。
所有改动均可开关，且默认全部禁用。完整微调清单请访问 Repo。（下方地球图标）

Punchline.Original: enjoy MSQ in Thai language!
Punchline.Translated: 用泰语享受 MSQ！

Description.Original: Translates FFXIV Main Scenario Quest (MSQ) dialogues and cutscenes into Thai. Enjoy the story in your native language!
Description.Translated: 将 FFXIV 主线剧情任务（MSQ）的对话和过场动画翻译成泰语。用你的母语享受剧情！

Punchline.Original: Track every adventurer you meet in Eorzea.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪你在 Eorzea 遇到的每一位冒险者。

Description.Original:
Track players you meet in FFXIV — who they are, when you ran into them, how their characters change over time. A focused social tracker built on the NexusKit framework.

Per-player detail view with Summary, Equipment, Class/Jobs, Achievements, Free Company, Encounters, History and Notes tabs. Optional enrichment from Lodestone (gear, FC link, achievement progress) and FFXIVCollect (mounts, minions, full achievement catalog). Live throttled refresh queue keeps external data fresh without hammering either service.

Configurable chat and toast notifications when players you've seen before change — rename, server transfer, Free Company join/leave/switch, achievement growth, refresh failures. Per-event filtering and history grouping so the chat doesn't drown you.

Powerful player-filter language with live preview to slice your list however you want; encounter history scoped per duty and content type; optional bridges to other Dalamud plugins (Lifestream world-travel, more to come).

Local-first: all data lives in a single SQLite file under your XIVLauncher config. Automated weekly maintenance keeps it tidy. English and German localization.
Description.Translated:
追踪你在 FFXIV 中遇到的玩家——他们是谁、你何时遇到他们、他们的角色如何随时间变化。基于 NexusKit 框架构建的专注社交追踪器。

每位玩家的详细视图，包含摘要、装备、职业/特职、成就、部队、遭遇、历史和备注标签页。可选从 Lodestone（装备、FC 链接、成就进度）和 FFXIVCollect（坐骑、宠物、完整成就目录）获取补充信息。实时限流刷新队列让外部数据保持最新，同时不会频繁冲击任一服务。

当你之前见过的玩家发生变化时，可配置聊天和 Toast 通知——改名、服务器转移、部队加入/离开/切换、成就增长、刷新失败。支持按事件过滤和历史分组，避免聊天频道把你淹没。

强大的玩家筛选语言，带实时预览，可按你的需要任意切分列表；遭遇历史按任务和内容类型限定；可选桥接到其他 Dalamud 插件（Lifestream 世界旅行，更多即将推出）。

本地优先：所有数据都存放在 XIVLauncher 配置下的单个 SQLite 文件中。每周自动维护保持整洁。提供英语和德语本地化。

Punchline.Original: Hide your character and world name while streaming.
Punchline.Translated: 直播时隐藏你的角色名和服务器名。

Description.Original: Locally spoofs your character name and world name to keep your identity private while streaming.
Description.Translated: 在本地伪装你的角色名和服务器名，以便直播时保护你的身份隐私。

Punchline.Original: Display your FFXIV PvP rank and live match stats in Discord Rich Presence.
Punchline.Translated: 在 Discord Rich Presence 中显示你的 FFXIV PvP 排名和实时比赛数据。

Description.Original: Shows Crystalline Conflict rank, live match K/D, character info, and location in Discord Rich Presence. Configure with /ffxivrpc.
Description.Translated: 在 Discord Rich Presence 中显示 Crystalline Conflict 排名、实时比赛 K/D、角色信息和位置。使用 /ffxivrpc 配置。

Punchline.Original: Draw or sheathe a little better(?)
Punchline.Translated: 拔刀或收刀稍微好一点（？）

Description.Original:
You can use this plugin to use the /draw or /sheathe emotes instead of your usual weapon draw/sheathe. 

(Also, you'll obviously need the emotes themselves)
Description.Translated:
你可以使用此插件来使用 /draw 或 /sheathe 表情动作，替代你通常的武器拔出/收起动作。

（当然，你显然需要先拥有这些表情动作）

Punchline.Original: Changes your VO language on a per-duty basis.
Punchline.Translated: 按副本更改你的 VO 语言。

Description.Original: Changes the cutscene voice language for configured duties and restores your default selection elsewhere.
Description.Translated: 为已配置的副本更改过场动画语音语言，在其他地方恢复你的默认选择。

Punchline.Original: When something you care about happens, Callouts tells you.
Punchline.Translated: 当你在意的事情发生时，Callouts 会告诉你。

Description.Original: User-defined trigger rules that turn in-game events into local alerts - Echo messages, sound effects, and toasts. Rules are configured entirely in the UI; everything stays on your machine.
Description.Translated: 用户定义的触发规则，将游戏内事件转化为本地提醒——Echo 消息、音效和 Toast 通知。所有规则完全在 UI 中配置；一切数据都保留在你的机器上。

Punchline.Original: Automatically source and buy housing furnishings at the best cross-world price.
Punchline.Translated: 自动以最佳跨服价格寻找并购买房屋家具。

Description.Original: Reads a MakePlace furnishing list, finds the cheapest market listings across all worlds via Universalis, then automates world-hopping and purchasing via Lifestream.
Description.Translated: 读取 MakePlace 家具清单，通过 Universalis 找到所有服务器中最便宜的市场挂单，然后通过 Lifestream 自动化跨服跳转和购买。

Punchline.Original: Never miss a party or raid callout again.
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会错过小队或团队喊话。

Description.Original: Echoes Party and Raid chat as a draggable HUD overlay so you never miss a callout while tunnel-visioning in raids. Supports priority word highlighting, fade animations, and full color customization.
Description.Translated: 将小队和团队聊天以可拖拽的 HUD 覆盖层回显，让你在团队副本中过度专注时也不会错过任何喊话。支持优先词高亮、淡入淡出动画和完整的颜色自定义。

Punchline.Original: A Lodestone-powered event calendar.
Punchline.Translated: 由 Lodestone 提供支持的活动日历。

Description.Original: Shows FFXIV Lodestone events, topics, notices, maintenance, and updates in an in-game calendar with Lodestone images.
Description.Translated: 在游戏内日历中显示 FFXIV Lodestone 的事件、主题、公告、维护和更新，并带有 Lodestone 图片。

Punchline.Original: 深层迷宫宝藏辅助插件 / DeepDungeon hoard helper
Punchline.Translated: 深层迷宫宝藏辅助插件 / DeepDungeon hoard helper

Description.Original: HoardFarm API15 维护版，用于深层迷宫宝藏路线辅助。
Description.Translated: HoardFarm API15 维护版，用于深层迷宫宝藏路线辅助。

Punchline.Original: Self-hosted synced in-world media screens for movie nights.
Punchline.Translated: 用于电影之夜的自托管同步游戏内媒体屏幕。

Description.Original: Host a small server; paired friends connect and automatically see the in-world screens (TVs) you create, all playing the same media. Move/resize/rotate gizmo, LibVLC video, auto-reconnect. Pairs with a self-hosted Owncast stream.
Description.Translated: 托管一个小型服务器；配对的好友连接后会自动看到你创建的游戏内屏幕（电视），全部播放相同媒体。可移动/调整大小/旋转 gizmo，LibVLC 视频，自动重连。可与自托管 Owncast 流搭配。

Punchline.Original: A sound cue for Kefka's Double-Trouble Trap.
Punchline.Translated: Kefka 的 Double-Trouble Trap 音效提示。

Description.Original: Plays a custom sound effect whenever you gain Kefka's "Double-Trouble Trap" debuff. The trigger status name, volume, and sound file are all configurable. Use /doubletrouble to open settings, or /doubletrouble test to preview the sound.
Description.Translated: 当你获得 Kefka 的“Double-Trouble Trap”负面状态时播放自定义音效。触发状态名称、音量与音效文件均可配置。使用 /doubletrouble 打开设置，或使用 /doubletrouble test 预览音效。

Punchline.Original: Experimental point-to-point autopilot helper.
Punchline.Translated: 实验性点对点自动导航辅助。

Description.Original: Manual destination autopilot scaffold for XIVPath. Uses vnavmesh IPC hooks when available.
Description.Translated: 用于 XIVPath 的手动目的地自动导航脚手架。可用时使用 vnavmesh IPC 钩子。

Punchline.Original: Track who received loot and where it happened.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪谁获得了战利品以及发生在何处。

Description.Original: Keeps a searchable history of loot messages, including the zone and recipient.
Description.Translated: 保存可搜索的战利品消息历史，包括区域和获得者。

Punchline.Original: Track your space cash!
Punchline.Translated: 追踪你的太空货币！

Description.Original: A plugin to track your Cosmocredit earnings per hour and total session earnings.
Description.Translated: 一个用于追踪每小时 Cosmocredit 收益和本次会话总收益的插件。

Punchline.Original: Japanese-first gathering navigator for miners and botanists.
Punchline.Translated: 面向采矿工和园艺工的日语优先采集导航。

Description.Original: GatherBuddy JP is a Japanese-first gathering navigation plugin for miners and botanists. It provides item search, route planning, teleport-assisted travel, auto-gather lists, and vnavmesh-assisted movement.
Description.Translated: GatherBuddy JP 是一个面向采矿工和园艺工的日语优先采集导航插件。它提供物品搜索、路线规划、传送辅助移动、自动采集列表以及 vnavmesh 辅助移动。

Punchline.Original: Scholar assistant: auto Eos summon/placement, manual override with return button, Biolysis alert, Chain Stratagem countdown.
Punchline.Translated: 学者助手：自动召唤/放置 Eos，带返回按钮的手动覆盖，Biolysis 提示，Chain Stratagem 倒计时。

Description.Original: Automatic Scholar assistant: summons Eos on login, instance entry, and after wipes; repositions her to the arena center in 8-player raids; plays an alert when Biolysis falls off; and shows a countdown overlay when Chain Stratagem is coming off cooldown. Manual override: if you place Eos yourself during a fight, auto-repositioning pauses and a draggable button appears on screen to send her back to center on demand. Use /xivsch to open settings.
Description.Translated: 自动学者助手：在登录、进入副本和团灭后召唤 Eos；在 8 人副本中将 Eos 重新定位到场地中心；Biolysis 消失时播放提示；Chain Stratagem 冷却即将结束时显示倒计时悬浮窗。手动覆盖：若你在战斗中自行放置 Eos，自动重新定位会暂停，屏幕上出现可拖动按钮，可根据需要将 Eos 送回中心。使用 /xivsch 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Roll /random and win a prize — now with history, stats, custom prizes, sound, and party mode!
Punchline.Translated: 掷 /random 赢取奖品——现支持历史记录、统计、自定义奖品、音效和队伍模式！

Description.Original: A gachapon gambling minigame. Type /gachapon to open the machine, then roll /random to play — the sum of your rolls decides your prize tier, from Common up to the JACKPOT. Includes a pull history log, detailed stats (best sum, win streaks, luckiest day), fully customizable prizes and rules, jackpot sound effects, gil/payout tracking, and a party mode that tracks everyone's rolls on a leaderboard.
Description.Translated: 一个扭蛋赌博小游戏。输入 /gachapon 打开机器，然后掷 /random 开始游戏——掷出的点数总和决定你的奖品等级，从 Common 到 JACKPOT。包含抽取历史记录、详细统计（最佳总和、连胜、最幸运的一天）、完全可自定义的奖品和规则、JACKPOT 音效、gil/奖励追踪，以及用排行榜追踪所有人掷骰的队伍模式。

Punchline.Original: Progressively morphs your character's body via Customize+ bone scaling.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Customize+ 骨骼缩放渐进改变你的角色身体。

Description.Original: Animates Customize+ bone scales from your current profile values toward a configurable target. Use /bodyflux to open the control window.
Description.Translated: 将 Customize+ 骨骼缩放从当前配置值动态过渡到可配置的目标值。使用 /bodyflux 打开控制窗口。

Punchline.Original: Apply full sets to your character in Glamourer with a single click.
Punchline.Translated: 在 Glamourer 中一键为你的角色应用整套套装。

Description.Original: Lists the game's complete named sets and applies a whole set or any single piece to your character through Glamourer, instead of picking each item from a dropdown.
Description.Translated: 列出游戏内所有完整的命名套装，并通过 Glamourer 将整套或任意单件应用到你的角色上，无需从下拉菜单中逐件挑选。

Punchline.Original: Haha claw goes whoosh
Punchline.Translated: 哈哈，爪子嗖嗖作响

Description.Original: Play the Cosmic Predator's Magitek Claw Sweep animation on demand, once or on a loop, while you're riding it. Purely cosmetic and local-only; nothing is sent to the server. Works on both the Cosmic Predator and the standard Magitek Predator. Commands: /clawsweep and /clawsweeploop.
Description.Translated: 在骑乘 Cosmic Predator 时按需播放其 Magitek Claw Sweep 动画，可播放一次或循环播放。纯外观且仅本地；不会向服务器发送任何内容。对 Cosmic Predator 和标准 Magitek Predator 均有效。命令：/clawsweep 和 /clawsweeploop。

Punchline.Original: Like Honorific, but for names.
Punchline.Translated: 类似 Honorific，但用于名字。

Description.Original: Changes your display name. Local only: visible only to yourself outside of HMS (HMapSync) sessions.
Description.Translated: 更改你的显示名称。仅本地：在 HMS（HMapSync）会话之外仅你自己可见。

Punchline.Original: Out of sight, out of mind.
Punchline.Translated: 眼不见，心不烦。

Description.Original: Hide NPCs with a single click
Description.Translated: 一键隐藏 NPC

Punchline.Original: Explore any zone together.
Punchline.Translated: 一起探索任意区域。

Description.Original: Load any in-game map client-side and explore it solo or with up to 20 friends, behind a packet filter that keeps the server seeing you as idle in your room. Shared weather, BGM and time; client-side mounts, emotes and minions; carpet floors for spots without collision; head-tilt and gaze sync for roleplay; and proximity say/yell passthrough. Co-op needs a relay key (closed beta); solo mode never connects to the relay.
Description.Translated: 在客户端加载任意游戏内地图，独自或与最多 20 位好友一同探索，并通过数据包过滤让服务器始终视你在房间内处于空闲状态。同步天气、BGM 与时间；客户端坐骑、情感动作与宠物；为没有碰撞的位置铺设地毯地板；为角色扮演提供歪头与视线同步；以及近距离说/喊话透传。合作模式需要中继密钥（封闭测试）；单人模式从不连接中继。

Description.Original: Play nearly any public facing video/image/music URL in game and with friends!
Description.Translated: 在游戏内与好友一起播放几乎任何公开的视频/图片/音乐 URL！

Punchline.Original: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.
Punchline.Translated: 逐帧分析战斗信息并找出最佳行动。

Description.Original:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.
Description.Translated:
逐帧分析战斗信息并找出最佳行动。

这意味着战斗中单帧内的几乎所有可用信息，包括队伍中所有玩家的状态、任何敌对目标的状态、技能冷却时间、角色的 MP 和 HP、角色位置、敌对目标的咏唱状态、连击、战斗持续时间、玩家等级等。
然后，它会在热键栏上高亮最佳行动，或帮助你点击它。
它是为`常规战斗`设计的，不适用于零式或绝境战。请谨慎使用。

Punchline.Original: A minimalist, easy-to-read combat tracker for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 一个极简、易读的 FFXIV 战斗追踪器。

Description.Original: HamMeter is a minimalist combat tracker and damage meter for Final Fantasy XIV, built with a strict focus on an easy-to-read layout! It reads encounter data from IINACT over Dalamud IPC.
Description.Translated: HamMeter 是一个为 Final Fantasy XIV 打造的极简战斗追踪器和伤害统计器，严格专注于易读的布局！它通过 Dalamud IPC 从 IINACT 读取战斗数据。

Punchline.Original: Generalized bar audit and gamba drink manager for FFXIV venues.
Punchline.Translated: 适用于 FFXIV 场所的通用吧台审计和 gamba 饮品管理器。

Description.Original:
Tracks venue bar sales, tips, buyouts, configurable gamba drink sessions, payouts, jackpots, and nightly reports.
Designed for multiple venues with venue-neutral branding.
Description.Translated:
追踪场所吧台销售、小费、买断、可配置的 gamba 饮品场次、赔付、头奖和夜间报告。
专为多个场所设计，采用场所中立品牌。

Punchline.Original: Venue raffle manager with true ticket-based random draws.
Punchline.Translated: 基于真实票券随机抽取的场所抽奖管理器。

Description.Original: Generic raffle manager for FFXIV venues with ticket pricing, base jackpots, split payouts, venue profiles, custom branding, target-based adds, winner animation, and chat announcements.
Description.Translated: 适用于 FFXIV 场所的通用抽奖管理器，具有票券定价、基础头奖、分成赔付、场所配置、自定义品牌、基于目标的添加、获奖动画和聊天公告。

Punchline.Original: Dealer-assist Blackjack & DRT for FFXIV venues.
Punchline.Translated: 为 FFXIV 场所提供荷官辅助 Blackjack 与 DRT。

Description.Original: Assists a single venue dealer with Blackjack phases, dice-based cards, bank tracking, narration, overlays, logs, and exports. Players do not need the plugin.
Description.Translated: 辅助单个场所荷官处理 Blackjack 阶段、骰子卡牌、资金追踪、旁白、悬浮窗、日志与导出。玩家无需安装该插件。

Punchline.Original: Buy shop items in custom quantities or stacks.
Punchline.Translated: 按自定义数量或整组购买商店物品。

Description.Original: Lists items from currently open shop addons and can buy items in chosen quantities or stack-sized batches, confirming quantity and yes/no prompts.
Description.Translated: 列出当前打开的商店界面中的物品，可按所选数量或整组批量购买，并确认数量与是/否提示。

Punchline.Original: Manage venue staff, shifts, attendance, and pay.
Punchline.Translated: 管理场所员工、排班、出勤与薪资。

Description.Original: Multi-venue staff, shift, attendance, and payroll management dashboard.
Description.Translated: 多场所员工、排班、出勤与薪资管理仪表盘。

Punchline.Original: Your plugin suite in one modern tablet OS.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的插件套件集成于一个现代平板 OS。

Description.Original: A modern tablet OS for Airi's venue apps.
Description.Translated: 用于 Airi 场所应用的现代平板 OS。

Punchline.Original: A ReShade preset that pays attention to where you are.
Punchline.Translated: 一个会留意你身处何地的 ReShade 预设。

Description.Original: Dalashade generates a separate ReShade preset from your base preset, then nudges known shader values using territory, weather, time, combat, cutscenes, and optional screenshot analysis. Use /dalashade to open it.
Description.Translated: Dalashade 会基于你的基础预设生成一个独立的 ReShade 预设，然后根据区域、天气、时间、战斗、过场动画以及可选的截图分析微调已知着色器数值。使用 /dalashade 打开。

Punchline.Original: Temporary encrypted .pmp transfer client.
Punchline.Translated: 临时加密 .pmp 传输客户端。

Description.Original: Uploads and downloads encrypted .pmp transfers through a private PmpShare Cloudflare Worker API. No plaintext files or decryption keys are sent to the server.
Description.Translated: 通过私有的 PmpShare Cloudflare Worker API 上传和下载加密的 .pmp 传输文件。不会向服务器发送明文文件或解密密钥。

Punchline.Original: Sanitized MINE Party Finder alerts for Discord.
Punchline.Translated: 面向 Discord 的净化版 MINE Party Finder 提醒。

Description.Original: Observes Party Finder listings, filters for qualifying MINE raid listings, sends sanitized observations to the official PFBeacon service, and can show spoiler-safe local alerts from the global feed. Does not send PF descriptions, player names, recruiter names, worlds, or Discord routing data.
Description.Translated: 监视 Party Finder 列表，筛选符合条件的 MINE 副本招募，将净化后的观测数据发送至官方 PFBeacon 服务，并可从全局数据流显示剧透安全的本地提醒。不会发送 PF 描述、玩家名称、招募者名称、服务器或 Discord 路由数据。

Punchline.Original: Move-by-move advice for Doman Mahjong.
Punchline.Translated: Doman Mahjong 的逐步建议。

Description.Original: Reads the Doman Mahjong board and recommends each move: discard, calls, riichi, and defense.
Description.Translated: 读取 Doman Mahjong 牌局并为每一步提供建议：打牌、鸣牌、立直和防守。

Punchline.Original: Save any housing layout you can walk into - no permissions needed.
Punchline.Translated: 保存任何你能走进去的房屋布置——无需权限。

Description.Original: Saves housing layouts to JSON files from anywhere you can stand: your own house or any home you visit.
Description.Translated: 从任何你能站立的位置将房屋布置保存为 JSON 文件：你自己的房屋或你访问的任何住宅。

Punchline.Original: Track your caught fish in-game, matched to the carbuncleplushy fish tracker.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内追踪你钓到的鱼，与 carbuncleplushy fish tracker 匹配。

Description.Original: Companion to the carbuncleplushy FFXIV Fish Tracker: tracks which fish you've caught, with website-matching filters and one-click export.
Description.Translated: carbuncleplushy FFXIV Fish Tracker 的配套插件：追踪你已钓到的鱼，提供与网站一致的筛选条件以及一键导出。

Punchline.Original: Wear any monster's face. Client-side mob disguises with a searchable catalog and animation triggers.
Punchline.Translated: 戴上任何怪物的脸。客户端怪物伪装，带可搜索目录与动画触发器。

Description.Original: A catalog of every mob in the game (16k+ models, 15.5k named) plus the full set of humanoid NPCs (Glamourer's NPC tab). Apply any mob's or NPC's look to yourself client-side (Brio-style ModelCharaId swap + redraw, or a Glamourer paint for humans), spawn disguised puppets, trigger action timelines for theatrics, and revert cleanly. Self-apply only, like Glamourer — never enforced on other players. Built for DM/event use — no mechanics, just the face.
Description.Translated: 收录游戏中所有怪物（16000+ 模型，15500 个有名称）以及全套人形 NPC（Glamourer 的 NPC 标签页）。在客户端把任何怪物或 NPC 的外观应用到自身（Brio 风格 ModelCharaId 替换 + 重绘，或对人类使用 Glamourer 上色），生成伪装人偶，触发动作时间轴用于演出，并干净地还原。仅自我应用，和 Glamourer 一样——绝不强制于其他玩家。为 DM/活动使用而构建——不涉及机制，只换脸。

Punchline.Original: Adjust gamepad stick deadzones in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内调整手柄摇杆死区。

Description.Original: Adds radial and axial stick input remapping with dead zone, max zone, anti-dead zone, and a compact live configuration UI.
Description.Translated: 添加径向与轴向摇杆输入重映射，包含死区、最大区、反死区，以及紧凑的实时配置 UI。

Punchline.Original: Search, route, and hunt drop-only materials.
Punchline.Translated: 搜索、规划路线并狩猎仅掉落材料。

Description.Original: Standalone monster-drop hunting and routing using local LuminaSupplemental data, manual hunt lists, vnavmesh navigation, mount support, and configurable combat handoff.
Description.Translated: 独立的怪物掉落狩猎与路线规划，使用本地 LuminaSupplemental 数据、手动狩猎列表、vnavmesh 导航、坐骑支持，以及可配置的战斗交接。

Punchline.Original: Spend non-gil currencies where the market actually moves.
Punchline.Translated: 在真正有市场流动性的地方花费非金币货币。

Description.Original: Read-only currency profit scanner for tomestones, scrips, seals, MGP, hunt currencies, FATE gemstones, and other spendable currencies. Uses Universalis sales, supply, and stale-data checks to rank marketable rewards by practical gil profit.
Description.Translated: 只读货币利润扫描器，适用于神典石、票据、军票、MGP、狩猎货币、FATE 晶石及其他可花费货币。使用 Universalis 的销售、供应与过期数据检查，按实际金币利润对可交易奖励进行排名。

Punchline.Original: Smart FFXIV marketboard automation.
Punchline.Translated: 智能 FFXIV 市场板自动化。

Description.Original: Fork build of AutoMarket Pro with retainer inventory scanning, sellability-aware Universalis ranking, filtered list/vendor modes, and marketboard automation while upstream changes are pending.
Description.Translated: AutoMarket Pro 的分支版本，包含雇员库存扫描、感知可售性的 Universalis 排名、过滤列表/商店模式，以及在上游变更待处理期间的市场板自动化。

Punchline.Original: What if Alexander spoke?
Punchline.Translated: 如果 Alexander 会说话会怎样？

Description.Original:
Plays the voicelines of voiced bosses on unvoiced ones.
Currently supported:
	- Alexander Resurrected (Windhurst) -> Alexander Prime and Perfect Alex
/spaketh - toggle the plugin on and off
Description.Translated:
为未配音的 Boss 播放已配音 Boss 的语音台词。
当前支持：
	- Alexander Resurrected (Windhurst) -> Alexander Prime 和 Perfect Alex
/spaketh - 切换插件的开启和关闭

Punchline.Original: Community-learned navigation trails for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 社区学习生成的 FFXIV 导航轨迹。

Description.Original: AetherTrail records player movement into a local navigation graph, renders trail guidance to map flags or quest targets, and supports opt-in party graph sync. Updated to include mapping function.
Description.Translated: AetherTrail 将玩家移动记录到本地导航图中，在地图标记或任务目标上渲染路径指引，并支持选择性加入的队伍导航图同步。已更新以包含地图功能。

Punchline.Original: Hide Party Finder listings whose comments match your blacklist.
Punchline.Translated: 隐藏评论与你的黑名单匹配的 Party Finder 招募信息。

Description.Original: Hides standard Party Finder listings whose comment matches user-defined patterns (plain text or regex). Useful for filtering out RMT/mercenary advertisements. Open the settings window with /bbm. Filtering is client-side only.
Description.Translated: 隐藏评论匹配用户定义模式（纯文本或正则表达式）的标准 Party Finder 招募信息。可用于过滤 RMT/代练广告。使用 /bbm 打开设置窗口。过滤仅在客户端进行。

Punchline.Original: I solemnly swear that I am up to no good.
Punchline.Translated: 我庄严宣誓我不干好事。

Description.Original: Peek into party finders to know who's in there.
Description.Translated: 窥探 Party Finder，了解里面都有谁。

Punchline.Original: Tired of missing stuff cause everything is in another timezone? Say less.
Punchline.Translated: 厌倦了因为所有事情都在另一个时区而错过内容？不用多说。

Description.Original:
Use this to know the current time in different timezones in a customizable way.
You can change the text scale, colors, position and even setup Alarms!
Description.Translated:
使用此插件以可自定义的方式查看不同时区的当前时间。
你可以更改文本缩放、颜色、位置，甚至设置闹钟！

Punchline.Original: Small quality-of-life tweaks to make Eorzea a little more comfortable.
Punchline.Translated: 为艾欧泽亚增添一些小而贴心的便利改进。

Description.Original: A collection of small quality-of-life tweaks designed to make your time in Eorzea more comfortable, one small luxury at a time. Use /llux to open the settings window.
Description.Translated: 一系列小型便利改进，旨在让你的艾欧泽亚时光更加舒适，一次享受一点小奢侈。使用 /llux 打开设置窗口。

Punchline.Original: Automatic Penumbra mod-conflict management for your Glamourer designs.
Punchline.Translated: 为你的 Glamourer 搭配自动管理 Penumbra 模组冲突。

Description.Original: Persona reads your Glamourer designs and the Penumbra mods behind them, works out which mod belongs to which item in each outfit, and flags when two outfits fight over the same item. It keeps every design self-contained so applying one never leaves a mod bleeding through from the last. Open it with /persona.
Description.Translated: Persona 会读取你的 Glamourer 搭配及其背后的 Penumbra 模组，分析出每个整套外观中哪个模组对应哪件物品，并在两套外观争用同一件物品时发出提示。它让每个搭配保持独立自洽，因此应用其中一套时绝不会残留上一套的模组效果。使用 /persona 打开。

Punchline.Original: A shared in-world video screen.
Punchline.Translated: 共享的世界内视频屏幕。

Description.Original: Renders an in-world video screen and syncs playback with other players running AlphaChannel over a self-hosted relay.
Description.Translated: 渲染一块世界内视频屏幕，并通过自建中继与其他运行 AlphaChannel 的玩家同步播放。

Punchline.Original: Standalone customizable HUD with action camera parity.
Punchline.Translated: 独立的可自定义 HUD，具备动作相机同等功能。

Description.Original: A standalone customizable HUD with nameplate parity, action camera controls, and backend/profile stability improvements.
Description.Translated: 独立的可自定义 HUD，具备名牌同等功能、动作相机控制，以及后端/配置稳定性改进。

Punchline.Original: Keep the people who matter in view.
Punchline.Translated: 让重要的人始终在视野中。

Description.Original: Control crowd density, keep important players, and inspect why someone is excluded. Use /eventhorizon or /eh.
Description.Translated: 控制人群密度、保留重要玩家，并查看某人被排除的原因。使用 /eventhorizon 或 /eh。

Punchline.Original: Bridging Eorzea and Telegram.
Punchline.Translated: 连接艾欧泽亚与 Telegram。

Description.Original: Bridges FFXIV chat and Telegram.
Description.Translated: 在 FFXIV 聊天与 Telegram 之间建立桥接。

Punchline.Original: Track non-MSQ content completion
Punchline.Translated: 追踪非主线内容完成度

Description.Original: Track unlocking and completion of all non-MSQ content across every expansion. Auto-detects progress from journal and achievements.
Description.Translated: 追踪各版本中所有非主线内容的解锁与完成情况。自动从任务日志与成就中检测进度。

Punchline.Original: Japanese raid terminology dictionary
Punchline.Translated: 日式副本术语词典

Description.Original: A lightweight dictionary for Japanese raid terminology, Party Finder shorthand, and job abbreviations. Useful for players raiding on Japanese Data Centers.
Description.Translated: 轻量级词典，收录日式副本术语、招募板简写与职业简称。适合在日本数据中心进行副本攻略的玩家使用。

Punchline.Original: Winamp-inspired Penumbra playlist switching for syncshell DJing.
Punchline.Translated: 受 Winamp 启发的 Penumbra 播放列表切换，用于 syncshell DJ。

Description.Original: Plan and perform Penumbra music-option playlists with Winamp-style controls - skinnable .wsz UI, playlist, window-shade modes and spectrum analyzer. Use /xivamp to open the player.
Description.Translated: 以 Winamp 风格控件规划并演出 Penumbra 音乐选项播放列表——可换肤的 .wsz 界面、播放列表、窗口卷帘模式和频谱分析器。使用 /xivamp 打开播放器。

Punchline.Original: Keeps your XIV Rus installation up to date.
Punchline.Translated: 让你的 XIV Rus 安装保持最新。

Description.Original: Maintains the latest compatible version of XIVRus by checking for updates, downloading releases, and installing them through Penumbra. Includes update channels, patch compatibility warnings, and manual update controls.
Description.Translated: 通过检查更新、下载发行版并经 Penumbra 安装，维护 XIVRus 的最新兼容版本。包含更新通道、补丁兼容性警告与手动更新控制。

Punchline.Original: Turn housing files/presets into usable Brio projects for Gposing!
Punchline.Translated: 把房屋文件/预设转换为可用于 GPose 的 Brio 项目！

Description.Original: Loads ReMakePlace-style housing layout files and saves them as a Brio Project to spawn furniture as Brio world objects for GPose photos.
Description.Translated: 加载 ReMakePlace 风格的房屋布局文件，并将其保存为 Brio Project，以便将家具作为 Brio 世界对象生成，用于 GPose 拍照。

Punchline.Original: Non-Functional. Use SkyrimCompass instead.
Punchline.Translated: 已失效。请改用 SkyrimCompass。

Description.Original: Currently Non functional and only useful if you like looking at broken code
Description.Translated: 目前无法使用，仅适合喜欢看坏掉代码的人。

Punchline.Original: An all-in-one toolkit for FFXIV venue hosts: attendance, raffles, auctions, giveaways, deathroll tournaments, bar games, menus, and quick announcements.
Punchline.Translated: 面向 FFXIV 店主的全能工具包：出勤、抽奖、拍卖、赠品、死亡轮盘锦标赛、酒吧游戏、菜单和快速公告。

Description.Original: An all-in-one venue host toolkit: Venue Counter (multi-venue attendance + lifetime time tracking), Raffle Helper, Auction Helper (gil shorthand + buyer tracking), Giveaway Helper (anti-cheat), DR Tourny Helper (single or double elimination), Shout/Yell Helper, Bar Game Helper (custom + survival games, fixed/tiered/high-score payouts), Menu Helper (per-venue menus, macro serve sequences), plus a Settings tab with backup/restore and a master panic switch. Open with /venuehelper (aliases /vhelp, /vh). Exports to TXT, CSV, PDF, or XLSX.
Description.Translated: 全能店主工具包：Venue Counter（多店铺出勤 + 累计时长追踪）、Raffle Helper、Auction Helper（gil 简写 + 买家追踪）、Giveaway Helper（防作弊）、DR Tourny Helper（单败或双败淘汰）、Shout/Yell Helper、Bar Game Helper（自定义 + 生存游戏，固定/分级/高分奖励）、Menu Helper（分店铺菜单、宏上菜流程），另有 Settings 标签页，含备份/恢复和主紧急开关。使用 /venuehelper（别名 /vhelp、/vh）打开。可导出为 TXT、CSV、PDF 或 XLSX。

Punchline.Original: Streamer mode: stream the game without showing Dalamud overlays.
Punchline.Translated: 主播模式：直播游戏时隐藏 Dalamud 悬浮窗。

Description.Original: Streamer mode / stream mode for FFXIV. Creates a second window with a clean image of the game (no ImGui/Dalamud) for capture in OBS. Optionally shows the scene without the game UI.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 的主播模式/直播模式。创建一个显示干净游戏画面的第二个窗口（无 ImGui/Dalamud），供 OBS 捕获。可选显示不带游戏 UI 的场景。

Punchline.Original: Your real FFXIV ping: the latency you actually feel, with jitter and loss.
Punchline.Translated: 你真实的 FFXIV 延迟：你实际感受到的延迟，包含抖动与丢包。

Description.Original:
Measures your true FFXIV ping by timing the game's own keepalive round-trip (the latency the server actually answers), not the OS network latency. Because it reads the game protocol, it reports the real latency you feel even when you route through a proxy or VPN, where ordinary ping tools only see localhost. Shows current ping, average, min, max, jitter and packet loss, in a floating overlay and in the server info bar.

Commands:
/trueping : open the settings window
/trueping overlay : toggle the floating overlay
/trueping dtr : toggle the server info bar entry
/trueping reset : clear the statistics
Description.Translated:
通过测量游戏自身 keepalive 往返时间来测量你真实的 FFXIV 延迟（服务器实际回应的延迟），而非操作系统的网络延迟。由于它读取游戏协议，即使你通过代理或 VPN 连接，也能报告你实际感受到的真实延迟，而普通 ping 工具此时只能看到 localhost。在悬浮窗和服务器信息栏中显示当前延迟、平均、最小、最大、抖动和丢包。

命令：
/trueping ：打开设置窗口
/trueping overlay ：切换悬浮窗
/trueping dtr ：切换服务器信息栏条目
/trueping reset ：清除统计数据

Punchline.Original: Cycle custom Honorific titles.
Punchline.Translated: 循环切换自定义 Honorific 称号。

Description.Original: Lets you create and rotate custom Honorific titles with color, glow, gradient, and animation options.
Description.Translated: 让你创建并轮换自定义 Honorific 称号，支持颜色、发光、渐变和动画选项。

Punchline.Original: Display your currently playing track as your Honorific title.
Punchline.Translated: 将你当前播放的曲目显示为 Honorific 称号。

Description.Original: Syncs the song playing on Deezer, Spotify or your browser to your in-game Honorific title. Requires the Honorific plugin.
Description.Translated: 将 Deezer、Spotify 或浏览器中播放的歌曲同步到游戏内的 Honorific 称号。需要 Honorific 插件。

Punchline.Original: Track achievements with native Achievement-window assisted refreshes.
Punchline.Translated: 借助原生成就窗口辅助刷新来追踪成就。

Description.Original: Use /achex to track achievements, open native Achievement entries, and passively cache observed progress. This Ex mainline build is non-automated; Ex+ is reserved for the experimental automation branch.
Description.Translated: 使用 /achex 追踪成就、打开原生成就条目，并被动缓存观察到的进度。此 Ex 主线版本为非自动化；Ex+ 保留给实验性自动化分支。

Punchline.Original: Quality-of-life tweaks: hotbar audit, submarine routes, craft-leve hand-ins, expert delivery, and glamour sync.
Punchline.Translated: 便捷性改进：快捷栏审查、潜艇航线、制作理符交纳、专家配送和幻化同步。

Description.Original:
A growing collection of FFXIV quality-of-life tweaks, each in its own settings tab:

- Hotbar Helper: when you open Actions & Traits, scans your hotbars against your current job and shows any actions or role actions you haven't slotted anywhere — then drag an icon straight onto a hotbar slot to assign it.
- Submarines: FC submarine status with per-sub EXP bars, plus a tabbed voyage route planner — EXP/hour levelling routes (with fuel cost), exploration routes that reveal the most still-undiscovered locations, and gil-farming routes (per-sub gil/hour, build and rank requirements) — with one-click apply, optional unlock-progression routing, and auto-repair.
- Leves: automated craft (tradecraft) leve hand-ins — pick a leve, stand at the counter, and it accepts and turns in until your allowance floor or items run out.
- Expert Delivery: adds a "Turn in all" button to the Grand Company Expert Delivery window that hands in every listed item and confirms each delivery for you.
- Glamour Sync: keeps a gear set's portrait matching its gear — after a glamour plate, a job change, or equipping Recommended Gear — so the "portrait doesn't match" warning stays gone.
Description.Translated:
不断增加的 FFXIV 便捷性改进合集，每项都有独立的设置标签页：

- 快捷栏助手：当你打开技能与特性时，会根据当前职业扫描你的快捷栏，并显示你尚未放置到任何位置的技能或职能技能——随后可将图标直接拖到快捷栏槽位进行分配。
- 潜艇：部队潜艇状态，带每艘潜艇的经验条，外加分标签页的航程路线规划器——经验/小时升级路线（含燃料成本）、能揭示最多仍未发现地点的探索路线，以及金币获取路线（每艘潜艇金币/小时、建造与等级要求）——支持一键应用、可选的解锁进度路线和自动修理。
- 理符：自动交纳制作（制作类）理符——选择理符，站在柜台前，它会持续接受并交纳，直到你的理符配额下限或物品耗尽。
- 专家配送：在大国防联军专家配送窗口中添加“全部交纳”按钮，可为你交纳列出的所有物品并确认每次配送。
- 幻化同步：让套装肖像与其装备保持一致——在应用幻化模板、切换职业或装备推荐装备后——使“肖像不匹配”警告不再出现。

Punchline.Original: I got Moodles + Loci playing (somewhat) nice. Oh and theres a compass, too.
Punchline.Translated: 我让 Moodles + Loci（勉强）和睦相处了。哦，还有个指南针。

Description.Original: Adds a Skyrim-style compass bar at the top of your screen. Shows cardinal directions, tick marks, and nearby entity markers (players, enemies, gathering nodes, and more). Use /compass to toggle and /compass config to open settings.
Description.Translated: 在屏幕顶部添加一条 Skyrim 风格的指南针条。显示方位、刻度标记和附近实体标记（玩家、敌人、采集点等）。使用 /compass 切换，使用 /compass config 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: A fast, filterable replacement for the Glamour Dresser and Armoire.
Punchline.Translated: 快速、可筛选的投影台与衣橱替代方案。

Description.Original: Puts a searchable, sortable overlay over your Glamour Dresser. Find armor and outfit sets instantly, spot duplicates, filter by location, slot or expansion, group pieces into their outfit glamour sets, and pull pieces out of the dresser into your bags at a dresser.
