Description.Translated: 在你的投影台上叠加可搜索、可排序的界面。即时找到装备与套装，发现重复项，按位置、部位或版本筛选，把单件归入对应的套装幻化，并可在投影台将单件取出放入背包。

Punchline.Original: Repeatedly assists the party leader.
Punchline.Translated: 反复协助小队队长。

Description.Original: When enabled, repeatedly sets your target to the current target of the party leader.
Description.Translated: 启用后，反复将你的目标设为小队队长的当前目标。

Description.Original: Yet another tweaks collection plugin.
Description.Translated: 又一个 tweaks 合集插件。

Punchline.Original: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Punchline.Translated: 为部队 'The Holiest Fluffiness' 而生的调整插件，现已向所有人开放。

Description.Original: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description.Translated: 为部队 'The Holiest Fluffiness' 而生的调整插件，现已向所有人开放。

Punchline.Original: Helper plugin assisting with some of DMU/UMAD/Kefka Ultimate mechanics
Punchline.Translated: 协助处理部分 DMU/UMAD/Kefka Ultimate 机制的辅助插件

Description.Original: As of now allows: display of a forsaken debuff + chat notifications for past/future, LC safespot solving, automarking for P3 Blackhole, parsing P4 Kefka Says casts
Description.Translated: 目前允许：显示 forsaken 减益 + 过去/未来的聊天通知，LC 安全点解算，P3 黑洞自动标记，解析 P4 Kefka Says 读条

Punchline.Original: WoW-style floating combat text, fully configurable.
Punchline.Translated: WoW 风格浮动战斗文本，完全可配置。

Description.Original: Replaces FFXIV's default floating combat text with expressive, fully configurable WoW-style animations. Supports per-category colors, crit pop effects, glow outlines, screen shake, particle effects, arc styles, and game fonts — for every damage type, heal, DoT, miss, buff, and debuff separately.
Description.Translated: 将 FFXIV 默认的浮动战斗文本替换为富有表现力、完全可配置的 WoW 风格动画。支持按类别设置颜色、暴击弹出效果、发光轮廓、屏幕震动、粒子效果、弧形样式和游戏字体——可分别针对每种伤害类型、治疗、DoT、未命中、增益和减益。

Punchline.Original: Track and run Deathroll games at FFXIV venues with live danger meters, battle animations, and tournament brackets.
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 场所追踪并运行 Deathroll 游戏，提供实时危险计量表、战斗动画和锦标赛对阵图。

Description.Original: Track live Deathroll games with a real-time danger meter and animated stick-figure battle scene. Run full tournaments with single or double elimination brackets in V-bracket or left-to-right layouts. The relay system broadcasts your bracket to spectators via /say with a 6-character code and syncs live to a web viewer at tometools.com/bracket — no plugin required for spectators. Venue-tagged leaderboards track wins, losses, net gil, and win rates across all your events. Roll button auto-sends /random when it is your turn. Games and history persist between sessions.
Description.Translated: 通过实时危险计量表和动画火柴人战斗场景追踪实时 Deathroll 游戏。可运行完整锦标赛，支持单败或双败淘汰对阵图，以及 V 形对阵图或从左到右布局。中继系统会通过 /say 用 6 位字符代码向观众广播你的对阵图，并实时同步到 tometools.com/bracket 的网页查看器——观众无需安装插件。场所标签排行榜可追踪你所有活动的胜场、败场、净 gil 和胜率。轮到你时，掷骰按钮会自动发送 /random。游戏和对局历史在会话之间持久保存。

Punchline.Original: Build a picked GPose cast and hide everyone else.
Punchline.Translated: 组建精选的 GPose 阵容并隐藏其他所有人。

Description.Original: A compact GPose casting tool. Search visible actors, import overworld players into GPose for Brio/Ktisis, build a picked group, and hide everyone else locally for cleaner screenshots.
Description.Translated: 一款紧凑的 GPose 选角工具。搜索可见角色，将主世界玩家导入 GPose 以供 Brio/Ktisis 使用，组建精选队伍，并在本地隐藏其他所有人，以获得更干净的截图。

Punchline.Original: Spawn visual markers in the world for yourself and others to see.
Punchline.Translated: 在世界中生成视觉标记，供自己和他人查看。

Description.Original: A plugin that allows spawning VFX markers at world positions and also showing them to other players. Use F1-F4 to spawn different markers.
Description.Translated: 一个允许在世界坐标处生成 VFX 标记，并向其他玩家显示的插件。使用 F1-F4 生成不同标记。

Punchline.Original: Rabbit-sharp senses for whispers and wandering eyes.
Punchline.Translated: 对私语和游移目光拥有兔子般敏锐的感知。

Description.Original: Rabbit-sharp senses for whispers and wandering eyes.
Description.Translated: 对私语和游移目光拥有兔子般敏锐的感知。

Punchline.Original: Six live games under one roof, with more on the way.
Punchline.Translated: 六款实时游戏集于一身，更多内容即将推出。

Description.Original: The all-in-one hosting tool for FFXIV gambling venues, with six live games: BAR 777, Coin Collector, Deathroll Tournament, Higher/Lower, Raffle, and Voting Madness. Handles player queues, trade verification, boosted pots, ticket draws, live vote tallying, automated chat, and a full transaction ledger.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 赌博场所的一站式主持工具，内置六款实时游戏：BAR 777、Coin Collector、Deathroll Tournament、Higher/Lower、Raffle 和 Voting Madness。可管理玩家队列、交易验证、加注奖池、抽票、实时投票统计、自动聊天以及完整的交易账本。

Punchline.Original: Plan recipes and find every material you still need.
Punchline.Translated: 规划配方并找出你仍需要的所有材料。

Description.Original: Build a combined plan from multiple FFXIV recipes, compare NQ and HQ requirements with live inventory and saved retainer snapshots, track timed gathering materials, and hand crafting or travel actions to Artisan, Teamcraft, and GatherBuddy.
Description.Translated: 可从多个 FFXIV 配方构建组合计划，将 NQ 与 HQ 需求与实时背包和已保存的雇员快照进行对比，追踪限时采集材料，并将制作或移动操作交给 Artisan、Teamcraft 和 GatherBuddy。

Punchline.Original: Mod synchronization between paired players.
Punchline.Translated: 配对玩家之间的 Mod 同步。

Description.Original: Synchronize Penumbra mods, Glamourer state, Customize+, Honorific, SimpleHeels, Moodles and Pet Names between paired players.
Description.Translated: 在配对玩家之间同步 Penumbra mod、Glamourer 状态、Customize+、Honorific、SimpleHeels、Moodles 和 Pet Names。

Punchline.Original: Save and restore Penumbra priorities per Glamourer design.
Punchline.Translated: 按 Glamourer 设计保存和恢复 Penumbra 优先级。

Description.Original: Snapshots your Penumbra mod priorities when a Glamourer design is applied, letting you restore them instantly when priorities drift.
Description.Translated: 在应用 Glamourer 设计时快照你的 Penumbra mod 优先级，让你在优先级变动时可立即恢复。

Punchline.Original: Track /random rolls, host raffles, and automate clipboard trading.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪 /random 点数、主持抽奖并自动化剪贴板交易。

Description.Original: A tracker and manager for various /random games. Includes High vs Low, raffles, convenient clipboard functions, and more!
Description.Translated: 用于各种 /random 游戏的追踪与管理工具。包含 High vs Low、抽奖、便捷剪贴板功能等！

Name.Original: Why can't I hold all these dice?
Name.Translated: Why can't I hold all these dice?

Punchline.Original: A PvE GCD streak HUD.
Punchline.Translated: PvE GCD 连击 HUD。

Description.Original: Shows a local-player PvE GCD streak meter with oGCD count, best combo, and rank. Style Meter does not automate actions, parse damage, or send network requests.
Description.Translated: 显示本地玩家的 PvE GCD 连击条，包含 oGCD 数量、最佳连击和评级。Style Meter 不会自动执行操作、解析伤害或发送网络请求。

Punchline.Original: A Plugin that allows for Chat-Integrated Polls
Punchline.Translated: 支持聊天集成的投票插件

Description.Original:
A Plugin that allows the creation of Polls within a Text-Channel!

/chatpoll : Opens ChatPoll
Description.Translated:
一个允许在文本频道中创建投票的插件！

/chatpoll : 打开 ChatPoll

Punchline.Original: Save Party Finder presets, deploy them in one click, and auto-renew before the listing expires.
Punchline.Translated: 保存 Party Finder 预设，一键部署，并在招募信息过期前自动续期。

Description.Original: Create reusable Party Finder recruitment presets by capturing your current setup, deploy any preset with a single click, and keep the listing alive by automatically re-recruiting before the 60-minute timer expires. Optional periodic refresh keeps your listing near the top of the search.
Description.Translated: 通过捕获当前设置来创建可复用的 Party Finder 招募预设，单击即可部署任意预设，并在 60 分钟计时器到期前自动重新招募以保持招募信息有效。可选的定期刷新可让招募信息保持在搜索顶部附近。

Punchline.Original: Dancing Mad (Ultimate) raid markers.
Punchline.Translated: Dancing Mad (Ultimate) 团队副本标记。

Description.Original: Adds support for the Dancing Mad (Ultimate) encounter, including an automarker for the Forsaken tower/AoE sequence (configurable tower order, priority, and per-role markers). A fork of Lemegeton by Paissa Heavy Industries.
Description.Translated: 添加对 Dancing Mad (Ultimate) 遭遇战的支持，包括 Forsaken 塔/AoE 序列的自动标记（可配置塔顺序、优先级和按职能标记）。Paissa Heavy Industries 的 Lemegeton 分支。

Punchline.Original: Team mistake tracking and TTS reminders
Punchline.Translated: 团队失误追踪与 TTS 提醒

Description.Original: Local team mistake tracking with timeline TTS reminders. Supports auto learning and FFLogs timeline import.
Description.Translated: 本地团队失误追踪，带时间轴 TTS 提醒。支持自动学习和 FFLogs 时间轴导入。

Punchline.Original: Sweep gil from every alt onto one character.
Punchline.Translated: 把所有小号的 gil 集中到一个角色上。

Description.Original: Consolidates gil from your alt characters onto a single main. Logs into each character, travels to a chosen world via Lifestream, walks to your main with vnavmesh, trades over all gil above a floor you set, then returns to the FC. Requires AutoRetainer, Lifestream and vnavmesh; the receiving character needs Dropbox running to auto-accept the trades.
Description.Translated: 将小号角色的 gil 集中到一个主角色上。依次登录每个角色，通过 Lifestream 前往指定服务器，用 vnavmesh 走到你的主角色处，交易超过设定下限的所有 gil，然后返回部队房屋。需要 AutoRetainer、Lifestream 和 vnavmesh；接收角色需要运行 Dropbox 以自动接受交易。

Punchline.Original: "Nice mailbox. It would be a shame if someone... emptied it, kupo."
Punchline.Translated: “不错的邮箱。要是有人……把它清空了，那就太可惜了，库啵。”

Description.Original: A better mail service. Bulk attachment claiming, bulk delete, and inventory pop.
Description.Translated: 更好的邮件服务。批量领取附件、批量删除，以及一键收取到背包。

Punchline.Original: Automate Free Company chest deposits, withdrawals, organization, and workshop material pulls.
Punchline.Translated: 自动进行部队储物柜的存入、取出、整理，以及工坊材料提取。

Description.Original: Free Company Chest Helper. Automate deposits, withdrawals, organization, crystals, workshop project pulls, and custom item lists.
Description.Translated: 部队储物柜助手。自动存入、取出、整理、水晶、工坊项目提取，以及自定义物品列表。

Punchline.Original: And I love... Mathematics
Punchline.Translated: 而我喜欢……数学

Description.Original: A Plugin to add together the value of sold items.
Description.Translated: 一个用于汇总已售出物品价值的插件。

Punchline.Original: Final Fantasy XIV em portugues brasileiro.
Punchline.Translated: Final Fantasy XIV 巴西葡萄牙语版。

Description.Original: Traduz a interface e os textos de Final Fantasy XIV para portugues brasileiro (PT-BR). Projeto de fa, nao-oficial e nao afiliado a Square Enix.
Description.Translated: 将 Final Fantasy XIV 的界面和文本翻译为巴西葡萄牙语（PT-BR）。粉丝项目，非官方，与 Square Enix 无关联。

Punchline.Original: A tabletop card game plugin for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 桌面卡牌游戏插件。

Description.Original: Play a tabletop card game directly in FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 直接在 FFXIV 中游玩桌面卡牌游戏。

Punchline.Original: A keyframe animator for in-game animation.
Punchline.Translated: 用于游戏内动画的关键帧动画器。

Description.Original: A simple keyframe editor to create and play back animations using Ktisis. Use /animator to open the plugin window.
Description.Translated: 使用 Ktisis 创建并播放动画的简易关键帧编辑器。使用 /animator 打开插件窗口。

Punchline.Original: Workshop logistics, gear planning and cleanup, and inventory history.
Punchline.Translated: 工坊物流、装备规划与清理，以及库存历史。

Description.Original: FFXIV workshop logistics, gear planning and reviewed cleanup through Squire, and optional receiver-backed inventory history.
Description.Translated: 通过 Squire 实现 FFXIV 工坊物流、装备规划与经审核的清理，以及可选的由接收端支持的库存历史。

Punchline.Original: Owner-scoped retainer stock, target plans, and reviewed transfers.
Punchline.Translated: 以所有者范围为界的雇员库存、目标计划与经审核的转移。

Description.Original:
Retainer Quartermaster (RQ) lets you browse player and retainer stock, track
target quantities, inspect listings, refresh retainer evidence, and run
explicitly reviewed retrieval or elemental deposit operations. Use /rq to
open Quartermaster.
Description.Translated:
Retainer Quartermaster (RQ) 让你浏览玩家与雇员库存、追踪
目标数量、查看上架信息、刷新雇员证据，并执行
经明确审核的取回或元素存入操作。使用 /rq
打开 Quartermaster。

Punchline.Original: Local agent control and inspection connector.
Punchline.Translated: 本地代理控制与检查连接器。

Description.Original: In-game connector for the loopback-only Dalamud Agent Bridge utility. Use /dab to inspect status and configure optional permissions.
Description.Translated: 用于仅限回环的 Dalamud Agent Bridge 工具的插件内连接器。使用 /dab 检查状态并配置可选权限。

Punchline.Original: Remote control of your chat.
Punchline.Translated: 远程控制你的聊天。

Description.Original: Allows you to control any instance of FF connected to chat or send commands.
Description.Translated: 允许你控制任何已连接到聊天的 FF 客户端实例，或发送命令。

Punchline.Original: Look at the person talking to you /lookatme
Punchline.Translated: 看向正在与你交谈的人 /lookatme

Description.Original: A plugin that targets the player that's talking to you, it shifts your target to the last message received, if you want to monitor that chat
Description.Translated: 一个将目标切换到正在与你交谈的玩家的插件，若你想关注该聊天，它会把你的目标切换到最近收到的消息。

Punchline.Original: Automatically backs up your Glamourer designs at user-set intervals.
Punchline.Translated: 按用户设定的间隔自动备份你的 Glamourer 设计方案。

Description.Original: Periodically creates timestamped backups of all your Glamourer designs to prevent outfit loss on crashes. Also saves your currently equipped outfit via the Glamourer API. Configure the backup interval in settings.
Description.Translated: 定期为你的所有 Glamourer 设计方案创建带时间戳的备份，以防崩溃时丢失服装搭配。同时通过 Glamourer API 保存你当前装备的服装。可在设置中配置备份间隔。

Punchline.Original: Track relic materials across inventory and retainers.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪背包与雇员中的古武材料。

Description.Original: Track relic weapon, tool, and armor progress across every job, with live material counts and optional FFXIV Collect sync.
Description.Translated: 追踪所有职业的古武武器、工具和防具进度，实时显示材料数量，并可选与 FFXIV Collect 同步。

Description.Original: Automagically walks you around the world to find S and A ranks.
Description.Translated: 自动带你在地图上四处奔走，寻找 S 级和 A 级恶名精英。

Punchline.Original: Automated FATE farming with puni.sh-style integrations.
Punchline.Translated: 具备 puni.sh 风格集成的自动化 FATE farming。

Description.Original: Automates FATE farming: leveling, single zone, shared fates, atma, demiatma, luminous crystals, memories, and a fully customizable manual mode. Integrates with vnavmesh, Lifestream, BossMod Reborn, Wrath Combo, Rotation Solver Reborn, and AutoRetainer.
Description.Translated: 自动化 FATE farming：升级、单区域、共享 FATE、atma、demiatma、luminous crystals、memories，以及完全可自定义的手动模式。与 vnavmesh、Lifestream、BossMod Reborn、Wrath Combo、Rotation Solver Reborn 和 AutoRetainer 集成。

Punchline.Original: Your complete FFXIV venue guide.
Punchline.Translated: 你的完整 FFXIV 场馆指南。

Description.Original: A Dalamud plugin for discovering FFXIV venues with 2D/3D interactive markers, live events, and built-in owner tools. Your complete FFXIV venue guide.
Description.Translated: 一个 Dalamud 插件，用于发现 FFXIV 场馆，提供 2D/3D 交互式标记、实时活动以及内置的场馆主工具。你的完整 FFXIV 场馆指南。

Punchline.Original: Run Truth or Dare rounds at your venue without tracking rolls by hand.
Punchline.Translated: 在你的场馆举办真心话大冒险环节，无需手动记录掷骰。

Description.Original: Opens a timed entry window, records one /random or /dice roll per player, then works out who asks and who answers. Highest roller sets the prompt, lowest takes it. Editable truth and dare lists feed !truth and !dare, plus jackpots, bonus prizes and settings profiles.
Description.Translated: 开启限时参与窗口，记录每位玩家的一次 /random 或 /dice 掷骰，然后判定谁提问、谁回答。掷骰最高者设定题目，最低者接受。可编辑的真心话和大冒险列表供 !truth 和 !dare 使用，另有头奖、额外奖品和设置配置档案。

Punchline.Original: Host live Chocobo Racing events with zero manual bookkeeping.
Punchline.Translated: 零手动记账举办实时 Chocobo Racing 活动。

Description.Original: Host live Chocobo Racing events at your venue with zero manual bookkeeping. Bets are captured from party and alliance chat automatically, player banks track every balance, and payouts are calculated at the click of a button. Run 2-10 chocobos with custom track lengths, odds, and branded chat messages. Full race history and profit/loss reporting included. Spectators can watch live and your players can place bets online with a PIN with the brand new webview feature.
Description.Translated: 在你的场馆零手动记账举办实时 Chocobo Racing 活动。下注会从小队和团队聊天中自动捕获，玩家资金账户跟踪每一笔余额，点击按钮即可计算赔付。可运行 2-10 只陆行鸟，自定义赛道长度、赔率和带有品牌标识的聊天消息。包含完整比赛历史和盈亏报告。观众可以实时观看，你的玩家可以使用 PIN 通过全新 webview 功能在线下注。

Punchline.Original: Find and host FFXIV gambling events near you.
Punchline.Translated: 寻找并举办你附近的 FFXIV 博彩活动。

Description.Original: Browse live gambling events across Eorzea, filter by game or data centre, and teleport straight there with Lifestream. Host your own session with game-specific rules, presets, and host profiles with automatic location updates, Discord webhooks, minimap host icons, and Party Finder shortcuts. Find or advertise for venues and hosts on the Recruitment board, and set custom alerts to be notified when a new event matches your preferences.
Description.Translated: 浏览艾欧泽亚各地的实时博彩活动，按游戏或数据中心筛选，并通过 Lifestream 直接传送到那里。使用各游戏专属规则、预设和主持人档案举办你自己的场次，支持自动位置更新、Discord webhooks、小地图主持人图标和 Party Finder 快捷方式。在招募板上寻找或宣传场馆和主持人，并设置自定义提醒，以便在新活动符合你的偏好时收到通知。

Punchline.Original: Quickly deposit/withdraw items from saddlebag via right-click
Punchline.Translated: 通过右键快速存取陆行鸟鞍囊物品

Description.Original: Quickly deposit and withdraw items from your chocobo saddlebag via right-click context menu.
Description.Translated: 通过右键上下文菜单快速存取陆行鸟鞍囊中的物品。

Punchline.Original: Eureka Tracker in a plugin with many other features.
Punchline.Translated: Eureka Tracker 集成于一个包含许多其他功能的插件中。

Description.Original:
A tool to assist you on your Eureka adventures, now updated for Dawntrail! Type /eurekahelper to get started.

Features include:
- In-Game Tracker GUI
- Instance Tracker
- Elementals Tracker
- Relic Helper
- Alarms
- Money NM weather timings
- More to come
Description.Translated:
助你进行 Eureka 冒险的工具，现已更新至 Dawntrail！输入 /eurekahelper 开始使用。

功能包括：
- 游戏内追踪 GUI
- 副本追踪
- 元素追踪
-  relic 助手
- 闹钟
- 金钱 NM 天气时间
- 更多功能即将推出

Punchline.Original: Track raid clears and unlock achievements.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪副本通关并解锁成就。

Description.Original: Adds achievement tracking and milestone unlocks to FFLogsViewer.
Description.Translated: 为 FFLogsViewer 添加成就追踪和里程碑解锁。

Punchline.Original: Collection of small QoL tweaks and commands
Punchline.Translated: 小型 QoL 调整和命令的集合

Description.Original: Collection of small QoL tweaks and commands
Description.Translated: 小型 QoL 调整和命令的集合

Punchline.Original: Display your retainers' remaining venture time in the DTR bar.
Punchline.Translated: 在 DTR 栏中显示你的雇员剩余探险时间。

Description.Original: Display your retainers' remaining venture time in the DTR bar.
Description.Translated: 在 DTR 栏中显示你的雇员剩余探险时间。

Punchline.Original: Virtually extends the in-game ignore list (client-side).
Punchline.Translated: 在客户端虚拟扩展游戏内忽略列表。

Description.Original: Client-side virtual extension of the FFXIV ignore list: additionally mute and hide players, with categories, notes and auto-expiry. UI available in English and German.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 忽略列表的客户端侧虚拟扩展：额外静音并隐藏玩家，支持分类、备注和自动过期。UI 提供英语和德语。

Punchline.Original: Host the Ripple Shot jackpot game from the bar.
Punchline.Translated: 在酒吧主持 Ripple Shot 头奖游戏。

Description.Original: Bartender tool for the Ripple Shot /random jackpot game: pricing, per-night caps with Supabase VIPs, a pot that grows as rolls happen, automatic win detection and payout, and a ready-to-paste chat announcement.
Description.Translated: 用于 Ripple Shot /random 头奖游戏的调酒师工具：定价、基于 Supabase VIP 的每晚上限、随掷骰增长的奖池、自动中奖检测与派彩，以及可直接粘贴的聊天公告。

Punchline.Original: Template for NNekoPlugins Dalamud Plugin Repositories.
Punchline.Translated: NNekoPlugins Dalamud 插件仓库的模板。

Description.Original: Organization Template for NNekoPlugins Dalamud Plugin Repositories.
Description.Translated: 用于 NNekoPlugins Dalamud 插件仓库的组织模板。

Punchline.Original: Your Last.fm now-playing track as an honorific
Punchline.Translated: 将你的 Last.fm 正在播放曲目作为 Honorific 称号

Description.Original: Update honorific title based on your currently playing Last.fm track (works with anything that scrobbles, e.g. YouTube Music, Spotify, foobar2000). Adapted from SpotifyHonorific by Valiice (AGPL-3.0).
Description.Translated: 根据你当前在 Last.fm 播放的曲目更新 Honorific 称号（适用于任何支持 scrobble 的服务，例如 YouTube Music、Spotify、foobar2000）。改编自 Valiice 的 SpotifyHonorific（AGPL-3.0）。

Description.Original: Host tool for running 3-digit POP Ticket lottery rounds in FFXIV. Add players, track bets, auto-detect winning numbers from chat, resolve payouts, and keep a full draw history.
Description.Translated: 用于在 FFXIV 中运行 3 位数 POP Ticket 彩票轮次的主持工具。添加玩家、跟踪投注、从聊天中自动检测中奖号码、结算派彩，并保留完整开奖历史。

Punchline.Original: A set of useful tools for gposing
Punchline.Translated: 一套用于 GPose 的实用工具

Description.Original: A set of useful tools for gposing
Description.Translated: 一套用于 GPose 的实用工具

Punchline.Original: Advanced controls for portraits & adventurer plates.
Punchline.Translated: 肖像与冒险者铭牌的高级控制。

Description.Original:
Take your portrait & adventurer plate game to the next level with this companion panel for the portrait editor.

• Rewind, fast forward, and step through animations frame by frame.
• Adjust character head and eye direction without moving the camera.
• Position camera and pivot point with a top-down map.
• More intuitive controls for lighting color and angle.
Description.Translated:
通过这个肖像编辑器的配套面板，让你的肖像与冒险者铭牌更上一层楼。

• 回退、快进并逐帧浏览动画。
• 在不移动镜头的情况下调整角色头部与视线方向。
• 通过俯视地图定位镜头与轴心点。
• 更直观的光照颜色与角度控制。

Punchline.Original: Let others see you as you see yourself.
Punchline.Translated: 让其他人以你眼中的自己来看待你。

Description.Original: This plugin will synchronize your Penumbra mods and current Glamourer state with other paired clients automatically.
Description.Translated: 此插件会自动将你的 Penumbra 模组与当前 Glamourer 状态同步到其他已配对的客户端。

Punchline.Original: Record and replay movement trajectories on a 2D map.
Punchline.Translated: 在 2D 地图上记录并回放移动轨迹。

Description.Original: Records the movement of yourself, party members, and bosses, and replays them on a 2D map. Commands: /mtracker, /mtracker map
Description.Translated: 记录你自己、队员和 BOSS 的移动，并在 2D 地图上回放。命令：/mtracker、/mtracker map

Punchline.Original: Plugin to save current appearance and applied mods of a character
Punchline.Translated: 用于保存角色当前外观及所应用模组的插件

Description.Original: Want to export your character and mods exactly as-is in a single collection *without* Mare? This plugin saves and loads your character's current appearance, and allows you to share modded characters without relying on MCDF.
Description.Translated: 想要在*不使用* Mare 的情况下，将你的角色与模组按原样导出为单个合集？此插件可保存并加载角色当前外观，并允许你在不依赖 MCDF 的情况下分享已装模组的角色。

Punchline.Original: A pose browser to work with Brio.
Punchline.Translated: 与 Brio 配合使用的姿势浏览器。

Description.Original: A pose browser interfacing with brio.
Description.Translated: 与 brio 交互的姿势浏览器。

Punchline.Original: Infinite Blue Mage spell loadouts.
Punchline.Translated: 无限 Blue Mage 技能配置方案。

Description.Original: Allows you to save, load, and share infinite Blue Mage spell loadouts and hotbars.
Description.Translated: 允许你保存、加载和分享无限的 Blue Mage 技能配置方案与热键栏。

Punchline.Original: Bookmark the venues you visit. View and manage guests for venues.
Punchline.Translated: 收藏你到访的场所。查看并管理场所的客人。

Description.Original: Save and share venues you visit or own. Get updates and logs for visitors coming and going. Guest list management tools for venue owners to view and easily export it for use with other applications. Icon by Silv :)
Description.Translated: 保存并分享你到访或拥有的场所。获取访客来去的更新与日志。为场所所有者提供的客人名单管理工具，可查看并轻松导出以供其他应用程序使用。图标由 Silv 制作 :)

Punchline.Original: See current player coordinates.
Punchline.Translated: 查看当前玩家坐标。

Description.Original: Displays current player coordinates.
Description.Translated: 显示当前玩家坐标。

Punchline.Original: Get the coordinate information for all nearby players
Punchline.Translated: 获取附近所有玩家的坐标信息

Description.Original: Allows you to get the coordinate information for all nearby players
Description.Translated: 允许你获取附近所有玩家的坐标信息

Punchline.Original: A game to play when dead.
Punchline.Translated: 死亡时玩的游戏。

Description.Original: Opens on death, or /aetherbomber. A Bomberman clone mini-game.
Description.Translated: 死亡时打开，或输入 /aetherbomber。一个 Bomberman 克隆小游戏。

Punchline.Original: A raid plan viewer, also to look at cats
Punchline.Translated: 一个副本攻略查看器，也能用来看猫

Description.Original: Where Do I Go? /wdig to check your spot! An image viewer plugin so you don't have to alt-tab or use a second monitor to reference guides or images while in game.'
Description.Translated: Where Do I Go? 输入 /wdig 查看你的站位！一个图片查看器插件，让你在游戏中查阅攻略或图片时无需 alt-tab 或使用第二块显示器。

Punchline.Original: We do a little testing
Punchline.Translated: 我们做点小测试

Description.Original: Testing tool based on AetherBox by BrakusTapus.
Description.Translated: 基于 BrakusTapus 的 AetherBox 的测试工具。

Punchline.Original: Browse and one-click apply FFXIV modded looks.
Punchline.Translated: 浏览并一键应用 FFXIV 模组外观。

Description.Original: Browse the Raimere catalog in-game, apply a look's glamour with one click via Glamourer, and open links to the component mods. Links only, no mod files are hosted or installed by this plugin.
Description.Translated: 在游戏内浏览 Raimere 目录，通过 Glamourer 一键应用某个外观的幻化，并打开组成模组的链接。仅提供链接，本插件不托管也不安装任何模组文件。

Punchline.Original: 杏仁造境 · FFXIV Housing Atelier /almond
Punchline.Translated: 杏仁造境 · FFXIV Housing Atelier /almond

Description.Original:
AlmondHousing · Housing Atelier — a focused FFXIV housing tool for furniture search, layout management, material audit, protected sharing, and advanced placement controls.

AlmondHousing · 杏仁造境，专注 FF14 房屋装修场景，提供家具检索、布局管理、物料盘点、加密分享与高级摆放调节。

/almond to open panel | 输入 /almond 打开面板
Description.Translated:
AlmondHousing · Housing Atelier — 专注 FFXIV 房屋装修场景的工具，提供家具检索、布局管理、物料盘点、加密分享与高级摆放调节。

AlmondHousing · 杏仁造境，专注 FF14 房屋装修场景，提供家具检索、布局管理、物料盘点、加密分享与高级摆放调节。

/almond 打开面板 | 输入 /almond 打开面板

Punchline.Original: Bridge one CWLS with your community Discord.
Punchline.Translated: 将一个 CWLS 与你的社区 Discord 桥接。

Description.Original: By FranFkntastic. Connect one FFXIV cross-world linkshell to a community-owned Discord bot with exact CWLS identity checks.
Description.Translated: 作者：FranFkntastic。通过精确的 CWLS 身份校验，将一个 FFXIV 跨服通讯贝连接到社区自有的 Discord 机器人。

Punchline.Original: A compact Dalamud market board helper for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 适用于 FFXIV 的紧凑 Dalamud 市场板助手。

Description.Original:
A compact market board helper with quick item lookup, sortable tables, configurable market scopes, and clearer Universalis freshness information.

Highlights:
  - Search from hover, hotkey, clipboard, or item name
  - Compare prices by world, data center, or region
  - Sort and resize market tables
  - View retainer names, buyer names, market freshness, and market velocity when available
Description.Translated:
一个小巧的市场板助手，支持快速物品查询、可排序表格、可配置市场范围，以及更清晰的 Universalis 新鲜度信息。

亮点：
  - 通过悬停、快捷键、剪贴板或物品名称搜索
  - 按服务器、数据中心或区域比较价格
  - 排序并调整市场表格大小
  - 在可用时查看雇员名称、买家名称、市场新鲜度和市场流通速度

Punchline.Original: High-resolution screenshots beyond the UI limit.
Punchline.Translated: 突破 UI 限制的高分辨率截图。

Description.Original: Switches to a custom high resolution so you can take screenshots beyond the in-game limit, then lets you restore your original resolution when done. Configure your target resolution once and trigger on demand.
Description.Translated: 切换到自定义高分辨率，以便拍摄超出游戏内限制的截图，完成后可恢复原始分辨率。一次配置目标分辨率，并按需触发。

Punchline.Original: Watch YouTube videos and livestreams (and more) on a wall in FFXIV, together with your friends.
Punchline.Translated: 与朋友一起在 FFXIV 的墙面上观看 YouTube 视频和直播（以及更多内容）。

Description.Original:
Projects YouTube videos and livestreams (and any source) onto a surface in the world or onto a minion, with a synchronized broadcast from the host to the peers. Requires DirectX 11.

⚠ IN TESTING & VALIDATION: the plugin is still in development and may freeze/crash.

To show the video ON A MINION you must install the (Penumbra) mod that provides the correct minion screen shape: https://www.xivmodarchive.com/modid/112306
Description.Translated:
将 YouTube 视频和直播（以及任意来源）投射到世界中的表面或宠物上，并由主机向对等端同步广播。需要 DirectX 11。

⚠ 测试与验证中：该插件仍在开发中，可能会卡死/崩溃。

要在宠物上显示视频，你必须安装可提供正确宠物屏幕形状的 (Penumbra) mod：https://www.xivmodarchive.com/modid/112306

Punchline.Original: View player information without manually clicking on them!
Punchline.Translated: 无需手动点击玩家即可查看玩家信息！

Description.Original: Lists all players in your current instance and lets you Examine, view their Adventure Plate, copy their name for /tell, invite them to party, or send a friend request — all without clicking on them directly.
Description.Translated: 列出你当前副本中的所有玩家，并允许你查看角色信息、查看他们的冒险者铭牌、复制其名称用于 /tell、邀请他们加入小队，或发送好友请求——全程无需直接点击他们。

Punchline.Original: Show your current project work as an Honorific title.
Punchline.Translated: 将你当前的项目工作显示为 Honorific 称号。

Description.Original: Reads a local project status bridge file and sends the current project activity to an Honorific-compatible title plugin.
Description.Translated: 读取本地项目状态桥接文件，并将当前项目活动发送到兼容 Honorific 的称号插件。

Punchline.Original: Local debug tools for troubleshooting.
Punchline.Translated: 用于故障排查的本地调试工具。

Description.Original: Local debug console for combat logs, addon snapshots, and Strategy Board inspection. Open with /ndc.
Description.Translated: 用于战斗日志、addon 快照和 Strategy Board 检查的本地调试控制台。使用 /ndc 打开。

Punchline.Original: Your phone, your OS, matchmaking and more
Punchline.Translated: 你的手机、你的 OS、匹配交友等等

Description.Original: FFXIV in-game dating and matchmaking — swipe, match, and chat with other adventurers. /aos opens the phone.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 游戏内约会与匹配——滑动、匹配，并与其他冒险者聊天。使用 /aos 打开手机。

Punchline.Original: Track your housing lottery bids: plot, world, entry number, results date, win/loss.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪你的房屋抽签出价：地块、服务器、入场号码、结果日期、输赢。

Description.Original: Passively records every housing lottery bid you place, per character, by reading the placard when you interact with it. One row per bid: character/world, region, district, ward, plot, size, FC-vs-personal, entry date, results-available date with live countdown, and outcome (Pending/Won/Lost). Auto-captures placard data during entry and results periods; auto-detects wins via the results SelectYesno; entry number is grabbed when shown and editable otherwise. Sortable table with click-to-expand details, per-column toggles, editable notes, and optional shared storage across all clients. Open with /hlt (alias /lotto).
Description.Translated: 通过在你与告示牌交互时读取告示牌，被动记录你提交的每一次房屋抽签出价，按角色区分。每次出价一行：角色/服务器、大区、区域、小区、地块、大小、部队房或个人房、入场日期、结果可查看日期（带实时倒计时），以及结果（待定/中签/未中）。在入场和结果期间自动捕获告示牌数据；通过结果 SelectYesno 自动检测中签；入场号码在显示时抓取，否则可编辑。可排序表格，点击展开详情，每列开关，可编辑备注，以及可选的跨所有客户端共享存储。使用 /hlt（别名 /lotto）打开。

Punchline.Original: Undercut, list, gather and buy — market board automation end to end.
Punchline.Translated: 压价、上架、采集和购买——市场板自动化端到端。

Description.Original:
Market Helper is an all-in-one market board tool with three tabs:

UNDERCUT — Stand near a summoning bell and press Run. It walks every retainer on the bell and undercuts each listed item to the lowest price. HQ/NQ handling, own-retainer protection, per-item overrides, and price memory within a run. Skips mannequin/display items (detected by the game's mannequin icon) so they're never touched or delisted.

LISTER — Build a list of items (hold CTRL and hover to quick-add, or search). Press Go and it walks the bell and lists them all, pricing each at the most common market price (ignoring lone troll/outlier listings) minus your undercut. Prices against your world, data center, or whole region. Handles the 20-item-per-retainer cap by rolling extra items to the next retainer. Includes a no-touch dry-run preview.

FLIPPER — Search any marketable item and compare prices across Japan, America, Europe and Materia via Universalis. Top 10 listings per region, best cross-region flip, and seller/buyer tax modeling.

BUYER — Build a shopping list with a per-item quantity and a hard max price. Import a MakePlace furniture list or build a list by hand, choose your scope — my world, my data center, my whole region, or a custom set of data centers — and press SCAN to sweep it via Universalis and see, per item, where the cheapest listings are and how many are available under your cap. Press SEND and it hops world to world with Lifestream, opens a market board, and buys everything at or under your price. Dry run is on by default so you can prove the route without spending a gil, and every purchase is verified against the game's own confirmation dialog before it's accepted.

Open with /markethelp, /market, /mh, or /undercut.
Description.Translated:
Market Helper 是一款一体化市场板工具，包含三个标签页：

UNDERCUT — 站在召唤铃旁并按下 Run。它会遍历铃上的每个雇员，并将每个上架物品压价到最低价。HQ/NQ 处理、自有雇员保护、按物品覆盖设置，以及单次运行内的价格记忆。跳过模特/展示物品（通过游戏的模特图标检测），因此它们永远不会被触碰或下架。

LISTER — 构建物品列表（按住 CTRL 并悬停可快速添加，或搜索）。按下 Go，它会遍历铃并全部上架，每个物品定价为最常见的市场价格（忽略孤立的钓鱼/异常上架）减去你的压价幅度。根据你的服务器、数据中心或整个大区定价。通过将额外物品滚动到下一个雇员来处理每个雇员 20 件物品的上限。包含无接触试运行预览。

FLIPPER — 搜索任何可交易物品，并通过 Universalis 比较日本、美国、欧洲和 Materia 的价格。每个大区前 10 条上架信息，最佳跨大区倒卖，以及卖家/买家税费建模。

BUYER — 构建购物清单，包含每个物品的数量和硬性最高价格。导入 MakePlace 家具列表或手动构建列表，选择你的范围——我的服务器、我的数据中心、我的整个大区，或自定义数据中心集合——然后按下 SCAN 通过 Universalis 扫描，查看每个物品最便宜的上架在哪里，以及在你的上限内有多少可用。按下 SEND，它会使用 Lifestream 在服务器之间跳转，打开市场板，并购买所有等于或低于你价格的物品。默认开启试运行，这样你可以在不花费一吉尔的情况下验证路线，并且每次购买在接受之前都会根据游戏自己的确认对话框进行验证。

使用 /markethelp、/market、/mh 或 /undercut 打开。

Punchline.Original: A Gposing tool.
Punchline.Translated: Gpose 工具。

Description.Original: A Gposing and scene tool.
Description.Translated: Gpose 与场景工具。

Punchline.Original: A clearer party death review.
Punchline.Translated: 更清晰的队伍死亡复盘。

Description.Original: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Description.Translated: 记录队伍死亡，按 pull 分组，包含致命事件、激活的状态以及近期行动时间轴。

Punchline.Original: Scale down Chaos
Punchline.Translated: 缩小 Chaos

Description.Original: Scales down Chaos in DMU for visibility.
Description.Translated: 在 DMU 中缩小 Chaos 以便看清。

Punchline.Original: Track DMU P3 Black Hole and P4 debuffs.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪 DMU P3 黑洞与 P4 减益。

Description.Original: Shows a compact DMU helper window for P3 Black Hole assignments and P4 debuff guidance.
Description.Translated: 显示一个紧凑的 DMU 助手窗口，用于 P3 黑洞分配与 P4 减益指引。

Punchline.Original: DMU mitigation timeline helper.
Punchline.Translated: DMU 减伤时间轴助手。

Description.Original: Shows upcoming dmu mitigation based on fight timeline
Description.Translated: 根据战斗时间轴显示即将到来的 DMU 减伤安排

Punchline.Original: Auto-refreshes your Party Finder listing on a timer.
Punchline.Translated: 定时自动刷新你的 Party Finder 招募列表。

Description.Original: Automatically refreshes your active Party Finder recruitment listing at a configurable interval
Description.Translated: 按可配置的间隔自动刷新你当前生效的 Party Finder 招募列表

Punchline.Original: Adds invisible collision barriers around locally-spawned objects.
Punchline.Translated: 在本地生成的物体周围添加不可见碰撞屏障。

Description.Original: Hooks the RMI (raw movement input) pipeline to intercept player movement before it reaches the game server. When the player attempts to walk into a registered barrier volume (placed around locally-visible props), the movement component pointing into the barrier is zeroed and a sliding response is computed. The server only ever sees the player stop moving naturally.
Description.Translated: 挂钩 RMI（原始移动输入）管线，在玩家移动到达游戏服务器前进行拦截。当玩家试图走入已注册的屏障体积（放置在本地可见道具周围）时，指向屏障的移动分量会被归零，并计算出滑动响应。服务器只会看到玩家自然地停止移动。

Punchline.Original: Spawn locally-visible props and environmental objects into the game world.
Punchline.Translated: 将本地可见的道具和环境物体生成到游戏世界中。

Description.Original: Spawns static game models (rocks, trees, furniture, environmental props) into the game world that only the local player can see. Uses direct actor spawn functions from FFXIVClientStructs. All spawned actors are tracked and cleaned up on zone change, logout, and plugin unload. Supports optional host/client sync so other players running LocalWorld can see the same props.
Description.Translated: 将静态游戏模型（岩石、树木、家具、环境道具）生成到游戏世界中，且只有本地玩家可见。使用来自 FFXIVClientStructs 的直接 actor 生成函数。所有生成的 actor 都会被追踪，并在切换区域、登出和插件卸载时清理。支持可选的 host/client 同步，以便其他运行 LocalWorld 的玩家也能看到相同的道具。

Punchline.Original: แปล UI ทั้งหมดของ FFXIV เป็นภาษาไทย
Punchline.Translated: 将 FFXIV 的全部 UI 翻译为泰语。

Description.Original:
Plugin แปลอินเตอร์เฟสของ Final Fantasy XIV ทั้งหมดเป็นภาษาไทย รองรับเมนู ภารกิจ ดันเจี้ยน และ UI ทุกประเภท

วิธีใช้: พิมพ์ /thaiui เพื่อเปิดหน้าตั้งค่า
Description.Translated:
将 Final Fantasy XIV 的全部界面翻译为泰语，支持菜单、任务、副本以及所有类型的 UI

使用方法：输入 /thaiui 打开设置窗口

Punchline.Original: Automate and track Death Roll matches.
Punchline.Translated: 自动化并追踪 Death Roll 对局。

Description.Original: Easyest Death Roll of your life.
Description.Translated: 你人生中最轻松的 Death Roll。

Punchline.Original: Dalamud Plugin Companion for FullParty.gg
Punchline.Translated: FullParty.gg 的 Dalamud 插件伴侣

Description.Original: Dalamud Plugin Companion for FullParty.gg
Description.Translated: FullParty.gg 的 Dalamud 插件伴侣

Punchline.Original: Display images or text when chat keywords appear.
Punchline.Translated: 聊天关键词出现时显示图片或文本。

Description.Original: Display images or text when chat log keywords appear.
Description.Translated: 聊天日志关键词出现时显示图片或文本。

Punchline.Original: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.
Punchline.Translated: 管理你的 Party Finder：预设、队伍进度和玩家查询。

Description.Original: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.
Description.Translated: 管理你的 Party Finder 招募，并查看与你一起玩的人。将任务、目标、职能和条件配置保存为预设，一键应用任意预设；实时查看招募信息和队伍填充情况；查询队伍成员的进度和社区评价。

Punchline.Original: Duty-pop alerts straight to your Discord DMs.
Punchline.Translated: 副本确认提醒直接发送到你的 Discord 私信。

Description.Original: Get a Discord DM the instant your duty pops. Join the DutyDM Discord server, enter your Discord username, and the bot will message you the moment your queue is ready - with an in-game popup confirming it sent.
Description.Translated: 副本一确认就收到 Discord 私信。加入 DutyDM Discord 服务器，输入你的 Discord 用户名，队列就绪的瞬间机器人就会给你发消息——并弹出游戏内提示确认已发送。

Punchline.Original: Raises everyone around you, and accepts your own. Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
Punchline.Translated: 复活你周围的每个人，并自动接受针对你的复活。为 Occult Crescent 和 FATE 打造。

Description.Original:
Raises dead players around you, and accepts raises cast on you.

Requires Rotation Solver Reborn - add the Combat Reborn repository:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/CombatRebornRepo/main/pluginmaster.json

One switch. Anyone in range who needs a raise gets one, Swiftcast first. In Occult Crescent it uses Occult Raise or Revive instead, which work on any job. It pauses your rotation only when a rez is genuinely about to happen, then puts it back exactly as it was. Four switches decide where it works: open world and FATEs, instanced duties, Eureka and Bozja, and the Crescent.

Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
Description.Translated:
复活你周围的死亡玩家，并接受施放在你身上的复活。

需要 Rotation Solver Reborn——添加 Combat Reborn 仓库：
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/CombatRebornRepo/main/pluginmaster.json

一个开关。范围内任何需要复活的人都会得到复活，优先使用 Swiftcast。在 Occult Crescent 中则改用 Occult Raise 或 Revive，它们适用于任何职业。只有当复活确实即将发生时才会暂停你的循环，然后原样恢复。四个开关决定它在哪些场景生效：开放世界和 FATE、副本、Eureka 和 Bozja，以及 Crescent。

为 Occult Crescent 和 FATE 打造。

Punchline.Original: A robust custom macro system for the Kefka UMAD/DMU Phase 4 mechanics.
Punchline.Translated: 为 Kefka UMAD/DMU 第四阶段机制打造的一套稳健的自定义宏系统。

Description.Original: A robust custom macro system for the Kefka UMAD/DMU Phase 4 mechanics. Press the buttons for what you see in the fight and it lays out clean, colour-coded callouts. Open with /snazzyp4.
Description.Translated: 为 Kefka UMAD/DMU 第四阶段机制打造的一套稳健的自定义宏系统。按你在战斗中看到的情况点击按钮，它就会给出整洁、带颜色标记的提示。使用 /snazzyp4 打开。

Punchline.Original: A sleek Penumbra bridge panel for GoonersLife+ mod control.
Punchline.Translated: 为 GoonersLife+ mod 控制打造的精美 Penumbra 桥接面板。

Description.Original: Goonerslife Penu Bridge is a dedicated overlay for controlling the GoonersLife+ Penumbra mod. Toggle options and mod states instantly from a clean, dark control panel without opening Penumbra.
Description.Translated: Goonerslife Penu Bridge 是用于控制 GoonersLife+ Penumbra mod 的专用悬浮面板。无需打开 Penumbra，即可在简洁的深色控制面板中即时切换选项和 mod 状态。

Punchline.Original: Flat, floor-projected waymarks.
Punchline.Translated: 平铺贴地的场地标记。

Description.Original: Renders the 8 field waymarks (A/B/C/D and 1/2/3/4) as flat, 2D markers lying on the floor instead of the 3D holographic pillars — like a raid-plan diagram, in-game. Markers follow uneven terrain and stairs. Optionally hides the native pillars (per waymark), and offers per-marker color, size, and opacity controls plus colorblind-friendly color schemes (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia) you can save, import, and export.
Description.Translated: 将 8 个场地标记（A/B/C/D 与 1/2/3/4）渲染为平贴在场地上的 2D 标记，而非 3D 全息光柱——就像游戏内的攻略站位图。标记会贴合起伏地形和楼梯。可选按标记隐藏原生光柱，并提供每个标记的颜色、大小和不透明度控制，以及可保存、导入和导出的色盲友好配色方案（红色盲、绿色盲、蓝色盲）。

Punchline.Original: Wear the look. Share the thread.
Punchline.Translated: 穿上造型，分享穿搭。

Description.Original: A creator-focused glamour platform for discovering, publishing, saving, and applying FFXIV looks through Aetherweave, with creator profiles, wardrobe management, dependency safety, and Glamourer integration.
Description.Translated: 面向创作者、通过 Aetherweave 发现、发布、保存并应用 FFXIV 造型的幻化平台，具备创作者主页、衣柜管理、依赖安全检查以及 Glamourer 集成。

Description.Original: A running log of everything you do while decorating your house, indoors and out in the yard: placing, removing, storing, moving, rotating, and dyeing furniture, all with coordinates. Forgot what you just changed, or moved something and want it back? Click a coordinate to move the selected item there, or hit Undo on any move to snap it back automatically. Also shows what changed while you were away, and keeps a separate history for each of your houses. Built to sit alongside Burning Down the House. Type /houselog to open it.
Description.Translated: 持续记录你在装饰房屋时的一切操作，包括室内与庭院：摆放、移除、收纳、移动、旋转和染色家具，并附上坐标。忘记刚刚改动了什么，或者移动了某件家具想还原？点击坐标即可将选中的家具移动到该位置，或对任意一次移动点击撤销，让它自动回到原位。还会显示你不在期间发生的改动，并为每栋房屋分别保存独立的历史记录。设计上与 Burning Down the House 搭配使用。输入 /houselog 打开。

Punchline.Original: Save and apply Party Finder recruitment presets instantly.
Punchline.Translated: 即时保存并应用 Party Finder 招募预设。

Description.Original:
Store a full Party Finder recruitment setup (duty, job slots, description, objective, loot rule, one player per job, language, and more) as a named preset and apply it in one go, instead of filling the form out by hand every time.

Fill a preset and review it, or fill and post the party in a single click. Optional auto-refresh keeps an active listing alive near the end of its hour, with the windows closed, and leaves your away status alone.

Open the Recruitment Criteria form (Recruit Members) to save or apply. Use /clarion.
Description.Translated:
将完整的 Party Finder 招募配置（任务、职业位、描述、目标、战利品规则、每职业一名玩家、语言等）保存为命名预设并一键套用，无需每次手动填写表单。

可以填入预设后先查看，也可以一键填入并发布招募。可选的自动刷新会在招募接近一小时结束时、在窗口关闭的情况下保持招募有效，且不会改动你的暂离状态。

打开招募条件表单（招募队员）即可保存或套用。使用 /clarion。

Punchline.Original: Plan and monitor your Free Company submarine fleets.
Punchline.Translated: 规划并监控你的 Free Company 潜艇舰队。

Description.Original: Plan Free Company submarine operations from local SubmarineTracker data: choose which tracked FCs to show, prioritize returns and next actions, forecast leveling and sector unlocks, review recorded salvage income, configure farming routes, and estimate ceruleum fuel runway. Requires Submarine Tracker to be installed and enabled. Open it with /seta. The installer icon was created with AI assistance.
Description.Translated: 基于本地 SubmarineTracker 数据规划 Free Company 潜艇作业：选择要显示的已追踪 FC、按返航与下一步行动排序、预测升级与海区解锁、查看已记录的打捞收益、配置采集路线，并估算青磷水燃料续航。需要安装并启用 Submarine Tracker。使用 /seta 打开。安装程序图标由 AI 协助创建。

Punchline.Original: Become the wind-up doll of your dreams, or wind dolls up.
Punchline.Translated: 成为你梦寐以求的发条玩偶，或者给玩偶上发条。

Description.Original: A (hopefully) simple plugin. Dolls need winding, and winders can wind up dolls.
Description.Translated: 一个（但愿）简单的插件。玩偶需要上发条，而上发条的人可以给玩偶上发条。

Punchline.Original: Hrothgar make coin. Coin good.
Punchline.Translated: Hrothgar 赚金币。金币好。

Description.Original: Automatically undercuts your retainer market board listings, with optional AutoRetainer post-venture integration. A rebrand/fork of Dagobert by SHOEGAZEssb.
Description.Translated: 自动压低你的雇员市场板挂单价格，可选与 AutoRetainer 的探索后处理集成。由 SHOEGAZEssb 制作的 Dagobert 的改名/分支版本。

Punchline.Original: Hrothgar smell you. Hrothgar know who watching.
Punchline.Translated: Hrothgar 闻得到你。Hrothgar 知道谁在盯着。

Description.Original: A nearby-player list where every row shows whether that player is targeting you, with a watcher history and alerts.
Description.Translated: 一个附近玩家列表，每一行都会显示该玩家是否正以你为目标，并带有观察者历史记录与提醒。

Punchline.Original: Your debuffs first
Punchline.Translated: 你的 debuff 优先

Description.Original: Reorders Focus Target status effects so your own debuffs appear first.
Description.Translated: 重新排序焦点目标的状态效果，使你自己的 debuff 优先显示。

Punchline.Original: BGM replacement with local audio support
Punchline.Translated: 支持本地音频的 BGM 替换

Description.Original:
Play and replace FFXIV background music. Supports local MP3/WAV files from your PC alongside all in-game tracks, with fade transitions and volume sync.

Originally by perchbird & Meli: https://github.com/perchbirdd/OrchestrionPlugin
Description.Translated:
播放并替换 FFXIV 背景音乐。支持来自你 PC 的本地 MP3/WAV 文件以及所有游戏内曲目，并带有淡入淡出过渡和音量同步。

原作者 perchbird & Meli：https://github.com/perchbirdd/OrchestrionPlugin

Punchline.Original: Drag party members to reorder your party list.
Punchline.Translated: 拖动队员以重新排序你的小队列表。

Description.Original: Hold Ctrl (configurable) and drag a party member onto another to reorder. Saves each group's preferred order and automatically restores it when the same members meet again — perfect for statics that want a consistent layout every pull. Supports per-group auto-apply modes, locking saved orders against accidental overwrites, and per-duty separate orders. Commands: /psorter (open settings), /psorter save (save current order to chat).
Description.Translated: 按住 Ctrl（可配置）并将一名队员拖到另一名队员上以重新排序。保存每个队伍的偏好顺序，并在相同成员再次组队时自动恢复——非常适合希望每次开怪都保持一致布局的固定队。支持按队伍自动应用模式、锁定已保存顺序以防止意外覆盖，以及按副本使用独立顺序。命令：/psorter（打开设置），/psorter save（将当前顺序保存到聊天）。

Punchline.Original: OBS chapter markers and YouTube timestamps for every raid pull. Use /chrono.
Punchline.Translated: 为每次团队副本尝试生成 OBS 章节标记和 YouTube 时间戳。使用 /chrono。

Description.Original:
Tracks pulls, wipes and clears in any duty. Per pull: fight name, phase, boss HP%, first death, duration.

Outputs OBS chapter markers via websocket, a paste-ready YouTube description block, and a direct push to a live stream's description over the YouTube Data API.

Short resets are filtered out automatically. /chrono to open, /chrono cfg for settings.
Description.Translated:
追踪任意副本中的尝试、团灭和通关。每次尝试记录：战斗名称、阶段、Boss 血量百分比、首个死亡、持续时间。

通过 websocket 输出 OBS 章节标记、可直接粘贴的 YouTube 描述块，并通过 YouTube Data API 直接推送到直播的简介。

短时间重置会自动过滤掉。/chrono 打开，/chrono cfg 进行设置。

Punchline.Original: Hide tooltips when you don't want them, keep them when you do.
Punchline.Translated: 在不想看到工具提示时隐藏，在需要时保留。

Description.Original: Stops action, item, pop-up help and crossbar hint tooltips from cluttering the screen. Toggle each type independently for in-combat and out-of-combat, set a duty override (follow combat rules, always show, or always hide while in an instance), and keep an exception so tooltips come back automatically whenever an inventory, armoury or character window is open. Original game settings are restored when the plugin is disabled. Commands: /quiettips (open settings), /quiettips toggle|on|off.
Description.Translated: 阻止动作、物品、弹出帮助和十字热键栏提示的工具提示弄乱屏幕。可分别为战斗中和战斗外独立切换每种类型，设置副本覆盖规则（遵循战斗规则、始终显示或在副本内始终隐藏），并保留一个例外，使打开物品栏、兵装库或角色窗口时工具提示自动恢复。禁用插件时会恢复原始游戏设置。命令：/quiettips（打开设置），/quiettips toggle|on|off。

Punchline.Original: Tune in to MOOGL Radio without leaving Eorzea.
Punchline.Translated: 无需离开 Eorzea 即可收听 MOOGL Radio。

Description.Original: Listen to MOOGL Radio, the FFXIV-themed internet radio station, from in-game.
Description.Translated: 在游戏内收听以 FFXIV 为主题的互联网电台 MOOGL Radio。

Punchline.Original: Automatically price and liquidate marketable inventory through retainers.
Punchline.Translated: 自动为可出售库存定价并通过雇员变现。

Description.Original: Modern retainer automation with strict HQ/NQ pricing, bounded retries, a sortable and searchable queue, protected-item rules, and fault recovery.
Description.Translated: 现代化的雇员自动化，支持严格的 HQ/NQ 定价、有限重试、可排序和搜索的队列、保护物品规则以及故障恢复。

Punchline.Original: Export your character and preview synchronized emotes in Blender.
Punchline.Translated: 导出你的角色并在 Blender 中预览同步的情感动作。

Description.Original: Self-only Blender export with synchronized body/face emotes, exact game props, indexed AVFX sources, and explicit local Penumbra animation imports, built on Meddle's AGPL extractor.
Description.Translated: 仅针对自身的 Blender 导出，包含同步的身体/面部情感动作、精确的游戏道具、索引化的 AVFX 资源，以及显式的本地 Penumbra 动画导入，基于 Meddle 的 AGPL 提取器构建。

Punchline.Original: Open an F-List /c/ page from a player's context menu.
Punchline.Translated: 从玩家上下文菜单打开 F-List /c/ 页面。

Description.Original: Adds an Open F-List /c/ entry to supported player context menus, with optional exact /c/ Search Info detection.
Description.Translated: 在支持的玩家上下文菜单中添加“Open F-List /c/”条目，并可选用精确的 /c/ Search Info 检测。

Punchline.Original: Organize your Penumbra mod library by creator, type, or both.
Punchline.Translated: 按创作者、类型或两者整理你的 Penumbra 模组库。

Description.Original: Sorts your installed Penumbra mods into folders by creator, type, or both. You approve every move before it happens, protect anything you want left alone, and can export or import the whole plan as an Excel workbook.
Description.Translated: 按创作者、类型或两者将已安装的 Penumbra 模组排序到文件夹中。每次移动执行前都会由你确认，你可以保护任何希望保持原样的内容，并能将整个方案导出或导入为 Excel 工作簿。

Punchline.Original: Go straight to the pose you want.
Punchline.Translated: 直接切换到你想要的姿势。

Description.Original: Jump directly to any idle pose with /spose <number> instead of cycling through them one by one.
Description.Translated: 使用 /spose <number> 直接跳转到任意待机姿势，而无需逐个循环切换。

Punchline.Original: Translate FFXIV natively and offline!
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 中原生离线翻译！

Description.Original: Offline translation plugin directly inside FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 直接在 FFXIV 内部的离线翻译插件。

Name.Translated: 亚拉戈翻译器（本地AI与在线）

Punchline.Original: FF14 für blinde Spieler via NVDA und Tastatur zugänglich machen.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 NVDA 和键盘让盲人玩家也能访问 FF14。

Description.Original: Macht FF14 für blinde Spieler zugänglich via NVDA/TOLK Integration, Audio-Navigation und vollständiger Tastatursteuerung.
Description.Translated: 通过 NVDA/TOLK 集成、音频导航和完整键盘控制，让盲人玩家也能访问 FF14。

Punchline.Original: In-game ACT-compatible parsing platform foundation.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内 ACT 兼容解析平台基础。

Description.Original: Self-contained ACT-compatible host with embedded FFXIV_ACT_Plugin, OverlayPlugin, optional plugin packages, and recoverable factory reset.
Description.Translated: 自包含的 ACT 兼容宿主，内嵌 FFXIV_ACT_Plugin、OverlayPlugin、可选插件包，以及可恢复的恢复出厂设置。

Punchline.Original: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Punchline.Translated: 通过导入的 Visland 路线平衡无人岛牧场库存。

Description.Original: Choose Island resources and stock levels, then let Stock Manager select imported Visland routes. Supports route editing and supervised generation, sortable resources, farming priorities with scheduled reviews, flight, underwater and guided cave navigation, an Island route map, mount override, stuck recovery, Lifestream, surplus export, run statistics, and /sm commands.
Description.Translated: 选择无人岛资源和库存水平，然后让 Stock Manager 选择导入的 Visland 路线。支持路线编辑与受监督生成、可排序资源、带定时复查的采集优先级、飞行、水下与引导式洞穴导航、无人岛路线图、坐骑覆盖、卡住恢复、Lifestream、盈余导出、运行统计以及 /sm 命令。

Punchline.Original: 镜头视距与视野控制 · Camera Zoom & FOV
Punchline.Translated: 镜头视距与视野控制 · 相机缩放与 FOV

Description.Original:
AlmondZoom 是一款轻量的 FFXIV 镜头工具，支持视距、FOV、相机高度、镜头碰撞和平滑过渡调节。

A lightweight FFXIV camera tool for zoom distance, FOV, camera height, collision control, and smooth transitions.

/az to open settings | 输入 /az 打开设置
Description.Translated:
AlmondZoom 是一款轻量的 FFXIV 镜头工具，支持视距、FOV、相机高度、镜头碰撞和平滑过渡调节。

一款轻量的 FFXIV 镜头工具，用于调节视距、FOV、相机高度、碰撞控制和平滑过渡。

输入 /az 打开设置

Punchline.Original: Use chat away from the game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏外使用聊天。

Description.Original:
Connect FFXIV to the XIVChat Next Windows client. Chat, friends, item/map cards and game screenshots, with optional self-hosted relay. English UI by default; Chinese is available in settings.

将 FFXIV 连接到 XIVChat Next 桌面客户端，支持聊天、好友、物品/地图卡片、游戏截图及可选自建中继。默认英文，可在设置中切换中文。
Description.Translated:
将 FFXIV 连接到 XIVChat Next Windows 客户端。支持聊天、好友、物品/地图卡片和游戏截图，以及可选的自建中继。默认英文界面；可在设置中切换中文。

将 FFXIV 连接到 XIVChat Next 桌面客户端，支持聊天、好友、物品/地图卡片、游戏截图及可选自建中继。默认英文，可在设置中切换中文。

Punchline.Original: An unofficial in-game log uploader client for FF Logs
Punchline.Translated: FF Logs 的非官方游戏内日志上传客户端

Description.Original: An alternative to the Archon App for uploading logs to the FF Logs service. Basic features are covered: uploading a log, splitting a log file, live logging.
Description.Translated: 用于将日志上传到 FF Logs 服务的 Archon App 替代品。涵盖基础功能：上传日志、拆分日志文件、实时日志记录。

Punchline.Original: Random glamour, on a timer.
Punchline.Translated: 定时随机幻化。

Description.Original: Automatically applies a random Glamourer design from your collection every X configurable minutes. Includes a rotation manager to exclude specific designs.
Description.Translated: 每隔 X 分钟（可配置）自动从你的收藏中应用一个随机 Glamourer 设计。包含轮换管理器，可排除特定设计。

Punchline.Original: Shared watch rooms, in-world TV, player tools, and emote remapping.
Punchline.Translated: 共享观看房间、游戏内电视、玩家工具和情感动作重映射。

Description.Original: Use responsibly
Description.Translated: 负责任地使用

Punchline.Original: Track and tend your outdoor garden patches from anywhere, then sweep the plot in one pass.
Punchline.Translated: 随时随地追踪并照料你的室外菜地，然后一次性扫完整个地块。

Description.Original: Keeps a persistent journal of every outdoor garden bed you own — personal, FC and shared estates — and reminds you when a crop needs tending, fertilizing or harvesting no matter where you are in the world. While standing at the plot, runs a guarded tend-all, fertilize-all, harvest-all or plant-a-plan sweep across the patch, and plans crossbreed layouts from a bundled dataset. Never travels, mounts or pathfinds on your behalf. This automates gameplay, which violates the FFXIV User Agreement and can get your account penalized or banned; use entirely at your own risk.
Description.Translated: 为你拥有的每一块室外菜地——个人房屋、FC 房屋与共享房屋——保存持续记录，并在作物需要照料、施肥或收获时提醒你，无论你身处何方。站在地块旁时，会对整块菜地进行带保护的照料全部、施肥全部、收获全部或按方案种植的批量操作，并可基于内置数据集规划杂交布局。绝不会代你移动、骑乘或寻路。这会自动化游戏玩法，违反 FFXIV 用户协议，可能导致账号被处罚或封禁；使用风险完全自负。

Punchline.Original: Pushes your submarine voyages to subs.bnuuy.gg automatically.
Punchline.Translated: 自动将你的潜水艇航行数据推送到 subs.bnuuy.gg。

Description.Original: Captures submarine voyage results (route, loot, timings) as they happen and pushes them to your Bunny Sub Tracker account. Pair it with a plugin token from your Profile page, map your in-game free companies/submarines to their platform counterparts, then let it run. Command: /bunnysync
Description.Translated: 在潜水艇航行结果（路线、战利品、时间）产生时捕获它们，并推送到你的 Bunny Sub Tracker 账号。把它与个人资料页中的插件 token 配对，将游戏内的部队/潜水艇映射到平台上的对应项，然后让它自动运行。命令：/bunnysync

Punchline.Original: FFXIV development utilities.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 开发工具。

Description.Original: Dalamud plugin development helper with party-list barrier-adjusted HP display and nearby solo-player content-participation nameplate tools.
Description.Translated: Dalamud 插件开发辅助工具，提供小队列表按护盾调整后的 HP 显示，以及附近单人玩家内容参与情况的姓名牌工具。

Punchline.Original: Every popoto gets a voice.
Punchline.Translated: 每个 popoto 都有自己的声音。

Description.Original: Distinct, LLM-cast synthetic voices for FFXIV NPCs, rendered locally.
Description.Translated: 为 FFXIV NPC 提供由 LLM 选配的独特合成语音，本地渲染。

Punchline.Original: Translate FFXIV UI and dialogue to Arabic
Punchline.Translated: 将 FFXIV 界面与对话翻译为阿拉伯语

Description.Original: Instant EN to AR translator for FFXIV dialogue and UI. Includes Arabic font support.
Description.Translated: 面向 FFXIV 对话与界面的即时英译阿翻译器。包含阿拉伯语字体支持。

Punchline.Original: Manager for dynamically adjusting textures
Punchline.Translated: 用于动态调整纹理的管理器

Description.Original: Helps set up custom textures to add custom decals / images on models by generating override textures.
Description.Translated: 通过生成覆盖纹理，帮助设置自定义纹理以在模型上添加自定义贴花 / 图像。

Punchline.Original: 파티 찾기 필터 프리셋으로 원하는 파티만 골라 보기 (한국 서버용)
Punchline.Translated: 使用队员招募筛选器预设只挑选想要的队伍（韩国服务器用）

Description.Original: 파티 찾기에 고급 필터 프리셋을 제공하는 플러그인입니다. 기본 필터 기능에 더해 프리셋 저장·전환, 임무/카테고리 화이트리스트·블랙리스트, 특정 플레이어 숨기기, 아이템 레벨 범위 필터, 복수 잡·슬롯 필터를 지원합니다. 한국 서버에 맞게 수정한 버전입니다.
Description.Translated: 为队员招募提供高级筛选器预设的插件。除基本筛选功能外，还支持预设保存与切换、任务/分类白名单与黑名单、隐藏特定玩家、品级范围筛选、多个职业/栏位筛选。是适配韩国服务器的修改版。

Punchline.Original: An in-game accessibility window for Discord voice-to-text callouts.
Punchline.Translated: 用于 Discord 语音转文字提示的游戏内无障碍窗口。

Description.Original: Displays a Discord channel's live voice-to-text callouts inside FFXIV, in a dedicated, fully customizable accessibility window. One-way relay (Discord to game). No fork needed — install, then enter your own Discord bot token and channel in settings. See the README for the one-time Discord setup.
Description.Translated: 在 FFXIV 内以专用、完全可自定义的无障碍窗口显示 Discord 频道的实时语音转文字提示。单向中继（Discord 到游戏）。无需 fork——安装后，在设置中输入你自己的 Discord bot token 和频道。一次性 Discord 设置请参阅 README。

Punchline.Original: Never miss another Firmament Fête.
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会错过任何 Firmament Fête。

Description.Original: Calibrates the Ishgardian Restoration Fête (Skyrise Celebration) countdown from the in-game objective list while you are in the Firmament and fires configurable chat, notification, and sound alerts at your chosen lead times.
Description.Translated: 当你身处 Firmament 时，根据游戏内目标列表校准 Ishgardian Restoration Fête（Skyrise Celebration）倒计时，并在你选择的提前时间触发可配置的聊天、通知和声音提醒。

Punchline.Original: Automate your hunting logs (Grand Company and class/job).
Punchline.Translated: 自动完成你的狩猎日志（Grand Company 和职业/特职）。

Description.Original: Works through your hunting logs for you — Grand Company (seals) or the current class/job log (XP), selectable in settings. Teleports/flies to each zone, walks to targets with vnavmesh, and clears the required marks using BossMod Reborn autorotation. Requires vnavmesh, Lifestream, and BossMod Reborn. Optional AutoDuty for the GC log's dungeon marks.
Description.Translated: 替你完成狩猎日志——可在设置中选择 Grand Company（军票）或当前职业/特职日志（经验）。传送到/飞往各区域，使用 vnavmesh 走向目标，并使用 BossMod Reborn 自动循环清除所需标记。需要 vnavmesh、Lifestream 和 BossMod Reborn。可选使用 AutoDuty 处理 GC 日志的副本标记。

Punchline.Original: He's making a list, and checking it twice.
Punchline.Translated: 他正在列一份清单，还要核对两遍。

Description.Original: Check to see if someone is on 'The List' and sync 'The List' with other people.
Description.Translated: 查看某人是否在“The List”上，并与其他人的“The List”同步。

Punchline.Original: 将 ACT Simulant 的本地状态转发给 Moodles
Punchline.Translated: 将 ACT Simulant 的本地状态转发给 Moodles

Description.Original: ACT 版 Simulant 的卫月伴生桥接器。通过本机命名管道接收状态请求，并转发到 Moodles IPC；不加载副本预设，也不执行机制时间轴。
Description.Translated: ACT 版 Simulant 的卫月伴生桥接器。通过本机命名管道接收状态请求，并转发到 Moodles IPC；不加载副本预设，也不执行机制时间轴。

Punchline.Original: Do some renovations.
Punchline.Translated: 做些翻新。

Description.Original: Spawn furniture, NPCs, lights, and map assets anywhere.
Description.Translated: 可随处生成家具、NPC、灯光和地图资源。

Punchline.Original: Everything you need for a nice roleplay session.
Punchline.Translated: 一场优质角色扮演所需的一切。

Description.Original: Highlights Say, Emote, and OOC in the native chat log, alerts you on mentions, and colors sender names by player group — the roleplay suite for FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 在原生日志中高亮 Say、Emote 和 OOC，提及你时发出提醒，并按玩家分组为发送者名称着色——FFXIV 的角色扮演套件。

Punchline.Original: Keep your Party Finder listing alive automatically.
Punchline.Translated: 自动让你的招募板信息保持有效。

Description.Original: Automatically re-posts ("reups") your Party Finder listing before the 60-minute timer expires, so your recruitment stays up without you having to manually re-list it every hour. Uses your last recruitment settings. Includes a manual /pfreup now command and a configurable renewal interval.
Description.Translated: 在 60 分钟计时结束前自动重新发布（“reup”）你的招募板信息，无需你每小时手动重新发布，招募就能持续在线。沿用你上次的招募设置。包含手动 /pfreup now 命令和可配置的续期间隔。

Punchline.Original: Play retro games inside FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 内玩复古游戏。

Description.Original: A multi-core libretro emulator embedded in a Dalamud window. Drop any libretro core into the cores/ folder — SNES, GBA, Genesis, and more. Keyboard and controller support, configurable key bindings, resolution scaling, CRT effects, friend spectating, and netplay.
Description.Translated: 一个嵌入 Dalamud 窗口的多核心 libretro 模拟器。将任意 libretro 核心放入 cores/ 文件夹——SNES、GBA、Genesis 等。支持键盘和控制器、可配置按键绑定、分辨率缩放、CRT 效果、好友观战和 netplay。

Punchline.Original: Track relic weapon quest progress across all expansions.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪所有资料片中的 relic weapon 任务进度。

Description.Original:
Track FFXIV relic weapon quest progress across all expansion series.

DM @mtvirux on discord for assistance or bug reports.
Description.Translated:
追踪 FFXIV 所有资料片系列中的 relic weapon 任务进度。

如需帮助或报告 bug，请在 discord 上私信 @mtvirux。

Punchline.Original: A seamless, adaptive replacement HUD for Final Fantasy XIV.
Punchline.Translated: 为 Final Fantasy XIV 提供的无缝、自适应替换 HUD。

Description.Original: A seamless, adaptive replacement HUD for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description.Translated: 为 Final Fantasy XIV 提供的无缝、自适应替换 HUD。

Punchline.Original: In-game companion for FroggeBot venue management.
Punchline.Translated: FroggeBot 场馆管理的游戏内助手。

Description.Original: View your VIP status, browse venue events, character profiles, giveaways, and raffles, and (for venue managers) review pending profile submissions - all without leaving the game. Companion client for the FroggeBot Discord bot.
Description.Translated: 查看你的 VIP 状态，浏览场馆活动、角色档案、赠品和抽奖，并且（对于场馆管理者）审核待处理的档案提交——全部无需离开游戏。FroggeBot Discord bot 的配套客户端。

Description.Original: Auto pillion with smart seat scanning and whitelisted auto group invite. Companion to Daedalus.
Description.Translated: 自动 pillion，具备智能座位扫描和白名单自动小队邀请。Daedalus 的配套插件。

Punchline.Original: Discord Rich Presence that allows you to utilize everything discord has to offer, including custom images, custom buttons, widgets, and more!
Punchline.Translated: Discord Rich Presence，让你能够利用 Discord 提供的一切功能，包括自定义图片、自定义按钮、小部件等！

Description.Original: Discord Rich Presence that allows you to utilize everything discord has to offer, including custom images, custom buttons, widgets, and more!
Description.Translated: Discord Rich Presence，让你能够利用 Discord 提供的一切功能，包括自定义图片、自定义按钮、小部件等！

Name.Translated: 更好的 Discord 状态显示

Punchline.Original: Kefka Says tracker and more, in an ImGui window.
Punchline.Translated: Kefka Says 追踪器及更多功能，位于 ImGui 窗口中。

Description.Original: A growing set of in-game raid tools, starting with Kefka Says, an in-game mirror of the Kefka Says / UMAD room tracker, synced with the webapp over the same WebSocket relay. Open with /xrt kefka.
Description.Translated: 一套不断增长的游戏内团队副本工具，从 Kefka Says 开始，它是 Kefka Says / UMAD 房间追踪器的游戏内镜像，通过同一个 WebSocket 中继与 webapp 同步。使用 /xrt kefka 打开。

Punchline.Original: Ambient beginnings for shared roleplay stories.
Punchline.Translated: 共享角色扮演故事的氛围开端。

Description.Original: Wondrous Places brings venue-focused roleplay prompts and interactions into an in-game Dalamud window. The Covenstead is its first venue module.
Description.Translated: Wondrous Places 将专注于场地的角色扮演提示和互动带入游戏内的 Dalamud 窗口。The Covenstead 是其第一个场地模块。

Punchline.Original: Held input repeats. Latest real press wins.
Punchline.Translated: 按住输入重复。最新的真实按键优先。

Description.Original: A newest-input smart buffer with a PvP action-only macro brake.
Description.Translated: 一个最新输入智能缓冲，带有仅限 PvP 动作的宏刹车。

Punchline.Original: Open F-list and X profiles advertised in player search comments.
Punchline.Translated: 打开玩家搜索备注中宣传的 F-list 和 X 个人资料。

Description.Original: Draws buttons beside the Adventurer Plate and Examine windows that open F-list (/c/ marker), X (@handle), Carrd (.carrd.co), RefSheet (ref.st/name), and RpHub (rphub.co/ch/) profiles found in a player's search comment. Also adds an Open F-list Profile context-menu action and the /social command for your current target.
Description.Translated: 在冒险者铭牌和查看窗口旁绘制按钮，用于打开在玩家搜索备注中找到的 F-list (/c/ 标记)、X (@handle)、Carrd (.carrd.co)、RefSheet (ref.st/name) 和 RpHub (rphub.co/ch/) 个人资料。还添加了一个“打开 F-list 个人资料”的上下文菜单操作，以及针对当前目标的 /social 命令。

Punchline.Original: Keep only the gear you actually use.
Punchline.Translated: 只保留你实际使用的装备。

Description.Original:
Tidies the Armoury Chest against your saved gearsets. Anything equipped, referenced by a gearset, or a higher-ilvl upgrade for a job you still play is kept; everything else is moved out to your bags, fullest armoury container first, so the run frees space where it is tightest. Every run is previewed item by item with the reason for each decision, and nothing moves until you confirm.

Also does the reverse (pulling gearset pieces back into the armoury) and offers a discard picker: an icon grid of leftover gear, framed by rarity, where anything equipped, in a gearset, or on your allowlist is never listed.
Description.Translated:
根据已保存的套装整理兵装库。已装备、被套装引用，或你仍在玩的职业的更高品级升级件都会保留；其余物品会移到你的背包中，优先移入最满的兵装库容器，以便在空间最紧张的地方释放空间。每次运行都会逐项预览并给出每项决策的原因，在你确认前不会移动任何东西。

也可反向操作（把套装部件拉回兵装库），并提供弃置选择器：一个按稀有度加框的剩余装备图标网格，其中已装备、在套装中或位于你的允许列表中的物品绝不会列出。

Punchline.Original: Browse community events sourced from partake.gg directly from your client!
Punchline.Translated: 直接从你的客户端浏览来源于 partake.gg 的社区活动！

Description.Original: Browse community events sourced from partake.gg directly from your client! XIV Hub fork with optional Lifestream travel: change to the event's world, or, with Lifestream + vnavmesh installed, walk straight to the event's housing plot/apartment door.
Description.Translated: 直接从你的客户端浏览来源于 partake.gg 的社区活动！XIV Hub 分支，支持可选的 Lifestream 传送：切换到活动所在的世界，或者，在安装了 Lifestream + vnavmesh 的情况下，径直走到活动的房屋地块/公寓门口。

Punchline.Original: Unified retainer inventory grid with one-click retrieve. Requires AllaganTools.
Punchline.Translated: 统一雇员库存网格，一键取回。需要 AllaganTools。

Description.Original: REQUIRES AllaganTools (a.k.a. Allagan Market / InventoryTools) installed and enabled — RetainerReach reads your retainer inventories from it. Unified view of your active character and all retainers' inventories as an in-game-style icon grid, with one-click Retrieve that summons each holding retainer at a nearby Summoning Bell and pulls selected items into your bags. Search by name, filter by category or crafting material, save recurring pulls as presets, and retrieve from chat via /retrieve. This plugin automates in-game actions (retainer bell interaction and item retrieval) on your behalf; use at your own risk with respect to the game's Terms of Service.
Description.Translated: 需要安装并启用 AllaganTools（又名 Allagan Market / InventoryTools）——RetainerReach 会从中读取你的雇员库存。以游戏内风格的图标网格统一查看你的当前角色和所有雇员的库存，并提供一键取回功能，可在附近的召唤铃处召唤每个持有物品的雇员，并将选中物品取回你的背包。可按名称搜索，按类别或制作材料筛选，将重复取回保存为预设，并通过 /retrieve 从聊天中取回。此插件会代表你自动化游戏内操作（与召唤铃交互和取回物品）；就游戏服务条款而言，使用风险由你自己承担。

Punchline.Original: One-click undercut of every retainer listing, fully local.
Punchline.Translated: 一键对所有雇员上架物品压价，完全本地运行。

Description.Original: Repinches your retainer market listings by undercutting the cheapest live competitor by 1 gil. Reads each listing straight from game memory, clicks the in-game market board's Compare Prices to find the current cheapest offering, and sets your asking price to one below it. Your own retainers and housing mannequins are never treated as competitors, so two retainers selling the same item don't chase each other down. No server, no telemetry, nothing leaves your client. Adds an Auto Pinch button next to AutoRetainer's retainer-list controls and a /autopinch command for the open retainer. AutoRetainer is optional (used only to pause its automation during a pinch run).
Description.Translated: 重新压价你的雇员市场上架物品，以低于当前最低活跃竞争者 1 吉尔的价格上架。直接从游戏内存读取每个上架信息，点击游戏内市场布告板的 Compare Prices 以找到当前最低报价，并将你的要价设为其低 1 吉尔。你自己的雇员和房屋人偶永远不会被视为竞争者，因此两个出售相同物品的雇员不会互相追低压价。无服务器、无遥测，任何内容都不会离开你的客户端。在 AutoRetainer 的雇员列表控件旁添加 Auto Pinch 按钮，并为当前打开的雇员添加 /autopinch 命令。AutoRetainer 是可选的（仅用于在压价运行期间暂停其自动化）。

Punchline.Original: Optimal blackjack moves for FFXIV /random card games.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV /random 卡牌游戏的最优二十一点操作。

Description.Original: Enter your hand and the dealer's up card and it tells you the mathematically best move (hit / stand / double / split), computed exactly for the in-game /random 1-13 (infinite-deck) variant. Configurable dealer rules (H17/S17), one-click buttons to say your move in chat (only when you press them, never automatic), and a live gil session tracker.
Description.Translated: 输入你的手牌和庄家明牌，它会告诉你数学上最优的操作（要牌 / 停牌 / 加倍 / 分牌），针对游戏内 /random 1-13（无限牌堆）变体精确计算。可配置庄家规则（H17/S17），一键按钮可在聊天中说出你的操作（仅在你按下时生效，绝不自动），以及实时吉尔场次追踪器。

Punchline.Original: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Punchline.Translated: 在 Final Fantasy XIV 中分享你正在收听的内容。

Description.Original: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Description.Translated: XIV.fm 会在玩家名牌上方锚定的卡片中显示 Last.fm 的收听状态。

Punchline.Original: Remove letterboxing from cutscenes on ultrawide monitors.
Punchline.Translated: 在超宽显示器上移除过场动画的黑边。

Description.Original: A community-maintained fork that removes 16:9 letterboxing from FFXIV cutscenes on ultrawide displays.
Description.Translated: 一个由社区维护的分支，可在超宽显示器上移除 FFXIV 过场动画中的 16:9 黑边。

Punchline.Original: Japanese mining overlay for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: 用于 FFXIV 的日语挖词覆盖层

Description.Original: Captures Japanese text from NPC dialogue, cutscenes, quest journals, item tooltips, and menus; tokenizes it with NMeCab; shows furigana + JLPT-coloured readings and JMdict definitions; one-click mines to Anki via AnkiConnect (with screenshot + sentence context); optional AI sentence translation.
Description.Translated: 从 NPC 对话、过场动画、任务日志、物品提示和菜单中捕获日语文本；使用 NMeCab 进行分词；显示假名注音 + 按 JLPT 着色的读音和 JMdict 释义；通过 AnkiConnect 一键挖词到 Anki（附带截图 + 句子上下文）；可选 AI 句子翻译。

Punchline.Original: Your collections, on xiv-shinies.com, the moment you earn them.
Punchline.Translated: 你的收藏，在你获得它们的瞬间，同步到 xiv-shinies.com。

Description.Original: Automatically records your collection progress on XIV Shinies (https://xiv-shinies.com). New quest, achievement, mount, and minion unlocks appear on the site within seconds; Triple Triad cards, orchestrion rolls, Occult Crescent progress, and the items the site tracks sync automatically in the background. Fully opt-in: nothing uploads until you finish the short setup, and you choose exactly which collections to send. Use /shinies to get started.
Description.Translated: 自动将你的收藏进度记录到 XIV Shinies（https://xiv-shinies.com）。新的任务、成就、坐骑和宠物解锁会在数秒内出现在网站上；Triple Triad 卡牌、orchestrion rolls、Occult Crescent 进度以及网站追踪的物品会在后台自动同步。完全自愿加入：在你完成简短设置之前不会上传任何内容，并且你可以精确选择要发送哪些收藏。使用 /shinies 开始。

Punchline.Original: A compact Occult Crescent window replacement.
Punchline.Translated: 一个紧凑的 Occult Crescent 窗口替代品。

Description.Original: Adds Full, Minimal, and hidden modes for the Occult Crescent information window.
Description.Translated: 为 Occult Crescent 信息窗口添加完整、极简和隐藏模式。

Punchline.Original: Wardrobe cleanup and collection helper.
Punchline.Translated: 衣橱清理与收藏助手。

Description.Original: Analyzes local wardrobe, armoire, glamour dresser, retainer cache, dyes, duplicates, glamour sets, and store outfit ownership. Command: /amb
Description.Translated: 分析本地衣橱、收藏柜、幻化台、雇员缓存、染料、重复物品、幻化套装以及商城套装拥有情况。命令：/amb

Punchline.Original: Weekly Fashion Report plans and character progress.
Punchline.Translated: 每周时尚品鉴方案与角色进度。

Description.Original: Shows the current Fashion Report theme, known gold items, 80-point and 100-point plans. Command: /fch
Description.Translated: 显示当前时尚品鉴主题、已知金牌物品、80 分和 100 分方案。命令：/fch

Punchline.Original: Where the hell is my friend?
Punchline.Translated: 我的好友到底在哪？

Description.Original: 找找好友究竟在哪
Description.Translated: 找找好友究竟在哪

Punchline.Original: A polished 50/50 drawing console for FFXIV venues.
Punchline.Translated: 面向 FFXIV 活动场所的精致 50/50 抽奖控制台。

Description.Original: Lucky Split is a host-side 50/50 drawing manager for Final Fantasy XIV venues. Create reusable venue presets, record confirmed ticket purchases, assign ticket ranges automatically, track the total prize pool and payout, draw a winner, retain history, and export the ledger.
Description.Translated: Lucky Split 是面向 Final Fantasy XIV 活动场所的主持端 50/50 抽奖管理器。创建可复用的活动场所预设，记录已确认的票券购买，自动分配票券区间，追踪总奖池与派彩，抽取获奖者，保留历史记录，并导出账本。

Punchline.Original: Retired: PvP pressure tracking moved to Seiton Sense.
Punchline.Translated: 已退役：PvP 压力追踪已移至 Seiton Sense。

Description.Original: The standalone HOWMANY plugin is retired because its pressure counter and improved pressure utilities are integrated into Seiton Sense 0.6. The existing package remains unchanged as a rollback.
Description.Translated: 独立版 HOWMANY 插件已退役，因为其压力计数器与改进后的压力工具已集成至 Seiton Sense 0.6。现有包保持不变，可用作回滚。

Punchline.Original: Applies the Emperor's New outfit to nearby female characters via Glamourer.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Glamourer 为附近的女性角色应用 The Emperor's New 套装。

Description.Original: Scans nearby player characters and applies "The Emperor's New Robe" and "The Emperor's New Breeches" to female characters using Glamourer's IPC. Local visual override only — requires Penumbra and Glamourer.
Description.Translated: 扫描附近的玩家角色，并使用 Glamourer 的 IPC 为女性角色应用 "The Emperor's New Robe" 和 "The Emperor's New Breeches"。仅限本地视觉覆盖——需要 Penumbra 和 Glamourer。

Punchline.Original: Browse actors and model appearance data safely.
Punchline.Translated: 安全地浏览 actor 与模型外观数据。

Description.Original: Standalone Human, Demihuman, and Monster morphing with actor restore and bulk outfits.
Description.Translated: 独立的人类、Demihuman 与 Monster 变形，支持 actor 还原与批量套装。

Punchline.Original: Stack the Inventory Grid HUD element vertically.
Punchline.Translated: 将 Inventory Grid HUD 元素垂直堆叠。

Description.Original: Reflows the Inventory Grid HUD element so the four bag rows stack in a column instead of sitting side by side. Choose the bag order, put the equipment button at the top or bottom, and adjust spacing and alignment. The element still moves normally in HUD Layout, and unchecking the plugin restores the vanilla layout.
Description.Translated: 重新排布 Inventory Grid HUD 元素，使四行背包纵向堆叠成一列，而非并排显示。可选择背包顺序、将装备按钮置于顶部或底部，并调整间距与对齐方式。该元素在 HUD Layout 中仍可正常移动，取消勾选该插件即可恢复原始布局。

Punchline.Original: A venue macro board for FF14 hosts.
Punchline.Translated: 面向 FF14 主持人的场所宏板。

Description.Original: A venue macro board for Final Fantasy XIV hosts.
Description.Translated: 面向 Final Fantasy XIV 主持人的场所宏板。

Punchline.Original: Tracks salvaged-jewelry and other stuff counts per character/world.
Punchline.Translated: 按角色/服务器追踪回收首饰及其他物品的数量。

Description.Original: Scrape together the existing pieces of jewelry and eagerly note down the quantity and current owner in Tataru's small notebook.
Description.Translated: 搜罗现有的首饰碎片，并热切地在 Tataru 的小本子里记下数量与当前持有者。

Punchline.Original: Your fish log, on the company books.
Punchline.Translated: 你的钓鱼日志，记录在部队账本上。

Description.Original: Syncs your fish log, mounts, minions, orchestrions, emotes, Triple Triad cards, and crafter stats to your Free Company's Morning Ledger site. Sign in with your Ledger account under /ledger.
Description.Translated: 将你的钓鱼日志、坐骑、宠物、管弦乐谱、情感动作、Triple Triad 卡牌和制作职业属性同步到部队的 Morning Ledger 网站。在 /ledger 下使用你的 Ledger 账号登录。

Punchline.Original: IdleSync
Punchline.Translated: IdleSync

Description.Original: IdleSync
Description.Translated: IdleSync

Punchline.Original: CPSync
Punchline.Translated: CPSync

Description.Original: CPSync
Description.Translated: CPSync

Punchline.Original: Node-based job rotation flow editor.
Punchline.Translated: 基于节点的职业循环流程编辑器。

Description.Original: Design your job rotation as a visual node graph. Flows replace hotbar actions in-game as you build them. Use /excombo to open the editor.
Description.Translated: 以可视化节点图设计你的职业循环。你构建的流程会在游戏中取代热键栏动作。使用 /excombo 打开编辑器。

Punchline.Original: Search item prices by data centre or world.
Punchline.Translated: 按大区或服务器搜索物品价格。

Description.Original: Browse HQ and NQ market board listings, search any item, switch between world or data centre scopes, and sort prices from highest to lowest. Slash command: /umb
Description.Translated: 浏览 HQ 和 NQ 市场板挂单，搜索任意物品，在服务器或大区范围之间切换，并按价格从高到低排序。斜杠命令：/umb

Punchline.Original: Easily clean out your Glamour Dresser.
Punchline.Translated: 轻松清理你的 Glamour Dresser。

Description.Original: A cute plugin to help you manage your Glamour Dresser by identifying items that share the same visual models.
Description.Translated: 一个可爱的插件，通过识别共享相同视觉模型的物品，帮助你管理 Glamour Dresser。

Punchline.Original: An immersive local divination table for roleplay readings.
Punchline.Translated: 用于角色扮演占卜的沉浸式本地占卜桌。

Description.Original: Erudite Divination is a local/social RP divination tool. It provides a themed in-game reading table and does not automate gameplay, read combat state, modify memory, use packets, or interact with FFXIV systems beyond normal Dalamud plugin UI.
Description.Translated: Erudite Divination 是一个本地/社交 RP 占卜工具。它提供一个主题化的游戏内占卜桌，不会自动化游戏操作、读取战斗状态、修改内存、使用数据包，也不会在常规 Dalamud 插件 UI 之外与 FFXIV 系统交互。

Punchline.Original: Rotate your saved Honorific titles on a per-character timer.
Punchline.Translated: 按角色定时轮换你保存的 Honorific 称号。

Description.Original: Honorific Carousel rotates saved Honorific title presets for the current character through Honorific IPC. It keeps Honorific as the source of truth for title text and styling while letting each configured character cycle through their own sequence.
Description.Translated: Honorific Carousel 通过 Honorific IPC 为当前角色轮换已保存的 Honorific 称号预设。它保留 Honorific 作为称号文本和样式的唯一来源，同时让每个已配置的角色按各自的顺序循环。

Punchline.Original: Remove letterboxing from cutscenes on ultrawide monitors.
Punchline.Translated: 在超宽屏显示器上移除过场动画的黑边。

Description.Original: Community-maintained (reborn) build of Ultrawide Cutscenes. Removes the letterboxing bars during cutscenes so they fill your whole (ultrawide) screen instead of being cropped to 16:9. Beware: with the bars gone you may see things outside the intended frame, such as NPCs popping in or T-posing. Originally by Maple; now maintained and kept up to date by Kako5555.
Description.Translated: 由社区维护（重生）的 Ultrawide Cutscenes 版本。移除过场动画中的黑边，使其填满整个（超宽）屏幕，而不是被裁剪为 16:9。注意：黑边消失后，你可能会看到预期画面之外的内容，例如 NPC 突然出现或摆出 T 字姿势。最初由 Maple 制作；现由 Kako5555 维护并保持更新。

Punchline.Original: HTTP bridge for native Linux Luminus.
Punchline.Translated: 用于原生 Linux Luminus 的 HTTP 桥接。

Description.Original: Exposes GPose, camera, world time/weather, territory, actors, appearance, equipment, skeleton posing, pose IPC, and game data over localhost HTTP. Auto-starts when signed in.
Description.Translated: 通过 localhost HTTP 公开 GPose、相机、世界时间/天气、区域、角色、外观、装备、骨骼姿势、pose IPC 和游戏数据。登录后自动启动。

Punchline.Original: Automatically logs your Mentor Roulette clears to Eorzean Ledger.
Punchline.Translated: 自动将你的导师随机任务通关记录上传至 Eorzean Ledger。

Description.Original: Detects when you queue and clear Duty Roulette: Mentor, times your run, counts commendations received, and submits it to your Eorzean Ledger (Mentor Ledger) account. Also offers a one-time import of runs cleared before you installed the plugin.
Description.Translated: 检测你何时排队并通关随机任务：导师，计时你的通关过程，统计收到的赞，并提交到你的 Eorzean Ledger（导师记录）账户。还提供一次性导入在你安装此插件之前已通关的记录。

Punchline.Original: Share your mods with friends
Punchline.Translated: 与好友分享你的模组

Description.Original: Sync mods between players using Penumbra, Glamourer, and other plugins
Description.Translated: 在使用 Penumbra、Glamourer 及其他插件的玩家之间同步模组

Punchline.Original: Let others see you as you see yourself, reimagined.
Punchline.Translated: 让他人看到你所看到的自己，重新构想。

Description.Original: This plugin will synchronize your Penumbra mods and current Glamourer state with other paired clients automatically.
Description.Translated: 此插件会自动将你的 Penumbra 模组和当前 Glamourer 状态同步到其他已配对的客户端。

Punchline.Original: Cross-data-centre linkshells with unlimited members.
Punchline.Translated: 跨数据中心、成员数量无上限的通讯贝。

Description.Original:
ExtraChat adds end-to-end encrypted, cross-data-centre, unlimited linkshells
to the game. (Fork of official plugin with features and some fixes)
Description.Translated:
ExtraChat 为游戏添加了端到端加密、跨数据中心、成员数量无上限的通讯贝。
（官方插件的分支版本，包含额外功能及部分修复）
