Punchline.Original: Eureka Logos Action dex, farming planner, and one-click Logos Manipulator auto-fill.
Punchline.Translated: 优雷卡文理技能图鉴、刷取规划器，以及一键自动填充文理控制台。

Description.Original: A collection log for all 56 Eureka Logos Actions. Syncs automatically from Drake's in-game Logos Action Log, so your dex fills itself with no manual ticking. Reads your live mneme stock at the Logos Manipulator and highlights every action you can synthesise but have never made. One click loads a combination into the Astral Array, stopping short of the synthesis itself so nothing is ever consumed without your say-so. The farming planner totals mnemes across everything you are working toward and groups them by the logogram that yields them, with map pins for where to farm. Includes a visual collection log, a pinnable overlay tracker, and ten UI themes.
Description.Translated: 收录全部 56 个优雷卡文理技能的收集图鉴。自动从游戏内 Drake 的文理技能日志同步，无需手动勾选即可填满图鉴。在文理控制台读取你的实时记忆存量，并高亮所有你能合成但从未制作过的技能。一键将组合加载到星极阵列中，但不会执行合成本身，因此未经你确认绝不会消耗任何材料。刷取规划器会统计你正在追求的所有目标所需的记忆总量，并按产出它们的文理魔纹分组，附带刷取地点的地图标记。包含可视化收集图鉴、可固定的悬浮追踪器以及十种界面主题。

Punchline.Original: Manage your Mods. Back them up. Restore them when needed.
Punchline.Translated: 管理你的 Mod。备份它们。在需要时恢复它们。

Description.Original: Manage your Mods. Back them up. Restore them when needed.
Description.Translated: 管理你的 Mod。备份它们。在需要时恢复它们。

Punchline.Original: Easily manage your staff members, create VIP lists, and register your DJs for your event. Register your club and support your staff with this tool
Punchline.Translated: 轻松管理你的员工成员，创建 VIP 列表，并为你的活动登记 DJ。使用此工具登记你的俱乐部并支持你的员工

Description.Original: Easily manage your staff members, create VIP lists, and register your DJs for your event. Register your club and support your staff with this tool

Punchline.Original: Community language localizer. Needs a language pack.
Punchline.Translated: 社区语言本地化器。需要语言包。

Description.Original:
Gubal Library hands the game pre-translated copies of its own text files, so the game draws another language itself, in its own font and its own layout. Your game installation is never modified.

It ships empty and belongs to no language: point it at a community language pack and the game speaks that language. You choose what gets translated and what stays English, part by part.

/gubal → Opens the settings window.
/gubal status → What is installed, what is being served, and whether it reached the game.
/gubal parts → Lists what the pack covers and what you have switched off.
/gubal check → Asks the publisher whether a newer pack exists.
/gubal usepack → Serves the installed pack, or stops serving it.
/gubal autoupdate → Fetches a newer pack while the game is starting.
/gubal debug on|off → Diagnostics for when a page or a font is not reaching the game.

A pack must match the patch you are running, and the game reads its text once at startup, so a change takes effect the next time you start the client.

Optional dialogue links open unlocked Unending Codex entries directly from NPC dialogue and cutscenes. Enable them in /gubal. Please report problems on GitHub.
Description.Translated:
Gubal Library 把游戏自身文本文件的预翻译副本交给游戏，于是游戏用自己的字体和排版自行绘制另一种语言。你的游戏安装文件绝不会被修改。

它出厂时是空的，且不属于任何语言：把它指向一个社区语言包，游戏就会说那种语言。你可以逐部分选择哪些内容被翻译、哪些保留英文。

/gubal → 打开设置窗口。
/gubal status → 已安装什么、正在提供什么，以及是否送达游戏。
/gubal parts → 列出语言包覆盖的内容以及你已关闭的部分。
/gubal check → 向发布者查询是否有更新的语言包。
/gubal usepack → 启用已安装的语言包，或停止启用。
/gubal autoupdate → 在游戏启动时获取更新的语言包。
/gubal debug on|off → 当某个页面或字体未送达游戏时进行诊断。

语言包必须与你正在运行的补丁版本匹配，并且游戏在启动时只读取一次文本，因此更改会在下次启动客户端时生效。

可选对话链接可从 NPC 对话和过场动画中直接打开已解锁的 Unending Codex 条目。在 /gubal 中启用。请在 GitHub 上报告问题。

Punchline.Translated: 了解你已拥有哪些幻化，并在游戏显示装备的任何地方标明。

Description.Original:
Enter a dungeon (or look one up) and Dungeon Drip shows the gear that drops there which is not yet in your Glamour Dresser or Armoire.

Open a vendor and a panel beside it lists the glamour gear that shop stocks, marked by where you already have each piece. Anything that cannot be kept as a glamour is left out.

Right-click gear anywhere in the game and it offers to try on the whole outfit the piece belongs to, and to say which duties drop it.

The window has a second view for your collection as a whole: which outfit sets you are closest to finishing, how full your Glamour Dresser is and what would free space in it, and what you are carrying that a box already has.

Because the game wipes Glamour Dresser data on every zone change and only loads the Armoire on demand, the plugin caches your collection per character and tells you when that snapshot is getting old.
Description.Translated:
进入副本（或查询副本）时，Dungeon Drip 会显示该处掉落、但尚未存入你的幻化柜或收藏柜的装备。

打开商人时，旁边会有一个面板列出该商店出售的幻化装备，并标注你已在何处拥有每件装备。任何无法作为幻化保存的物品都会被排除。

在游戏中的任何位置右键点击装备，它会提供试穿该装备所属的整套套装，并告知哪些副本会掉落它。

该窗口还有第二个视图，用于查看你的整体收藏：你最接近集齐的套装、你的幻化柜有多满以及什么可以腾出空间，以及你携带的物品中有哪些收藏柜已经有了。

由于游戏在每次切换区域时都会清除幻化柜数据，并且只在需要时加载收藏柜，该插件会按角色缓存你的收藏，并在该快照过期时提示你。

Description.Original: Gathers a fixed Diadem route natively — finds the real node at each waypoint, flies in on a combined fly/land/walk path, and works the item slots itself. Respects the sequential node chains (a node is always exhausted before moving on, since the next one only spawns then), spends Revisit GP procs on skills, and learns which spots reliably open each node. Handles the whole round trip: leave duty, certify loot at Flotpassant, spend scrips at Enie, repair with dark matter, and re-enter via Aurvael. Includes an Artisan-driven crafting loop for the Skybuilders' collectables. Requires vnavmesh.
Description.Translated: 以原生方式采集固定的 The Diadem 路线——在每个路径点找到真正的采集点，沿飞/降/走的组合路径飞行前往，并自行处理物品槽位。遵循顺序采集点链（一个采集点总是先采尽再前往下一个，因为下一个只在那时才会生成），将 Revisit GP 触发用于技能，并学习哪些位置能可靠地开启每个采集点。处理整个往返流程：离开任务、在 Flotpassant 鉴定战利品、在 Enie 处花掉工票、用暗物质修理，并通过 Aurvael 重新进入。包含用于 Skybuilders' 收藏品的 Artisan 驱动制作循环。需要 vnavmesh。

Punchline.Original: Local Kefka P4 position practice.
Punchline.Translated: 本地 Kefka P4 站位练习。

Description.Original: A private, local-only Kefka P4 practice simulator and ground overlay. It reads only your position and facing and never changes game state. Open it with /kefkap4.
Description.Translated: 一个仅限本地、私有的 Kefka P4 练习模拟器与地面覆盖层。它只读取你的位置与朝向，绝不改变游戏状态。使用 /kefkap4 打开。

Punchline.Original: A pocketful of small plugins in one.
Punchline.Translated: 一袋小插件，合而为一。

Description.Original:
Buddy's Buddy is a host for small, self-contained modules. Each module is its own mini-plugin with its own tab, settings and commands, and can be enabled or disabled independently.

Buddy's Bag empties the chocobo saddlebag into your inventory.
Buddy's Chest tallies the whole free company chest and withdraws every unit of a chosen item.
Buddy's Slaves tallies every retainer and withdraws a shopping list of items, taking as much as each retainer can supply before moving on.
Buddy's Desynther desynthesises from your bags and armoury chest and keeps a ledger of the yields.
Buddy's Stash searches everything you own, everywhere it is, from one box.
Buddy's Purse totals your gil across character, retainers and the free company chest.
Buddy's Ledger records every trade and totals what each player has given you over all of them.
Buddy's Jobs is an opt-in shared board of requests — post one, claim someone else's, mark it delivered. It is off by default and talks to a server you deploy yourself.
Description.Translated:
Buddy's Buddy 是小型自包含模块的宿主。每个模块都是自己的迷你插件，拥有各自的标签页、设置与命令，可独立启用或禁用。

Buddy's Bag 将陆行鸟鞍囊清空到你的背包。
Buddy's Chest 统计整个部队宝库，并取出所选物品的每一个。
Buddy's Slaves 统计每个雇员，并按购物清单取出物品，先从每个雇员能提供的量取走再继续。
Buddy's Desynther 从背包与兵装库中分解物品，并记录产出账目。
Buddy's Stash 在一个框中搜索你拥有的一切，无论其位于何处。
Buddy's Purse 汇总你角色、雇员与部队宝库中的金币总额。
Buddy's Ledger 记录每一笔交易，并统计每位玩家在所有交易中给你的总量。
Buddy's Jobs 是一个可选加入的共享请求板——发布一条请求、领取他人的、标记为已交付。默认关闭，与你自行部署的服务器通信。

Punchline.Original: Automate the ARR Zodiac relic line
Punchline.Translated: 自动化 ARR Zodiac 遗物任务线

Description.Original:
Data-driven automation engine for the ARR Zodiac relic line (A Relic Reborn through Zodiac Zeta). It plans and drives the stage objectives - Atma FATE farming, Animus book leves and dungeons, Novus materia/scroll planning, Nexus light farming, and the Jalzahn/Gerolt upgrade turn-ins - by orchestrating other plugins over IPC rather than replacing them.

Requires these companion plugins, installed and working: vnavmesh (movement), BossMod Reborn, Rotation Solver Reborn or Wrath Combo (combat), Lifestream (aetheryte travel), TextAdvance (dialogue), and AutoDuty (dungeons). The Dependencies tab in /relic config shows live status for each.

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK: automating movement and combat is botting under the FINAL FANTASY XIV User Agreement, and Square Enix suspends and terminates accounts for it. The risk is highest for the open-world stages (Atma, Animus, Nexus, Zeta), which run in shared content where other players can observe and report you. Neither this plugin nor its authors can reduce that risk or protect you from it.

This software takes control of your character for long unattended sessions. It is incomplete, it has rough edges, and stages will occasionally stall and need manual help. Do not run it unattended if that is not acceptable to you. Bug reports should include /xllog output with 'Enable debug log' turned on in /relic config.
Description.Translated:
用于 ARR Zodiac 遗物任务线（从 A Relic Reborn 到 Zodiac Zeta）的数据驱动自动化引擎。它规划并驱动各阶段目标——Atma FATE 刷取、Animus 书理符与副本、Novus 魔晶石/卷轴规划、Nexus 光之刷取，以及 Jalzahn/Gerolt 升级交付——通过 IPC 编排其他插件，而非取代它们。

需要以下配套插件已安装并可正常工作：vnavmesh（移动）、BossMod Reborn、Rotation Solver Reborn 或 Wrath Combo（战斗）、Lifestream（以太之光传送）、TextAdvance（对话）以及 AutoDuty（副本）。/relic config 中的 Dependencies 标签页会显示每一项的实时状态。

使用风险自负：根据《FINAL FANTASY XIV 用户协议》，自动化移动与战斗属于使用外挂，Square Enix 会因此暂停和终止账号。开放世界阶段（Atma、Animus、Nexus、Zeta）风险最高，因为这些阶段在共享内容中运行，其他玩家可以观察并举报你。本插件及其作者都无法降低该风险，也无法保护你免受其影响。

本软件会在长时间无人值守的会话中接管你的角色。它并不完整，仍有粗糙之处，各阶段偶尔会卡住并需要手动协助。如果这让你无法接受，请不要在无人值守时运行它。问题报告应包含 /xllog 输出，并在 /relic config 中开启 'Enable debug log'。

Punchline.Original: Displays PlayerNames of friends in Frontlines.
Punchline.Translated: 在前线显示好友的玩家名。

Description.Original: Use /friendlyfire to toggle the configuration window.
Description.Translated: 使用 /friendlyfire 切换配置窗口。

Punchline.Original: Paired animation sync for Penumbra.
Punchline.Translated: 为 Penumbra 提供配对动画同步。

Description.Original: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Description.Translated: 一个 Penumbra 动画启动器，用于整理、配对并同步多角色动画。

Punchline.Original: Plan and track an accurate chocobo color feeding route in game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内规划并追踪精确的陆行鸟颜色喂食路线。

Description.Original: Calculates and tracks ordered fruit routes between companion chocobo colors.
Description.Translated: 计算并追踪搭档陆行鸟各颜色之间有顺序的果实路线。

Punchline.Original: A bucket of small utilities
Punchline.Translated: 一堆小工具

Description.Original:
A set of small quality-of-life utilities. Everything is toggleable, and the ones that act on their own are off by default.
/dsu opens the window; every feature is explained there.
Description.Translated:
一组小型便利工具。所有功能均可开关，会自动生效的功能默认关闭。
/dsu 打开窗口；每个功能都在其中说明。

Punchline.Original: Screens, signage and shared boards for your house
Punchline.Translated: 为你的房屋提供屏幕、标牌与共享看板

Description.Original: Flat screens placed anywhere in a house, correctly hidden by walls and people. Shows an image or a rotating set, from your PC or a link, and a whole room of them can be shared with your Free Company from one file.
Description.Translated: 可放置在房屋任意位置的平面屏幕，会被墙壁和人物正确遮挡。可显示来自你电脑或链接的图片或轮播图组，整个房间的屏幕可通过一个文件与部队共享。

Punchline.Original: Automatically accepts incoming raises.
Punchline.Translated: 自动接受收到的复活。

Description.Original: Automatically clicks Accept on FFXIV's incoming Raise dialog. Detection uses the game's active resurrection agent and does not depend on the raising player's name.
Description.Translated: 自动点击 FFXIV 收到的复活对话框中的接受。检测使用游戏的活动复活代理，不依赖于复活玩家的名称。

Punchline.Original: PF / Ikuya / NAUR mitigation timelines in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内 PF / Ikuya / NAUR 减伤时间轴。

Description.Original: Displays editable job/role-specific mitigation reminders using default plans based on PF, Ikuya, and NAUR mitigation strategies where available.
Description.Translated: 显示可编辑的、按职业/职能区分的减伤提醒，使用基于 PF、Ikuya 和 NAUR 减伤策略的默认方案（如果可用）。

Punchline.Original: Record encounter timelines and build MitPlan plans.
Punchline.Translated: 记录遭遇时间轴并构建 MitPlan 方案。

Description.Original: Records encounter casts and abilities, provides editable phase anchors and mitigation assignments, imports mitigation CSV files, and sends reviewed plans directly to MitPlan.
Description.Translated: 记录遭遇的施法和技能，提供可编辑的阶段锚点和减伤分配，导入减伤 CSV 文件，并将审核后的方案直接发送到 MitPlan。

Punchline.Original: Flash low enemy HP and MP in PvP.
Punchline.Translated: 在 PvP 中闪烁提示敌人低 HP 和 MP。

Description.Original: A configurable Crystalline Conflict HUD with a low-resource alert panel, red/blue screen flashes, and projected enemy HP/MP bars.
Description.Translated: 可配置的 Crystalline Conflict HUD，包含低资源警报面板、红/蓝屏幕闪烁以及投影的敌人 HP/MP 条。

Punchline.Original: Search and edit the game's Character and System Configuration menu options.
Punchline.Translated: 搜索并编辑游戏的角色和系统配置菜单选项。

Description.Original: Adds a searchable window over the options in the game's native Character Configuration and System Configuration menus. Type part of an option's name, see its current value, and edit it inline. Values are read and written through Dalamud's IGameConfig service, the same store the native menus use. Use /ofinder or /pfind to toggle the window in-game.
Description.Translated: 在游戏原生的角色配置和系统配置菜单的选项上添加一个可搜索窗口。输入选项名称的一部分，查看其当前值，并就地编辑。值通过 Dalamud 的 IGameConfig 服务读写，与原生菜单使用相同的存储。使用 /ofinder 或 /pfind 在游戏中切换窗口。

Punchline.Original: OccultHelper is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
Punchline.Translated: OccultHelper 帮你让 Occult Crescent 体验更顺畅。

Description.Original:
OccultHelper is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: occulthelper (alias: och)
  /occulthelper → Opens the main window
  /occulthelper config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /occulthelper config list → Lists config keys
  /occulthelper config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /occulthelper config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /occulthelper buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /occulthelper tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /occulthelper illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /occulthelper reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /occulthelper (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)
Description.Translated:
OccultHelper 帮你让 Occult Crescent 体验更顺畅。
- 不再需要烦人的“走路”或“找宝箱”。那是给失败者准备的。
- 一个可爱的小 Fate 和 CE 面板，会告诉你它给什么奖励，还会帮你自动寻路到那里，哇哦。
- 为那些宁愿去摸草或玩一款内容有价值的游戏的人准备的一个额外非法的“illegal mode”。

命令前缀：occulthelper（别名：och）
  /occulthelper → 打开主窗口
  /occulthelper config → 打开配置（别名：cfg, c）
  /occulthelper config list → 列出配置键
  /occulthelper config get <key> → 打印配置值
  /occulthelper config set <key> <value> → 设置配置值
  /occulthelper buff → 开始/停止 buff 运行
  /occulthelper tp [fate|ce|pot] → 传送到最近的匹配活动
  /occulthelper illegal [on|off|toggle] → 控制 Illegal Mode（无参数时打开窗口）
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-ce → 将正在登记的 CE 标记在地图上
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-fate → 在地图上标记一个 FATE
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → 标记一个非 pot FATE
  /occulthelper reload-translations → 重新加载翻译文件（别名：rt）
  /och … → 与 /occulthelper 相同（旧别名；也可用 /occultcrescenthelper）

Punchline.Original: Ping display with Linux support
Punchline.Translated: 带 Linux 支持的 Ping 显示

Description.Original:
Displays your connection latency in the server info bar, with an optional graph and monitor window.

This build adds address detection that works under Linux/Wine, where the standard client-state method does not resolve the game server address.

An unofficial fork of PingPlugin by karashiiro, redistributed under the MIT License. All original credit goes to karashiiro.

Original project: https://github.com/karashiiro/PingPlugin
Description.Translated:
在服务器信息栏显示你的连接延迟，并提供可选的图表和监视窗口。

此构建加入了可在 Linux/Wine 下工作的地址检测，标准客户端状态方法在此无法解析游戏服务器地址。

karashiiro 的 PingPlugin 的非官方分支，按 MIT 许可证重新分发。所有原始功劳归 karashiiro。

原项目：https://github.com/karashiiro/PingPlugin

Punchline.Original: Monitors party changes.
Punchline.Translated: 监控队伍变化。

Description.Original:
Monitors your party and reports changes. Tracks members joining and leaving, can look up encounter logs, and optionally relays party activity to a Discord channel.

Discord and FFLogs integration are optional and require you to supply your own credentials in the plugin settings. No credentials are bundled with the plugin.
Description.Translated:
监控你的队伍并报告变化。追踪成员加入和离开，可查询遭遇日志，并可选将队伍活动转发到 Discord 频道。

Discord 和 FFLogs 集成为可选，并且需要你在插件设置中提供自己的凭据。插件不附带任何凭据。

Punchline.Original: Automatically hunt mobs for specific items
Punchline.Translated: 自动狩猎怪物以获取特定物品

Description.Original:
Automatically hunts mobs to collect specific items. Teleports to the right zone, mounts and flies to spawn points, engages and chains kills, tracks inventory progress live, and returns home when every enabled item is complete.

Organise items into hunt lists, import ingredient lists from Artisan (only ingredients that drop from mobs in the database are added), and edit the mob database in game.

Requires vnavmesh, Rotation Solver Reborn and Lifestream.
Description.Translated:
自动狩猎怪物以收集特定物品。传送到正确区域，上坐骑并飞往刷新点，接敌并连续击杀，实时追踪背包进度，并在所有已启用物品完成后返回家中。

将物品整理为狩猎列表，从 Artisan 导入材料列表（仅添加数据库中由怪物掉落的材料），并在游戏内编辑怪物数据库。

需要 vnavmesh、Rotation Solver Reborn 和 Lifestream。

Punchline.Original: Save and auto-restore Party Finder slot configurations
Punchline.Translated: 保存并自动恢复 Party Finder 槽位配置

Description.Original: A plugin that helps manage Party Finder recruitment configurations. Save preset slot layouts and automatically reapply them when party members leave, eliminating the need to manually reconfigure slots repeatedly.
Description.Translated: 一个帮助管理 Party Finder 招募配置的插件。保存预设槽位布局，并在队员离开时自动重新应用，免去反复手动重新配置槽位。

Punchline.Original: Fixes how bone physics look at higher framerates.
Punchline.Translated: 修复高帧率下骨骼物理的表现。

Description.Original: Enables an unused flag in the client that fixes bone physics at high framerates.
Description.Translated: 启用客户端中一个未使用的标志，修复高帧率下的骨骼物理。

Punchline.Original: Modify chest bones for specific gear.
Punchline.Translated: 为特定装备修改胸部骨骼。

Description.Original: Add gear model-specific bone overrides.
Description.Translated: 添加针对装备模型专用的骨骼覆盖。

Punchline.Original: Inspect the game's Lua state and run custom Lua code
Punchline.Translated: 查看游戏的 Lua 状态并运行自定义 Lua 代码

Description.Original: Inspect the game's Lua state and run custom Lua code
Description.Translated: 查看游戏的 Lua 状态并运行自定义 Lua 代码

Punchline.Original: Occult Crescent map with treasure guides, event tracking and Magic Pot predictions.
Punchline.Translated: 带有宝藏指南、事件追踪和魔法罐预测的 Occult Crescent 地图。

Description.Original: Display-only Occult Crescent atlas with treasure spot checks and field markers, FATE/CE timers and progress, Magic Pot prediction and alerts, carrot and Forked Tower markers, aetherytes, visit history, and local observation collection. It does not automate movement or interaction.
Description.Translated: 仅显示的 Occult Crescent 地图册，包含宝藏点检查与场景标记、FATE/CE 计时与进度、魔法罐预测与警报、胡萝卜和 Forked Tower 标记、以太之光、访问历史以及本地观察收集。它不会自动移动或交互。

Punchline.Original: Routes FFXIV's background music to its own audio device so streamers can keep BGM in VODs while excluding it from the live stream.
Punchline.Translated: 将 FFXIV 的背景音乐路由到独立的音频设备，让主播可以在 VOD 中保留 BGM，同时将其从直播中排除。

Description.Original: Detects the currently playing FFXIV BGM, decodes the game's own music file, and plays it out through an audio device you choose (e.g. a virtual audio cable). Combined with muting the game's built-in BGM, this lets OBS capture the music on a separate source that you can include in recordings but leave off the stream track. See the README for OBS routing.
Description.Translated: 检测当前播放的 FFXIV BGM，解码游戏自身的音乐文件，并通过你选择的音频设备（例如虚拟音频线）播放。配合将游戏内置 BGM 静音，这能让 OBS 在独立来源上捕获音乐，你可以将其包含在录制中但不放入直播音轨。OBS 路由方式请参阅 README。

Punchline.Original: Catch players staring at you red-handed.
Punchline.Translated: 当场抓住盯着你的玩家。

Description.Original: A lightweight, modern UI plugin that monitors nearby players and highlights those who have you targeted. Includes a stealthy context menu for inspecting others without changing your own facing direction.
Description.Translated: 一个轻量、现代的 UI 插件，监控附近玩家并高亮那些以你为目标的玩家。包含一个隐蔽的上下文菜单，可在不改变你自身朝向的情况下查看他人。

Punchline.Original: Run your whole bar shift from one window.
Punchline.Translated: 在一个窗口里完成整个酒吧班次。

Description.Original:
A bartender's companion for FFXIV roleplay venues.

- A full drinks menu with prices, categories and availability
- A free-form order scratchpad plus structured order tickets
- A tip ledger with nightly and weekly totals, keeping payouts separate
- A roleplay macro library with placeholders and a rehearsal mode
- A weekly shift planner in Server Time, able to import opening hours from ffxivvenues.com
- A recurring announcer that can advertise the venue on a timer

Everything is configurable in the window. Chat output defaults to copying to your clipboard; sending directly is opt-in.
Description.Translated:
一个面向 FFXIV 角色扮演场所的调酒师助手。

- 完整的饮品菜单，含价格、分类和供应状态
- 自由格式的订单草稿本加结构化订单票据
- 小费账本，含每晚和每周总计，并将支付款项单独记录
- 带占位符和排练模式的角色扮演宏库
- 按服务器时间的每周排班计划器，可从 ffxivvenues.com 导入营业时间
- 可定时为场所做广告的循环播报器

所有内容均可在窗口中配置。聊天输出默认复制到剪贴板；直接发送需主动选择启用。

Punchline.Original: Archive your character in a portable, generic format
Punchline.Translated: 以可移植的通用格式归档你的角色

Description.Original: Archive your character in a portable, generic format
Description.Translated: 以可移植的通用格式归档你的角色

Punchline.Original: Use F11 to go between fullscreen and windowed mode
Punchline.Translated: 使用 F11 在全屏和窗口模式之间切换

Description.Original: Use F11 to go between fullscreen and windowed mode.
Description.Translated: 使用 F11 在全屏和窗口模式之间切换。

Punchline.Original: Notify a webhook for certain game events.
Punchline.Translated: 在特定游戏事件发生时通知 webhook。

Description.Original: Sends messages to a specified webhook endpoint, such as when a duty is popped or your character has logged in.
Description.Translated: 向指定的 webhook 端点发送消息，例如在任务弹出或你的角色登录时。

Punchline.Original: Damage, drawn in game
Punchline.Translated: 伤害，在游戏内绘制

Description.Original: A combat meter that runs inside the game. Reads the parse from IINACT over plugin IPC and draws it here.
Description.Translated: 一个在游戏内运行的战斗统计。通过插件 IPC 从 IINACT 读取解析数据并在此处绘制。

Punchline.Original: Stops DelvUI from reacting through overlapping plugin windows.
Punchline.Translated: 阻止 DelvUI 透过重叠插件窗口响应。

Description.Original: Publishes a tiny cursor guard to DelvUI's native third-party clipping system only while the mouse is actually over Penumbra, QoLBar, or another interactive ImGui window. This prevents DelvUI click-through without stale full-window clipping artifacts. Use /dig for settings.
Description.Translated: 仅在鼠标实际位于 Penumbra、QoLBar 或其他可交互 ImGui 窗口上时，向 DelvUI 原生的第三方裁剪系统发布一个微型光标防护。这可以防止 DelvUI 点击穿透，同时不会产生陈旧的全窗口裁剪伪影。使用 /dig 进行设置。

Punchline.Original: Shows Glamourer Preview Manager images when hovering QoLBar outfit buttons.
Punchline.Translated: 悬停 QoLBar 服装按钮时显示 Glamourer Preview Manager 图像。

Description.Original: Detects text shortcuts drawn inside QoLBar and displays the matching Glamourer Preview Manager screenshot as a hover preview. Use /qgp for settings (legacy alias: /qolglampreview).
Description.Translated: 检测 QoLBar 内绘制的文本快捷方式，并显示匹配的 Glamourer Preview Manager 截图作为悬停预览。使用 /qgp 进行设置（旧别名：/qolglampreview）。

Punchline.Original: La faiblesse elementaire des CE et FATE de l'Occult Crescent, avant le pop.
Punchline.Translated: Occult Crescent 的 CE 和 FATE 的元素弱点，在刷新前。

Description.Original: Apprend automatiquement la faiblesse elementaire de chaque boss de Critical Encounter et de FATE en lisant le statut pose par Occult Libra, puis vous l'affiche des l'entree dans la zone du CE, avant meme que le boss n'apparaisse. Commande : /occultweak
Description.Translated: 通过读取 Occult Libra 施加的状态，自动获知每个 Critical Encounter 和 FATE boss 的元素弱点，并在你进入 CE 区域后、甚至在 boss 出现前就显示给你。命令：/occultweak

Punchline.Original: Automatically sends pairing requests to nearby Lightfinder users with safeguards.
Punchline.Translated: 自动向附近的 Lightfinder 用户发送配对请求，并带有保护措施。

Description.Original: A companion for Lightless Sync that can automatically contact nearby Lightfinder broadcasters. Includes a master toggle, a 3–30 second delay, persistent decline blacklist, pending/paired protection, joined/shared syncshell protection, status log, and automatic pause while Lightless is disconnected. Use /lap for settings. The old /lightautopair command remains available as an alias.
Description.Translated: Lightless Sync 的配套插件，可自动联系附近的 Lightfinder 广播者。包含主开关、3–30 秒延迟、持久拒绝黑名单、待处理/已配对保护、已加入/共享 syncshell 保护、状态日志，以及在 Lightless 断开连接时自动暂停。使用 /lap 进行设置。旧的 /lightautopair 命令仍可作为别名使用。

Punchline.Original: Highlight spearfishing fish speed and size cues
Punchline.Translated: 高亮鱼叉捕鱼中鱼的速度与体型提示

Description.Original: Highlight spearfishing fish speed and size cues
Description.Translated: 高亮鱼叉捕鱼中鱼的速度与体型提示

Punchline.Original: Because clicking sync is so 2023.
Punchline.Translated: 因为点同步已经是 2023 年的老做法了。

Description.Original: Syncs your character data to XIV Hub locally in real time.
Description.Translated: 在本地实时将你的角色数据同步至 XIV Hub。

Punchline.Original: Nur dein Schaden und deine Heilung, ohne Tick-Spam.
Punchline.Translated: 只看你自己的伤害和治疗，没有跳字刷屏。

Description.Original: Persoenliches PvE- und PvP-Combat-Log fuer verursachten und erlittenen Schaden sowie gewirkte und erhaltene Heilung. Zeigt aktive Buffs und Debuffs als Ereigniskontext und buendelt DoT- und HoT-Ticks.
Description.Translated: 个人 PvE 与 PvP 战斗日志，记录造成的与承受的伤害，以及施放的与获得的治疗。以事件上下文显示当前生效的 Buff 与 Debuff，并合并 DoT 与 HoT 的跳数。

Punchline.Original: Polish live dialogue translation for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 为 FFXIV 提供波兰语实时对话翻译。

Description.Original: Translates Final Fantasy XIV NPC dialogue into Polish and displays it in a dedicated overlay. Open the plugin with /lore.
Description.Translated: 将 Final Fantasy XIV 的 NPC 对话翻译为波兰语，并显示在专用悬浮窗中。使用 /lore 打开插件。

Punchline.Original: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。
Punchline.Translated: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。

Description.Original: 屏蔽所有非小队成员的玩家模型，可选择仅在战斗中生效或常驻生效，并可保留死亡玩家模型以便完成复活成就。
Description.Translated: 屏蔽所有非小队成员的玩家模型，可选择仅在战斗中生效或常驻生效，并可保留死亡玩家模型以便完成复活成就。

Punchline.Original: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。
Punchline.Translated: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。

Description.Original: 在屏幕和列表中标记新月岛附近的宝箱与被啃过的胡萝卜。支持本地地图旗标，并在默语频道输出可点击坐标。
Description.Translated: 在屏幕和列表中标记新月岛附近的宝箱与被啃过的胡萝卜。支持本地地图旗标，并在默语频道输出可点击坐标。

Punchline.Original: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。
Punchline.Translated: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。

Description.Original: 游玩白魔法师时，如果当前同步等级尚未达到救疗的解锁等级，按下救疗会改为施放治疗。达到解锁等级后，救疗保持原样。
Description.Translated: 游玩白魔法师时，如果当前同步等级尚未达到救疗的解锁等级，按下救疗会改为施放治疗。达到解锁等级后，救疗保持原样。

Punchline.Original: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。
Punchline.Translated: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。

Description.Original: 可锁定四页角色背包中的指定格子。受保护道具不会参与自动整理，仍可选中、使用和手动拖动，但无法出售、丢弃或上交任务。支持物品右键菜单、纯本地幽灵物品、物品 ID 浏览器和 /isl 设置窗口。
Description.Translated: 可锁定四页角色背包中的指定格子。受保护道具不会参与自动整理，仍可选中、使用和手动拖动，但无法出售、丢弃或上交任务。支持物品右键菜单、纯本地幽灵物品、物品 ID 浏览器和 /isl 设置窗口。

Punchline.Original: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。
Punchline.Translated: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。

Description.Original: 为原生定型文提供轻量快速搜索窗口，支持中文与拼音筛选、动态技能和历史技能定型文。历史技能热键栏支持按当前或指定职业筛选、查看旧技能描述与原图标，并在图标失效时显示默认失效图标。使用 /qat 打开，/qat hotbar 打开历史技能热键栏。
Description.Translated: 为原生定型文提供轻量快速搜索窗口，支持中文与拼音筛选、动态技能和历史技能定型文。历史技能热键栏支持按当前或指定职业筛选、查看旧技能描述与原图标，并在图标失效时显示默认失效图标。使用 /qat 打开，/qat hotbar 打开历史技能热键栏。

Punchline.Original: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。
Punchline.Translated: [oldstable] 新版功能已迁移至 QToolKit。

Description.Original: 将角色背包、陆行鸟鞍囊、雇员背包、幻化台和收藏柜保存为本地快照并提供搜索。鸟包按已加载页面增量合并并保留未加载页；雇员仅在背包窗口和全部页面就绪时更新，避免按需加载或残留状态清空、串写本地索引。支持批量取存与跨雇员合并。使用 /ebsearch 打开。
Description.Translated: 将角色背包、陆行鸟鞍囊、雇员背包、幻化台和收藏柜保存为本地快照并提供搜索。鸟包按已加载页面增量合并并保留未加载页；雇员仅在背包窗口和全部页面就绪时更新，避免按需加载或残留状态清空、串写本地索引。支持批量取存与跨雇员合并。使用 /ebsearch 打开。

Punchline.Original: Shows flank and rear markers on positional hotbar actions.
Punchline.Translated: 在需要身位的热键栏动作上显示侧面和背面标记。

Description.Original: Draws an F or R badge over hotbar actions that currently require a flank or rear positional, including dynamically changing combo actions.
Description.Translated: 在当前需要侧面或背面身位的热键栏动作上绘制 F 或 R 标记，包括动态变化的连击动作。

Punchline.Original: Native-styled player, target, and cast bars.
Punchline.Translated: 原生风格的玩家、目标和咏唱条。

Description.Original: Replaces the player and target frames with compact, configurable unit frames styled to match the native FFXIV HUD.
Description.Translated: 用紧凑、可配置的单位框架替换玩家和目标框架，风格与原生 FFXIV HUD 匹配。

Punchline.Original: A readable replacement-aware combat HUD for Viper.
Punchline.Translated: 为 Viper 提供的清晰易读、可识别技能替换的战斗 HUD。

Description.Original: Shows Viper's current combo action, mandatory follow-ups, positionals, buffs, and job gauges in a compact movable HUD.
Description.Translated: 在紧凑的可移动 HUD 中显示 Viper 当前的连击动作、必接后续技能、身位、增益和职业量谱。

Punchline.Original: Split and rearrange job resource gauges
Punchline.Translated: 拆分并重新排列职业资源量谱

Description.Original: Split and rearrange job resource gauges
Description.Translated: 拆分并重新排列职业资源量谱

Punchline.Original: Show where items can be bought from vendors
Punchline.Translated: 显示物品可从哪些商人处购买

Description.Original: Show where items can be bought from vendors
Description.Translated: 显示物品可从哪些商人处购买

Punchline.Original: Auto-manages PlayerSync and Lightless Sync when AutoRetainer multi mode is active
Punchline.Translated: AutoRetainer 多角色模式启用时自动管理 PlayerSync 和 Lightless Sync

Description.Original: Watches AutoRetainer's multi mode toggle and automatically disables PlayerSync (MareSempiterne) and Lightless Sync while multi mode is running, preventing the crash bugs caused by their memory usage. Optionally re-enables them when multi mode stops. Use /mmm to open settings.
Description.Translated: 监视 AutoRetainer 的多角色模式开关，在多角色模式运行时自动禁用 PlayerSync（MareSempiterne）和 Lightless Sync，防止因其内存占用而导致的崩溃 bug。可选择在多角色模式停止时重新启用它们。使用 /mmm 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: A dedicated hotbar-style job switcher.
Punchline.Translated: 专用的热键栏风格职业切换器。

Description.Original: Displays registered gearsets on custom movable bars with drag-and-drop job and role-group assignment.
Description.Translated: 在可自定义的可移动栏上显示已注册的套装，支持拖放分配职业与职能分组。

Punchline.Original: Shows your hitbox point and world directions around your character.
Punchline.Translated: 显示你的判定点与世界方向。

Description.Original: Draws a dot at the local player's exact world position with N, S, E, and W labels projected onto the ground around the player.
Description.Translated: 在本地玩家的精确世界坐标处绘制一个点，并在玩家周围的地面上投影 N、S、E、W 标签。

Punchline.Original: Tracks North Horn pot FATE rotations.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪 North Horn pot FATE 轮换。

Description.Original: Starts a 30-minute countdown when either North Horn pot FATE spawns and shows which pot FATE is expected next.
Description.Translated: 当 North Horn 的任意一个 pot FATE 刷新时开始 30 分钟倒计时，并显示下一个预期刷新的 pot FATE。

Punchline.Original: Per-job cosmetic keybind labels for hotbar slots.
Punchline.Translated: 按职业为热键栏槽位显示外观性键位标签。

Description.Original: Displays configurable per-job PvE and PvP keybind text on native hotbar slots without changing the game's actual keybindings.
Description.Translated: 在原版热键栏槽位上显示可按职业配置的 PvE 与 PvP 键位文本，不改变游戏的实际键位绑定。

Punchline.Original: Changes visible minion size locally.
Punchline.Translated: 本地更改可见的宠物大小。

Description.Original: Adjusts the local display scale of minions. Use /minionscaler to configure.
Description.Translated: 调整宠物的本地显示缩放。使用 /minionscaler 进行配置。

Punchline.Original: Turns auto-translate phrases into stickers over players' heads.
Punchline.Translated: 将自动翻译短语变成玩家头顶的贴纸。

Description.Original:
When someone sends a chat message made up only of auto-translate phrases, replaces their native chat bubble with a sticker image. Mapping is 1:1 and user configurable. Receive-only: this plugin never sends chat and never reads your chat log.

Stickers live in packs, stamped with the character that authored them. Share one as a zip, an https link, or automatically with your Snowcloak pairs. Pack sync is off by default, only ever sends a link rather than images, and will not install a pack unless it belongs to the character sharing it.

Players without the plugin just see an ordinary auto-translate phrase.

Alpha: bubble replacement works and is confirmed in-game, but expect rough edges. Use /stickerchat to configure and /stickerchat debug to inspect bubble nodes.
Description.Translated:
当有人发送完全由自动翻译短语组成的聊天消息时，将其原生气泡替换为贴纸图片。映射为 1:1 且可由用户配置。仅接收：此插件从不发送聊天，也从不读取你的聊天记录。

贴纸以包的形式存在，并标有创作它们的角色。可通过 zip、https 链接分享，或自动与你的 Snowcloak 配对共享。包同步默认关闭，只会发送链接而非图片，且只有当包属于分享它的角色时才会安装。

未安装该插件的玩家只会看到普通的自动翻译短语。

Alpha：气泡替换功能可用并已在游戏中确认，但可能会有粗糙之处。使用 /stickerchat 进行配置，使用 /stickerchat debug 检查气泡节点。

Punchline.Original: Priority-sorted gathering node tracker. No automation.
Punchline.Translated: 按优先级排序的采集点追踪器。无自动化。

Description.Original: Shows a priority-sorted list of active and upcoming gathering nodes from your wishlist, using FFXIV's deterministic weather and Eorzea clock. Read-only by design: no automated movement or gathering.
Description.Translated: 根据你的愿望清单，显示按优先级排序的当前与即将出现的采集点列表，使用 FFXIV 的确定性天气与艾欧泽亚时钟。设计上为只读：不进行自动移动或采集。

Punchline.Original: Deal blackjack tables across Eorzea.
Punchline.Translated: 在艾欧泽亚各地发牌二十一点牌桌。

Description.Original: An experimental multiplayer blackjack table for FFXIV. Includes solo practice, hosted tables, and remote online play.
Description.Translated: 一个实验性的 FFXIV 多人二十一点牌桌。包含单人练习、主持牌桌和远程在线游玩。

Punchline.Original: Follows a live game of Blitzball, for players, refs and announcers.
Punchline.Translated: 跟踪一场实时 Blitzball 比赛，供玩家、裁判和解说使用。

Description.Original: Reads a Blitzball match out of Yell chat and follows it against the rules: phases, rounds, score, possession, and where every player is standing. Shows the sphere on a field view and over the arena itself, with each player's declared action and their roll. Flags anything that does not match the rules, and leaves the call to the referees.
Description.Translated: 从 Yell 聊天中读取 Blitzball 比赛并按规则跟踪：阶段、回合、比分、控球权，以及每名玩家的站位。在场地视图和竞技场本体上显示球，并显示每名玩家声明的行动及其掷骰。标记任何不符合规则的情况，最终判定交由裁判。

Punchline.Original: View FFXIV Collect collections (mounts, minions, orchestrions, etc.) in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内查看 FFXIV Collect 的收藏（坐骑、宠物、管弦乐谱等）。

Description.Original: Shows a character's collection (yours, or any player via right-click) using FFXIV Collect data: mounts, minions, orchestrions, emotes, hairstyles, bardings. Per-category progress, icons, search. UI available in English and Russian. Not affiliated with FFXIV Collect.
Description.Translated: 使用 FFXIV Collect 数据展示角色的收藏（你自己的，或右键点击任意玩家）：坐骑、宠物、管弦乐谱、情感动作、发型、陆行鸟装甲。按分类显示进度、图标、搜索。UI 支持英语和俄语。与 FFXIV Collect 无关联。

Punchline.Original: Toggleable always face camera for macros.
Punchline.Translated: 可通过宏切换的始终面向镜头。

Description.Original: Makes your character look at the camera (like HaselTweaks' Always Face Camera) and can be toggled on and off with a macro via /afc.
Description.Translated: 让你的角色看向镜头（类似 HaselTweaks 的 Always Face Camera），并可通过 /afc 宏开启和关闭。

Punchline.Original: The dealer's in-game companion for the Catsino casino.
Punchline.Translated: Catsino 赌场的庄家游戏内伴侣。

Description.Original: The dealer's control panel, paired with the Catsino backend.
Description.Translated: 庄家的控制面板，与 Catsino 后端配套。

Punchline.Original: Browse and apply Glamourer outfits visually.
Punchline.Translated: 可视化浏览并应用 Glamourer 幻化。

Description.Original: A visual companion for Glamourer with outfit thumbnails, collections, and one-click application.
Description.Translated: Glamourer 的可视化伴侣，提供幻化缩略图、收藏集和一键应用。

Punchline.Original: Multi-character linking, housing, animation, and gil tools
Punchline.Translated: 多角色关联、房屋、动画和金币工具

Description.Original: AltMate supports multiple FFXIV clients running on the same PC. It provides linked controls, housing tracking, Penumbra emote playback, and shared gil summaries. Data stays on the local PC. Japanese and English UI are supported.
Description.Translated: AltMate 支持在同一台 PC 上运行多个 FFXIV 客户端。它提供联动控制、房屋追踪、Penumbra 情感动作播放和共享金币摘要。数据保留在本地 PC 上。UI 支持日语和英语。

Punchline.Original: Host and run venue trivia.
Punchline.Translated: 主持并运行场地问答活动。

Description.Original: Host controls for Mair's Trivia. Open with /mairstrivia.
Description.Translated: Mair's Trivia 的主持控制。使用 /mairstrivia 打开。

Punchline.Original: A beautiful area notification as you walk in and out of zones.
Punchline.Translated: 在你进出区域时显示精美的区域通知。

Description.Original:
Announces the region, zone, area and sub-area you walk into with a styled, animated on-screen notification. It can announce weather changes too, and redraw the game's own banners (Quest Accepted, Duty Commenced, Level Up!) in the same style.

Every line takes its own colours, outline, drop shadow and font: one of the game's own faces, or any font file on your PC.

A notification can make a sound as it arrives, either one of the game's own chat sound effects or a file of your own. Off until you turn it on, and it follows your in-game volume and mute settings.

Inspired by Nekres' "Regions of Tyria" for Guild Wars 2.

Open settings with /regions.
Description.Translated:
以带样式、带动画的屏幕通知播报你进入的大区、地图、区域和子区域。它也能播报天气变化，并以相同风格重绘游戏自带的横幅（任务接受、任务开始、等级提升！）。

每一行都可单独设置颜色、描边、投影和字体：游戏自带的字体之一，或你电脑上的任意字体文件。

通知到达时可以播放声音，可使用游戏自带的聊天音效之一，或你自己的文件。默认关闭，开启后会遵循游戏内的音量和静音设置。

灵感来自 Nekres 为 Guild Wars 2 制作的 "Regions of Tyria"。

使用 /regions 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Retired: stable CC-protection cues moved to Seiton Sense.
Punchline.Translated: 已退役：稳定的控制保护提示已移至 Seiton Sense。

Description.Original: The standalone CC Immunity Watch plugin is retired because its validated full-immunity cues are integrated into Seiton Sense 0.6. The existing package remains unchanged as a rollback.
Description.Translated: 独立的 CC Immunity Watch 插件已退役，因为其经过验证的完全免疫提示已整合进 Seiton Sense 0.6。现有包保持不变，仅作为回滚之用。

Punchline.Original: Assistiert mit einem Tastendruck dem nächsten brauchbaren Ally.
Punchline.Translated: 按一次键即可协助下一个可用的队友。

Description.Original: DEPRECATED: Near Assist ist ab Version 0.5 in Seiton Sense integriert. Dieses eigenständige Paket bleibt nur als Rollback erhalten. Seiton Sense: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kittenhaswares-ui/SeitonSense/main/repo.json
Description.Translated: 已弃用：Near Assist 自 0.5 版本起已整合进 Seiton Sense。此独立包仅作为回滚保留。Seiton Sense：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kittenhaswares-ui/SeitonSense/main/repo.json

Punchline.Original: Retired: merged into Seiton Sense.
Punchline.Translated: 已退役：已合并至 Seiton Sense。

Description.Original: This standalone plugin is retired. Its focus-target glow now lives in Seiton Sense alongside a current-target highlight and a separate information HUD.
Description.Translated: 此独立插件已退役。其焦点目标发光效果现位于 Seiton Sense 中，与当前目标高亮以及独立的信息 HUD 一同提供。

Punchline.Original: Push your gearsets to Eorzea Arsenal to compare them against BiS.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的套装推送到 Eorzea Arsenal，与 BiS 进行比较。

Description.Original: Reads your gearsets across all jobs and pushes them to your Eorzea Arsenal account so the web app can show your gear vs BiS, and can optionally upload which equippable items you own (inventory + retainers). Connect once (browser approval or paste an API key), then use /xivarsenal. Bilingual DE/EN. Using Dalamud violates the FFXIV ToS; all uploads are strictly opt-in.
Description.Translated: 读取你所有职业的套装，并将其推送到你的 Eorzea Arsenal 账户，以便 Web 应用可以显示你的装备与 BiS 的对比，还可以选择上传你拥有的可装备物品（背包 + 雇员）。连接一次（浏览器批准或粘贴 API 密钥），然后使用 /xivarsenal。支持 DE/EN 双语。使用 Dalamud 违反 FFXIV ToS；所有上传均严格选择加入。

Punchline.Original: Find, rank, and reach FATEs without the busywork.
Punchline.Translated: 寻找、排序并抵达 FATE，无需繁琐操作。

Description.Original: Lists the active FATEs in your current zone, ranks them by distance, remaining time, and progress, and shows the nearest aetheryte for each one. Adds a flag button for sharing a target with your party and an optional single trigger for the small preparation steps around entering a FATE. The plugin never plays for you.
Description.Translated: 列出你当前区域中活跃的 FATE，按距离、剩余时间和进度排序，并显示每个 FATE 最近的以太之光。添加一个标记按钮，用于与队伍分享目标，以及一个可选的单一触发器，用于进入 FATE 前的小型准备步骤。该插件永远不会替你操作。

Punchline.Original: Every gearset, sorted, filtered, one click to switch.
Punchline.Translated: 所有套装，排序、过滤，一键切换。

Description.Original:
The game lists your gearsets by name and nothing else. Gearbook adds what that list is missing: a search, filters by role and category, favourites, your own tags and notes, and a compact bar of job icons you can leave on screen and click to switch. A switcher on the front of the bar swaps it between your favourites, one role, one category or one of your own tags without opening a window.

It is built for the case the game handles worst, several sets for the same job, so a dark knight for one fight, another for a different one, and a third for a glamour are three separate entries rather than one guess. Rename them, reorder them, delete one, and your tags and notes stay on the right sets.

It can also tidy the game's own gearset list into the order Gearbook shows, which is the one thing it changes rather than reads. That runs only when you press the button, keeps the order it found so you can put it back, and stops at the first move that does not land where it was aimed.

Otherwise nothing happens on its own. Gearbook switches a gearset only when you click or type, and there is no automation, no queueing and no acting on your behalf while you are away. It needs no account, no server and no internet connection. Nothing leaves your machine.
Description.Translated:
游戏仅按名称列出你的套装，别无其他。Gearbook 添加了该列表缺失的内容：搜索、按角色和类别过滤、收藏、你自己的标签和备注，以及一个紧凑的职业图标栏，你可以将其留在屏幕上并点击切换。栏前端的切换器可以在你的收藏、单个角色、单个类别或你自己的某个标签之间切换，而无需打开窗口。

它专为游戏处理得最差的情况而构建，即同一职业有多个套装，因此一个用于某场战斗的暗黑骑士、另一个用于不同战斗、第三个用于幻化，是三个独立条目，而不是一个猜测。重命名、重新排序、删除其中一个，你的标签和备注仍会保留在正确的套装上。

它还可以将游戏自身的套装列表整理为 Gearbook 显示的顺序，这是它唯一更改而非读取的内容。这仅在你按下按钮时运行，会保留它找到的顺序，以便你可以恢复，并且在第一个未达到预期位置的移动处停止。

否则不会自行发生任何事情。Gearbook 仅在你点击或输入时切换套装，没有自动化、没有队列，也不会在你离开时代表你行动。它不需要账户、服务器和互联网连接。没有任何数据离开你的机器。

Punchline.Original: Per-slot wardrobe for Penumbra mods, with image previews.
Punchline.Translated: 适用于 Penumbra mod 的每槽位衣柜，带图片预览。

Description.Original: A visual wardrobe for Penumbra mods. Each entry targets a single equipment slot, so you can wear or unwear exactly what you want without disturbing the rest of your look. Handles items spanning several mods, mod option groups, variants, and hair and other customisation mods. Save looks as outfits with per-item dyes, dye a whole outfit at once, and edit an outfit by wearing it and swapping pieces on the character. Import a whole batch of mods at once, or one at a time. Animations, VFX and mounts can be managed alongside your gear if you want them. Also does image previews, tags, favourites, search and sort, and automated screenshot sessions.
Description.Translated: 一个用于 Penumbra mod 的可视化衣柜。每个条目针对单个装备槽位，因此你可以精确穿戴或脱下你想要的内容，而不影响其余外观。处理跨越多个 mod、mod 选项组、变体以及发型和其他自定义 mod 的物品。将外观保存为带有每件物品染色的套装，一次性染色整个套装，并通过在角色上穿戴和更换部件来编辑套装。一次导入一整批 mod，或一次一个。动画、VFX 和坐骑可以根据需要与装备一起管理。还支持图片预览、标签、收藏、搜索和排序，以及自动截图会话。

Punchline.Original: Cible rapidement les joueurs autour de toi, morts en premier.
Punchline.Translated: 快速选定你周围的玩家，优先死者。

Description.Original: Affiche tous les joueurs proches (groupe et hors groupe) tries par distance, avec une barre de PV cliquable pour les cibler. Pratique pour reperer et ressusciter les morts. Commande : /nearby
Description.Translated: 显示所有附近的玩家（队伍内和队伍外），按距离排序，并带有可点击的 HP 条来选定他们。方便发现和复活死者。命令：/nearby

Punchline.Original: Farm any mob, or anything it drops, until you have enough.
Punchline.Translated: 刷任意怪物，或它掉落的任何物品，直到你刷够为止。

Description.Original:
Pick a mob, or pick an item you want it to drop, and AutoKill goes and farms it. It works out where the mob lives, teleports to the zone, mounts, flies over and kills its way around the field until you have what you asked for.

Search by mob name, or by item and see which mobs drop it. Set any mix of a kill count, a time limit and an amount of any item, and choose whether the first target ends the run or all of them must be met. Dying or filling your bags always ends it, and you get a chat line and a toast when it does.

It farms a whole field rather than one point, flying a circuit around it and moving on when a spot is cleared instead of standing over a respawn timer. How quickly a place comes back is not in any dataset, so it measures that as it goes and uses it to decide when a spot is worth returning to. Finished runs are kept so repeating one is a single click.

Movement needs vnavmesh. Fighting is handed to Wrath Combo, and left completely alone if your auto-rotation is already running.
Description.Translated:
选择一个怪物，或选择你想让它掉落的物品，AutoKill 就会去刷它。它会找出怪物的所在地，传送到该区域，上坐骑，飞过去，并在野外一路击杀，直到你获得想要的东西。

按怪物名称搜索，或按物品搜索并查看哪些怪物会掉落它。可任意组合设置击杀数量、时间限制和任意物品数量，并选择是第一个目标达成即结束，还是必须全部满足。死亡或背包满总是会结束，结束时你会收到一条聊天信息和一条弹窗提示。

它会刷整片区域而不是一个点，绕着区域飞一圈，清完一个点就继续前进，而不是站在原地等刷新计时。某个地点多久刷新不在任何数据集中，因此它会在过程中测量，并据此判断某个点是否值得返回。已完成的运行会被保留，因此重复一次只需单击。

移动需要 vnavmesh。战斗交给 Wrath Combo；如果你的自动循环已在运行，则完全不会干预。

Punchline.Original: Read Trust NPC levels/EXP from the game and recommend duties.
Punchline.Translated: 从游戏中读取 Trust NPC 等级/EXP 并推荐副本。

Description.Original: In-game Trust EXP calculator that reads levels from the Dawn Trust system
Description.Translated: 游戏内的 Trust EXP 计算器，从 Dawn Trust 系统读取等级

Punchline.Original: Batch materia exchanges at Mutamix.
Punchline.Translated: 在 Mutamix 批量兑换魔晶石。

Description.Original: A private development plugin for selected-grade Mutamix materia exchanges. Use /mutamix to open the control window.
Description.Translated: 一个用于所选等级 Mutamix 魔晶石兑换的私人开发插件。使用 /mutamix 打开控制窗口。

Punchline.Original: No more Chinese characters loss in game. 不要再給我等號了==
Punchline.Translated: 游戏中不再丢失中文字符。不要再给我等号了==

Description.Original:
Readable Chinese in chat please. Convert missing Chinese glyphs into Japanese kanji to let them shows.
講話都是等號是要我通靈？ 缺字自動轉日文漢字工具
Note: Only support in Traditional Chinese.
註：只支援繁體中文

Commands: /nme or /nomoreequals
Description.Translated:
聊天里请显示可读中文。将缺失的中文字形转换为日文汉字以使其显示。
讲话都是等号是要我通灵？ 缺字自动转日文汉字工具
注：仅支持繁体中文。
注：仅支持繁体中文

命令：/nme 或 /nomoreequals

Punchline.Original: Tracking Occult Crescent.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪 Occult Crescent。

Description.Original: Tracking Occult Crescent. Use /hornwatch to open the plugin. Settings are available from the gear icon in the Plugin Installer.
Description.Translated: 追踪 Occult Crescent。使用 /hornwatch 打开插件。可在插件安装器中的齿轮图标处进行设置。

Punchline.Original: Draw locally stored challenge cards in game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内抽取本地存储的挑战卡牌。

Description.Original: Player-run levemetes card game for truth or dare shenanigans.  Categorized play with custom decks that can be created and shared between players!  Open with /levemetes
Description.Translated: 由玩家主持的 levemetes 卡牌游戏，用于真心话大冒险之类的整活。分类游玩，支持可创建并在玩家之间分享的自定义卡组！用 /levemetes 打开

Punchline.Original: Role-specific accessibility callouts for DMU Phase 3.
Punchline.Translated: 针对 DMU 三阶段的职能专属无障碍提示。

Description.Original: Movable high-contrast MT, OT, H1, H2 and D1-D4 callouts for the MUR/OCE Bowels of Agony strategy in Dancing Mad (Ultimate) Phase 3.
Description.Translated: 用于 Dancing Mad (Ultimate) 三阶段 MUR/OCE Bowels of Agony 打法的可移动高对比度 MT、OT、H1、H2 和 D1-D4 提示。

Punchline.Original: A standalone box of small quality-of-life tools.
Punchline.Translated: 一个独立的小型便利工具合集。

Description.Original: LimLoToolkit is a single window that collects small quality-of-life tools for the Occult Crescent and beyond. Coffer Lines draws a line from you to nearby bronze and silver treasure coffers, and can optionally target and open one once you walk up to it. Enemy Vision draws each nearby enemy's detection area on the ground - a wedge for enemies that only see in front, a circle for those that detect in all directions - and turns it red when you are standing inside. Alongside them sit a live character and zone readout and an Eorzea clock with the next weather window. Every tool can be switched on or off individually. The plugin is fully standalone - it needs no other plugins installed and talks to nothing outside the game.
Description.Translated: LimLoToolkit 是一个单一窗口，汇集了针对 Occult Crescent 及更多内容的小型便利工具。Coffer Lines 会从你身上画出一条线指向附近的青铜和白银宝箱，并且在你走到宝箱旁时可选择选中并打开其中一个。Enemy Vision 会在地面上绘制每个附近敌人的侦测范围——只看到正前方的敌人显示为扇形，全方位侦测的敌人显示为圆形——当你站在其中时会变为红色。除此之外还有实时的角色与区域信息读出，以及带下一天气窗口的艾欧泽亚时钟。每个工具都可以单独开启或关闭。该插件完全独立——无需安装任何其他插件，也不与游戏外的任何东西通信。

Punchline.Original: Track glams, Fashion Report, randomize glamour plates and more. All with a cool native UI.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪幻化、时尚报告、随机幻化套装等，全都配有一个好用的原生 UI。

Description.Original: Track glamour dresser and armoire items, Fashion Report, randomize glamour plates, see whether you already own the item at a single glance, favorite and keep track of outfits you wish to get.
Description.Translated: 追踪幻化柜和衣橱中的物品、时尚报告，随机化幻化套装，一眼看出你是否已拥有该物品，收藏并记录你想要获取的套装。

Punchline.Original: Quality-of-life tools that connect your game to MogHouse. Timers and duty pops, pushed to your phone.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的游戏与 MogHouse 连接起来的便利工具。倒计时和副本弹出都会推送到你的手机。

Description.Original:
Companion plugin for MogHouse (mog-house.com).

An all-in-one home for quality-of-life tools that link FINAL FANTASY XIV to your MogHouse account. Tools are added over time; each one can be switched on or off individually, and nothing leaves the game unless you enable it.

Timers: reads the timers you already see in the game's own Timers window (CTRL+U), including submarine and airship voyages, retainer ventures, map and leve allowances, custom deliveries and allied society dailies, and syncs them to your profile. MogHouse then pushes you a notification the moment one comes up, on web and mobile, even while the game and your PC are off. Voyages are timed to the last vessel back, so one notification means the whole fleet is home.

Duty Finder: when the confirm window appears, MogHouse pushes the duty or roulette name to your phone, so you know whether it is worth the sprint back to the desk. By default it stays quiet while the game is the window you are looking at.

The plugin is read-only: it collects your own data and reports status. It never performs an in-game action — it will not commence a duty for you, and it does not skip, confirm or automate anything.

Open it with /moghouse. Requires a MogHouse account, and a free one is enough: it syncs one character and sends one timer alert of your choosing, plus duty pops. Mog+ lifts both limits and warns you before a timer lands rather than as it does.
Description.Translated:
MogHouse (mog-house.com) 的配套插件。

集于一处的生活便利工具，将 FINAL FANTASY XIV 与你的 MogHouse 账号连接。工具会陆续添加；每个都可以单独开启或关闭，除非你启用，否则任何数据都不会离开游戏。

Timers：读取游戏自身计时器窗口（CTRL+U）中你已经能看到的计时器，包括潜水艇与飞空艇探索、雇员探险、地图与理符限额、定制交货和友好部族日常，并将其同步到你的个人资料。之后一旦有计时器到期，MogHouse 会立即在网页和移动端向你推送通知，即使游戏和你的电脑已关闭。探索以最后一艘回港的船只为准计时，所以一条通知就意味着整支舰队都已归来。

Duty Finder：当确认窗口出现时，MogHouse 会把副本或随机任务名称推送到你的手机，让你知道是否值得冲回桌前。默认情况下，当游戏是你正在查看的窗口时，它会保持安静。

该插件是只读的：它收集你自己的数据并报告状态。它绝不会执行游戏内操作——不会替你参加副本，也不会跳过、确认或自动化任何内容。

用 /moghouse 打开。需要 MogHouse 账号，免费账号就够了：它可以同步一个角色、发送一条你选择的时间提醒，外加副本弹出通知。Mog+ 会解除这两项限制，并在计时器到期前而非到期时提醒你。

Punchline.Original: Discord alerts for Auroral Mirage in North Horn.
Punchline.Translated: North Horn 出现 Auroral Mirage 时的 Discord 提醒。

Description.Original: Sends one Discord webhook notification when Auroral Mirage appears while you are in North Horn.
Description.Translated: 当你在 North Horn 时 Auroral Mirage 出现，发送一次 Discord webhook 通知。

Punchline.Original: Automatically compress textures in newly installed Penumbra mods.
Punchline.Translated: 自动压缩新安装的 Penumbra 模组中的纹理。

Description.Original: Detects completed Penumbra mod installations and offers configurable Base, Normal, and Mask texture compression. Use /aetherpress to open settings.
Description.Translated: 检测已完成的 Penumbra 模组安装，并提供可配置的 Base、Normal 和 Mask 纹理压缩。使用 /aetherpress 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Automated hunt train follower. /autohunt
Punchline.Translated: 自动跟随狩猎车。 /autohunt

Description.Original:
Follows a hunt train conductor: parses map flags, auto-teleports, mounts and navigates with vnavmesh, unmounts at the spot, follows party to the pull, and engages combat with Rotation Solver Reborn.

Commands: /autohunt (or /hta) — open settings. /autohunt clear — clear conductors. /autohunt add <name> or /autohunt <name> — set conductor.
Description.Translated:
跟随狩猎车车头：解析地图标记，自动传送、上坐骑并使用 vnavmesh 导航，到点下坐骑，跟随队伍到开怪点，并使用 Rotation Solver Reborn 进入战斗。

命令： /autohunt （或 /hta）— 打开设置。 /autohunt clear — 清除车头。 /autohunt add <name> 或 /autohunt <name> — 设置车头。

Punchline.Original: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
Punchline.Translated: 记住每一步，光之战士们。

Description.Original: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
Description.Translated: 任务进度与节奏——一本记录你故事旅程的反思笔记，而非记分板。

Punchline.Original: Captures Party Finder listings and reports them to pfexplorer for cross-client search.
Punchline.Translated: 捕获 Party Finder 招募信息并将其报告给 pfexplorer，以进行跨客户端搜索。

Description.Original:
Captures Party Finder listings as you play and shares them to pfexplorer.com, so you can search Party Finder across every data center instead of just your own.

Features:
- Cross-DC search — see and filter listings from every data center, not just the one you're on
- Click a listing to jump straight to it in-game (opens Party Finder to the right category automatically)
- Notifications for new matches, party size changes, and listings closing — each with its own configurable chat color and clickable chat links
- Full results window or a compact minimal view
- Filter by job, item level, data center, category, and freshness
- Optional background scanner keeps contributing fresh data even when you're not manually browsing Party Finder
Description.Translated:
在你游玩时捕获 Party Finder 招募信息并分享至 pfexplorer.com，让你可以跨所有大区搜索 Party Finder，而不仅限于自己所在的大区。

功能：
- 跨大区搜索 — 查看并筛选来自每个大区的招募，而不仅是你所在的大区
- 点击招募即可在游戏内直接跳转（自动打开 Party Finder 至对应分类）
- 新匹配、队伍人数变化和招募关闭的通知 — 每项均可配置聊天颜色和可点击的聊天链接
- 完整结果窗口或紧凑极简视图
- 按职业、物品品级、大区、分类和新鲜度筛选
- 可选的后台扫描器，即使你没有手动浏览 Party Finder，也能持续贡献新数据

Punchline.Original: Turns your leves and Grand Company supply into a crafting list.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的理符和大国防联军补给转化为制作清单。

Description.Original:
Docket reads the deliveries the game already asks of you and hands them to Vulcan.

It lists the craftable items required by your accepted levequests, and by the Grand Company supply window while it is open. Uncheck what you do not want, then send the rest as a Vulcan crafting list. Vulcan resolves precrafts, materials and gathering on its own.

Docket reads. It never crafts, gathers, buys, or writes into another plugin's configuration file.
Description.Translated:
Docket 会读取游戏已经要求你提交的交付任务，并将它们交给 Vulcan。

它会列出你已接受的理符任务，以及大国防联军补给窗口打开时所需的可制作物品。取消勾选你不想要的内容，然后把其余内容作为 Vulcan 制作清单发送。Vulcan 会自行解析预制作、材料和采集。

Docket 只读取。它从不制作、采集、购买，也不会写入其他插件的配置文件。

Punchline.Original: Counts completed FATEs. Manual reset only.
Punchline.Translated: 统计已完成的 FATE 数量。仅可手动重置。

Description.Original: Cumulative counter of completed FATEs. Survives relogs, game restarts and plugin reloads. Only goes back to zero via the Reset button or /fate reset. Built for Demiatma farming: when one drops, the count is frozen in a pending entry so the number stays correct even if you keep farming.
Description.Translated: 已完成 FATE 的累计计数器。可在重新登录、游戏重启和插件重载后保留。只有通过 Reset 按钮或 /fate reset 才会归零。专为刷 Demiatma 设计：当掉落一个时，计数会冻结在待处理条目中，因此即使你继续刷，数字也会保持正确。

Punchline.Original: Filters the game's item lists and marks what matters.
Punchline.Translated: 筛选游戏物品列表并标记重要内容。

Description.Original:
Sift puts your own criteria on top of the item lists the game already shows you.

In your bags: pick the categories and bounds you care about, save them as named loadouts, and the matching slots are tinted in the native inventory window. Items reserved by a gearset are counted and protected, glamours included.

At a counter: rows that fail your filter are greyed out and cannot be bought by accident. Filter by equip level, by class job, or by which stats an item carries -- and the Current button reads your own equipped gear to set all three at once.

Covers the ordinary vendor and the Grand Company seal exchange. It moves items only when you ask it to entrust them.
Description.Translated:
Sift 会把你自己的条件叠加在游戏已向你显示的物品列表之上。

在你的背包中：选择你关心的类别和范围，将它们保存为命名预设，匹配的物品栏位会在原生背包窗口中着色。被装备套装预留的物品会被计入并受到保护，包括幻化。

在商店柜台：不符合筛选条件的行会变灰，无法被误买。可按装备等级、职业或物品携带的属性筛选——而 Current 按钮会读取你自己装备的装备，以一次性设置全部三项。

覆盖普通商人和大国防联军军票兑换。只有当你要求它托管物品时，它才会移动物品。

Punchline.Original: Exports your squadron as an ffxivsquadron.com import code.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的中队导出为 ffxivsquadron.com 导入码。

Description.Original:
SquadronScribe reads your Grand Company squadron and writes the import code that ffxivsquadron.com expects.

Open the Squadron Members window at your barracks and an Export button appears beside it. One click copies the code; paste it into the site's import box.

SquadronScribe reads. It never assigns, trains, dismisses, or sends a mission.
Description.Translated:
SquadronScribe 会读取你的大国防联军中队，并生成 ffxivsquadron.com 所需的导入码。

在军营打开中队成员窗口后，旁边会出现一个 Export 按钮。一键复制代码；将其粘贴到网站导入框中。

SquadronScribe 只读取。它从不分配、训练、解雇或派遣任务。

Punchline.Original: A configurable circular cursor with GCD progress.
Punchline.Translated: 可配置的环形光标，带 GCD 进度。

Description.Original: Replaces the in-game cursor with a hollow ring and center dot. Global cooldown progress can appear as an inner ring, outer ring, stroke overlay, or pie overlay. Open settings with /cursorring.
Description.Translated: 将游戏内光标替换为空心圆环和中心点。全局冷却进度可显示为内环、外环、描边叠加或扇形叠加。使用 /cursorring 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Cross-world shopping made easy.
Punchline.Translated: 跨服购物变得简单。

Description.Original:
Buying, not selling. Give MarketTraveler a shopping list with a price ceiling per item and it works the market board for you: searches each item, skips anything over your ceiling, and reports what it actually bought — counted from your bags, not from the listing.

Shopping always happens in Limsa Lominsa, on whichever world it travels to.

Requires both Lifestream (world travel) and vnavmesh (walking the ~50 yalms from the aetheryte to the board). The Dependencies tab checks both are installed and that their IPC actually answers, and blocks a run if either would fail.
Description.Translated:
只买不卖。给 MarketTraveler 一份购物清单并为每件物品设置价格上限，它就会替你操作市场布告板：搜索每件物品，跳过超过你上限的物品，并报告实际买到的内容——以你的背包为准，而非以挂牌为准。

购物始终在 Limsa Lominsa 进行，无论它前往哪个服务器。

需要同时安装 Lifestream（跨服传送）和 vnavmesh（从以太之光步行到布告板约 50 yalms）。Dependencies 标签页会检查两者是否已安装以及其 IPC 是否真正响应，若任一不满足则阻止运行。

Punchline.Original: Keeps PvP resources and Guard state above the 3D world.
Punchline.Translated: 让 PvP 资源和 Guard 状态显示在 3D 世界之上。

Description.Original:
Draws stabilized PvP player HP, shield, MP, and Guard-state indicators in Dalamud's foreground UI layer so terrain and map geometry cannot cover them.

Use /ptop to configure.
Description.Translated:
在 Dalamud 的前景 UI 层绘制稳定的 PvP 玩家 HP、护盾、MP 和 Guard 状态指示器，使地形和地图几何无法遮挡它们。

使用 /ptop 进行配置。

Punchline.Original: Live AI translation of cutscene and NPC dialogue, overlaid on the original text.
Punchline.Translated: 对过场动画和 NPC 对话进行实时 AI 翻译，并叠加显示在原文之上。

Description.Original:
Translates in-game cutscene and NPC dialogue in real time using a user-defined AI translation endpoint (OpenAI-compatible, e.g. OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter). The translation is drawn as an overlay on top of or above the original text.

Commands:
/tt - open the main window
/ttconfig - open the settings window
Description.Translated:
使用用户定义的 AI 翻译端点（OpenAI 兼容，例如 OpenAI、DeepSeek、Ollama、LM Studio、OpenRouter）实时翻译游戏内的过场动画和 NPC 对话。翻译以叠加层形式绘制在原文之上或上方。

命令：
/tt - 打开主窗口
/ttconfig - 打开设置窗口

Punchline.Original: Automatically navigate to and collect missing Aether Currents
Punchline.Translated: 自动导航并收集缺失的风脉

Description.Original: Reads the aether currents obtained in the current zone, lists the missing ones, and automatically navigates to and collects them using vnavmesh.
Description.Translated: 读取当前区域已获得的风脉，列出缺失的风脉，并使用 vnavmesh 自动导航并收集它们。

Punchline.Original: Test and organize your Penumbra mods without leaving the game.
Punchline.Translated: 无需离开游戏即可测试和整理你的 Penumbra 模组。

Description.Original: Inspect and temporarily test a mod on your character, then preview and apply an organization for your Penumbra library. Command: /prism.
Description.Translated: 在你的角色上查看并临时测试某个模组，然后预览并应用对 Penumbra 库的整理。命令：/prism。

Punchline.Original: Plan a shopping list, travel efficiently, and buy live market listings.
Punchline.Translated: 规划购物清单，高效旅行，并购买实时市场挂单。

Description.Original: Compare Universalis listings, plan quantities and budgets, then use Lifestream to travel and purchase verified live listings.
Description.Translated: 比较 Universalis 挂单，规划数量与预算，然后使用 Lifestream 旅行并购买已验证的实时挂单。

Punchline.Original: Runs dungeons for your whole fleet — and picks up where it left off.
Punchline.Translated: 为你的整个舰队运行副本——并能从上次中断处继续。

Description.Original: Automated dungeon running for multibox fleets. Paths through the dungeon, engages trash, hands bosses to BossMod Reborn and resumes pathing. Reads the duty objective list so an interrupted run resumes where it stopped instead of restarting. Every box paths itself and syncs on objectives, and repairs and extracts materia between runs. Companion to Daedalus.
Description.Translated: 面向多开舰队的自动化副本运行。在副本中寻路，处理小怪，将 Boss 交给 BossMod Reborn，然后继续寻路。读取任务目标列表，因此中断的副本会从停止处继续，而不是重新开始。每个窗口自行寻路并在目标上同步，并在两次运行之间修理和精炼魔晶石。Daedalus 的配套插件。

Punchline.Original: Custom kill, death, assist, and Battle High sounds for PvP.
Punchline.Translated: 为 PvP 自定义击杀、死亡、助攻和 Battle High 音效。

Description.Original: Plays configurable sound clips on PvP kills, deaths, assists, killstreaks, and Frontline Battle High rank-ups. Version 0.1 — experimental.
Description.Translated: 在 PvP 击杀、死亡、助攻、连杀和前线 Battle High 等级提升时播放可配置的音效片段。版本 0.1 — 实验性。

Punchline.Original: A dedicated Party Finder for plugin users, featuring 3D BossMod mirroring and mechanic solving.
Punchline.Translated: 面向插件用户的专用 Party Finder，具备 3D BossMod 镜像和机制解算。

Description.Original: A dedicated Party Finder tailored for the plugin-enabled community, featuring real-time 3D BossMod mirroring, advanced mechanic drawing and solving, and essential helper tools.
Description.Translated: 为使用插件的社区量身打造的专用 Party Finder，具备实时 3D BossMod 镜像、高级机制绘制与解算，以及必要的辅助工具。

Punchline.Original: [Questionable dev plugin]: Renders gathering location.
Punchline.Translated: [Questionable 开发插件]：渲染采集位置。

Description.Original: [Questionable dev plugin]: Renders gathering location using Pictomancy.
Description.Translated: [Questionable 开发插件]：使用 Pictomancy 渲染采集位置。

Punchline.Original: Smart hotbar icon swapping for potions
Punchline.Translated: 智能切换药水的热键栏图标

Description.Original:
PotionSwapper, I am going into battle and need my finest potions.

XIVCombo but for your potions!
Description.Translated:
PotionSwapper，我要上战场了，需要我最好的药水。

XIVCombo 但用于你的药水！

Punchline.Original: Spin tracks and let the party sync in - natively, on Linux.
Punchline.Translated: 播放曲目，让派对同步加入——在 Linux 上原生运行。

Description.Original: The Linux build of EchoMix. Same relay, same DJ profiles, same live shows as the Windows version - but the audio engine is a native Linux binary talking straight to PipeWire/PulseAudio instead of running through Wine's emulated audio. An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Description.Translated: EchoMix 的 Linux 版本。与 Windows 版相同的转播、相同的 DJ 配置、相同的现场演出——但音频引擎是原生 Linux 二进制，直接与 PipeWire/PulseAudio 通信，而不是通过 Wine 的模拟音频。一个交互式 DJ 控制台，带有实时混音工具、自定义播放列表，以及带音频可视化的同步听众模式。

Punchline.Original: MIDI editor, live view, and auto-play helper for Bard Performance.
Punchline.Translated: 用于演奏模式的 MIDI 编辑器、实时视图和自动演奏助手。

Description.Original: Loads MIDI files, separates tracks as instruments, displays live Bard Performance note prompts, and can auto-play by sending mapped Performance key presses to the focused game window.
Description.Translated: 加载 MIDI 文件，将音轨分离为乐器，显示演奏模式的实时音符提示，并可通过向焦点游戏窗口发送映射的演奏按键来自动演奏。

Punchline.Original: Synced bard ensemble: accept the invite, get your part, auto-play in time.
Punchline.Translated: 同步的诗人合奏：接受邀请，获取你的声部，按时自动演奏。

Description.Original: Companion plugin for Ombra bard performances. When the host invites the party, an Accept & Sync window pops up: accept to download the song, get your assigned part and instrument, and auto-play perfectly in sync with the host.
Description.Translated: Ombra 诗人演出的配套插件。当主持人邀请队伍时，会弹出 Accept & Sync 窗口：接受后即可下载歌曲，获取分配给你的声部和乐器，并与主持人完美同步地自动演奏。

Punchline.Original:
Nintendo Pro controller for FFXIV
让最终幻想14支持SwitchPro手柄
Punchline.Translated:
Nintendo Pro controller for FFXIV
让最终幻想14支持SwitchPro手柄

Description.Original: 在游戏进程内直接将官方 Pro 手柄输入翻译为 FFXIV 手柄输入，不创建虚拟设备、不隐藏系统手柄。使用 /npro 打开设置。
Description.Translated: 在游戏进程内直接将官方 Pro 手柄输入翻译为 FFXIV 手柄输入，不创建虚拟设备、不隐藏系统手柄。使用 /npro 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Automated FATE grinding — RSR fights, BossMod dodges, vnavmesh walks.
Punchline.Translated: 自动化 FATE 刷取 — RSR 战斗，BossMod 躲避，vnavmesh 寻路。

Description.Original: Standalone rebuild of the Date With Destiny / Fate Tool Kit module from ffxiv-bundleoftweaks. Combat rotation by Rotation Solver Reborn, AoE avoidance and targeting by BossMod (Reborn), pathing by vnavmesh. Requires vnavmesh, BossMod Reborn, Rotation Solver Reborn, and TextAdvance.
Description.Translated: ffxiv-bundleoftweaks 中 Date With Destiny / Fate Tool Kit 模块的独立重制版。战斗循环由 Rotation Solver Reborn 负责，AoE 规避与选目标由 BossMod (Reborn) 负责，寻路由 vnavmesh 负责。需要 vnavmesh、BossMod Reborn、Rotation Solver Reborn 和 TextAdvance。

Punchline.Original: Automated hunt bill orchestration.
Punchline.Translated: 自动化狩猎通缉令编排。

Description.Original: Automates FFXIV hunt bills using Lifestream, vnavmesh, RotationSolverReborn, and optional HuntHelper integration.
Description.Translated: 使用 Lifestream、vnavmesh、RotationSolverReborn 以及可选的 HuntHelper 集成来自动化 FFXIV 狩猎通缉令。

Punchline.Original: Autonomous ordinary monster-drop farming.
Punchline.Translated: 自主普通怪物掉落物刷取。

Description.Original: Create loot lists with target quantities, resolve monster spawns, validate level safety, teleport, mount, navigate, fight, and continue until the list is complete.
Description.Translated: 创建带有目标数量的战利品清单，解析怪物刷新点，验证等级安全性，传送、上坐骑、寻路、战斗，并持续直到清单完成。

Punchline.Original: Automatically updates your gearset portrait when glamour changes.
Punchline.Translated: 幻化变化时自动更新你的套装肖像。

Description.Original: Detects when your character's glamour changes and automatically updates the associated gearset portrait, so you never have to manually re-save it again.
Description.Translated: 检测你的角色幻化何时变化，并自动更新关联的套装肖像，因此你再也无需手动重新保存。

Punchline.Original: Run a Blackjack table in your FFXIV venue.
Punchline.Translated: 在你的 FFXIV 会场经营一张 Blackjack 桌。

Description.Original: Run a blackjack table in your FFXIV venue. Narrates each beat to chat, draws cards from /random rolls, tracks every player's bank, and reconciles the night's gil against your wallet. Type /twentyone to open the table.
Description.Translated: 在你的 FFXIV 会场经营一张 blackjack 桌。向聊天频道播报每一步，通过 /random 掷骰抽牌，追踪每位玩家的资金，并将当晚的 gil 与你钱包对账。输入 /twentyone 打开牌桌。

Punchline.Original: Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button.
Punchline.Translated: 将连击和互斥技能整合到一个按钮上。

Description.Original: 粗制滥造AI翻译
Description.Translated: 粗制滥造AI翻译

Punchline.Original: Auto-travels between worlds and capitals, shouting your message at each stop.
Punchline.Translated: 在世界和主城之间自动旅行，并在每一站喊出你的消息。

Description.Original: Automatically travels world to world via Lifestream and shouts a message at each capital city.
Description.Translated: 通过 Lifestream 自动在世界之间旅行，并在每个主城喊出消息。

Punchline.Original: Your character on Linkshell, updated while you play. Minion count included.
Punchline.Translated: 你在 Linkshell 上的角色，游玩时自动更新。包含宠物数量。

Description.Original:
Reads your own character in game (jobs, gear, collections, achievements, progress) and keeps your linkshell.me profile up to date while you play. Nothing is read or sent until you claim one. Settings has a switch for each thing it reads, and one for all of it.

Glamours: /lss glam shows the plates you have set up. Save one and it goes in your own library on this PC, where you name it, try it on, and wear it again from any character. Send it to Linkshell and it lands as a draft, where you add a picture and publish it. Nothing about your plates is sent unless you send it. The same window puts an outfit into the plate you have open when you ask; the game's own Save is still yours to press.

Five extras, off until you turn them on. Linkshell chat puts your Free Company's Linkshell room in your chat log, tagged, and you answer from our own window or with /lss say; it never reads the game's chat. Mark on map lets your own profile drop a flag on your in-game map. Discord status gives the Discord app on your PC your character, job, zone and profile link. Save Glamour puts an entry on the game's right-click menu that copies what a character is visibly wearing into your library on this PC; it stays there and can never be sent to Linkshell. People you group with tells Linkshell that you and somebody shared a party, as a scrambled pair with no name, no place and no time, forgotten after a week. The last two are the only ones here that involve anybody but you.

To start, mint a claim code on https://linkshell.me and run /lss claim <code> in game.
Description.Translated:
在游戏中读取你自己的角色（职业、装备、收藏、成就、进度），并在你游玩时保持 linkshell.me 个人资料更新。在你认领之前，不会读取或发送任何内容。设置中为它读取的每一项都提供了开关，也有一个总开关。

幻化：/lss glam 会显示你已经设置的幻化模板。保存一个后，它会进入本机上你自己的库，你可以在那里为它命名、试穿，并从任何角色再次穿上它。发送到 Linkshell 后，它会作为草稿保存，你可以在那里添加图片并发布。除非你主动发送，否则不会发送任何关于你幻化模板的内容。当你要求时，同一个窗口会把一套服装放入你当前打开的幻化模板；游戏自带的保存仍需要你自己按下。

五项附加功能，默认关闭，直到你开启它们。Linkshell 聊天会把你部队的 Linkshell 房间放入你的聊天日志，并带有标记，你可以从我们自己的窗口或使用 /lss say 回复；它从不读取游戏内的聊天。在地图上标记让你自己的个人资料在游戏内地图上放置一个标记。Discord 状态会把你的角色、职业、区域和个人资料链接提供给电脑上的 Discord 应用。保存幻化会在游戏的右键菜单中添加一个条目，将某个角色当前可见的穿着复制到本机上你的库中；它会留在那里，且永远无法发送到 Linkshell。与你组队的人会告知 Linkshell 你和某人共享过队伍，以打乱的配对形式，不含名字、地点和时间，一周后遗忘。最后两项是这里唯一涉及你以外其他人的功能。

开始使用时，在 https://linkshell.me 生成一个认领码，并在游戏中运行 /lss claim <code>。

Punchline.Original: Automatically switches ReShade presets based on zone, weather, and time of day.
Punchline.Translated: 根据区域、天气和时间自动切换 ReShade 预设。

Description.Original: Reads the current zone, weather, and time of day and publishes them over a Sharingway IPC channel so a companion ReShade addon can switch presets automatically. Use /pway to open the window, /pway status for a text summary, /pway config for settings.
Description.Translated: 读取当前区域、天气和时间，并通过 Sharingway IPC 通道发布，以便配套的 ReShade 插件自动切换预设。使用 /pway 打开窗口，/pway status 查看文本摘要，/pway config 进行设置。

Punchline.Original: Track FFXIV duties, time, Gil, characters and party members.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪 FFXIV 副本、时间、金币、角色和队员。

Description.Original: Tracks FFXIV duties, time spent, clears, wipes, Gil changes, multiple characters and encountered party/alliance members. Includes persistent local storage and Excel export.
Description.Translated: 追踪 FFXIV 副本、花费时间、通关、团灭、金币变化、多个角色以及遇到的队员/团队队员。包含持久化本地存储和 Excel 导出。

Punchline.Original: Finish your sightseeing log.
Punchline.Translated: 完成你的探索笔记。

Description.Original:
Tourist adds a window to assist with the sightseeing log.

- ! Added vnavmesh features
- Show when sightseeing log vistas are available
- Add markers for ARR vistas
- Open vista locations on your map
- Hide already completed or unavailable vistas
- Show the command needed for each vista

"sightseeing" icon by muhammad, from thenounproject.com CC BY 3.0
Description.Translated:
Tourist 添加一个窗口来辅助探索笔记。

- ! 添加了 vnavmesh 功能
- 显示探索笔记观景点何时可用
- 为 ARR 观景点添加标记
- 在地图上打开观景点位置
- 隐藏已完成或不可用的观景点
- 显示每个观景点所需的命令

“sightseeing”图标由 muhammad 制作，来自 thenounproject.com，CC BY 3.0

Punchline.Original: Keep track of players you meet.
Punchline.Translated: 记录你遇到的玩家。

Description.Original:
PlayerTrack helps you keep a record of who you meet and the content you played together.
Organize players into categories, keep notes, and track them across name/world changes.
Customization options include colors, icons, nameplates, and alerts.
Description.Translated:
PlayerTrack 帮助你记录你遇到的人以及你们一起玩过的内容。
将玩家整理到分类中，保留备注，并在他们改名/转服后继续追踪。
自定义选项包括颜色、图标、名牌和提醒。

Punchline.Original: Orchestrate Critical Engagements on the Bozjan Southern Front and Zadnor
Punchline.Translated: 统筹 Bozjan Southern Front 和 Zadnor 上的 Critical Engagements

Description.Original: Reads live Bozja/Zadnor field-operation state (mettle, resistance rank, Lost Action holster, Critical Engagement phases) and orchestrates vnavmesh for movement, BossMod Reborn for AoE avoidance and Rotation Solver Reborn for rotations. Includes multibox coordination across game clients and Resistance relic progress tracking.
Description.Translated: 读取实时 Bozja/Zadnor 战地行动状态（mettle、resistance rank、Lost Action holster、Critical Engagement phases），并统筹 vnavmesh 进行移动、BossMod Reborn 进行 AoE 回避，以及 Rotation Solver Reborn 进行循环。包含跨游戏客户端的多开协调和 Resistance 遗物进度追踪。

Punchline.Original: Walk onto your target's spot and match the way they're facing.
Punchline.Translated: 走到目标的位置，并匹配其面向。

Description.Original: Walks your character onto the spot a target is standing on, then turns you to face the same way they do. Movement is real: your character walks there under its own power, easing off speed on the final approach so it settles on the mark rather than overshooting it. Supports a target-relative offset, a facing offset, and a continuous follow mode that keeps you on their mark as they move. Built for lining up at close quarters - there is no pathfinding.
Description.Translated: 让你的角色走到目标所站的位置，然后让你转向与他们相同的方向。移动是真实的：你的角色依靠自身力量走过去，并在最后接近时放缓速度，以便停在标记点上而不是冲过头。支持相对于目标的偏移、面向偏移，以及持续跟随模式，在他们移动时让你保持在其标记点上。为近距离对齐而构建——没有寻路。

Punchline.Original: One click to clear vendor-replaceable clutter out of your bags
Punchline.Translated: 一键清理背包中可从商人处回购的杂物

Description.Original: Flags inventory items as junk when they are re-buyable from an NPC vendor under a gil threshold AND are either low-level/untimed gathering node drops or only used in below-max-level crafts. Sells them to any open shop on a single confirmed click, and retrieves matching junk out of your retainers at a summoning bell.
Description.Translated: 当物品可在低于某个 gil 阈值的 NPC 商人处回购，并且要么是低等级/无时限采集节点掉落物，要么只用于低于最高等级的制作时，将背包物品标记为垃圾。在一次确认点击后把它们卖给任何已打开的商店，并在召唤铃处从雇员身上取回匹配的垃圾物品。

Punchline.Original: See what's up in North Horn, then click once to get there.
Punchline.Translated: 看看 North Horn 有什么，一键即可抵达。

Description.Original: Lists the Critical Encounters and FATEs running in Occult Crescent: North Horn and walks you to any of them with a single click, choosing between walking, an aetheryte hop and Occult Return. Also tracks the pot cycle, keeps your knowledge-crystal buffs topped up, and can step around monsters and pick up coffers on the way. Does nothing outside North Horn.
Description.Translated: 列出 Occult Crescent: North Horn 中正在进行的 Critical Encounters 和 FATE，并一键带你前往任意一个，自动在步行、传送至以太之光和 Occult Return 之间选择。还会追踪 pot 循环、维持你的 knowledge crystal 增益，并能在途中绕开怪物、顺路拾取宝箱。在 North Horn 之外不执行任何操作。

Punchline.Original: Build a glamour, share it, and wear anyone else's.
Punchline.Translated: 打造幻化、分享幻化，并穿上任何人的幻化。

Description.Original: Dress your character in any item in the game from a searchable in-game wardrobe, dye every slot, edit full appearance and save named outfits. Then publish the look to a community catalogue you can browse, filter, vote on and favourite without leaving the game - and put anyone else's glamour on with one click, with a revert that is always one click away. No other plugins required.
Description.Translated: 通过游戏内可搜索的衣橱，让角色穿上游戏中的任何物品，为每个部位染色，编辑完整外观并保存命名套装。然后把这套造型发布到社区图鉴，你无需离开游戏即可浏览、筛选、投票和收藏——还能一键穿上别人的幻化，且随时一键还原。无需其他插件。

Punchline.Original: A roleplay profile for your character, readable at a glance.
Punchline.Translated: 为你的角色创建一眼可读的角色扮演档案。

Description.Original: Write a full roleplay profile for your character - name, appearance, backstory, hooks and rumours - and read anyone else's by hovering them. Set statuses that hang under your character for others to read at a glance, and keep private notes on everyone you have met.
Description.Translated: 为你的角色撰写完整的角色扮演档案——姓名、外观、背景故事、剧情钩子和传闻——只需将鼠标悬停在他人身上即可阅读其档案。设置悬挂在角色下方的状态，让他人一眼即可读到，并为每个见过的人保存私人笔记。

Punchline.Original: Auto-press a keyboard key a set number of times, or forever.
Punchline.Translated: 自动按下键盘按键指定次数，或无限次。

Description.Original: A simple auto-presser. Add one or more keys, each set to tap repeatedly (N times or unlimited, at a delay you choose) or hold down (timed or until stopped) - they all run at once, so you can e.g. hold one key while tapping another. Sends keys to FFXIV only and keeps working while tabbed out. Open with /autoclick.
Description.Translated: 一个简单的自动按键工具。添加一个或多个按键，每个都可设为重复点按（N 次或无限次，延迟自定）或按住不放（定时或直到停止）——它们会同时运行，因此你可以一边按住某个键一边点按另一个键。仅向 FFXIV 发送按键，切出窗口后仍可继续工作。使用 /autoclick 打开。

Punchline.Original: Right-click any item to copy its cross-DC undercut price.
Punchline.Translated: 右键任意物品即可复制其跨大区压价价格。

Description.Original: Right-click a marketable item in your inventory and pick "Undercut price (copy)" to query Universalis across your world, data center, or entire region, and copy the lowest-minus-1 gil price straight to your clipboard. "Load in Undercutter" opens a window with the full listing breakdown. A /undercut window is also available for manual lookups.
Description.Translated: 在背包中右键可出售的物品，选择 “Undercut price (copy)”，即可查询 Universalis 上你的服务器、大区或整个区域的数据，并把最低价减 1 的金币价格直接复制到剪贴板。“Load in Undercutter” 会打开一个窗口，显示完整的挂单明细。也可通过 /undercut 窗口手动查询。

Punchline.Original: Unite. Learn. Mimic.
Punchline.Translated: 联合。学习。模仿。

Description.Original: Compares learned Blue Mage spells across a party, shows where to find missing ones, and helps plan what to learn next together - multilingual (DE/EN/FR/JA), syncs via export/import codes, no gameplay automation.
Description.Translated: 对比队伍中已学会的 Blue Mage 法术，显示缺失法术的获取位置，并帮助一起规划接下来要学习的内容 - 支持多语言（DE/EN/FR/JA），通过导出/导入代码同步，无游戏自动化。

Punchline.Original: A quest arrow that knows the way: teleports, doors and aethernet included — plus an unlock checklist.
Punchline.Translated: 一个认路的任务箭头：包含传送、门和以太之光网络——外加解锁清单。

Description.Original: Guides you to your quest objective with an on-screen arrow that understands teleports, building entrances and city aethernet routing. Tracks every quest-unlockable feature, mount and dungeon you can pick up right now, and routes you to the quest givers.
Description.Translated: 通过屏幕上的箭头引导你前往任务目标，该箭头能处理传送、建筑入口和城市以太之光路线。追踪所有当前可通过任务解锁的功能、坐骑和副本，并为你规划前往任务发布者的路线。

Description.Original: Farms FATEs for you: tick the zones, and the plugin teleports in, finds active FATEs, and runs them in a loop, with Lifestream support for instance, world, and local crystal navigation.
Description.Translated: 为你刷 FATE：勾选区域后，插件会自动传送过去，寻找进行中的 FATE 并循环完成，支持 Lifestream 进行副本、服务器和本地水晶导航。

Punchline.Original: The official mechanic simulator of UMADcorp. Go to an inn and start practice. No, seriously, go do it!
Punchline.Translated: UMADcorp 官方机制模拟器。去旅馆开始练习。不，说真的，去做吧！

Description.Original: Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics using the official UMADcorp approved strats.
Description.Translated: 在客户端生成虚假的队伍成员和首领，让你可以用 UMADcorp 官方认可的战术练习副本机制。

Punchline.Original: Apply an imported FFXIV materia plan to your equipped gear.
Punchline.Translated: 将导入的 FFXIV 魔晶石方案应用到已装备的装备上。

Description.Original: Imports xivgear exports, validates slot plans, and provides a one-click meld workflow.
Description.Translated: 导入 xivgear 导出数据，校验镶嵌槽方案，并提供一键镶嵌流程。

Punchline.Original: Every plugin. One orbit.
