Punchline.Translated: 所有插件。一个轨道。

Description.Original: Unified storefront for official and community Dalamud plugins. Browse, compare sources, review findings, install, update, and manage your library.
Description.Translated: 统一商店，汇集官方与社区 Dalamud 插件。浏览、比较来源、查看审核结果、安装、更新并管理你的插件库。

Punchline.Original: Party game helpers for FFXIV hosts, starting with blackjack.
Punchline.Translated: 面向 FFXIV 主持人的派对游戏助手，从 21 点开始。

Description.Original: GamesNook is a growing toolbox for FFXIV party hosts. It currently features a full blackjack table, with bingo, truth or dare, and more on the way. Use /gnook to open the window.
Description.Translated: GamesNook 是面向 FFXIV 派对主持人的不断扩展的工具箱。目前包含完整的 21 点牌桌，宾果、真心话大冒险等更多内容即将推出。使用 /gnook 打开窗口。

Punchline.Original: Select inventory gear and safely queue pentamelds.
Punchline.Translated: 选择背包中的装备并安全排队五重镶嵌。

Description.Original: Inventory picker and guarded pentameld queue. Defaults to Critical Hit > Direct Hit > Determination with strict no-overcap behavior.
Description.Translated: 背包选择器与受保护的五重镶嵌队列。默认优先级为暴击 > 直击 > 信念，并严格避免属性溢出。

Punchline.Original: A fully custom, tab-based replacement for the in-game chat window.
Punchline.Translated: 完全自定义、基于标签页的游戏内聊天窗口替代品。

Description.Original: Replaces the default FFXIV chat log with a custom ImGui interface: unlimited freely-configurable tabs (any mix of channels), any tab can be popped out into its own floating window, whispers get their own per-partner tab or window, clickable links, BTTV/7TV emote rendering, AI-assisted replies/rephrasing (optional Gemini key), auto-reply, and disk-backed history capped at 1 GiB. Not affiliated with Square Enix, Twitch, BetterTTV, 7TV or Google.
Description.Translated: 用自定义 ImGui 界面替代 FFXIV 默认聊天记录：无限量、可自由配置的标签页（任意频道组合），任意标签页都可弹出为独立浮动窗口，悄悄话会为每位对话对象生成单独的标签页或窗口，链接可点击，支持 BTTV/7TV 表情渲染，AI 辅助回复/改写（可选 Gemini 密钥），自动回复，以及上限为 1 GiB 的磁盘存储历史记录。与 Square Enix、Twitch、BetterTTV、7TV 或 Google 无关联。

Punchline.Original: One-click repeat leve delivery (Deliver All).
Punchline.Translated: 一键重复理符交纳（Deliver All）。

Description.Original: Automates repeat levequest delivery: accept a leve, turn it in, repeat until leve allowances run out — with one click. Pairs with Pandora's Box 'Auto-select Turn-ins' when installed, and falls back to its own built-in slot filler otherwise. No navigation: you stand at the levemete and delivery NPC.
Description.Translated: 自动化重复交纳理符任务：接受理符，交纳，重复，直到理符限额耗尽——只需一键。安装 Pandora's Box 后，可与其“Auto-select Turn-ins”搭配使用；否则回退到自身内置的槽位填充。无导航：你需站在理符发行员和交纳 NPC 处。

Punchline.Original: Runs the Main Scenario unattended — and remembers where it stopped.
Punchline.Translated: 无人值守运行主线剧情——并记住它停在哪里。

Description.Original: Automated Main Scenario questing. Walks each quest from accept to complete, travels between zones, resolves dialogue, and hands solo instances to BossMod Reborn and dungeons to Theseus. Progress is read back from the game's own quest state, so a crash, logout or reload resumes exactly where it stopped. Every character quests independently; a fleet dashboard shows where each one is. Companion to Daedalus and Theseus.
Description.Translated: 自动完成主线任务。从接取到完成逐步推进每个任务，在区域间移动，处理对话，并将单人副本交给 BossMod Reborn、将副本交给 Theseus。进度从游戏自身的任务状态中读取，因此崩溃、登出或重载后都能从停止处精确继续。每个角色独立做任务；一个队列仪表盘会显示每个角色的所在位置。Daedalus 与 Theseus 的配套插件。

Punchline.Original: Render words between Common and Vieran.
Punchline.Translated: 在 Common 与 Vieran 之间转换文字。

Description.Original: A focused roleplay translation tool for Common and Vieran, with optional local detection of Vieran in Say and custom emotes. Open it with /woodword. Woodword never changes or posts chat.
Description.Translated: 专注于 Common 与 Vieran 的角色扮演翻译工具，可选在 Say 和自定义情感动作中本地检测 Vieran。使用 /woodword 打开。Woodword 绝不修改或发送聊天内容。

Punchline.Original: Zeigt woher Glams und Mounts kommen.
Punchline.Translated: 显示幻化与坐骑的来源。

Description.Original: Hover über ein Item oder Mount und sieh sofort die Quelle — Dungeon, Shop, Craft, Event. Kein Wiki mehr nötig. Befehle: /glamsource
Description.Translated: 将鼠标悬停在物品或坐骑上，即可立刻看到来源——副本、商店、制作、活动。不再需要 Wiki。命令：/glamsource

Punchline.Original: Save an examined character's glamour to Discord with one explicit click.
Punchline.Translated: 通过一次明确点击，将查看角色的幻化保存到 Discord。

Description.Original: Adds a SendDiscord button beside the Examine window. Only when pressed, it posts a cropped image, target character name, appearance item names, and Eorzea Database search links to the configured Discord Webhook. The UI supports English and Japanese.
Description.Translated: 在 Examine 窗口旁添加一个 SendDiscord 按钮。仅在按下时，才将裁剪后的图片、目标角色名、外观物品名称以及 Eorzea Database 搜索链接发送到已配置的 Discord Webhook。界面支持英语和日语。

Punchline.Original: Manage characters, jobs, playtime, Lodestone profiles, and configuration folders.
Punchline.Translated: 管理角色、职业、游戏时长、Lodestone 资料与配置文件夹。

Description.Original: Stores logged-in character details, jobs, playtime, Lodestone IDs, and configuration-folder mappings locally, then presents them in a searchable UI and CSV export. Optional external lookup and login-time playtime acquisition require explicit settings.
Description.Translated: 在本地存储已登录角色的详情、职业、游戏时长、Lodestone ID 以及配置文件夹映射，并在可搜索的 UI 和 CSV 导出中呈现。可选的外部查询与登录时获取游戏时长需要显式设置。

Punchline.Original: Visualize and unlock Aether Currents across every expansion.
Punchline.Translated: 可视化并解锁所有资料片的以太 currents。

Description.Original: Shows field Aether Current and quest progress by expansion and area. It can process the current area or a selected expansion, using vnavmesh for field travel and Questionable for quests. Includes a map view, individual actions, route recalculation, and English/Japanese UI.
Description.Translated: 按资料片和区域显示野外以太 currents 与任务进度。可处理当前区域或选定资料片，使用 vnavmesh 进行野外移动，使用 Questionable 完成任务。包含地图视图、单项操作、路线重算，以及英文/日文界面。

Punchline.Original: Item and action names in several languages at once.
Punchline.Translated: 同时以多种语言显示物品和技能名称。

Description.Original:
Adds the item and action name in the languages you pick to the game's own tooltips and cast bars, read from the client's own data.

DM @mtvirux on discord for assistance or bug reports.
Description.Translated:
将你选择的语言的物品和技能名称添加到游戏自带的提示框和施法条中，数据读取自客户端自身数据。

如需帮助或报告 bug，请在 Discord 上私信 @mtvirux。

Punchline.Original: PlayerSync first; Lightless only as fallback.
Punchline.Translated: 优先 PlayerSync；仅在回退时使用 Lightless。

Description.Original: PlayerSync-first ownership with verified active-overlap diagnostics. /syncbridge
Description.Translated: 以 PlayerSync 为优先的归属判定，并带有经验证的活动重叠诊断。/syncbridge

Punchline.Original: Add damage type, source, and calculated mitigation to native flytext.
Punchline.Translated: 为原生浮动战斗文字添加伤害类型、来源和计算后的减伤。

Description.Original: GPL-3.0 Damage Info derivative that annotates local incoming damage with calculated active mitigation.
Description.Translated: GPL-3.0 Damage Info 衍生插件，为本地受到的伤害标注计算后的当前减伤。

Punchline.Original: Removes skill-name labels from floating combat text, with an optional speed slider.
Punchline.Translated: 移除浮动战斗文字中的技能名称标签，并带有可选速度滑块。

Description.Original: Removes the skill/ability name label from floating combat text, leaving only the number, color, size, and crit/direct-hit bounce animation. Also adds an optional speed slider (/plainflytext) that slows or speeds up native flytext's animation - lower makes numbers linger and float up more slowly.
Description.Translated: 移除浮动战斗文字中的技能/能力名称标签，仅保留数字、颜色、大小和暴击/直击弹跳动画。还添加可选速度滑块（/plainflytext），可减慢或加快原生浮动战斗文字的动画——数值越低，数字停留越久、上浮越慢。

Punchline.Original: Shows which emotes your mods change, and plays them.
Punchline.Translated: 显示你的模组修改了哪些表情动作，并播放它们。

Description.Original: Lists emotes, dances and idle poses altered by Penumbra mods, plays them with one click and lets you pin favourites. Idle poses can be picked directly instead of cycling through them. Requires Penumbra.
Description.Translated: 列出被 Penumbra 模组修改的表情、舞蹈和待机姿势，一键播放并可将喜爱的动作固定。待机姿势可直接选择，无需循环切换。需要 Penumbra。

Punchline.Original: Your glamour, Glamourer and Penumbra outfit workspace.
Punchline.Translated: 你的幻化、Glamourer 与 Penumbra 服装工作区。

Description.Original: Use your character as the viewer for a live complete-look dresser, reuse Glamourer designs, keep a local wardrobe, manage equipment-affecting Penumbra mods, and cache openly attributed public glamour recipes from supported sources.
Description.Translated: 以你的角色为预览对象，提供实时整体造型换装器，可复用 Glamourer 设计，保存本地衣柜，管理影响装备的 Penumbra 模组，并缓存来自支持来源、公开署名的公共幻化配方。

Punchline.Original: Sort your inventory across retainers automatically.
Punchline.Translated: 自动在你的雇员之间整理背包。

Description.Original: Assign item categories to retainers, choose a priority order, protect items with Never Deposit, preview assignments, and automatically sort matching inventory stacks from a nearby Summoning Bell.
Description.Translated: 为雇员分配物品类别，设定优先级顺序，用“永不存入”保护物品，预览分配结果，并在附近的召唤铃处自动整理匹配的背包堆叠。

Punchline.Original: Know what to sell, buy, craft, gather — and what to do next.
Punchline.Translated: 了解该卖什么、买什么、制作什么、采集什么——以及下一步做什么。

Description.Original: FFXIV economy decision support for Dalamud. Ranks selling, buying, crafting and gathering opportunities using Universalis, inventory/Market Board observations, vendor economics and your own trading history. Includes native item-tooltip insights, inventory right-click lookups, unified Opportunities, cashflow/FIFO analytics and personal sales/listing history. No automated buying, selling, repricing or queued native Market Board scanning. The plugin icon was created with AI assistance.
Description.Translated: 面向 Dalamud 的 FFXIV 经济决策支持。利用 Universalis、背包/市场布告板观察、商店经济和你自己的交易历史，对出售、购买、制作和采集机会进行排名。包含原生物品提示信息、背包右键查询、统一机会列表、现金流/FIFO 分析以及个人销售/上架历史。不会自动购买、出售、改价或排队扫描原生市场布告板。插件图标由 AI 协助创作。

Punchline.Original: Send Penumbra model files to Blender and back with a single click.
Punchline.Translated: 一键将 Penumbra 模型文件发送到 Blender 并传回。

Description.Original: Enables easy importing of Penumbra model files in Blender and exporting them back to the game with just a single click. Provides various utilities and settings to make mod creation and editing easier and faster.
Description.Translated: 可轻松在 Blender 中导入 Penumbra 模型文件，并只需一键即可将其导出回游戏。提供多种实用工具和设置，让模组创作与编辑更轻松快捷。

Punchline.Original: Assistant Logos bilingue FR/EN pour Eureka, consultable partout.
Punchline.Translated: Eureka 的 FR/EN 双语 Logos 助手，随处可查看。

Description.Original: Conserve les fonctions originales de Logogram Helper, ajoute /logo, mémorise le dernier stock de logogrammes, indique de quel éclat vient chaque logogramme et permet de basculer toute l'interface entre français et anglais.
Description.Translated: 保留 Logogram Helper 的原有功能，添加 /logo，记住上一次的文理库存，标明每个文理来自哪种碎片，并允许整个界面在法语和英语之间切换。

Punchline.Original: Undercut automatique des ventes de servant.
Punchline.Translated: 自动压低雇员售卖价格。

Description.Original: Automatise le repricing des ventes d'un servant avec les données live du Market Board, en respectant HQ/NQ, les propres servants et le délai configuré.
Description.Translated: 使用 Market Board 实时数据自动重新定价雇员的售卖物品，同时考虑 HQ/NQ、自己的雇员以及配置的延迟。

Punchline.Original: Indique clairement la direction regardée par un mob.
Punchline.Translated: 清晰指示怪物面朝的方向。

Description.Original: Affiche une flèche 3D configurable au-dessus d'un mob sélectionné et continue de le suivre lorsque la cible du joueur change.
Description.Translated: 在选中的怪物上方显示可配置的 3D 箭头，并在玩家目标改变时继续跟随它。

Punchline.Original: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Punchline.Translated: 播放曲目，让队伍同步加入。

Description.Original: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Description.Translated: 一个交互式 DJ 台，带有实时混音工具、自定义播放列表，以及带音频可视化的同步听众模式。

Punchline.Original: Simulate your rotation, then see how your real kills measure up.
Punchline.Translated: 模拟你的循环，然后看看你的实际击杀表现如何。

Description.Original: Simulates a full-length fight for your job using your own gear or a best-in-slot preset, then reports the DPS and shows exactly where it came from. Compares gear, melds and consumables, checks your openers and burst windows, and analyses an FFLogs report against the simulated ceiling. Kills on supported encounters can be scored and submitted to per-job leaderboards.
Description.Translated: 使用你自己的装备或最佳配装预设，为你的职业模拟一场完整长度的战斗，然后报告 DPS 并准确显示其来源。比较装备、魔晶石镶嵌和消耗品，检查你的起手和爆发窗口，并根据模拟上限分析 FFLogs 报告。受支持遭遇战中的击杀可以被评分并提交到各职业排行榜。

Punchline.Original: ペットを指定座標へ移動させる
Punchline.Translated: 将宠物移动到指定坐标

Description.Original: 自分の召喚獣・フェアリーに「移動」を出して、指定した座標へ歩かせます。/petmove x y z、here、target、follow、list、cursor。
Description.Translated: 对自己的召唤兽/妖精下达“移动”指令，使其走向指定坐标。/petmove x y z、here、target、follow、list、cursor。

Punchline.Original: Zeigt die ausgelosten Jobs und den Live-Jobstatus deiner Party.
Punchline.Translated: 显示队伍中抽到的职业以及实时职业状态。

Description.Original: Verbindet sich über deine PlayerID mit Funny Duty Roulette, zeigt alle Job-Zuweisungen der aktuellen Session und prüft live, ob die Party bereits auf diese Jobs gewechselt ist.
Description.Translated: 通过你的 PlayerID 连接到 Funny Duty Roulette，显示当前会话的所有职业分配，并实时检查队伍是否已切换到这些职业。

Punchline.Original: 戦闘系プラグインの設定を一括管理。JOB・ロール・プリセット切替に対応。
Punchline.Translated: 统一管理战斗类插件的设置。支持按职业、职能、预设切换。

Description.Original: BossMod / BossMod Reborn / Rotation Solver Reborn / Wrath Combo の主要戦闘設定をまとめて確認・変更し、JOB・ロール・名前付きプリセットとして保存できます。
Description.Translated: 集中查看和修改 BossMod / BossMod Reborn / Rotation Solver Reborn / Wrath Combo 的主要战斗设置，并可保存为职业、职能或命名预设。

Punchline.Original: A DPS meter that shows what you are doing right now.
Punchline.Translated: 显示你当前正在做什么的 DPS 计量器。

Description.Original: Shows the damage you are actually dealing, averaged over a rolling time window instead of the whole fight, and keeps encounters together across cutscenes and downtime. Requires IINACT.
Description.Translated: 显示你实际造成的伤害，按滚动时间窗口平均而非整场战斗，并在过场动画和停战期间保持战斗记录连续。需要 IINACT。

Punchline.Original: Counts what others do to you and shows it above your head.
Punchline.Translated: 统计他人对你的互动并显示在头顶。

Description.Original: Counts emotes and chat messages directed at you and briefly displays the tally as your title. Rules define which emotes, which trigger words and which channels count, what the message says and in which colours. Requires Honorific. Counts are stored locally and never leave your machine.
Description.Translated: 统计针对你的情感动作和聊天消息，并短暂将计数作为你的称号显示。规则可定义哪些情感动作、哪些触发词和哪些频道计入、消息内容以及颜色。需要 Honorific。计数保存在本地，绝不会离开你的电脑。

Punchline.Original: INZONE Budsの左右・ケース残量をゲーム内に表示します。
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内显示 INZONE Buds 左右耳机与充电盒的剩余电量。

Description.Original: Sony INZONE Buds（WF-G700N）のUSBトランシッターからバッテリー残量を取得し、オーバーレイとDTRバーへ表示します。
Description.Translated: 从 Sony INZONE Buds（WF-G700N）的 USB 收发器获取电池余量，并显示在悬浮窗与 DTR 栏中。

Punchline.Original: Browse and install mods from the comfort of your FFXIV house
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 的家中舒适地浏览并安装 mod

Description.Original: Browse xivmodarchive.com from inside the game and install mods into Penumbra in one click. Fork of Noevain/ModArchiveBrowser, updated for Dalamud API 15.
Description.Translated: 在游戏内浏览 xivmodarchive.com，并一键将 mod 安装到 Penumbra。Noevain/ModArchiveBrowser 的分支，已更新至 Dalamud API 15。

Punchline.Original: Watch together without making FFXIV download or launch media tools.
Punchline.Translated: 无需让 FFXIV 下载或启动媒体工具即可一起观看。

Description.Original: Safety-focused in-game media playback with an independent companion for prebuffered public media.
Description.Translated: 注重安全性的游戏内媒体播放，配有独立伴生程序用于预缓冲公共媒体。

Punchline.Original: Custom nameplate titles with colours and animated effects.
Punchline.Translated: 带有颜色与动画效果的自定义名牌称号。

Description.Original: Create your own nameplate titles, save them into a personal list, and dress them up with full RGB colours, glow, and animated effects such as rainbow waves, fades, pulses, typewriter, glitch and more. Inspired by Honorific.
Description.Translated: 创建你自己的名牌称号，保存到个人列表中，并用完整 RGB 颜色、发光以及彩虹波、淡入淡出、脉冲、打字机、故障等动画效果加以装饰。灵感来自 Honorific。

Punchline.Original: Browse and preview all game items on your character.
Punchline.Translated: 浏览所有游戏物品并在你的角色上预览。

Description.Original: Every equippable item in the game, in a categorized grid with icons. Hover to preview, apply to your character to see how it looks, and manage or remove what you are wearing.
Description.Translated: 游戏中所有可装备物品，以带图标的分类网格呈现。悬停即可预览，应用到角色上查看效果，并可管理或移除你正在穿戴的物品。

Punchline.Original: Your friends are worth it.
Punchline.Translated: 你的朋友值得。

Description.Original: An improved, responsive, and feature-rich friend list for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description.Translated: 为 Final Fantasy XIV 打造的改进版、响应迅速且功能丰富的好友列表。

Punchline.Original: Empower your RP with dynamic emotes and infinite custom hotbars.
Punchline.Translated: 用动态情感动作和无限自定义热键栏强化你的 RP。

Description.Original: An advanced emote manager and RP hotbar suite for Final Fantasy XIV. Features dynamic emote tracking based on active Penumbra mods, unlock source lookups, custom tagging/grouping, and responsive floating hotbars.
Description.Translated: 为 Final Fantasy XIV 打造的高级情感动作管理器与 RP 热键栏套件。具备基于已启用 Penumbra 模组的动态情感动作追踪、解锁来源查询、自定义标签/分组，以及响应式浮动热键栏。

Punchline.Original: Recommended Gear across everything you own.
Punchline.Translated: 在你拥有的所有地方推荐装备。

Description.Original: Find recommended gear across your inventory, Armoury Chest, chocobo saddlebag, retainers, glamour dresser and armoire, then build a persistent retrieve-to-equip checklist.
Description.Translated: 在背包、兵装库、陆行鸟鞍囊、雇员、幻化柜和收藏柜中查找推荐装备，然后生成一份可持续保存的取出并装备清单。

Punchline.Original: Call anything in any loaded plugin, directly.
Punchline.Translated: 直接调用任何已加载插件中的任何内容。

Description.Original: Resolves live plugin instances through Dalamud's plugin manager and invokes their internals by reflection, bypassing IPC surfaces and their gates. Includes a task engine for sequencing multi-step automation across plugins, SND-compatible event triggers, and a file bridge for driving a client from outside the game.
Description.Translated: 通过 Dalamud 的插件管理器解析活动插件实例，并以反射调用其内部实现，绕过 IPC 接口及其限制。包含用于跨插件编排多步骤自动化的任务引擎、兼容 SND 的事件触发器，以及用于从游戏外驱动客户端的文件桥接。

Punchline.Original: A screen in the world, showing whatever is live.
Punchline.Translated: 世界中的一块屏幕，播放任何直播内容。

Description.Original: Puts a live stream on a screen anchored in the world: place it on a wall, size it, and watch while you play. Plays Twitch, YouTube, Plex, direct streams and thousands of live TV channels, painted onto a real in-game surface so the game lights and occludes it properly. Party groups let a room watch the same thing together from a six-character code.
Description.Translated: 将直播流放到一个锚定在世界中的屏幕上：把它放在墙上、调整大小，边玩边看。可播放 Twitch、YouTube、Plex、直链直播流以及数千个直播电视频道，并渲染到真实的游戏内表面上，因此游戏光照和遮挡会正确作用于它。小队组可通过六位字符代码让一屋子人一起观看同一内容。

Punchline.Original: Google Translate, but for dragonspeak.
Punchline.Translated: Google Translate，但用于龙语。

Description.Original: A scratchpad translator for the FFXIV dragon tongue. Type English, get dragonspeak with proper Verb-Object-Subject grammar, and copy it out in one click. Translates both directions, and ships the full 'A Lesson in Dragonspeak' text plus the canon dictionary as an in-game reader.
Description.Translated: 用于 FFXIV 龙语的草稿本翻译器。输入英语，获得符合正确动词-宾语-主语语法的龙语，并可一键复制。支持双向翻译，并附带完整的 'A Lesson in Dragonspeak' 文本以及官方词典作为游戏内阅读器。

Punchline.Original: Log-trigger rules with tags, commands, waits, and Lua. EN/JA UI.
Punchline.Translated: 带有标签、命令、等待和 Lua 的日志触发规则。支持英文/日文界面。

Description.Original: All collected logs are evaluated against every enabled rule. Rules are organized with tags. Flow steps are Wait, Command, and Lua. UI language follows Dalamud, or can be switched between English and Japanese in Settings.
Description.Translated: 所有收集到的日志都会与每个启用的规则进行匹配。规则通过标签进行组织。流程步骤包括等待、命令和 Lua。界面语言跟随 Dalamud，或可在设置中切换英文和日文。

Punchline.Original: Retrieve materia and meld from an exdreams share URL.
Punchline.Translated: 从 exdreams 分享链接中获取魔晶石并镶嵌。

Description.Original: CTRL+Right-click retrieves materia once (auto-accepts the confirm dialog). /mex parses an exdreams gear share URL for inventory check, dry-run, and auto-meld.
Description.Translated: CTRL+右键单击获取一次魔晶石（自动接受确认对话框）。/mex 解析 exdreams 装备分享链接，用于库存检查、试运行和自动镶嵌。

Punchline.Original: Mortal / Akochan suggestions and auto-play. Mortal installs on first launch.
Punchline.Translated: Mortal / Akochan 建议和自动打牌。Mortal 在首次启动时安装。

Description.Original: Reads Doman Mahjong and uses Mortal or Akochan for discard, riichi, pass, chi, pon, kan, ron, and tsumo. Mortal is installed automatically on first launch. Akochan can run in realtime or precision mode.
Description.Translated: 读取 Doman Mahjong，并使用 Mortal 或 Akochan 进行舍牌、立直、过、吃、碰、杠、荣和和自摸。Mortal 在首次启动时自动安装。Akochan 可以在实时或精确模式下运行。

Name.Translated: 多玛方城战求解器调试

Punchline.Original: Withdraw missing recipe materials from each retainer.
Punchline.Translated: 从每个雇员处取出缺少的配方材料。

Description.Original: Reads the open crafting recipe and withdraws missing materials from each retainer. SND is not required. Allagan Tools is optional for stock lookup.
Description.Translated: 读取打开的制作配方，并从每个雇员处取出缺少的材料。不需要 SND。Allagan Tools 可选，用于库存查询。

Punchline.Original: Buys a shopping list off the market board.
Punchline.Translated: 从市场板购买购物清单。

Description.Original: Works a list of items, quantities and per-item price ceilings against the market board, buying the cheapest acceptable listings for you. Walks to a board, searches, and buys with human-variable timing. Exposes a Dalamud IPC API so other plugins can submit buy orders and read back what was purchased and at what price.
Description.Translated: 根据一份包含物品、数量和每件价格上限的清单在市场板上进行操作，为你购买最便宜的合格挂单。走向市场板，搜索，并以类人可变的时间间隔购买。公开一个 Dalamud IPC API，以便其他插件可以提交购买订单并读回购买了哪些物品以及以什么价格购买。

Punchline.Original: Jump/Emote Block (JEBlock) compliments Gagspeak. Lock your partner into an emote without forcing HARDCORE mode.
Punchline.Translated: Jump/Emote Block (JEBlock) 是 Gagspeak 的补充。无需强制 HARDCORE 模式即可将你的搭档锁定在表情动作中。

Description.Original: When using Triggers or Puppeteer for emotes, your partner may escape by tapping jump or performing a new /emote. This plugin blocks those requests if a user configured 'Loci' effect is detected.
Description.Translated: 当使用 Triggers 或 Puppeteer 进行表情动作时，你的搭档可能会通过点击跳跃或执行新的 /emote 来逃脱。如果检测到用户配置的 'Loci' 效果，此插件会阻止这些请求。

Punchline.Original: Turns your combat actions into a chest-scaling mini-game.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的战斗动作变成胸部缩放迷你游戏。

Description.Original: Drives Customize+ chest scale from your choice of source: a Food Buff timer, Mana percentage, or an in-combat Job Actions mode built around GCD usage, tracked job abilities, jumping, and damage taken. Displayed as an animated baby-bottle HUD gauge with configurable fill zones, a pause toggle, and an optional high-scale threshold effect (vignette, glow, heartbeat sound). Fully configurable in-game via a settings window. Requires Customize+. Local only: nobody else sees it.
Description.Translated: 通过你选择的来源驱动 Customize+ 胸部缩放：食物 Buff 计时器、法力百分比，或围绕 GCD 使用、追踪的职业能力、跳跃和受到伤害构建的战斗中职业动作模式。显示为动画奶瓶 HUD 计量条，可配置填充区域、暂停开关，以及可选的高缩放阈值效果（暗角、发光、心跳声）。可通过设置窗口在游戏内完全配置。需要 Customize+。仅本地：其他人看不到。

Punchline.Original: A clickable list of nearby targetable players.
Punchline.Translated: 附近可选中玩家的可点击列表。

Description.Original: Shows a compact, clickable list of player characters you can actually target, so you can heal or raise people in The Hunt, Diadem, Eureka, Bozja and the Occult Crescent without fighting the mouse.
Description.Translated: 显示一个紧凑、可点击的你实际可以选中的玩家角色列表，这样你就能在 The Hunt、Diadem、Eureka、Bozja 和 Occult Crescent 中治疗或复活他人，而无需与鼠标搏斗。

Punchline.Original: A one click menu for your installed plugins.
Punchline.Translated: 已安装插件的一键菜单。

Description.Original: Adds a small floating button that opens a searchable, scrollable list of every installed and enabled plugin, each with its Open and Settings windows one click away. Plugins can be hidden from the list and brought back later.
Description.Translated: 添加一个小型浮动按钮，打开可搜索、可滚动的已安装并启用插件列表，每个插件的打开和设置窗口都只需点击一次。插件可以从列表中隐藏，之后可以恢复。

Punchline.Original: Mods are like onions, they have layers!
Punchline.Translated: 模组就像洋葱，它们有层！

Description.Original: Install skin mods as layers and not as skin replacements. Designed to work across female bodies, works with OMP files and Proteus mods.
Description.Translated: 以图层方式安装皮肤模组，而不是作为皮肤替换。设计为可跨女性身体模型工作，支持 OMP 文件和 Proteus 模组。

Punchline.Original: Poses are like onions--- err wrong notebook
Punchline.Translated: 姿势就像洋葱——呃，拿错笔记本了

Description.Original: Turn your current pose into an idle pose with a single click in no time.
Description.Translated: 只需单击一下，即可将你当前的姿势立即转换为待机姿势。

Punchline.Original: Your chest tracks your mana bar.
Punchline.Translated: 你的胸部会跟随法力条变化。

Description.Original: Drives the breast bones from how much mana you have left, through Customize+. Full at 100%, smaller as you spend - or the other way round. Your own Customize+ profile is read and carried along, so nothing else you have scaled is lost while it runs. Requires Customize+. Local only: nobody else sees it.
Description.Translated: 通过 Customize+ 根据你剩余的法力值驱动胸部骨骼。100% 时最大，消耗后变小——或者反过来。会读取并沿用你自己的 Customize+ 配置，因此运行时你缩放过的其他内容不会丢失。需要 Customize+。仅本地生效：其他玩家看不到。

Punchline.Original: Transform your minions into familiar NPCs.
Punchline.Translated: 把你的宠物变成熟悉的 NPC。

Description.Original:
Replaces selected minions with NPCs.
Command: /minionmirage
Description.Translated:
将选定的宠物替换为 NPC。
命令：/minionmirage

Punchline.Original: Capture inspected glamours and keep a searchable Glamour Library.
Punchline.Translated: 记录查看过的幻化，并维护可搜索的幻化库。

Description.Original: Capture inspected character glamours into a searchable local Library with previews, gear and dye recipes, ownership tracking, personal previews, and sharing tools.
Description.Translated: 将查看过的角色幻化记录到可搜索的本地库中，包含预览、装备与染剂配方、持有情况追踪、个人预览和分享工具。

Punchline.Original: Removes the sun while you're indoors.
Punchline.Translated: 你在室内时移除太阳。

Description.Original: Gets rid of the void sun — the sun that shines through the walls while you are inside a housing interior. Everything is back to normal the moment you step outside.
Description.Translated: 消除虚空太阳——当你处于房屋内部时透过墙壁照射进来的太阳。你一走到室外，一切就恢复正常。

Punchline.Original: Two buttons. Your whole DPS rotation. You still throw the punches.
Punchline.Translated: 两个按钮。你的整套 DPS 循环。你仍然亲手出拳。

Description.Original:
Collapses each supported job into a single-target button and an AoE button. The button shows the action that is correct right now given your cooldowns, gauge, buffs, target count and whether you are moving. It never presses anything for you: one keypress is always exactly one action.

Built for players who cannot sustain a full hotbar - limited hand mobility, chronic pain, tremor, fatigue, one-handed play - who want to keep playing themselves rather than hand the fight to an automation plugin.
Description.Translated:
将每个受支持职业压缩为一个单体按钮和一个 AoE 按钮。该按钮会根据你的冷却、量谱、增益、目标数量以及你是否在移动，显示当前正确的技能。它永远不会替你按键：一次按键始终恰好对应一个技能。

专为无法持续操作完整热键栏的玩家打造——手部活动受限、慢性疼痛、震颤、疲劳、单手游玩——他们希望继续自己玩，而不是把战斗交给自动化插件。

Punchline.Original: Build, share and call raid strategies without leaving the game.
Punchline.Translated: 无需离开游戏即可构建、分享并指挥团队副本策略。

Description.Original: Build, share and call raid strategies without leaving the game. Slide-based arena diagrams, per-player cooldown assignments, and shotcall reminders anchored to real boss casts or to timings the plugin learns from your own pulls.
Description.Translated: 无需离开游戏即可构建、分享并指挥团队副本策略。基于幻灯片的场地示意图、按玩家分配的冷却安排，以及锚定到真实 Boss 读条或插件从你自己的尝试中学习到的时机的指挥提醒。

Punchline.Original: Posing, lighting and whole-scene staging for group pose. Beta.
Punchline.Translated: 为 group pose 提供姿势、灯光和整场布置。Beta。

Description.Original:
Poser is a posing and scene tool for FINAL FANTASY XIV's group pose.

- Pose actors bone by bone: overlay handles, a graphical body map, and numeric transforms
- IK on any bone with a parent, plus mirror, link and named bone-visibility presets
- Spawn actors and objects, or click a world handle to bring what is already there into the scene
- Borrow the map's own objects by reference and give them back untouched on release
- Save and restore the whole shot — actors, objects, lights, camera and environment — with load options
- Custom lights, camera control and a free camera; snapping, group pivot and group moves
- Gaze control and one-click expressions
- A pose library with tags, authors and search; import and export poses, and MCDF appearance files
- Time, weather and festival control
- On-screen dialogue panels, chat bubbles and status lines drawn with the game's own UI
- Reference pictures as floating, aspect-locked windows
- Twenty-five rebindable actions with Poser, Brio and Ktisis presets

This is a beta. It is not stable and it is not finished. Poser is derivative of Anamnesis, Ktisis and Brio, and those three are the mature tools.

Poser was coded with the use of artificial intelligence. The plugin says so on first launch and asks you to confirm before the workspace opens.
Description.Translated:
Poser 是用于 FINAL FANTASY XIV 的 group pose 的姿势与场景工具。

- 逐骨骼为角色摆姿势：叠加控制柄、图形化身体图以及数值变换
- 在任意有父级的骨骼上使用 IK，另有镜像、链接和命名的骨骼可见性预设
- 生成角色和物体，或点击世界控制柄将已经存在的对象带入场景
- 以引用方式借用地图自身的物体，并在释放时原样归还
- 保存并恢复整个镜头——角色、物体、灯光、相机和环境——并带有加载选项
- 自定义灯光、相机控制和自由相机；吸附、组枢轴和组移动
- 视线控制和一键表情
- 带标签、作者和搜索的姿势库；导入和导出姿势，以及 MCDF 外观文件
- 时间、天气和节日控制
- 使用游戏自身 UI 绘制的屏幕对白面板、聊天气泡和状态栏
- 作为浮动、锁定宽高比窗口的参考图片
- 二十五个可重新绑定的动作，带有 Poser、Brio 和 Ktisis 预设

这是一个 beta 版本。它不稳定，也尚未完成。Poser 衍生自 Anamnesis、Ktisis 和 Brio，而这三者是成熟工具。

Poser 在编码时使用了人工智能。插件会在首次启动时说明这一点，并在工作区打开前要求你确认。

Punchline.Original: Export your collections to FFXIV Collect.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的收藏导出到 FFXIV Collect。

Description.Original: Creates FFXIV Collect import data from your character's collections.
Description.Translated: 根据你角色的收藏创建 FFXIV Collect 导入数据。

Punchline.Original: AutoRetainer ventures plus built-in market board pinch
Punchline.Translated: AutoRetainer 雇员探险，外加内置市场板抓取

Description.Original: After AutoRetainer collects a venture and assigns a quick venture, Custom MB Plugin pinches that retainer's market listings (embedded Dagobert engine) before moving to the next retainer. Requires AutoRetainer Multi-Mode. Disable the separate Dagobert plugin. Slash command: /custommb (use '/custommb config' for settings)
Description.Translated: AutoRetainer 收取探险并指派快速探险后，Custom MB Plugin 会在前往下一个雇员前抓取该雇员的市场列表（内置 Dagobert 引擎）。需要 AutoRetainer 多模式。请禁用独立的 Dagobert 插件。斜杠命令：/custommb（使用 '/custommb config' 进行设置）

Punchline.Original: Manage a party-based Hot Potato dice game.
Punchline.Translated: 管理基于队伍的 Hot Potato 骰子游戏。

Description.Original: A Dalamud plugin for managing a party-based Hot Potato dice game. Tracks players, rounds, Hot Potato numbers, eliminations, turn order, and party announcements.
Description.Translated: 一个用于管理基于队伍的 Hot Potato 骰子游戏的 Dalamud 插件。跟踪玩家、轮次、Hot Potato 数字、淘汰、回合顺序和队伍公告。

Punchline.Original: Bind your own slash commands to your animation mods.
Punchline.Translated: 将自己的斜杠命令绑定到你的动画 mod。

Description.Original: Bind your own slash command to a Penumbra preset and a vanilla emote. Typing the command applies the mod options, redraws, and performs the emote - so your custom animation plays without opening Penumbra mid-scene. Other players see it through the sync service they already use.
Description.Translated: 将自己的斜杠命令绑定到 Penumbra 预设和游戏原生表情动作。输入命令即可应用 mod 选项、重绘并执行表情动作——这样你的自定义动画就能在场景中直接播放，而无需中途打开 Penumbra。其他玩家通过他们已在使用的同步服务看到该效果。

Punchline.Original: Lifetime hunt mark kill counter.
Punchline.Translated: 终生狩猎怪物击杀计数器。

Description.Original: Keeps a permanent, per-mark count of every hunt mark you get credit for killing, broken down by rank and expansion. Seeds pre-existing totals from your achievements, and keeps counting after the achievement is complete.
Description.Translated: 永久记录你每次获得击杀认定的狩猎怪物数量，按等级和资料片分类。会根据你的成就预填已有总数，并在成就完成后继续计数。

Punchline.Original: Show your Spotify track as an Honorific title.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的 Spotify 曲目显示为 Honorific 称号。

Description.Original: Shows your current Spotify track as an Honorific title, including local files, formatting, cleanup, styling, supporter effects, reliability handling, content filtering, saved profiles, portable settings, and optional combat auto-hide.
Description.Translated: 将你当前的 Spotify 曲目显示为 Honorific 称号，包括本地文件、格式化、清理、样式、支持者特效、可靠性处理、内容过滤、已保存配置、便携设置，以及可选的战斗时自动隐藏。

Punchline.Original: Dice, initiative and encounter tracking for in-game tabletop sessions.
Punchline.Translated: 用于游戏内跑团会话的骰子、先攻与遭遇追踪。

Description.Original:
Dice, initiative and encounter tracking for tabletop roleplay sessions run inside FFXIV.

This does nothing on its own. Everyone playing needs this plugin installed, and it needs a connection to a relay — one person hosts a session and admits the others individually with a code. There is nothing to try alone, and anyone without the plugin cannot take part.

Rolls are made in the plugin rather than by the game, so 4d6+2 works where /dice cannot. Campaign history is stored on the host's machine.
Description.Translated:
用于在 FFXIV 内进行的桌面角色扮演聚会的骰子、先攻与遭遇追踪。

该插件本身不执行任何功能。所有参与玩家都需要安装此插件，并且需要连接到中继——由一人主持聚会，并通过代码逐个允许其他人加入。无法独自试用，未安装该插件的人也无法参与。

掷骰由插件而非游戏执行，因此 /dice 无法处理的 4d6+2 也能使用。战役历史存储在主持人的机器上。

Punchline.Original: Venue profiles, VIP arrival alerts, and privacy-first shift reporting.
Punchline.Translated: 场地档案、VIP 到场提醒和隐私优先的轮班报告。

Description.Original: A privacy-first venue door and VIP management plugin for FFXIV. Includes venue-specific VIP and staff relationships, tier benefits, Add Target, right-click tools, native nameplate markers, UI packs, and anonymous aggregate shift reports.
Description.Translated: 一款面向 FFXIV 的隐私优先场地门禁与 VIP 管理插件。包含场地专属的 VIP 与员工关系、等级福利、Add Target、右键工具、原生名牌标记、UI 包以及匿名汇总轮班报告。

Punchline.Original: Put a browser window on a wall in your house.
Punchline.Translated: 把浏览器窗口放到你房屋的墙上。

Description.Original: Captures a browser or Discord window and draws it on a 16:9 screen in FFXIV housing. Use your own browser (uBlock, etc.). Open with /viewin.
Description.Translated: 捕获浏览器或 Discord 窗口，并将其绘制到 FFXIV 房屋内的 16:9 屏幕上。使用你自己的浏览器（uBlock 等）。通过 /viewin 打开。

Punchline.Original: Revisa Forsaken, Limit Cut y el timing de las acciones locales.
Punchline.Translated: 查看 Forsaken、Limit Cut 和本地动作的时机。

Description.Original: Midnight Timeline registra un timeline de acciones local ligero y proporciona evidencia retrospectiva de Forsaken y P3 Limit Cut en Dancing Mad.
Description.Translated: Midnight Timeline 记录轻量级的本地行动时间轴，并为 Dancing Mad 中的 Forsaken 和 P3 Limit Cut 提供回溯证据。

Punchline.Original: Empty your retainer without emptying your patience.
Punchline.Translated: 清空你的雇员，而不清空你的耐心。

Description.Original:
A panel that clips onto the retainer windows and does the fetching, stowing and pricing in bulk.

- Lists what is in the open retainer and what is in your own bags, with a search and a category filter
- Type an amount per item, or take everything the filters are showing, press OK, and the batch is carried across
- Works both ways: retrieve from the retainer, or stow into it
- Saved lists, either as an exact amount or as a 'top me up to N' target
- Build a list straight from a crafting recipe: pick the craft and the number of runs
- Put items up for sale undercutting the competition, with prices from universalis.app
- Reprice every listing of an item at once, which matters for things that can only be listed one at a time

You open the retainer yourself; the plugin never walks anywhere or clicks through NPC menus.

Every request is throttled and verified before the next is sent, and everything that changes game state goes through a single checked gateway: nothing is sent that the game's own interface would refuse. The first time you reprice or list something it changes one and stops, so you can confirm it took before the rest follows.
Description.Translated:
一个附着在雇员窗口上的面板，可批量取出、存入和定价。

- 列出已打开雇员中的物品和你自己背包中的物品，并带有搜索和分类筛选
- 为每件物品输入数量，或取出筛选器显示的所有物品，按 OK，整批物品就会被转移
- 双向可用：从雇员取出，或存入雇员
- 已保存列表，可以是精确数量，也可以是“补足到 N”的目标
- 直接根据制作配方构建列表：选择制作物品和制作次数
- 以低于竞争者的价格上架物品，价格来自 universalis.app
- 一次为某件物品的所有挂单重新定价，这对只能逐个上架的物品很重要

你自己打开雇员；插件绝不会自动走路或点击 NPC 菜单。

每个请求都会在下一次发送前被限流并验证，所有改变游戏状态的改动都会经过一个受检查的单一入口：游戏自身界面会拒绝的内容不会被发送。你第一次重新定价或上架某物时，它只会改动一个并停止，以便你确认它已生效后再继续其余操作。

Punchline.Original: Confirm before leaving Phantom Freelancer in Occult Crescent.
Punchline.Translated: 离开 Occult Crescent 中的 Phantom Freelancer 前确认。

Description.Original: Asks for confirmation before leaving Phantom Freelancer in Occult Crescent
Description.Translated: 在离开 Occult Crescent 中的 Phantom Freelancer 前请求确认

Punchline.Original: Turns D-Pad and face buttons into configurable turbo (auto-repeat) buttons.
Punchline.Translated: 将 D-Pad 和正面按键变为可配置的 turbo（自动重复）按键。

Description.Original: Lets you enable turbo (rapid-fire) behavior on the D-Pad and the four face buttons (North/South/West/East - Triangle/Cross/Square/Circle or Y/A/X/B) of your gamepad. While a turbo-enabled button is held, it pulses on/off at a per-button configurable press/release interval, so whatever action it's bound to in-game repeats automatically for as long as you hold it.
Description.Translated: 允许你在手柄的 D-Pad 和四个正面按键（北/南/西/东 - Triangle/Cross/Square/Circle 或 Y/A/X/B）上启用 turbo（连发）行为。按住已启用 turbo 的按键时，它会按每个按键可配置的按下/释放间隔开/关脉冲，因此只要按住，它在游戏内绑定的任何动作都会自动重复。

Punchline.Original: Colorize your macro chat text.
Punchline.Translated: 为你的宏聊天文本上色。

Description.Original: A private development plugin that recolors chat lines sent by your macros using <white>, <green>, <red>, <blue>, <yellow>, <purple>, <orange> and <#RRGGBB> tags. Coloring is local to your client. Use /prism to open the settings window.
Description.Translated: 一个私人开发插件，可使用 <white>、<green>、<red>、<blue>、<yellow>、<purple>、<orange> 和 <#RRGGBB> 标签为你的宏发送的聊天行重新着色。着色仅在本地客户端生效。使用 /prism 打开设置窗口。

Punchline.Original: Aモブハントツアーの探索・記録・MAP共有を補助します。
Punchline.Translated: 辅助 Aモブハントツアー 的探索、记录与地图共享。

Description.Original: Aモブハントツアーを補助するツール。漆黒・暁月・黄金のAモブ候補地点巡回、探索・討伐記録、MOBハント用リスト、MAPリンク共有に対応します。
Description.Translated: 辅助 Aモブハントツアー 的工具。支持暗影之逆焰、晓月之终途、黄金的遗产的 A怪候选地点巡回、探索与讨伐记录、怪物狩猎用列表、地图链接共享。

Punchline.Original: 2台のDalamudをLANで双方向接続する汎用ブリッジ
Punchline.Translated: 通过 LAN 双向连接两台 Dalamud 的通用网桥

Description.Original: 同じLAN内の2台のPC上のDalamud間で、任意メッセージを双方向送受信する汎用LANブリッジ。SND、ECHO、COMMAND、Dalamud IPCに対応。
Description.Translated: 在同一 LAN 内的两台 PC 上的 Dalamud 之间，双向收发任意消息的通用 LAN 网桥。支持 SND、ECHO、COMMAND、Dalamud IPC。

Punchline.Original: Discontinued - replaced by SpotifyTrackHonorific.
Punchline.Translated: 已停用 - 由 SpotifyTrackHonorific 取代。

Description.Original: Discontinued legacy DiscordActivityHonorific fork. Replaced by the standalone SpotifyTrackHonorific plugin.
Description.Translated: 已停用的旧版 DiscordActivityHonorific 分支。由独立插件 SpotifyTrackHonorific 取代。

Punchline.Original: Scan Free Companies on your PC, manage the list in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在 PC 上扫描部队，在游戏内管理列表。

Description.Original: Receives Free Company scan results from the FCGoblin desktop app and lists them in-game.
Description.Translated: 从 FCGoblin 桌面应用接收部队扫描结果，并在游戏内列出。

Punchline.Original: Show enemy spawn areas on the native map.
Punchline.Translated: 在原生地图上显示敌人出现区域。

Description.Original: Click an enemy name in the hunting log, relic book, or other enemy lists to show its spawn area on the map. Relic book FATE clicks are optional and show FATE spawn areas, including prerequisite chains. Hunting log: click the name, not the icon. /efind opens settings; /efind Name looks up an enemy.
Description.Translated: 在狩猎手册、古武书或其他敌人列表中点击敌人名称，即可在地图上显示其出现区域。古武书 FATE 点击为可选功能，会显示 FATE 出现区域，包括前置任务链。狩猎手册：点击名称，而非图标。/efind 打开设置；/efind Name 查询敌人。

Punchline.Original: Instance guides, current-boss mechanics and observed combat guidance.
Punchline.Translated: 副本攻略、当前 Boss 机制与观测到的战斗指引。

Description.Original: Automatic instance guides, concise boss mechanics and central combat alerts. Combines community sources with live observations, a 2D radar and a 3D overlay. Customizable layout and local AI model selection.
Description.Translated: 自动副本攻略、简明 Boss 机制与集中战斗提示。结合社区资料与实时观测、2D 雷达和 3D 悬浮窗。布局可自定义，并可选择本地 AI 模型。

Punchline.Original: DMU P4 assignment helper.
Punchline.Translated: DMU P4 分配助手。

Description.Original: DMU P4 assignment helper with manual and experimental automatic mechanic detection.
Description.Translated: DMU P4 分配助手，含手动与实验性的自动机制检测。

Punchline.Original: Hear an orchestrion roll before you go and earn it.
Punchline.Translated: 在你去获取管弦乐谱之前先听一听。

Description.Original: Preview any orchestrion roll before you go and earn it. Right-click a roll in your bags for a small player, or open the browser and search every track in the game — including the ones you do not own yet. The zone music steps aside while you listen and comes back when you stop.
Description.Translated: 在你去获取管弦乐谱之前先试听。在背包中右键点击乐谱可弹出一个小播放器，或打开浏览器搜索游戏中的每一首曲目——包括你尚未拥有的。试听时场景音乐会让位，停止后恢复。

Punchline.Original: A rotation coach that is trying to become unnecessary.
Punchline.Translated: 一个试图让自己变得多余的循环教练。

Description.Original: Learn your rotation instead of following a highlight. Start a practice run on a striking dummy and Miyagi walks you through the opener a button at a time, lighting up the next key on your own hotbar. Then it fades: it waits for you to hesitate, then only corrects you, then goes quiet and tells you afterwards what the run actually cost — uptime, casts you cancelled by moving, cooldowns you sat on. Black Mage at level 100.
Description.Translated: 学会你的循环，而不是跟着高亮走。在木人上开始一次练习，Miyagi 会一个按键一个按键地带你走开场，点亮你自己热键栏上的下一个键。然后它会淡出：等你犹豫时才出现，之后只做纠正，最后彻底安静，并在结束后告诉你这次练习实际付出了什么代价——输出时间、因移动而取消的施法、被你闲置的技能冷却。黑魔法师 100 级。

Punchline.Original: Shows what you're watching on Plex, in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内显示你正在 Plex 上观看的内容。

Description.Original: Polls your Plex Media Server and displays the currently playing movie or episode, with play state and progress, in your own nameplate and the server info bar. Sharing this with other players requires the separate Honorific plugin.
Description.Translated: 轮询你的 Plex Media Server，在你的名牌和服务器信息栏中显示正在播放的电影或剧集，含播放状态与进度。与其他玩家分享此信息需要另外安装 Honorific 插件。

Punchline.Original: Your duty diary - history, stats, loot and queue times in one window.
Punchline.Translated: 你的任务日记——历史、统计、战利品与排队时间尽在一窗。

Description.Original: Logs the duty instances you complete, plus rare loot, queue times, and roulette bonuses.
Description.Translated: 记录你完成的任务副本，以及稀有战利品、排队时间和随机任务奖励。

Punchline.Original: Community translations for Wrath Combo, as a separate plugin.
Punchline.Translated: Wrath Combo 的社区翻译，以独立插件形式提供。

Description.Original: Overlays translated strings onto Wrath Combo's UI without modifying Wrath Combo itself. Translations live in loose JSON files, so they can be edited and reloaded in-game.
Description.Translated: 将翻译后的字符串覆盖到 Wrath Combo 的 UI 上，而不修改 Wrath Combo 本身。翻译存放在独立的 JSON 文件中，因此可以在游戏内编辑并重新加载。

Punchline.Original: Text-to-speech callouts for boss abilities in duties and open-world encounters.
Punchline.Translated: 为副本和野外遭遇中的 Boss 技能提供文本转语音提示。

Description.Original:
Listens for dangerous enemy abiltiies and announces it via Text to Speech (TTS). Allows creation of custom warnings on a per ability basis

Commands:
/vcallouts - Toggles the main status window.
/vcallouts custom - Opens the Custom Warnings window to browse, filter, and edit your warnings.
/vcallouts newcustom - Quickly adds a warning for the most recently heard ability.
/vcallouts blacklistlast - Silences the most recently heard ability for good.
Description.Translated:
监听危险的敌人技能，并通过文本转语音（TTS）进行播报。可按技能单独创建自定义警告

命令：
/vcallouts - 切换主状态窗口。
/vcallouts custom - 打开自定义警告窗口，以浏览、筛选和编辑你的警告。
/vcallouts newcustom - 为最近听到的技能快速添加警告。
/vcallouts blacklistlast - 永久屏蔽最近听到的技能。

Punchline.Original: Track Deep Dungeons, including Pilgrim’s Traverse and duo estimates.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪深层迷宫，包括 Pilgrim’s Traverse 和双人预估。

Description.Original: Track solo and party runs, floor statistics, and score estimates. Independent community preview. Pilgrim’s Traverse scoring is provisional. Open settings with /ddtp.
Description.Translated: 追踪单人及组队挑战、楼层统计和分数预估。独立社区预览版。Pilgrim’s Traverse 计分仍为暂定。使用 /ddtp 打开设置。

Name.Translated: 深层迷宫追踪 — Pilgrim & Party

Punchline.Original: Multi-venue operations console.
Punchline.Translated: 多场馆运营控制台。

Description.Original: Venue-scoped operations, promotion, and backend-compatible venue games. Working modules: Attendance, Greeter, VIP, ShoutRunner, Party Finder, Mair's Trivia, Mair's Editor, Bingo, Raffle, Brackets, Block Letters, Giveaways, Macro, Shouts.
Description.Translated: 按场馆范围进行运营、宣传，以及兼容后端的场馆游戏。可用模块：Attendance、Greeter、VIP、ShoutRunner、Party Finder、Mair's Trivia、Mair's Editor、Bingo、Raffle、Brackets、Block Letters、Giveaways、Macro、Shouts。

Punchline.Original: Automatic friendly mouseover casting with no spell lists.
Punchline.Translated: 无需技能列表的自动指向友方施法。

Description.Original: Automatic friendly casting through native unit frames, with no spell lists or macros. Includes strict invalid-recipient protection, self-cast and bypass modifiers, useful cast history, checked recovery, and optional ground placement at hovered allies. Keeps your selected target and native action queue.
Description.Translated: 通过原生单位框体自动对友方施法，无需技能列表或宏。包含严格的无目标保护、自我施法与绕过修饰键、实用的施法历史、带校验的恢复，以及可选的以悬停队友为目标的放置类技能。保留你选中的目标和原生技能队列。

Punchline.Original: Browse FFXIV's wardrobe like a boutique.
Punchline.Translated: 像逛精品店一样浏览 FFXIV 的衣柜。

Description.Original: Browse FFXIV equipment like a boutique, preview items and dyes instantly, organize Favorites and Designs, use the Crystal Wardrobe, and view offline acquisition information.
Description.Translated: 像逛精品店一样浏览 FFXIV 装备，即时预览物品与染剂，整理收藏与设计，使用水晶衣柜，并查看离线获取信息。

Punchline.Original: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Punchline.Translated: 偏移、保存并重放姿势；自动发现 Penumbra 动画 mod。

Description.Original: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Description.Translated: 动画辅助插件，可偏移角色姿势，保存命名预设并重放，自动发现 Penumbra 姿势 mod，并与搭档手动重新同步情感动作时机。

Punchline.Original: Consent-based Owner/Sub control: outfit, title, gesture, and leash.
Punchline.Translated: 基于同意的 Owner/Sub 控制：服装、称号、手势与牵引绳。

Description.Original: A consent-based collar control plugin. Gameplay commands use ordinary in-game tells; relay-assisted pairing and encrypted catalog synchronization use the Oathbound Cloudflare service, while gameplay actions remain local to the Sub's client.
Description.Translated: 基于同意的项圈控制插件。玩法指令使用游戏内普通密语；中继辅助配对与加密目录同步使用 Oathbound Cloudflare 服务，而玩法操作仍保留在 Sub 的客户端本地。

Punchline.Original: What to flip right now.
Punchline.Translated: 现在该倒卖什么。

Description.Original: TSM-inspired FFXIV market flip ranker: auto-logged journal, Universalis-powered FlipScore, and a minimal price DSL. Read-only + user-clicks only.
Description.Translated: 受 TSM 启发的 FFXIV 市场倒卖排行：自动记录日志、由 Universalis 驱动的 FlipScore，以及极简价格 DSL。只读 + 仅用户点击。

Description.Original: Calculates crafting and gathering profit margins using live Universalis market data.
Description.Translated: 使用实时 Universalis 市场数据计算制作与采集的利润率。

Punchline.Original: A polished, temporary gear-set launcher.
Punchline.Translated: 一个精致的临时套装启动器。

Description.Original: Opens a compact native-icon launcher with R3, captures only its D-pad and action buttons while active, supports multiple exact gear sets per job, and keeps controller focus distinct from data-driven role hues.
Description.Translated: 用 R3 打开紧凑的原生图标启动器，激活时仅捕获其方向键与动作按钮，支持每个职业多个精确套装，并让手柄焦点与数据驱动的职能色相保持区分。

Punchline.Original: Keep your plugin installs in sync across all your systems.
Punchline.Translated: 让你的插件安装在所有系统中保持同步。

Description.Original: Have you ever logged in on another machine and realized half your plugins are missing? PluginSync compares the plugins installed on this machine with the plugin list you synced from your other setup, shows exactly what's missing (and what's extra), and lets you install the missing ones with one click — including plugins from third-party repos, which are added automatically (AutoDuty-style). Sync your plugin list via a local file, any raw-text URL, or catbox.moe (no account needed).
Description.Translated: 你是否曾在另一台机器上登录，然后发现一半插件都不见了？PluginSync 会将本机已安装的插件与你从其他配置同步的插件列表进行比较，准确显示缺少哪些（以及多出哪些），并让你一键安装缺少的插件——包括来自第三方仓库的插件，这些仓库会自动添加（AutoDuty 风格）。可通过本地文件、任意 raw-text URL 或 catbox.moe（无需账户）同步插件列表。

Punchline.Original: Standalone S-rank travel, parking, tagging, and recovery.
Punchline.Translated: 独立的 S-rank 移动、停放、标记和恢复。

Description.Original: Consumes HuntAlerts and Sonar S-rank reports, travels safely through normal World Visit and vnavmesh, retries missing entities and routes without false-clearing, requires positive kill evidence, queues later hunts, and performs one gated ranged tag.
Description.Translated: 会消费 HuntAlerts 和 Sonar 的 S-rank 报告，通过正常的 World Visit 和 vnavmesh 安全移动，在不会误清除的情况下重试缺失实体和路线，要求有明确的击杀证据，将后续狩猎加入队列，并执行一次受控的远程标记。

Punchline.Original: A clean, safety-first S-rank hunting beta.
Punchline.Translated: 一个简洁、安全优先的 S-rank 狩猎 beta。

Description.Original: Independent Sentinel hunt plugin with Sonar and HuntAlerts intake, expansion filters, a persistent FIFO queue, Ul'dah world travel through Lifestream, vnavmesh flight and protected 25-yalm parking, WAR Tomahawk tagging at 95% HP, incidental-aggro handling, and death recovery. Automation is off by default; direct Faloop input is planned.
Description.Translated: 独立的 Sentinel 狩猎插件，支持 Sonar 和 HuntAlerts 输入、资料片过滤、持久 FIFO 队列、通过 Lifestream 的 Ul'dah 世界旅行、vnavmesh 飞行和受保护的 25 yalm 停放、在 95% HP 时用 WAR Tomahawk 标记、意外仇恨处理以及死亡恢复。自动化默认关闭；计划支持直接 Faloop 输入。

Punchline.Original: Automatically strips a character's gear to Smallclothes or the Emperor's Set when a specified emote or action is used.
Punchline.Translated: 当使用指定表情或动作时，自动将角色装备更换为 Smallclothes 或 Emperor's Set。

Description.Original: Automatically changes a character's gear via Glamourer to Smallclothes or the Emperor's New Set when specified emotes or combat actions are used, with per-slot control, delay, and duration options, then reverts back to normal gear.
Description.Translated: 当使用指定表情或战斗动作时，通过 Glamourer 自动将角色装备更换为 Smallclothes 或 The Emperor's New Set，并支持按部位控制、延迟和持续时间选项，随后恢复为正常装备。

Punchline.Original: Temporary groups for locked instances!
Punchline.Translated: 用于锁定副本的临时队伍！

Description.Original: Create a temporary chats for you and your friends, that are working inside a duty or locked instances. Add how many people u want, and manage it from there.
Description.Translated: 为你和你的朋友创建临时聊天，可在任务或锁定副本内使用。添加你想要的人数，并在那里进行管理。

Punchline.Original: Automation utilities for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 自动化实用工具

Description.Original: Quality of life automation features including auto Priority Aetheryte Pass usage (/passauto) and auto-cancel Jog buff after Sprint expires (/nojog).
Description.Translated: 便利性自动化功能，包括自动使用优先以太药通行证（/passauto）以及在疾跑结束后自动取消慢跑增益（/nojog）。

Punchline.Original: Highlights the items and gear you no longer need.
Punchline.Translated: 高亮你不再需要的物品和装备。

Description.Original: Paste Teamcraft's inventory-cleanup list and Cratools fades the inventory slots you need to keep, so the removable items stand out. The armory cleanup scan marks gear no class you play can wear, or that you already own something better than, and tints it in the Armoury Chest. Read-only: it never moves or discards anything.
Description.Translated: 粘贴 Teamcraft 的背包清理列表，Cratools 会让需要保留的背包格变淡，使可移除的物品更加醒目。军械库清理扫描会标记没有你所玩职业能穿戴的装备，或你已拥有更好替代品的装备，并在军械库中为其着色。只读：它绝不会移动或丢弃任何物品。

Punchline.Original: Soft Safety Lock to prevent accidental in-game interactions
Punchline.Translated: 软安全锁，防止游戏内误操作

Description.Original: Blocks vendor windows, duty finder interactions, and quest acceptance dialogs when enabled. Use /safetylock to toggle. Features enable-on-startup and individual feature toggles.
Description.Translated: 启用后阻止商人窗口、任务搜索器交互以及任务接受对话框。使用 /safetylock 切换。具备启动时启用和各项功能独立开关。

Punchline.Original: Drive FFXIV from a Stream Deck.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Stream Deck 操控 FFXIV。

Description.Original: Exposes a local API that a companion Elgato Stream Deck plugin talks to. Provides auto-populated browsers for every emote, mount and minion you own, plus live status readouts on deck keys. Open /ttd for a link to download that companion plugin.
Description.Translated: 暴露一个本地 API，供配套的 Elgato Stream Deck 插件通信。为每个你拥有的情感动作、坐骑和宠物提供自动填充的浏览器，并在 Deck 按键上显示实时状态。打开 /ttd 获取该配套插件的下载链接。

Punchline.Original: Change 3rd person camera angle depending on camera zoom.
Punchline.Translated: 根据镜头缩放改变第三人称镜头角度。

Description.Original:
Change the 3rd person camera angle character config setting depending how zoomed in you are.
Zoom out, and you will be able to see more of the world. Zoom in, the camera will be focused on your character.
Description.Translated:
根据你的缩放程度改变第三人称镜头角度角色设置。
拉远时，你能看到更多世界。拉近时，镜头会聚焦在你的角色上。

Punchline.Original: Parece que va a llover.
Punchline.Translated: 看起来要下雨了。

Description.Original: It just a LunoBox
Description.Translated: 只是一个 LunoBox

Punchline.Original: The next Aetherphone, before everyone else.
Punchline.Translated: 下一代 Aetherphone，抢先所有人体验。

Description.Original: The beta channel for Aetherphone: builds straight off the development branch, installed side by side with the stable plugin so you can test what is coming next without giving up the phone you use every day.
Description.Translated: Aetherphone 的测试版频道：直接基于开发分支构建，与稳定版插件并排安装，让你在不放弃日常所用手机的情况下测试即将推出的内容。

Punchline.Original: Create and track personalized timers in FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 中创建并追踪个性化计时器。

Description.Original: Create persistent manual and game-linked countdown timers with configurable alerts, snooze controls, and an in-game overlay.
Description.Translated: 创建可持久保存的手动计时器和与游戏关联的倒计时，支持可配置提醒、稍后提醒控制和游戏内悬浮窗。

Punchline.Original: Clears out your junk and puts the rest away.
Punchline.Translated: 清理你的垃圾，并把其余物品收纳好。

Description.Original:
Gleam finds the junk in your bags, armoury chest, saddlebag, retainers and glamour dresser, and clears it out with one button. You choose whether it puts things up on the market board, sells them to vendors or discards them.

- Shows you everything first. Nothing leaves your bags until you press Clean.
- Layouts put the rest away, such as materia to the saddlebag and spare gear to a retainer.
- Hands-free trips walk to your retainers, the dresser and a merchant for you.
- Statistics show everything it has cleared.

Commands

/gleam
    Opens or closes Gleam. /gl does the same.
/gleam organize
    Opens the layouts that put things away.
/gleam stats
    Shows your statistics.
/gleam history
    Lists everything Gleam has cleaned or moved.
/gleam settings
    Opens the settings.
/gleam scan
    Looks through your inventory again.
/gleam merge
    Merges split stacks.
/gleam stop
    Stops whatever Gleam is doing.
/gleam selftest
    Checks what Gleam can find in the game without touching anything.
/gleam report
    Copies a bug report to your clipboard.
/gleam troubleshoot
    Opens the troubleshooting window.

Requires vnavmesh, and Lifestream to travel between towns. Gleam automates game actions, so use it at your own risk.
Description.Translated:
Gleam 会找出你背包、兵装库、陆行鸟鞍囊、雇员和幻化柜中的垃圾，并一键清理。你可以选择是把物品挂到市场布告板、卖给商人还是直接丢弃。

- 先向你展示所有内容。在你按下 Clean 之前，不会有任何东西离开你的背包。
- 布局会把其余物品收纳好，例如把魔晶石放进陆行鸟鞍囊，把备用装备交给雇员。
- 免手动行程会替你走到雇员、幻化柜和商人处。
- 统计信息会显示它清理过的所有内容。

命令

/gleam
    打开或关闭 Gleam。/gl 作用相同。
/gleam organize
    打开用于收纳物品的布局。
/gleam stats
    显示你的统计信息。
/gleam history
    列出 Gleam 清理或移动过的所有内容。
/gleam settings
    打开设置。
/gleam scan
    再次扫描你的物品栏。
/gleam merge
    合并拆分的堆叠。
/gleam stop
    停止 Gleam 正在执行的操作。
/gleam selftest
    检查 Gleam 能在游戏中找到什么，但不会触碰任何内容。
/gleam report
    将错误报告复制到剪贴板。
/gleam troubleshoot
    打开疑难解答窗口。

需要 vnavmesh，以及用于在城镇间移动的 Lifestream。Gleam 会自动执行游戏操作，因此使用时请自行承担风险。

Punchline.Original: Quietly updates old Penumbra mods to Dawntrail when you import them.
Punchline.Translated: 在你导入旧 Penumbra mod 时，静默将其更新到 Dawntrail。

Description.Original:
Updates mods made before Dawntrail (7.0) the same way TexTools does, without TexTools. Requires Penumbra.

- Import a mod in Penumbra as usual: if it was made before Dawntrail, its models, materials and textures are updated in the background and Penumbra reloads it. Nothing to click.
- Scan your whole Penumbra library, see which mods are pre-Dawntrail, and update them all at once.
- Convert a .pmp or .ttmp2 file: the updated copy is saved next to it as "(Dawntrail).pmp" and imported into Penumbra.

Mods that already work in Dawntrail are never touched. Files are changed in place and no backup is kept.

Commands: /dtready (window), /dtready scan, /dtready convert <file>

The conversion is ported from TexTools' xivModdingFramework. Dawntrail Ready is free software under the GPL-3.0, like TexTools.
Description.Translated:
以与 TexTools 相同的方式更新在 Dawntrail (7.0) 之前制作的 mod，无需 TexTools。需要 Penumbra。

- 像往常一样在 Penumbra 中导入 mod：如果它是在 Dawntrail 之前制作的，其模型、材质和纹理会在后台更新，并由 Penumbra 重新加载。无需点击任何内容。
- 扫描你的整个 Penumbra 库，查看哪些 mod 是 Dawntrail 之前的，并一次性全部更新。
- 转换 .pmp 或 .ttmp2 文件：更新后的副本会以 "(Dawntrail).pmp" 保存到其旁边，并导入到 Penumbra。

已在 Dawntrail 中可用的 mod 绝不会被触碰。文件会原地修改，且不会保留备份。

命令：/dtready（窗口）、/dtready scan、/dtready convert <file>

该转换移植自 TexTools 的 xivModdingFramework。Dawntrail Ready 是遵循 GPL-3.0 的自由软件，与 TexTools 一样。

Punchline.Original: Tracks equipment spiritbond growth during duties.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪任务中装备精炼度的增长。

Description.Original: Tracks equipment spiritbond increases during duties, groups them by instance, and monitors active spiritbond buffs. Use /spiritbond to open the menu.
Description.Translated: 追踪任务中装备精炼度的增长，按副本分组，并监控激活的精炼度增益。使用 /spiritbond 打开菜单。

Punchline.Original: Roleplay chat assistance powered by AI.
Punchline.Translated: 由 AI 驱动的角色扮演聊天辅助。

Description.Original:
AIRoleplay helps draft in-character game chat replies using recent chat context and a configurable character prompt.

Commands:
/airp - Open AIRoleplay.
/airp [message] - Generate in the selected mode.
/airp r [name] [instruction] - Switch to reply assist and draft a reply.
/airp status - Show the current mode and auto response settings.
/airp help - Show this command list.
Description.Translated:
AIRoleplay 使用最近的聊天上下文和可配置的角色提示词，帮助起草符合角色设定的游戏聊天回复。

命令：
/airp - 打开 AIRoleplay。
/airp [message] - 在所选模式下生成。
/airp r [name] [instruction] - 切换到回复辅助并起草回复。
/airp status - 显示当前模式和自动回复设置。
/airp help - 显示此命令列表。

Punchline.Original: 妖怪武器の取得状況とレジェンドメダル対象地域を一覧表示します。
Punchline.Translated: 一览显示妖怪武器获取状况与传说徽章目标地区。

Description.Original: 妖怪ウォッチコラボの全17武器について、取得済みチェックを保存し、対応する妖怪レジェンドメダルが入手できるF.A.T.E.地域を表示します。
Description.Translated: 针对妖怪手表联动的全部 17 种武器，保存已获取勾选，并显示可获得对应妖怪传说徽章的 F.A.T.E. 地区。

Punchline.Original: Your media. Your friends. One screen. Watch together anywhere in Eorzea.
Punchline.Translated: 你的媒体。你的朋友。一块屏幕。在艾欧泽亚任何地方一起观看。

Description.Original: Synchronized local, web, Plex, and live screen-sharing watch parties for FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 适用于 FFXIV 的同步本地、网页、Plex 与实时屏幕共享观影派对。

Punchline.Original: Walk or run depending on how far you press.
Punchline.Translated: 根据按键按下的幅度行走或奔跑。

Description.Original: Analog movement for keyboards with analog keys (Wooting, Razer Analog, DrunkDeer, NuPhy, Keychron HE and others). Press a movement key lightly to walk, fully to run.
Description.Translated: 为带有模拟键轴（Wooting、Razer Analog、DrunkDeer、NuPhy、Keychron HE 等）的键盘提供模拟移动。轻按移动键行走，完全按下奔跑。

Punchline.Original: Correctly places your character's feet on the ground in real time.
Punchline.Translated: 实时让角色的双脚正确贴地。

Description.Original: Real-time inverse kinematics for your character. Bends the legs against the game's world so the feet rest on slopes and steps instead of clipping through or floating, lean into slopes while running, and many other features.
Description.Translated: 为你的角色提供实时反向运动学。让双腿根据游戏世界弯曲，使双脚贴合斜坡和台阶，而不是穿模或悬空；奔跑时身体向斜坡倾斜，以及许多其他功能。

Punchline.Original: A personal collection of quality of life tweaks.
Punchline.Translated: 个人收藏的一系列便利性调整。

Description.Original: Small quality of life tweaks, each one individually toggleable. Configured through a native game window.
Description.Translated: 小型便利性调整，每项均可单独开关。通过原生游戏窗口进行配置。

Punchline.Original: Play your own voicelines when you use an action.
Punchline.Translated: 使用技能时播放你自己的语音。

Description.Original: Plays user-supplied audio clips in 3D space when you use actions. Clips are mapped per action and per character voice type from an in-game editor.
Description.Translated: 当你使用技能时，在 3D 空间中播放用户提供的音频片段。可通过游戏内编辑器按技能和角色语音类型映射片段。

Punchline.Original: Watch a Kosmi room together, in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内一起观看 Kosmi 房间。

Description.Original:
Puts a Kosmi room on a screen inside FFXIV, joining as a real Kosmi guest via a
sandboxed out-of-process browser, so playback stays perfectly synced with the rest of the room.

Commands:
/wa - toggle the main viewer/control window
/wa view - open the main window
/wa join <kosmi url or WA1: invite> - join a room, or accept an invite (with confirmation)
/wa settings - open Settings (identity, volume/mute, join/leave, invite, screen placement)
/wa invite - copy a shareable invite for your current room and screen
/wa sync <WA1P: message> - apply a shared screen position (with confirmation)
/wa place - open the screen placement window
/wa depth - toggle quad vs. depth-tested screen rendering
/wa vol <0-150> - set volume
/wa mute - toggle mute
/wa snapshot - save a debug screenshot + DOM outline
Description.Translated:
将 Kosmi 房间放到 FFXIV 内的屏幕上，并通过
沙盒化的进程外浏览器以真实 Kosmi 访客身份加入，因此播放可与房间内其他成员保持完美同步。

命令：
/wa - 切换主查看器/控制窗口
/wa view - 打开主窗口
/wa join <kosmi url or WA1: invite> - 加入房间，或接受邀请（带确认）
/wa settings - 打开设置（身份、音量/静音、加入/离开、邀请、屏幕放置）
/wa invite - 复制当前房间和屏幕的可分享邀请
/wa sync <WA1P: message> - 应用共享屏幕位置（带确认）
/wa place - 打开屏幕放置窗口
/wa depth - 在四边形渲染与深度测试屏幕渲染之间切换
/wa vol <0-150> - 设置音量
/wa mute - 切换静音
/wa snapshot - 保存调试截图 + DOM 轮廓

Punchline.Original: Reacts to emotes performed on you with a temporary Glamourer design and Moodle.
Punchline.Translated: 对你执行的情感动作做出反应，应用临时的 Glamourer 设计和 Moodle。

Description.Original: Listens for emotes targeted at you and applies a configured Glamourer design and Moodles status in response, automatically reverting the Glamourer design after a set duration.
Description.Translated: 监听以你为目标的情感动作，并作为回应应用配置好的 Glamourer 设计和 Moodles 状态，在设定时长后自动还原 Glamourer 设计。

Punchline.Original: Shift search comment and online status by zone, activity, and schedule.
Punchline.Translated: 按区域、活动和日程切换搜索留言与在线状态。

Description.Original: Rules change your search comment, online status, and optional commands from zone, duty, activity, job, world, and schedule.
Description.Translated: 规则可根据区域、任务、活动、职业、服务器和日程更改搜索留言、在线状态及可选命令。

Punchline.Original: Browse the Eorzean mod archive without leaving the game.
Punchline.Translated: 无需离开游戏即可浏览艾欧泽亚的模组档案库。

Description.Original: A polished, provider-based in-game catalog for discovering Final Fantasy XIV mods.
Description.Translated: 一个精致的、基于提供者的游戏内目录，用于发现 Final Fantasy XIV 模组。

Punchline.Original: FFXIV connection diagnostics with ping history and endpoint detection.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 连接诊断，提供延迟历史与端点检测。

Description.Original: A local FFXIV network diagnostics plugin. It monitors a configured or detected endpoint, stores session history, provides manual route testing, and can experimentally detect the active game endpoint.
Description.Translated: 一个本地 FFXIV 网络诊断插件。它监控已配置或已检测的端点，存储会话历史，提供手动路由测试，并可实验性地检测当前游戏端点。

Punchline.Original: Formes, bordures, taille précise et disposition de vos dix barres d'actions.
Punchline.Translated: 十条动作栏的形状、边框、精确尺寸与布局。

Description.Original: 12 formes, 15 bordures réglables, zoom des illustrations, taille précise et disposition libre. Presets, édition groupée, profils par job ou personnage, visibilité contextuelle et partage avec aperçu. Fenêtre fermée au chargement ; application automatique optionnelle. Version expérimentale à valider en jeu. /hotbaratelier pour les réglages ; /hotbaratelier off pour restaurer. Version expérimentale ; essais en jeu encore à confirmer.
Description.Translated: 12 种形状、15 种可调边框、插图缩放、精确尺寸与自由布局。预设、批量编辑、按职业或角色的配置档案、情境可见性，以及带预览的分享。加载时窗口关闭；可选自动应用。实验性版本，仍需在游戏中验证。/hotbaratelier 打开设置；/hotbaratelier off 恢复。实验性版本；游戏内测试仍待确认。

Punchline.Original: Vos tâches Codex, directement dans FF14.
Punchline.Translated: 你的 Codex 任务，直接在 FF14 中。

Description.Original: Affiche les tâches Codex du PC, leurs états et les demandes d'intervention. Nécessite le relais local Codex Monitor. Version expérimentale ; essais en jeu encore à confirmer. Node.js 22.22.2 minimum et Codex sont nécessaires ; le quota utilise le CLI Codex connecté. Aucune relance nécessaire avec le relais 0.11.0 déjà actif. Si votre relais est plus ancien, relancez le relais intégré depuis Réglages → Connexion ; un relais externe se met à jour et se relance depuis son dossier.
Description.Translated: 显示 PC 上的 Codex 任务、其状态和介入请求。需要本地中继 Codex Monitor。实验性版本；游戏内测试仍待确认。至少需要 Node.js 22.22.2 和 Codex；配额使用已连接的 Codex CLI。若已运行 0.11.0 中继则无需重启。如果你的中继更早，请从 设置 → 连接 重启内置中继；外部中继需在其文件夹中更新并重启。

Punchline.Original: Voir plus loin sur la mini-carte native.
Punchline.Translated: 在原生小地图上看得更远。

Description.Original: Mini-carte carrée, zoom réglable, profils par zone et raccourci de dézoom temporaire. Fond, cadre, éléments du HUD et marqueurs personnalisables. Réglages dans /minizoom. Client 2026.09.01.0000.0000. Icône, masque et cadres créés avec l’aide de Codex. Version expérimentale ; essais en jeu encore à confirmer.
Description.Translated: 方形小地图、可调缩放、按区域配置文件以及临时缩小快捷键。背景、边框、HUD 元素和标记均可自定义。设置位于 /minizoom。客户端 2026.09.01.0000.0000。图标、遮罩和边框在 Codex 的帮助下创建。实验性版本；游戏内测试仍有待确认。

Punchline.Original: Tag, flag, filter, then preview items for your glamours.
Punchline.Translated: 为幻化物品添加标签、标记、筛选，然后预览。

Description.Original:
Designed to help you tag, flag, organize and filter items effortlessly to preview them, bridging the gap between massive item databases and style creation. 

- Create custom tags, manage those tags, flag items between 5 different categories 
- Filter them by your tags, flags and other attributes 
- Preview them one by one or cycle through them on your character or in the fitting room 

Prerequisites for preview on character: Glamourer
Description.Translated:
旨在帮助你轻松地给物品添加标签、标记、整理和筛选以进行预览，弥合海量物品数据库与风格创作之间的差距。

- 创建自定义标签、管理这些标签、在 5 种不同类别之间标记物品
- 按你的标签、标记和其他属性筛选
- 逐个预览，或在你的角色身上或试衣间中循环浏览

在角色上预览的前提条件：Glamourer

Punchline.Original: Customize quest objective text and popup layout.
Punchline.Translated: 自定义任务目标文本和弹窗布局。

Description.Original: Customize FFXIV's center-screen quest objective popup with custom text colors, font size, position, scale, presets, and optional Penumbra-based textures.
Description.Translated: 使用自定义文本颜色、字体大小、位置、缩放、预设以及可选的基于 Penumbra 的纹理来自定义 FFXIV 屏幕中央的任务目标弹窗。

Punchline.Original: How much MSQ is left, and how long it will actually take you.
Punchline.Translated: 还剩多少主线任务，以及实际需要多长时间。

Description.Original: Tracks your Main Scenario progress per character and estimates the time to the end of the current expansion and to the end of the MSQ, based on how fast you have been clearing quests.
Description.Translated: 按角色追踪你的主线剧情进度，并根据你完成任务的快慢，估算到达当前资料片结尾和主线剧情结尾所需的时间。

Punchline.Original: Controls ReShade shaders based on what's going on in game
Punchline.Translated: 根据游戏中的情况控制 ReShade 着色器

Description.Original: Dynamic ReShade presets that react to what's happening in game — time of day, weather, location and more — through a visual node Animator, plus per-zone, cutscene and duty presets. Requires ReShade with the reshade_controller addon in the game folder.
Description.Translated: 动态 ReShade 预设会通过可视化节点 Animator 对游戏中的情况（一天中的时间、天气、地点等）做出反应，并提供按区域、过场动画和任务的预设。需要在游戏文件夹中安装带有 reshade_controller 插件的 ReShade。

Punchline.Original: Tracks /random rolls for private round games.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪用于私人回合游戏的 /random 掷骰。

Description.Original:
Reads chat messages, detects /random rolls, tracks Truth or Dare rounds, and provides configurable !truth, !dare, !help, !tod2, and !wifi helpers.

Commands:
/rt - open or close the window.
/rt help - show the full command and trigger list locally.
Description.Translated:
读取聊天消息，检测 /random 掷骰，追踪 Truth or Dare 回合，并提供可配置的 !truth、!dare、!help、!tod2 和 !wifi 辅助功能。

命令：
/rt - 打开或关闭窗口。
/rt help - 在本地显示完整的命令和触发词列表。

Punchline.Original: Sync emotes like never before!
Punchline.Translated: 以前所未有的方式同步情感动作！

Description.Original: Syncs emotes by using the chat itself, read Usage tab!
Description.Translated: 通过聊天本身同步情感动作，请阅读 Usage 标签页！

Punchline.Original: Click where you wanna go!
Punchline.Translated: 点击你想去的地方！

Description.Original: Click where you wanna go!
Description.Translated: 点击你想去的地方！

Punchline.Original: A collection of gamba games for dealers
Punchline.Translated: 为庄家准备的 gamba 游戏合集

Description.Original: A plugin for dealers to provide gamba games without relying on /dice. Type /drgames to start
Description.Translated: 供庄家使用的插件，无需依赖 /dice 即可提供 gamba 游戏。输入 /drgames 开始

Punchline.Original: Right-click any in-game item to view it on FFXIV Console Games Wiki.
Punchline.Translated: 右键点击任意游戏内物品，即可在 FFXIV Console Games Wiki 上查看。

Description.Original: Adds a 'See in Wiki' entry to the context menu of items in your inventory, armory chest, chat links, and more. Clicking it opens the item's page on consolegameswiki directly in your default browser.
Description.Translated: 为背包、兵装库、聊天链接等处的物品右键菜单添加“See in Wiki”选项。点击后会直接在默认浏览器中打开该物品在 consolegameswiki 上的页面。

Punchline.Original: Active beta for explainable Frontline group-following and MCH decisions.
Punchline.Translated: 可解释的 Frontline 跟团与 MCH 决策的活跃 beta。

Description.Original: Active-beta Frontline plugin with fail-closed player classification, friendly-force clustering, stable target and group commitment, vnavmesh navigation integration, an opt-in MCH combat controller, and detailed diagnostics.
Description.Translated: 活跃 beta 的 Frontline 插件，具备 fail-closed 玩家分类、友军聚类、稳定的目标与团队承诺、vnavmesh 导航集成、可选加入的 MCH 战斗控制器，以及详细诊断。

Punchline.Original: Reliable, manual three-state switching for installed Dalamud plugins.
Punchline.Translated: 为已安装的 Dalamud 插件提供可靠的手动三态切换。

Description.Original: Create named profiles from the live installed-plugin list, assign literal Enable, Leave Alone, or Disable rules, apply them on demand with disable-first ordering and per-plugin verification, and detect drift without continuously enforcing state.
Description.Translated: 从实时已安装插件列表创建命名配置文件，分配确切的 Enable、Leave Alone 或 Disable 规则，按需应用它们，并采用先禁用排序和逐插件验证，同时检测漂移而无需持续强制执行状态。

Punchline.Original: Keeps your fishing bait and lures stocked, on its own.
Punchline.Translated: 自行保持你的钓鱼鱼饵和拟饵库存充足。

Description.Original:
Reads your GatherBuddy Reborn auto-gather list, works out which fishing bait and lures those fish need, and compares that against your inventory.

It shows what is missing, where to buy it and what it costs. It travels to the vendors on its own with vnavmesh and Lifestream, restocks at gil shops and scrip exchanges, plans a route across several vendors, rides to the Cosmic Exploration planets, and can fill the rest at the market board within a price per item and a total per run that you set.

Opens with /masterbaiter or the shorter /mbait.

Requires GatherBuddy Reborn, vnavmesh and Lifestream.
Description.Translated:
读取你的 GatherBuddy Reborn 自动采集列表，算出那些鱼需要哪些钓鱼鱼饵和拟饵，并将其与你的库存进行对比。

它会显示缺少什么、在哪里购买以及花费多少。它会借助 vnavmesh 和 Lifestream 自行前往商人处，在 gil 商店和票据兑换处补货，规划跨多个商人的路线，骑乘前往 Cosmic Exploration 星球，并且可以在你设置的每件价格和每次运行总价范围内，在市场布告板补齐剩余部分。

使用 /masterbaiter 或更短的 /mbait 打开。

需要 GatherBuddy Reborn、vnavmesh 和 Lifestream。

Punchline.Original: Inject custom boss modules into BossModReborn at runtime
Punchline.Translated: 在运行时向 BossModReborn 注入自定义 Boss 模块

Description.Original: Dynamically injects external boss modules into BossModReborn at runtime without modifying the base plugin.
Description.Translated: 在运行时动态将外部 Boss 模块注入 BossModReborn，而无需修改基础插件。

Punchline.Original: A TV on your house wall.
Punchline.Translated: 你房屋墙上的电视。

Description.Original:
Put a TV on your house wall playing video from YouTube, Twitch or Kick.

Everyone announces their own TV and you pick which one to watch. Whoever tunes in sees the screen on the wall the owner chose, at the size they set.
Description.Translated:
把电视放在你的房屋墙上，播放来自 YouTube、Twitch 或 Kick 的视频。

每个人都会公告自己的电视，你选择要看哪一个。任何收看的人都会看到房主所选墙上的屏幕，尺寸也由房主设定。

Punchline.Original: Because clicking it yourself was clearly out of the question.
Punchline.Translated: 因为显然，自己动手点一下是不可能的。

Description.Original:
Congratulations, you have installed a plugin whose entire purpose is to press buttons in Penumbra so that you do not have to. A proud day.

How it works, since you were going to ask: it watches your character - weapon drawn, sat down, mounted, swimming, loitering within eight yalms of someone you tolerate - and flips mod settings to match. You can stack conditions, because naturally one was never going to be enough. "Weapon drawn AND near a friend AND not in combat" is, apparently, a thing you needed. It works. Nobody is asking questions.

It also puts every setting back afterwards, so your mod list survives contact with your own decisions. You are welcome.

Not liable for redraws at dramatically inconvenient moments, or for the dawning realisation that your character now has better situational awareness than you do.
Description.Translated:
恭喜，你安装了一个唯一目的就是在 Penumbra 里替你按按钮的插件。值得骄傲的一天。

既然你肯定会问，那就说说原理：它会监视你的角色——拔出武器、坐下、骑乘、游泳、在你能容忍的人八 yalms 范围内闲逛——并相应地切换 mod 设置。你可以叠加条件，毕竟一个条件自然永远不够。「拔出武器 且 靠近好友 且 不在战斗中」显然是你需要的东西。它能用。没人提问。

它还会在之后把每项设置都恢复原样，所以你的 mod 列表能挺过你自己的决定。不客气。

不对在极其不方便的时刻重绘，或对你逐渐意识到自己的角色如今比你有更好的态势感知负责。

Punchline.Original: What you up to? See where opted-in friends are and what they are doing.
Punchline.Translated: 你在忙什么？查看已选择加入的好友在哪里、在做什么。

Description.Original:
Wyu2 - "what you up to?" - shows friends who opted in on a radar, on the zone map, and in a live activity list: which zone and public instance they are in, which duty they are running, which job they are playing, and whether they are fighting, gathering, crafting, queueing or just idling in Limsa.

Nobody appears until they opt in. You swap share codes, both sides accept, and even then nothing leaves your machine until you turn sharing on and tick the fields you want to send. Each update is encrypted separately for each recipient, so a relay only ever moves blobs it cannot read. Point it at your own relay - one ships with the source - and delete your account whenever you like.

Commands: /wyu2 for the friend list, /wyu2 radar, /wyu2 map, /wyu2 config, /wyu2 share on|off, /wyu2 pause [minutes], /wyu2 note <text>.
Description.Translated:
Wyu2 ——「what you up to?」——在雷达、区域地图和实时活动列表上显示已选择加入的好友：他们身处哪个区域和公共实例、在跑哪个副本、在玩哪个职业，以及他们是在战斗、采集、制作、排队，还是只是在 Limsa 发呆。

在对方选择加入之前，没有人会显示出来。你们交换共享码，双方都接受，即便如此，在你打开共享并勾选想要发送的字段之前，什么都不会离开你的机器。每次更新都会为每个接收者单独加密，所以中继服务器搬运的只是它读不懂的数据块。把它指向你自己的中继——源码中附带一个——并且随时可以删除你的账号。

命令：/wyu2 打开好友列表，/wyu2 radar，/wyu2 map，/wyu2 config，/wyu2 share on|off，/wyu2 pause [minutes]，/wyu2 note <text>。

Punchline.Original: Real-time combat damage/healing meter for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 实时战斗伤害/治疗统计表。

Description.Original: Tracks damage dealt, healing done, DPS, HPS, overhealing, damage taken, and more in real time for you and your party. Stores up to 20 recent combat sessions with manual save slots. Fully configurable display, bar colors, and window styles.
Description.Translated: 为玩家和队伍实时追踪造成的伤害、完成的治疗、DPS、HPS、过量治疗、承受伤害等数据。可保存最近 20 场战斗记录，并提供手动存档位。显示内容、条状颜色和窗口样式均可完全自定义。

Punchline.Original: Build custom raid notes and button-driven callouts.
Punchline.Translated: 构建自定义 raid 笔记与按钮驱动的提示。

Description.Original: Make free-form canvases with buttons, icons, and instruction panels. EchoCanvas is entirely manual and never plays the game for you.
Description.Translated: 用按钮、图标和指示面板制作自由布局的画布。EchoCanvas 完全手动，绝不会替你玩游戏。

Punchline.Original: Resize your FFXIV window beyond your display resolution.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的 FFXIV 窗口尺寸调整到超过显示器分辨率。

Description.Original: WindowResize+ sets the FFXIV game window to an arbitrary size beyond your display resolution. It is useful for high-resolution screenshots without going fullscreen and requires borderless or windowed mode.
Description.Translated: WindowResize+ 可将 FFXIV 游戏窗口设置为超过显示器分辨率的任意尺寸。它适合在不进入全屏的情况下拍摄高分辨率截图，需要无边框或窗口模式。

Punchline.Original: Turns eating food into a waist-scaling meter.
Punchline.Translated: 将进食变成腰部缩放计量条。

Description.Original: Drives Customize+ waist scale from your Well Fed food buff. Starts at a configurable Baseline, decays toward a configurable Minimum over time, and jumps up toward a configurable Maximum every time you eat. Displayed as a small chicken-leg HUD gauge. Fully configurable in-game via a settings window. Requires Customize+. Local only: nobody else sees it.
Description.Translated: 根据你的 Well Fed 食物增益驱动 Customize+ 腰部缩放。从可配置的 Baseline 开始，随时间衰减至可配置的 Minimum，每次进食则向可配置的 Maximum 跃升。以小鸡腿 HUD 计量条显示。可通过设置窗口在游戏内完全配置。需要 Customize+。仅本地：其他人看不到。

Punchline.Original: Plays an emote when you open the map or a crafting/gathering/fishing log.
Punchline.Translated: 打开地图或制作/采集/钓鱼日志时播放表情动作。

Description.Original: Automatically triggers /navigate when you open the world or zone map, and /read when you open the Crafting, Gathering, or Fishing Log. /navigate and /read can interrupt each other, but neither restarts its own animation on a quick reopen.
Description.Translated: 打开世界地图或区域地图时自动触发 /navigate，打开制作、采集或钓鱼日志时自动触发 /read。/navigate 和 /read 可以互相打断，但快速重新打开时两者都不会重启自身的动画。

Description.Original: Submarine and airship tracker: every FC vessel this client has seen, out/returned counts on the server info bar, EXP and rank-up calculator, route suggestions that respect rank, range, fuel and unlocks (must-include + progression), one-click route entry into the in-game planner, loot history, supply warnings and a part optimizer. Companion to Daedalus.
Description.Translated: 潜水艇与飞空艇追踪器：此客户端见过的每艘部队船只、服务器信息栏上的外出/返回计数、EXP 与升阶计算器、遵守等级、航程、燃料与解锁条件的路线建议（必须包含 + 进阶）、一键将路线填入游戏内规划器、战利品历史、补给警告以及部件优化器。Daedalus 的配套插件。

Description.Original: AAA-tier custom scrolling combat text and WeakAuras-style trackers.
Description.Translated: AAA 级自定义滚动战斗文字与 WeakAuras 风格追踪器。

Punchline.Original: Type less, alias more.
Punchline.Translated: 少打字，多别名。

Description.Original: Lets you set up your own command aliases in the chat box - type a short alias and have it silently rewritten into a different command before it's sent. Includes an "Alt Mode" for aliases that need to be resent through the chat box rather than injected directly, and lets you reorder the list with up/down arrows.
Description.Translated: 让你在聊天框中设置自己的命令别名——输入一个简短别名，它会在发送前被静默改写为另一条命令。包含 "Alt Mode"，用于需要经由聊天框重新发送而非直接注入的别名，并允许用上下箭头重新排列列表。

Punchline.Original: Ever wanted to see some useless info for no reason?
Punchline.Translated: 曾经想无缘无故看些无用信息吗？

Description.Original: A simple program that shows some useless info on your character's jobs and location info. More coming soon most likely.
Description.Translated: 一个简单程序，会显示你角色职业和位置信息的一些无用信息。很可能很快会加入更多内容。

Punchline.Original: You deal, it does the rest.
Punchline.Translated: 你发牌，其余交给它。

Description.Original:
Runs the boring half of dealing blackjack at a venue.

It watches the cards, adds everything up, and tells you who won and what you owe them. Bets stick around between rounds, so no more retyping the same numbers all night.

Regulars can leave their gil with you instead of trading every hand. And when the night's done, the payout tab sorts out the split, whether you're playing off your own gil or the venue's.

Blackjack engine borrowed from Infi's DeathRoll Helper (https://github.com/Infiziert90/DeathRoll). 

/blackjack — open the window, /blackjack config — open settings, /blackjack on | off — start or stop watching rolls
Description.Translated:
负责在场馆发二十一点时无聊的那一半。

它看着牌，计算所有点数，并告诉你谁赢了以及你欠他们多少。赌注会在轮次之间保留，所以不用整晚重复输入相同的数字。

常客可以把他们的 gil 留在你这里，而不用每手都交易。当夜晚结束时，赔付标签页会算好分成，无论你是用自己的 gil 还是场馆的 gil 来玩。

二十一点引擎借用自 Infi 的 DeathRoll Helper (https://github.com/Infiziert90/DeathRoll)。 

/blackjack — 打开窗口，/blackjack config — 打开设置，/blackjack on | off — 开始或停止监视掷骰

Punchline.Original: Automatic roulette run history with a SQLite database
Punchline.Translated: 使用 SQLite 数据库自动记录随机任务历史

Description.Original: A Dalamud (FFXIV Quick Launcher) plugin that records every roullete run (entry, exit, duration, party, role, status) to a SQLite database, with a filterable, sortable history window that can be exported to CSV. non roulette runs are not logged
Description.Translated: 一个 Dalamud（FFXIV Quick Launcher）插件，将每次随机任务运行（进入、退出、时长、队伍、职能、状态）记录到 SQLite 数据库，并带有可筛选、可排序且可导出为 CSV 的历史窗口。非随机任务运行不会被记录
