Punchline.Original: Hold skill to cast for controller!
Punchline.Translated: 手柄按住技能即可施法！

Description.Original: Allows holding buttons from the cross hotbar (D-Pad + ABXY) to repeatedly attempt to cast on a configurable interval.
Description.Translated: 允许按住十字热键栏（D-Pad + ABXY）上的按钮，以可配置的间隔重复尝试施法。

Punchline.Original: Find your next capture.
Punchline.Translated: 找到你的下一个抓捕目标。

Description.Original: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Description.Translated: 点击 Bestiary 条目以找到其抓捕地点或副本。高亮附近未抓捕的野兽，并可选地使用 Lifestream 和 vnavmesh 前往它们。/bnav 打开 Bestiary；/bnav config 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Your loading screens, your way!
Punchline.Translated: 你的加载画面，由你决定！

Description.Original: Replaces loading screen imagery with custom defined images.
Description.Translated: 用自定义图片替换加载画面图像。

Punchline.Original: Pairs with Xhani BiS Tracker and uploads gear snapshots (read-only).
Punchline.Translated: 与 Xhani BiS Tracker 配对并上传装备快照（只读）。

Description.Original: Read-only companion for Xhani BiS Tracker. Pairs with your account, then scans your own character's equipped gear, Armory Chest, and inventory and uploads snapshots so the web app can track BiS progress. Syncs automatically on login, job change, and inventory change (debounced), or on demand via /xbis sync. Never reads other players' data, never automates gameplay, and never writes anything back to the game.
Description.Translated: Xhani BiS Tracker 的只读伴侣插件。与你的账号配对后，扫描你自己角色的已装备物品、兵装库和背包并上传快照，以便网页应用追踪 BiS 进度。在登录、切换职业和背包变动（防抖）时自动同步，也可通过 /xbis sync 手动同步。绝不读取其他玩家的数据，绝不自动化游戏操作，也绝不向游戏写入任何内容。

Punchline.Original: Runs the Bassment Pizza Challenge: watches /random, calls the rounds, keeps the queue.
Punchline.Translated: 主持 Bassment Pizza Challenge：监听 /random，报出轮次，维护队列。

Description.Original: In-game referee for the Pizza Challenge. Announces each round, judges every /random against the threshold, moves through each player's pies and the queue, and keeps the night's stats and Hall of Fame. Made for the Bassment; announces in chat on your behalf, so it lives in this custom repository rather than the official list.
Description.Translated: Pizza Challenge 的游戏内裁判。播报每一轮，根据阈值判定每次 /random，依次推进每位玩家的派与队列，并记录当晚的统计数据和名人堂。为 Bassment 制作；会代表你在聊天中播报，因此它位于此自定义仓库而非官方列表。

Punchline.Original: Crafting helper for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 的制作助手。

Description.Original: CielCraft is a crafting plugin for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description.Translated: CielCraft 是 Final Fantasy XIV 的制作插件。

Punchline.Original: BossMod Reborn auf Deutsch
Punchline.Translated: BossMod Reborn 德语版

Description.Original: Translates the BossMod Reborn user interface into German at runtime. Does not modify the BossMod Reborn plugin itself: all strings are swapped in memory and restored when this plugin is unloaded.
Description.Translated: 在运行时将 BossMod Reborn 的用户界面翻译为德语。不会修改 BossMod Reborn 插件本身：所有字符串均在内存中替换，并在卸载此插件时还原。

Punchline.Original: Transforms Lalafells into other races.
Punchline.Translated: 将拉拉肥转换成其他种族。

Description.Original: Tired of ankle-biters? This client-side visual filter swaps Lalafell models for a grown-up race of your choice without touching game servers. Features robust /mash configurations and a right-click in-game whitelist with blazing-fast, targeted character refreshing to instantly exclude specific players without screen flicker. Requires Penumbra.
Description.Translated: 厌倦了咬脚踝的小家伙？这个客户端视觉过滤会把拉拉肥模型替换成你选择的成年种族，不会触碰游戏服务器。具备强大的 /mash 配置以及游戏内右键白名单，配合极快的定向角色刷新，可立即排除特定玩家且不会造成画面闪烁。需要 Penumbra。

Punchline.Original: Connects the game to the XIVLauncher Android app.
Punchline.Translated: 将游戏与 XIVLauncher Android 应用连接。

Description.Original: Ships with XIVLauncher Android. Shows the device's battery in the server info bar, and lets the app raise the Android keyboard when the game asks for text. Does nothing when the game is not running under XIVLauncher Android.
Description.Translated: 随 XIVLauncher Android 一同提供。在服务器信息栏显示设备电量，并可在游戏请求文本输入时让应用唤起 Android 键盘。当游戏不是在 XIVLauncher Android 下运行时不起任何作用。

Punchline.Original: Swap the game's music for your own songs, right in game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏中直接把游戏的音乐换成你自己的歌曲。

Description.Original:
Make a music mod in a minute, without leaving the game. Requires Penumbra.

- Pick any of the game's songs from the list (names come from Orchestrion's song list), or press Replace on what is playing now.
- Drop in your own song: MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A, AAC, MP4, WMA and more. Soundswap converts it the way the game stores music, matches its volume to the song it replaces and sets up the loop.
- Layered songs (the ones the game fades between during a fight) get a choice per layer: your song, silence, or the game's own layer.
- Build & install puts the mod in Penumbra and switches it on; with Orchestrion installed, Play in game plays it straight away. Or export a .pmp to share.

Commands: /soundswap
Description.Translated:
一分钟内做好音乐模组，无需离开游戏。需要 Penumbra。

- 从列表中选择任意游戏歌曲（名称来自 Orchestrion 的歌曲列表），或对当前正在播放的歌曲按下 Replace。
- 放入你自己的歌曲：MP3、WAV、OGG、FLAC、M4A、AAC、MP4、WMA 等。Soundswap 会按游戏存储音乐的方式转换它，将其音量匹配到被替换的歌曲并设置循环。
- 分层歌曲（战斗中游戏会在各层之间淡入淡出的那些）可逐层选择：你的歌曲、静音，或游戏自带的层。
- Build & install 会把模组放入 Penumbra 并启用；安装了 Orchestrion 后，Play in game 可直接播放。或者导出 .pmp 用于分享。

命令：/soundswap

Punchline.Original: Shows a Hello World window.
Punchline.Translated: 显示一个 Hello World 窗口。

Description.Original: A minimal Dalamud plugin that opens a window saying "Hello World" - a starting point for future plugins. Toggle with /helloworld.
Description.Translated: 一个极简的 Dalamud 插件，会打开一个显示“Hello World”的窗口——作为未来插件的起点。使用 /helloworld 切换。

Punchline.Original: Prints a chat message when a friend logs in.
Punchline.Translated: 好友上线时输出聊天消息。

Description.Original: Monitors the FFXIV friends list and prints a chat notification when a friend changes from offline to online after the list updates.
Description.Translated: 监控 FFXIV 好友列表，并在列表更新后好友从离线变为在线时输出聊天通知。

Punchline.Original: Standalone hunt scouting, private-group sync, spawn windows and live mark tracking.
Punchline.Translated: 独立狩猎侦察、私人群组同步、刷新窗口与实时标记追踪。

Description.Original: Standalone hunt tracking for FFXIV: scout and share trains, track S/A-rank windows, map possible S-rank spawn points, view live marks and pool trigger-mob kills with a private group. Includes native train reports, lifetime hunt tallies and optional Lifestream travel.
Description.Translated: 独立的 FFXIV 狩猎追踪：侦察并分享狩猎车，追踪 S/A 级刷新窗口，在地图上标出可能的 S 级刷新点，查看实时标记，并与私人群组汇集触发怪击杀数。包含原生狩猎车报告、生涯狩猎统计以及可选的 Lifestream 传送。

Punchline.Original: In-game view of your XIVMit mitigation plan.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内查看你的 XIVMit 减伤计划。

Description.Original: Loads a plan from xivmit.app and shows your upcoming mitigations on a live fight clock. Starts automatically on combat and stays synced from boss casts and phase transitions. Use /xivmit to open.
Description.Translated: 从 xivmit.app 加载计划，并在实时战斗计时器上显示即将使用的减伤。进入战斗时自动启动，并根据 Boss 读条和阶段转换保持同步。使用 /xivmit 打开。

Punchline.Original: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Punchline.Translated: PvP 提示、Smart Tab、响应辅助与生存工具。

Description.Original: A local PvP HUD with Death Recap, a personal CC match diary, job/mode display profiles, a HUD editor, pressure history, repeated MP reminders and crystal end-time alerts. Includes searchable CC player rankings and prediction, nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Description.Translated: 一个本地 PvP HUD，包含 Death Recap、个人 CC 对局日记、职业/模式显示配置、HUD 编辑器、压力历史、重复 MP 提醒和水晶结束时间警报。包含可搜索的 CC 玩家排名与预测、名牌提示、Limit Break 警报、Ping Helpers、medicine-kit 信标、范围环、Wolves' Den 地图面板、恢复与职业助手、Smart Tab、协助宏、MP 音效和目标高亮。

Punchline.Original: Редактор HUD: привязки, группы, свойства и обмен раскладками.
Punchline.Translated: HUD 编辑器：吸附、分组、属性与布局分享。

Description.Original: Редактируйте HUD прямо в игре: сетка, привязки, групповое перемещение, масштаб, форма панелей и включение элементов. Импорт и экспорт раскладки строкой. Команда /hudworkshop. Поддерживается только Dalamud 15.0.3.4 (API 15).
Description.Translated: 直接在游戏中编辑 HUD：网格、吸附、组移动、缩放、面板形状和元素启用。通过字符串导入和导出布局。命令 /hudworkshop。仅支持 Dalamud 15.0.3.4 (API 15)。

Punchline.Original: Adds row probabilities to the Wondrous Tails display.
Punchline.Translated: 为 Wondrous Tails 显示添加行概率。

Description.Original: This plugin prints the probability of getting a row in Wondrous Tails to the in-game display along with the average probability of what would happen if you shuffled.
Description.Translated: 此插件会将 Wondrous Tails 中连成一行的概率，以及重抽时的平均概率，打印到游戏内显示中。

Punchline.Original: Sightseeing vistas, logged for you.
Punchline.Translated: 观光景点，替你记录。

Description.Original: Fills in your Sightseeing Log for you: tick the vistas you want, and the plugin travels to each one, waits for its hour and weather, performs the emote the log asks for, and moves on until every vista is logged.
Description.Translated: 替你填写 Sightseeing Log：勾选你想要的景点，插件会前往每个景点，等待对应的时间和天气，执行笔记要求的情感动作，然后继续，直到所有景点都被记录。

Punchline.Original: Introduction and full-plugin installation guidance.
Punchline.Translated: 简介与完整插件安装指南。

Description.Original: Open /dnav for an introduction. Get the full plugin through Discord and install it with Aethertek Plugin Manager (APM).
Description.Translated: 打开 /dnav 查看简介。通过 Discord 获取完整插件，并使用 Aethertek Plugin Manager (APM) 安装。

Punchline.Original: A pearl in your pocket.
Punchline.Translated: 口袋里的明珠。

Description.Original: An in-game communicator for FINAL FANTASY XIV: a docked, always-on handset with a home screen, notifications, and themeable wallpapers.
Description.Translated: FINAL FANTASY XIV 的游戏内通讯器：一个停靠式、常开的手持终端，带有主屏幕、通知和可更换主题的壁纸。

Punchline.Original: Bingo host relay and client management.
Punchline.Translated: Bingo 主控中继与客户端管理。

Description.Original: Host relay plugin for multi-card bingo.
Description.Translated: 用于多卡 Bingo 的主控中继插件。

Description.Original: FFXIV Plugin for Running Raffles with a Wheel of Names Backend
Description.Translated: 用于配合 Wheel of Names 后端进行抽奖的 FFXIV 插件

Punchline.Original: Send your FFXIV collections to Codex Olympia. / Envoie tes collections vers Codex Olympia.
Punchline.Translated: 将你的 FFXIV 收藏发送到 Codex Olympia。 / 将你的收藏发送到 Codex Olympia。

Description.Original:
Reads what your character has unlocked in-game, collections, outfits and armoire included, shows it to you, and sends it to Codex Olympia when you ask. Nothing is sent without your action (or your standing consent, with automatic sync turned on), and nothing is ever unchecked on your behalf: gaps are reported in the app, where you decide. Also prints a chat notice when an outfit piece lands in your bags. Exclusive to the Codex Olympia website (https://codex-olympia.com/): without an account on the app, this plugin is useless.

Lit ce que ton personnage a debloque dans le jeu, tenues et armoire comprises, te le montre, et l'envoie a Codex Olympia quand tu le demandes. Rien n'est envoye sans ton geste (ou sans ton accord donne une fois pour toutes, avec la synchro automatique), et rien n'est jamais decoche a ta place : les ecarts sont rapportes dans l'application, et c'est toi qui tranches. Previent aussi dans le journal quand une piece de tenue arrive dans tes sacs. Exclusif au site Codex Olympia : sans compte sur l'application, il ne sert a rien.
Description.Translated:
读取你的角色在游戏内已解锁的内容，包括收藏、套装与装备库，向你展示，并在你请求时发送到 Codex Olympia。未经你的操作（或开启自动同步后的一次性授权），不会发送任何内容，也绝不会替你取消勾选：差异会在应用中报告，由你决定。当有套装部件进入你的背包时，还会在聊天栏提示。仅限 Codex Olympia 网站（https://codex-olympia.com/）：若没有该应用上的账号，本插件毫无用处。

读取你的角色在游戏内已解锁的内容，包括套装和装备库，展示给你，并在你要求时发送到 Codex Olympia。未经你的操作（或一次授权后开启自动同步），不会发送任何内容，也绝不会替你取消勾选：差异会在应用中报告，由你来决断。当有套装部件进入你的背包时，也会在日志中提示。仅限 Codex Olympia 网站：若没有该应用上的账号，它毫无用处。

Punchline.Original: Track self-imposed miscellaneous challenges
Punchline.Translated: 追踪自行设定的各类挑战

Description.Original: A tracker for miscellaneous self-imposed FFXIV challenges across combat, exploration, gathering, crafting and social play. Challenges complete themselves when their conditions are met - walk a route, emote at a spot, ride a particular mount somewhere, or wear a full outfit in a given zone - and a popup celebrates each one. Progress is kept per install with the date you finished each challenge, and a separate permanent record means a reset is always recoverable. Includes a suggestion button for sending ideas straight to the developer. Commands: /tchallenges, /tchal
Description.Translated: 用于追踪 FFXIV 中自行设定的战斗、探索、采集、制作与社交等各类挑战。达成条件后挑战会自动完成——走完一条路线、在某个地点做情感动作、骑特定坐骑到某处，或在指定区域穿齐整套装备——每次完成都会有弹窗庆祝。进度按安装保存，并记录完成每个挑战的日期，另有独立的永久记录，因此重置后始终可以恢复。包含建议按钮，可直接向开发者发送想法。命令：/tchallenges、/tchal

Punchline.Original: Range tes tenues dans la coiffeuse tout seul. EXPERIMENTAL. Par Codex Olympia.
Punchline.Translated: 自动将你的幻化服装存入幻象衣柜。EXPERIMENTAL。作者 Codex Olympia。

Description.Original: Compare tes sacs, ton arsenal et tes servants a ta coiffeuse, liste ce qui reste a deposer, et le range pour toi en suivant exactement les fenetres du jeu. EXPERIMENTAL, en cours de developpement : rien ne se lance sans un geste de ta part, et tout s'arrete au premier imprevu.
Description.Translated: 将你的背包、军械库和雇员与幻象衣柜进行比对，列出仍未存入的物品，并严格按照游戏窗口为你存放。EXPERIMENTAL，开发中：没有你的操作不会启动任何流程，出现任何意外都会立即停止。

Punchline.Original: Perd des combats du Choc des mascottes pour toi. / Loses Lord of Verminion matches for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你输掉 Lord of Verminion 对战。 / Loses Lord of Verminion matches for you.

Description.Original:
Enchaine les combats contre un maitre du Choc des mascottes sans les jouer : inscription, confirmation, on regarde l'ordinateur gagner, on quitte, on recommence, jusqu'au nombre voulu. Une defaite compte pour le carnet de defis de la semaine, c'est tout l'interet. Rien ne se lance sans ton geste, et Arreter coupe tout. Par Codex Olympia.

Chains Lord of Verminion Master Battles without playing them: queue, confirm, watch the AI win, leave, repeat, up to the number you set. A loss still counts for the weekly challenge log, which is the whole point. Nothing starts without you, and Stop ends everything. By Codex Olympia.
Description.Translated:
连续进行与 Lord of Verminion 大师的对战而不亲自操作：排队、确认、看着电脑获胜、离开、重复，直到达到设定次数。失败同样计入每周挑战手账，这正是目的所在。没有你的操作不会启动任何流程，点击 Stop 即可全部停止。作者 Codex Olympia。

Chains Lord of Verminion Master Battles without playing them: queue, confirm, watch the AI win, leave, repeat, up to the number you set. A loss still counts for the weekly challenge log, which is the whole point. Nothing starts without you, and Stop ends everything. By Codex Olympia.

Punchline.Original: 固定攻略向けのタイムラインメモ/軽減計画ツール
Punchline.Translated: 固定队向时间轴备忘/减伤规划工具

Description.Original: タイムライン作成、PTスロット別の軽減割り当て、ギミックメモのオーバーレイ表示、FFLogs URLからの下書き生成、.radflowのエクスポート/合成ができます。
Description.Translated: 可以创建时间轴、按小队位置分配减伤、以悬浮窗显示机制备忘、根据 FFLogs URL 生成草稿、导出/合并 .radflow。

Description.Original: Show server id for eureka instances
Description.Translated: 显示 Eureka 实例的服务器 ID

Punchline.Original: 专注于钓鱼。【不包含 24 小时全自动】/ Focus on fishing. [Excludes 24h auto]
Punchline.Translated: 专注于钓鱼。【不包含 24 小时全自动】/ 专注于钓鱼。[不包含 24 小时全自动]

Description.Original:
准备好启动：能帮你钓鱼王，还能自动出海垂钓、做空岛成就、完成一些宇宙探索任务。
Ready to go: Supports Big Fish, Ocean Fishing, Diadem farming, and automates certain Stellar Missions in Cosmic Exploration.
Description.Translated:
准备好启动：能帮你钓鱼王，还能自动出海垂钓、做空岛成就、完成一些宇宙探索任务。
准备好启动：支持 Big Fish、Ocean Fishing、Diadem 采集，并能自动完成 Cosmic Exploration 中的某些 Stellar Missions。

Punchline.Original: Your message in any language. Bidirectional chat translation focused on active communication.
Punchline.Translated: 你的消息可用任意语言。专注于主动交流的双向聊天翻译。

Description.Original: Automatically translates outgoing and incoming chat messages. Supports Google Translate, Papago, LibreTranslate, Yandex, and Local AI with configurable fallback, automatic primary recovery, and optional romanized output. No API Key required.
Description.Translated: 自动翻译发送和接收的聊天消息。支持 Google Translate、Papago、LibreTranslate、Yandex 和 Local AI，可配置回退、自动恢复主服务，并可选择罗马化输出。无需 API Key。
